	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{

	}

	private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		string text = null;
		if (allowCustomizedStrings)
		{
			text = ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
		}
		if (text == null)
		{

			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			text = sR.GetString(name, culture);

			{

			}
		}

		{
			try
			{
				text = string.Format(null, text, args);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)

[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
internal sealed class LocalizedCategoryAttribute : CategoryAttribute
{
	public LocalizedCategoryAttribute(string category)
		: base(category)
	{
	}

	protected override string GetLocalizedString(string value)
	{
		return SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, value);
	}
}
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
{
	private bool loaded;

	public override string Description
	{
		get
		{
			if (!loaded)
			{
				loaded = true;
				base.DescriptionValue = SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, base.Description);
			}
			return base.Description;
		}
	}

	public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
		: base(description)
	{
	}
}
internal sealed class InternalDynamicResourceString : DynamicResourceString
{
	internal InternalDynamicResourceString(ResourceCustomizer customizer, CultureInfo cultureInfo, string resourceName, object[] args)
		: base(customizer, cultureInfo, resourceName, args)
	{
	}

	protected override string GetStringFromResource(string resourceName, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		return SR.GetString(culture, resourceName, null);
	}
}

				if (g_Location == null)

			get
			{
				if (g_XamRibbonScreenTip == null)
				{
					g_XamRibbonScreenTip = ResourceSet.GetSealedResource(ResourcesInternal, typeof(XamRibbonScreenTip)) as Style;
				}
				return g_XamRibbonScreenTip;
			}
		}

	public class RibbonAssemblyResourceSetLoader : AssemblyResourceSetLoader
	{
		protected override void OnRegisterResourceSets(string groupingName)
		{
			if (groupingName == "Ribbon" || groupingName == null)
			{
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonGeneric.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonOnyx.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonAero.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonRoyale.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonRoyaleStrong.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonLunaNormal.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonLunaOlive.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonLunaSilver.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonOffice2k7Blue.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonOffice2k7Black.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonOffice2k7Silver.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonScenic.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonOffice2010Blue.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonOffice2013.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonIGTheme.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonMetro.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonMetroDark.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonRoyalDark.Locator>.Location);
				AssemblyResourceSetLoader.RegisterResourceSet(RibbonResourceSet<RibbonRoyalLight.Locator>.Location);
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Windows.Automation.Peers.Ribbon
{
	public class ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer : ItemsControlAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider, ISelectionProvider
	{
		private class ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer : ItemAutomationPeer, ISelectionItemProvider
		{
			private ApplicationMenu2010 Menu => base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer.Owner as ApplicationMenu2010;

			bool ISelectionItemProvider.IsSelected
			{
				get
				{
					ApplicationMenu2010 menu = Menu;
					return menu.SelectedTabItem == base.Item;
				}
			}

			IRawElementProviderSimple ISelectionItemProvider.SelectionContainer => ProviderFromPeer(base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer);

			public ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer(object item, ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer itemsControlAutomationPeer)
				: base(item, itemsControlAutomationPeer)
			{
			}

			protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
			{
				DependencyObject wrapper = GetWrapper();
				if (wrapper is ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item)
				{
					if (applicationMenu2010Item.ItemType == ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button)
					{
						return AutomationControlType.MenuItem;
					}
					return AutomationControlType.TabItem;
				}
				if (wrapper is Separator)
				{
					return AutomationControlType.Separator;
				}
				return AutomationControlType.MenuItem;
			}

			protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = ((ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer)base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer).Owner as ApplicationMenu2010;
				applicationMenu?.ApplyTemplate();
				List<AutomationPeer> list = base.GetChildrenCore();
				if (applicationMenu != null && applicationMenu.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(base.Item) is ApplicationMenu2010Item { IsSelectedTab: not false })
				{
					ContentPresenter selectedTabContentHost = applicationMenu.SelectedTabContentHost;
					if (selectedTabContentHost != null)
					{
						List<AutomationPeer> children = new FrameworkElementAutomationPeer(selectedTabContentHost).GetChildren();
						if (children != null)
						{
							if (list == null)
							{
								list = children;
							}
							else
							{
								list.AddRange(children);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			protected override string GetClassNameCore()
			{
				return "ApplicationMenu2010Item";
			}

			internal DependencyObject GetWrapper()
			{
				ItemsControl itemsControl = base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer.Owner as ItemsControl;
				return itemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(base.Item);
			}

			private void SelectItem(bool isAddToSelection)
			{
				VerifyEnabled();
				ApplicationMenu2010 menu = Menu;
				ApplicationMenu2010Item tabItem = GetWrapper() as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
				if (menu.SelectedTab != base.Item)
				{
					if (isAddToSelection && menu.SelectedTab != null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					menu.SelectThisTab(tabItem);
				}
			}

			protected void VerifyEnabled()
			{
				if (!IsEnabled())
				{
					throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
				}
			}

			void ISelectionItemProvider.AddToSelection()
			{
				SelectItem(isAddToSelection: true);
			}

			void ISelectionItemProvider.RemoveFromSelection()
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}

			void ISelectionItemProvider.Select()
			{
				SelectItem(isAddToSelection: false);
			}
		}

		private static readonly MethodInfo _findItemPeerMethod;

		ExpandCollapseState IExpandCollapseProvider.ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (((ApplicationMenu2010)base.Owner).IsOpen)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		bool ISelectionProvider.CanSelectMultiple => false;

		bool ISelectionProvider.IsSelectionRequired => true;

		static ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer()
		{
			_findItemPeerMethod = typeof(ItemsControlAutomationPeer).GetMethod("FindOrCreateItemAutomationPeer", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
		}

		public ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer(ApplicationMenu2010 owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override ItemAutomationPeer CreateItemAutomationPeer(object item)
		{
			return new ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer(item, this);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Menu;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "ApplicationMenu2010";
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			string text = base.GetNameCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = ((ApplicationMenu2010)base.Owner).Caption;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		private ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer GetItemPeer(ApplicationMenu2010Item container)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer applicationMenu2010ItemPeer = null;
			if (_findItemPeerMethod != null)
			{
				object obj = ((ItemsControl)base.Owner).ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(container);
				try
				{
					applicationMenu2010ItemPeer = _findItemPeerMethod.Invoke(this, new object[1] { obj }) as ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (applicationMenu2010ItemPeer == null)
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(container);
				if (automationPeer != null)
				{
					applicationMenu2010ItemPeer = automationPeer.EventsSource as ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer;
				}
			}
			return applicationMenu2010ItemPeer;
		}

		internal void RaiseExpandCollapseStateChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.PropertyChanged))
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, oldValue ? ExpandCollapseState.Expanded : ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed, newValue ? ExpandCollapseState.Expanded : ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseSelectionEvents(ApplicationMenu2010Item oldContainer, ApplicationMenu2010Item newContainer)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = base.Owner as ApplicationMenu2010;
			ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer itemPeer = GetItemPeer(oldContainer);
			ApplicationMenu2010ItemPeer itemPeer2 = GetItemPeer(newContainer);
			if (itemPeer2 != null)
			{
				itemPeer2.RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementSelected);
				itemPeer2.RaisePropertyChangedEvent(SelectionItemPatternIdentifiers.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			if (itemPeer != null)
			{
				if (itemPeer2 == null)
				{
					itemPeer.RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementRemovedFromSelection);
				}
				itemPeer.RaisePropertyChangedEvent(SelectionItemPatternIdentifiers.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
			if (itemPeer2 == null && itemPeer == null)
			{
				RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.SelectionPatternOnInvalidated);
			}
		}

		protected void VerifyEnabled()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()
		{
			VerifyEnabled();
			((ApplicationMenu2010)base.Owner).Close();
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Expand()
		{
			VerifyEnabled();
			((ApplicationMenu2010)base.Owner).Show();
		}

		IRawElementProviderSimple[] ISelectionProvider.GetSelection()
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = base.Owner as ApplicationMenu2010;
			ApplicationMenu2010Item selectedTab = applicationMenu.SelectedTab;
			if (selectedTab != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer itemPeer = GetItemPeer(selectedTab);
				if (itemPeer != null)
				{
					return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { ProviderFromPeer(itemPeer) };
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class GalleryToolDropDownPresenterAutomationPeer : ItemsControlAutomationPeer, ISelectionProvider
	{
		private Hashtable _itemPeers = new Hashtable();

		bool ISelectionProvider.CanSelectMultiple => false;

		bool ISelectionProvider.IsSelectionRequired => false;

		public GalleryToolDropDownPresenterAutomationPeer(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "GalleryToolDropDownPresenter";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Selection)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override ItemAutomationPeer CreateItemAutomationPeer(object item)
		{
			if (item is GalleryItem)
			{
				GalleryItemAutomationPeer galleryItemAutomationPeer = new GalleryItemAutomationPeer(item as GalleryItem, this);
				_itemPeers[item] = galleryItemAutomationPeer;
				return galleryItemAutomationPeer;
			}
			if (item is GalleryItemGroup)
			{
				GalleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer galleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer = new GalleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer(item as GalleryItemGroup, this);
				_itemPeers[item] = galleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer;
				return galleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer;
			}
			return null;
		}

		IRawElementProviderSimple[] ISelectionProvider.GetSelection()
		{
			GalleryToolDropDownPresenter galleryToolDropDownPresenter = base.Owner as GalleryToolDropDownPresenter;
			GalleryItem selectedItem = galleryToolDropDownPresenter.GalleryTool.SelectedItem;
			if (selectedItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<IRawElementProviderSimple> list = new List<IRawElementProviderSimple>(1);
			if (_itemPeers[selectedItem] is GalleryItemAutomationPeer peer)
			{
				list.Add(ProviderFromPeer(peer));
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			foreach (DictionaryEntry itemPeer2 in _itemPeers)
			{
				GalleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer galleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer = itemPeer2.Value as GalleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer;
				if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(galleryItemGroupItemAutomationPeer.Item as UIElement) is GalleryItemGroupAutomationPeer galleryItemGroupAutomationPeer)
				{
					GalleryItemAutomationPeer itemPeer = galleryItemGroupAutomationPeer.GetItemPeer(selectedItem);
					if (itemPeer != null)
					{
						list.Add(ProviderFromPeer(itemPeer));
						return list.ToArray();
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class GalleryItemAutomationPeer : ItemAutomationPeer, ISelectionItemProvider
	{
		bool ISelectionItemProvider.IsSelected => (base.Item as GalleryItem).IsSelected;

		IRawElementProviderSimple ISelectionItemProvider.SelectionContainer => ProviderFromPeer(base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer);

		public GalleryItemAutomationPeer(GalleryItem owner, ItemsControlAutomationPeer container)
			: base(owner, container)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.ListItem;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "GalleryItem";
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return ((GalleryItem)base.Item).Text;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.SelectionItem)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return null;
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.AddToSelection()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			if (!((ISelectionItemProvider)this).IsSelected)
			{
				GetGalleryInfo(out var gallery, out var _);
				if (gallery == null || gallery.ItemBehavior == GalleryToolItemBehavior.Button || gallery.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				((ISelectionItemProvider)this).Select();
			}
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.RemoveFromSelection()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			(base.Item as GalleryItem).IsSelected = false;
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.Select()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			GetGalleryInfo(out var gallery, out var group);
			if (gallery != null)
			{
				if (gallery.ItemBehavior == GalleryToolItemBehavior.StateButton)
				{
					(base.Item as GalleryItem).IsSelected = true;
				}
				else
				{
					RaiseItemClickedEvent(gallery, group);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseItemClickedEvent(GalleryTool gallery, GalleryItemGroup group)
		{
			if (gallery != null)
			{
				GalleryItemPresenter presenter = null;
				ItemsControlAutomationPeer itemsControlAutomationPeer = base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer;
				if (itemsControlAutomationPeer != null)
				{
					presenter = ((ItemsControl)itemsControlAutomationPeer.Owner).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(base.Item) as GalleryItemPresenter;
				}
				GalleryItemEventArgs args = new GalleryItemEventArgs(gallery, group, base.Item as GalleryItem, presenter);
				gallery.RaiseItemClicked(args);
			}
		}

		private void GetGalleryInfo(out GalleryTool gallery, out GalleryItemGroup group)
		{
			gallery = null;
			group = null;
			if (base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer is GalleryItemGroupAutomationPeer)
			{
				group = (base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer as GalleryItemGroupAutomationPeer).Owner as GalleryItemGroup;
				gallery = group.GalleryTool;
			}
			else if (base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer is GalleryToolPreviewPresenterAutomationPeer)
			{
				GalleryToolPreviewPresenter galleryToolPreviewPresenter = (base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer as GalleryToolPreviewPresenterAutomationPeer).Owner as GalleryToolPreviewPresenter;
				gallery = galleryToolPreviewPresenter.GalleryTool;
			}
			else if (base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer is GalleryToolDropDownPresenterAutomationPeer)
			{
				GalleryToolDropDownPresenter descendant = (base.ItemsControlAutomationPeer as GalleryToolDropDownPresenterAutomationPeer).Owner as GalleryToolDropDownPresenter;
				gallery = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(descendant, typeof(GalleryTool), allowSubclassOfType: false) as GalleryTool;
			}
		}
	}

		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = base.GetChildrenCore();
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = new FrameworkElementAutomationPeer(base.Owner as FrameworkElement);
			List<AutomationPeer> children = automationPeer.GetChildren();
			if (children != null)
			{
				for (int num = children.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
				{
					AutomationPeer automationPeer2 = children[num];
					if (automationPeer2 is GalleryItemPresenterAutomationPeer)
					{
						children.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = children;
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(children);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

	public class MenuToolAutomationPeer : MenuToolBaseAutomationPeer, IInvokeProvider, IToggleProvider
	{
		ToggleState IToggleProvider.ToggleState
		{
			get
			{
				if (((MenuTool)base.Owner).IsChecked)
				{
					return ToggleState.On;
				}
				return ToggleState.Off;
			}
		}

		public MenuToolAutomationPeer(MenuTool owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "MenuTool";
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return ButtonToolAutomationPeer.GetToolName(base.Owner, base.GetNameCore());
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			MenuTool menuTool = base.Owner as MenuTool;
			if ((menuTool.ButtonType == MenuToolButtonType.Segmented || menuTool.ButtonType == MenuToolButtonType.SegmentedState) && patternInterface == PatternInterface.Invoke)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (menuTool.ButtonType == MenuToolButtonType.SegmentedState && patternInterface == PatternInterface.Toggle)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		internal virtual void RaiseToggleStatePropertyChangedEvent(bool? oldValue, bool? newValue)
		{
			if (AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.PropertyChanged) && oldValue != newValue)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(TogglePatternIdentifiers.ToggleStateProperty, DropDownToggleAutomationPeer.ConvertToToggleState(oldValue), DropDownToggleAutomationPeer.ConvertToToggleState(newValue));
			}
		}

		void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
		{
			VerifyEnabled();
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, (DispatcherOperationCallback)delegate
			{
				((MenuTool)base.Owner).RaiseClick(allowToggleState: true);
				return (object)null;
			}, null);
		}

		void IToggleProvider.Toggle()
		{
			VerifyEnabled();
			((MenuTool)base.Owner).SetIsChecked(!((MenuTool)base.Owner).IsChecked);
		}
	}

		}

	public class RibbonGroupAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		ExpandCollapseState IExpandCollapseProvider.ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = base.Owner as RibbonGroup;
				if (ribbonGroup.Location == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar && ribbonGroup.IsOpen)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
				}
				if (ribbonGroup.Location == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar && !ribbonGroup.IsOpen)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				if (ribbonGroup.IsCollapsed)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		public RibbonGroupAutomationPeer(RibbonGroup owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.ToolBar;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "RibbonGroup";
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			string text = base.GetNameCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = ((RibbonGroup)base.Owner).Caption;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		internal void RaiseExpandCollapseStateChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.PropertyChanged))
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, oldValue ? ExpandCollapseState.Expanded : ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed, newValue ? ExpandCollapseState.Expanded : ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed);
			}
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = base.Owner as RibbonGroup;
			ribbonGroup.IsOpen = false;
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Expand()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = base.Owner as RibbonGroup;
			ribbonGroup.IsOpen = true;
		}
	}

	public class DropDownToggleAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IToggleProvider
	{
		ToggleState IToggleProvider.ToggleState
		{
			get
			{
				DropDownToggle dropDownToggle = (DropDownToggle)base.Owner;
				return ConvertToToggleState(dropDownToggle.IsDroppedDown);
			}
		}

		public DropDownToggleAutomationPeer(DropDownToggle owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.CheckBox;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "DropDownToggle";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Toggle)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		internal virtual void RaiseToggleStatePropertyChangedEvent(bool? oldValue, bool? newValue)
		{
			if (AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.PropertyChanged) && oldValue != newValue)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(TogglePatternIdentifiers.ToggleStateProperty, ConvertToToggleState(oldValue), ConvertToToggleState(newValue));
			}
		}

		void IToggleProvider.Toggle()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			DropDownToggle dropDownToggle = base.Owner as DropDownToggle;
			dropDownToggle.IsDroppedDown = !dropDownToggle.IsDroppedDown;
		}

		internal static ToggleState ConvertToToggleState(bool? value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				true => ToggleState.On, 
				false => ToggleState.Off, 
				_ => ToggleState.Indeterminate, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class ToolMenuItemAutomationPeer : MenuItemAutomationPeer, IToggleProvider
	{
		ToggleState IToggleProvider.ToggleState
		{
			get
			{
				ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = base.Owner as ToolMenuItem;
				return ToToggleState(toolMenuItem.IsChecked);
			}
		}

		public ToolMenuItemAutomationPeer(ToolMenuItem owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = base.Owner as ToolMenuItem;
			List<AutomationPeer> list = base.GetChildrenCore();
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			}
			if (toolMenuItem.Tool != null && !(toolMenuItem.Tool is ItemsControl))
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(toolMenuItem.Tool as UIElement);
				if (automationPeer == null)
				{
					automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(toolMenuItem.Tool as UIElement);
				}
				if (automationPeer != null)
				{
					list.Add(automationPeer);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "ToolMenuItem";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = base.Owner as ToolMenuItem;
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Toggle && toolMenuItem.IsCheckableInternal)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		internal void RaiseToggleStatePropertyChangedEvent(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != newValue)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(TogglePatternIdentifiers.ToggleStateProperty, ToToggleState(oldValue), ToToggleState(newValue));
			}
		}

		private static ToggleState ToToggleState(bool value)
		{
			if (!value)
			{
				return ToggleState.Off;
			}
			return ToggleState.On;
		}

		void IToggleProvider.Toggle()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = base.Owner as ToolMenuItem;
			if (!toolMenuItem.IsCheckableInternal)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			toolMenuItem.IsChecked = !toolMenuItem.IsChecked;
		}
	}
	public class XamRibbonAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer
	{
		public XamRibbonAutomationPeer(XamRibbon owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.ToolBar;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "XamRibbon";
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			if (!(base.Owner is XamRibbon xamRibbon))
			{
				return new List<AutomationPeer>();
			}
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			}
			foreach (ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup in xamRibbon.ContextualTabGroups)
			{
				list.Add(contextualTabGroup.GetPeer(createIfNull: true));
			}
			list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(xamRibbon.RibbonTabControl));
			ContentControl applicationMenuSite = xamRibbon.ApplicationMenuSite;
			if (applicationMenuSite != null && applicationMenuSite.Content is UIElement)
			{
				AutomationPeer item = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(applicationMenuSite.Content as UIElement);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = xamRibbon.QuickAccessToolbar;
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer item2 = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(quickAccessToolbar);
				list.Add(item2);
			}
			TabItemAreaToolbar tabItemAreaToolbar = xamRibbon.TabItemAreaToolbar;
			if (tabItemAreaToolbar != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer item3 = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(tabItemAreaToolbar);
				list.Add(item3);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			string text = base.GetNameCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = "Infragistics XamRibbon";
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ApplicationMenuItemsPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel, IScrollInfo
	{
		internal class ScrollData
		{
			internal ScrollViewer _scrollOwner;

			internal System.Windows.Size _extent;

			internal System.Windows.Size _viewport;

			internal Vector _offset;

			internal bool _canHorizontallyScroll;

			internal bool _canVerticallyScroll;

			internal void Reset()
			{
				_offset = default(Vector);
				_extent = default(System.Windows.Size);
				_viewport = default(System.Windows.Size);
			}

			internal void VerifyScrollData(System.Windows.Size viewPort, System.Windows.Size extent)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Width))
				{
					viewPort.Width = extent.Width;
				}
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Height))
				{
					viewPort.Height = extent.Height;
				}
				bool flag = !RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(_viewport.Width, viewPort.Width) || !RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(_viewport.Height, viewPort.Height) || !RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width) || !RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width);
				_viewport = viewPort;
				_extent = extent;
				flag |= VerifyOffset();
				if (_scrollOwner != null && flag)
				{
					_scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
			}

			private bool VerifyOffset()
			{
				double x = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.X, _extent.Width - _viewport.Width), 0.0);
				double y = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.Y, _extent.Height - _viewport.Height), 0.0);
				Vector offset = _offset;
				_offset = new Vector(x, y);
				if (RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(_offset.X, offset.X))
				{
					return !RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(_offset.Y, offset.Y);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private ApplicationMenuPresenter _menu;

		private bool _generateChildrenCalled;

		private List<UIElement> _generatedChildren;

		private ItemContainerGenerator _itemContainerGenerator;

		private UIElementCollection _privateChildren;

		private ScrollData _scrollDataInfo;

		private const double LineOffset = 16.0;

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_privateChildren == null)
				{
					return base.VisualChildrenCount;
				}
				return _privateChildren.Count;
			}
		}

		internal List<UIElement> GeneratedChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (_generatedChildren == null)
				{
					_generatedChildren = new List<UIElement>();
				}
				return _generatedChildren;
			}
		}

		internal ApplicationMenuPresenter Menu
		{
			get
			{
				return _menu;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _menu)
				{
					Release();
					_menu = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private ScrollData ScrollDataInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (_scrollDataInfo == null)
				{
					_scrollDataInfo = new ScrollData();
				}
				return _scrollDataInfo;
			}
		}

		bool IScrollInfo.CanHorizontallyScroll
		{
			get
			{
				return ScrollDataInfo._canHorizontallyScroll;
			}
			set
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._canHorizontallyScroll = value;
			}
		}

		bool IScrollInfo.CanVerticallyScroll
		{
			get
			{
				return ScrollDataInfo._canVerticallyScroll;
			}
			set
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._canVerticallyScroll = value;
			}
		}

		double IScrollInfo.ExtentHeight => ScrollDataInfo._extent.Height;

		double IScrollInfo.ExtentWidth => ScrollDataInfo._extent.Width;

		double IScrollInfo.HorizontalOffset => ScrollDataInfo._offset.X;

		ScrollViewer IScrollInfo.ScrollOwner
		{
			get
			{
				return ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner;
			}
			set
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._scrollOwner = value;
			}
		}

		double IScrollInfo.VerticalOffset => ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y;

		double IScrollInfo.ViewportHeight => ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Height;

		double IScrollInfo.ViewportWidth => ScrollDataInfo._viewport.Width;

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (_privateChildren == null)
			{
				return finalSize;
			}
			ScrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(finalSize, ScrollDataInfo._extent);
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(finalSize);
			finalRect.Location = new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - ScrollDataInfo._offset.X, 0.0 - ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y);
			for (int i = 0; i < _privateChildren.Count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = _privateChildren[i];
				if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
					finalRect.Height = desiredSize.Height;
					finalRect.Width = Math.Max(desiredSize.Width, finalSize.Width);
					uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
					finalRect.Y += finalRect.Height;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= VisualChildrenCount)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (_privateChildren == null)
			{
				return base.GetVisualChild(index);
			}
			return _privateChildren[index];
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = default(System.Windows.Size);
			if (_menu != null)
			{
				ApplicationMenuRecentItemsPanel recentItemsPanel = _menu.RecentItemsPanel;
				if (recentItemsPanel == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_ApplicationMenuRecentItemsPanelMissing"));
				}
				GenerateChildren();
				System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = availableSize;
				availableSize2.Height = double.PositiveInfinity;
				availableSize2.Width = double.PositiveInfinity;
				for (int i = 0; i < _privateChildren.Count; i++)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = _privateChildren[i];
					if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
					{
						uIElement.Measure(availableSize2);
						System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
						if (desiredSize.Width > size.Width)
						{
							size.Width = desiredSize.Width;
						}
						size.Height += desiredSize.Height;
					}
				}
			}
			ScrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(availableSize, size);
			if (availableSize.Width < size.Width)
			{
				size.Width = availableSize.Width;
			}
			if (availableSize.Height < size.Height)
			{
				size.Height = availableSize.Height;
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected override void OnIsItemsHostChanged(bool oldIsItemsHost, bool newIsItemsHost)
		{
			if (!newIsItemsHost)
			{
				Release();
			}
			base.OnIsItemsHostChanged(oldIsItemsHost, newIsItemsHost);
		}

		private void GenerateChildren()
		{
			if (_generateChildrenCalled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.IsItemsHost && Menu != null && Menu.RibbonTool != null)
			{
				if (_itemContainerGenerator == null)
				{
					_itemContainerGenerator = ((IItemContainerGenerator)Menu.ItemContainerGenerator).GetItemContainerGeneratorForPanel((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)this);
					_itemContainerGenerator.ItemsChanged += OnItemsChanged;
				}
				IItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = _itemContainerGenerator;
				itemContainerGenerator.RemoveAll();
				if (_privateChildren == null)
				{
					_privateChildren = CreateUIElementCollection(null);
				}
				else
				{
					_privateChildren.Clear();
				}
				GeneratedChildren.Clear();
				ApplicationMenuRecentItemsPanel recentItemsPanel = Menu.RecentItemsPanel;
				recentItemsPanel?.Children.Clear();
				_generateChildrenCalled = true;
				int num = 0;
				ApplicationMenu applicationMenu = Menu.RibbonTool as ApplicationMenu;
				int count = applicationMenu.Items.Count;
				using (itemContainerGenerator.StartAt(new GeneratorPosition(-1, 0), GeneratorDirection.Forward))
				{
					while (itemContainerGenerator.GenerateNext() is UIElement uIElement)
					{
						GeneratedChildren.Add(uIElement);
						if (num < count || recentItemsPanel == null)
						{
							_privateChildren.Add(uIElement);
						}
						else
						{
							recentItemsPanel.Children.Add(uIElement);
						}
						num++;
						itemContainerGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(uIElement);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			_privateChildren = base.InternalChildren;
		}

		private void OnItemsChanged(object sender, ItemsChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				_generateChildrenCalled = false;
				GenerateChildren();
				break;
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void Release()
		{
			if (_itemContainerGenerator != null)
			{
				_itemContainerGenerator.ItemsChanged -= OnItemsChanged;
			}
			if (_privateChildren != null)
			{
				_privateChildren.Clear();
			}
			if (_generatedChildren != null)
			{
				_generatedChildren.Clear();
			}
			if (_menu != null)
			{
				_menu.RecentItemsPanel?.Children.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void AdjustVerticalOffset(double adjustment)
		{
			((IScrollInfo)this).SetVerticalOffset(adjustment + ((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset);
		}

		private void AdjustHorizontalOffset(double adjustment)
		{
			((IScrollInfo)this).SetHorizontalOffset(adjustment + ((IScrollInfo)this).HorizontalOffset);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(-16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(-16.0);
		}

		Rect IScrollInfo.MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty || visual == null || !IsAncestorOf(visual))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect rect = visual.TransformToAncestor(this).TransformBounds(rectangle);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
			Rect rect3 = Rect.Intersect(rect, rect2);
			if (rect3.Width != rect.Width)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (rect.Right > rect2.Right)
				{
					num = rect.Right - rect2.Right;
				}
				if (rect.Left - num - rect2.Left < 0.0)
				{
					num += rect.Left - num - rect2.Left;
				}
				rect.X -= num;
				num += ((IScrollInfo)this).HorizontalOffset;
				((IScrollInfo)this).SetHorizontalOffset(num);
			}
			if (rect3.Height != rect.Height)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (rect.Bottom > rect2.Bottom)
				{
					num2 = rect.Bottom - rect2.Bottom;
				}
				if (rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top < 0.0)
				{
					num2 += rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top;
				}
				rect.Y -= num2;
				num2 += ((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset;
				((IScrollInfo)this).SetVerticalOffset(num2);
			}
			return rect;
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset((double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset((double)(-SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines) * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset((double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset((double)(-SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines) * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(0.0 - ((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportHeight);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(0.0 - ((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportWidth);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportWidth);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportHeight);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			RibbonGroupPanel.EnsureIsANumber(offset);
			offset = Math.Max(offset, 0.0);
			if (!RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(offset, ScrollDataInfo._offset.X))
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.X = offset;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			RibbonGroupPanel.EnsureIsANumber(offset);
			offset = Math.Max(offset, 0.0);
			if (!RibbonGroupPanel.AreClose(offset, ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y))
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y = offset;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}
	}

		internal static void ProcessDirectionalNavigationKey(FrameworkElement source, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(source);
			ApplicationMenu applicationMenu = null;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				applicationMenu = ribbon.ApplicationMenu;
			}
			if (applicationMenu == null || !applicationMenu.IsOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			FocusNavigationDirection? direction = ToolMenuItem.GetDirection(e);
			if (!direction.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			IInputElement focusedElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = focusedElement as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement == applicationMenu.Presenter)
			{
				PopupOwnerProxy.FocusFirstItem(applicationMenu.Presenter);
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab)
			{
				frameworkElement.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(direction.Value));
				e.Handled = true;
				if (frameworkElement is ToolMenuItem && Keyboard.FocusedElement is DependencyObject && GetAppMenuAncestor(Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject) is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
				{
					((ToolMenuItem)frameworkElement).SimulateMouseLeave();
				}
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = frameworkElement.PredictFocus(direction.Value);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = dependencyObject as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject appMenuAncestor = GetAppMenuAncestor(frameworkElement2);
			DependencyObject appMenuAncestor2 = GetAppMenuAncestor(frameworkElement);
			ApplicationMenuPresenter applicationMenuPresenter = applicationMenu.Presenter as ApplicationMenuPresenter;
			bool flag = direction == FocusNavigationDirection.Up || direction == FocusNavigationDirection.Down;
			bool flag2 = appMenuAncestor2 != appMenuAncestor;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (appMenuAncestor2 is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
				{
					if (frameworkElement == frameworkElement2 || flag2)
					{
						if (direction == FocusNavigationDirection.Up)
						{
							frameworkElement.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Previous));
						}
						else
						{
							frameworkElement.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Next));
						}
						flag2 = false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						DependencyObject elementToFocus = ToolMenuItem.GetElementToFocus(frameworkElement2);
						if (elementToFocus is FrameworkElement)
						{
							frameworkElement2 = elementToFocus as FrameworkElement;
						}
						Rect rect = new Rect(Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement2, default(System.Windows.Point)), frameworkElement2.RenderSize);
						Rect rect2 = new Rect(Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement, default(System.Windows.Point)), frameworkElement.RenderSize);
						if (direction == FocusNavigationDirection.Up)
						{
							if (rect.Bottom > rect2.Bottom && !frameworkElement2.IsAncestorOf(frameworkElement))
							{
								flag2 = true;
							}
						}
						else if (rect.Top < rect2.Top && !frameworkElement2.IsAncestorOf(frameworkElement))
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						bool flag3 = direction == FocusNavigationDirection.Up;
						DependencyObject[] array = new DependencyObject[3] { applicationMenuPresenter.MenuItemsPanel, applicationMenuPresenter.RecentItemsPanel, applicationMenu.FooterToolbar };
						int num = Array.IndexOf(array, appMenuAncestor2) + 3;
						int num2 = (flag3 ? (num - 4) : (num + 4));
						int num3 = ((!flag3) ? 1 : (-1));
						for (int i = num + num3; i != num2; i += num3)
						{
							DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = array[i % 3];
							if (dependencyObject2 != null && (flag3 ? PopupOwnerProxy.FocusLastItem(dependencyObject2) : PopupOwnerProxy.FocusFirstItem(dependencyObject2)))
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						frameworkElement2.Focus();
						if (frameworkElement2 is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
						{
							System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e2 = new System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs(e.KeyboardDevice, e.InputSource, e.Timestamp, Key.Oem3);
							toolMenuItem.RaiseMenuItemOnKeyDown(e2);
						}
					}
				}
				DependencyObject dependencyObject3 = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
				if (frameworkElement is ToolMenuItem && dependencyObject3 != null && GetAppMenuAncestor(dependencyObject3) is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
				{
					((ToolMenuItem)frameworkElement).SimulateMouseLeave();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				frameworkElement2.Focus();
			}
			if (frameworkElement == Keyboard.FocusedElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag4 = false;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject4 = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
			if (frameworkElement is ToolMenuItem && Selector.GetIsSelected(frameworkElement))
			{
				switch (XamRibbon.GetLocation(frameworkElement))
				{
				case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems:
					flag4 = true;
					break;
				case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu:
					if (dependencyObject4 != null && XamRibbon.GetLocation(dependencyObject4) != ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu)
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				Selector.SetIsSelected(frameworkElement, isSelected: false);
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private static DependencyObject GetAppMenuAncestor(DependencyObject descendant)
		{
			while (descendant != null)
			{
				if (descendant is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar || descendant is ApplicationMenuRecentItemsPanel || descendant is ApplicationMenuItemsPanel)
				{
					return descendant;
				}
				descendant = Utilities.GetParent(descendant, includeLogicalParent: true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void OnAccessKeyPressed(object sender, AccessKeyPressedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenuPresenter applicationMenuPresenter = (ApplicationMenuPresenter)sender;
			ApplicationMenu applicationMenu = applicationMenuPresenter.RibbonTool as ApplicationMenu;
			if (e.Target != null && applicationMenu != null && applicationMenu.FooterToolbar != null)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.Target;
				while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
				{
					dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (dependencyObject != null && Utilities.IsDescendantOf(applicationMenu.FooterToolbar, dependencyObject, preferLogicalTree: false))
				{
					e.Scope = applicationMenuPresenter;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnClassKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessDirectionalNavigationKey(sender as ApplicationMenuPresenter, e);
		}

		private class BackstageAdorner : Adorner
		{
			private ApplicationMenu2010 _menu;

			private UIElement _constrainingElement;

			private UIElement _adornerLayerHost;

			private bool _areAnimationsStarted;

			private const double ExtraShiftDown = 0.0;

			protected override int VisualChildrenCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_menu == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return 1;
				}
			}

			internal BackstageAdorner(ApplicationMenu2010 menu, UIElement constrainingElement, UIElement adornerLayerHost, UIElement adornedElement)
				: base(adornedElement)
			{
				_menu = menu;
				_constrainingElement = constrainingElement;
				_adornerLayerHost = adornerLayerHost;
				AddVisualChild(menu);
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
			{
				Rect finalRect = new Rect(finalSize);
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_menu);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					if (_constrainingElement is FrameworkElement)
					{
						FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _constrainingElement as FrameworkElement;
						finalRect.Width = frameworkElement.ActualWidth;
						finalRect.Height = frameworkElement.ActualHeight;
					}
					System.Windows.Size size = finalRect.Size;
					RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost = ((ribbon.RibbonWindow != null) ? ribbon.RibbonWindow.ContentHost : null);
					System.Windows.Point offset = GetOffset();
					finalRect.Height = Math.Max(finalRect.Height - GetFileTabOffset(), 0.0);
					finalRect.Y += size.Height - finalRect.Height;
					finalRect.Width = Math.Max(finalRect.Width - offset.X, 0.0);
					finalRect.Height = Math.Max(finalRect.Height - offset.Y, 0.0);
					if (ribbonWindowContentHost != null && !ribbon.IsOffice2013Theme)
					{
						finalRect.Height = Math.Max(finalRect.Height - ribbonWindowContentHost.BackgroundAreaMargin.Bottom, 0.0);
						finalRect.Width = Math.Max(finalRect.Width - (ribbonWindowContentHost.BackgroundAreaMargin.Left + ribbonWindowContentHost.BackgroundAreaMargin.Right), 0.0);
						finalRect.X += ribbonWindowContentHost.BackgroundAreaMargin.Left - ribbonWindowContentHost.RibbonAreaMargin.Left;
					}
					if (!_areAnimationsStarted)
					{
						StartOpenAnimations();
					}
				}
				_menu.Arrange(finalRect);
				return finalSize;
			}

			protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
			{
				if (_menu != null && index == 0)
				{
					return _menu;
				}
				return base.GetVisualChild(index);
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
			{
				System.Windows.Size availableSize = constraint;
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_menu);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					if (_constrainingElement != null)
					{
						availableSize = _constrainingElement.RenderSize;
					}
					RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost = ((ribbon.RibbonWindow != null) ? ribbon.RibbonWindow.ContentHost : null);
					System.Windows.Point offset = GetOffset();
					if (!double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height))
					{
						availableSize.Height = Math.Max(availableSize.Height - offset.Y, 0.0);
						availableSize.Height = Math.Max(availableSize.Height - GetFileTabOffset(), 0.0);
						if (ribbonWindowContentHost != null)
						{
							availableSize.Height = Math.Max(availableSize.Height - ribbonWindowContentHost.BackgroundAreaMargin.Bottom, 0.0);
						}
					}
					if (!double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width))
					{
						availableSize.Width = Math.Max(availableSize.Width - offset.X, 0.0);
						if (ribbonWindowContentHost != null)
						{
							availableSize.Width = Math.Max(availableSize.Width - (ribbonWindowContentHost.BackgroundAreaMargin.Left + ribbonWindowContentHost.BackgroundAreaMargin.Right), 0.0);
						}
					}
				}
				_menu.Measure(availableSize);
				return constraint;
			}

			protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) == null)

					ApplicationMenu2010 menu = _menu;
					_menu = null;

			}

			private double GetFileTabOffset()
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010FileTab fileTabElement = _menu.GetFileTabElement();
				double num = 0.0;
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_menu);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					if (ribbon.IsOffice2013Theme)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					try
					{
						Rect rect = fileTabElement.TransformToAncestor(ribbon).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, fileTabElement.ActualWidth, fileTabElement.ActualHeight));
						num = ((!ribbon.IsOffice2013Theme) ? rect.Bottom : rect.Top);
					}
					catch
					{
						if (!ribbon.IsOffice2013Theme)
						{
							num = ribbon.RibbonTabControl.TabHeaderHeight;
						}
						num += (double)ribbon.GetValue(XamRibbon.CaptionHeightProperty);
					}
					if (!ribbon.IsMinimized)
					{
						num += 0.0;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			private System.Windows.Point GetOffset()
			{
				System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_menu);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost = ((ribbon.RibbonWindow != null) ? ribbon.RibbonWindow.ContentHost : null);
					if (ribbonWindowContentHost == null)
					{
						try
						{
							Rect rect = ribbon.TransformToVisual(_adornerLayerHost).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, ribbon.ActualWidth, ribbon.ActualHeight));
							result.Y += rect.Y;
							result.X += rect.X;
						}
						catch (InvalidOperationException)
						{
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}

			private void StartOpenAnimations()
			{
				_areAnimationsStarted = true;
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_menu);
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsOffice2013Theme)
				{
					TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
					DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
					doubleAnimation.From = -100.0;
					doubleAnimation.To = 0.0;
					doubleAnimation.Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200.0));
					doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = new CubicEase();
					doubleAnimation.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
					_menu.SetValue(SlideTransformPropertyKey, translateTransform);
					translateTransform.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.XProperty, doubleAnimation);
					ContentPresenter selectedTabContentHost = _menu.SelectedTabContentHost;
					if (selectedTabContentHost != null)
					{
						DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation2 = new DoubleAnimation();
						doubleAnimation2.From = 0.0;
						doubleAnimation2.To = 1.0;
						doubleAnimation2.Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1500.0));
						doubleAnimation2.EasingFunction = new CubicEase();
						doubleAnimation2.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
						selectedTabContentHost.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, doubleAnimation2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(SlideTransformPropertyKey);
				}
			}

		private class BackstageKeyTipProvider : IKeyTip, IKeyTipContainer
		{
			private ApplicationMenu2010 _menu;

			public KeyTipAlignment Alignment => KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter;

			public string AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

			public string Caption => _menu.Caption ?? string.Empty;

			public KeyTipActivationBehavior ActivationBehavior => KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips;

			public bool IsEnabled => _menu.IsEnabled;

			public bool IsVisible
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement adornedElement = AdornedElement;
					if (adornedElement != null && adornedElement != _menu && adornedElement.IsVisible)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return _menu.IsVisible;
				}
			}

			public string KeyTipValue
			{
				get
				{
					string text = _menu.KeyTip;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = XamRibbon.GetString("ApplicationMenuDefaultKeyTip");
					}
					return text;
				}
			}

			public System.Windows.Point Location
			{
				get
				{
					System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
					UIElement adornedElement = AdornedElement;
					if (adornedElement != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Size renderSize = adornedElement.RenderSize;
						if (renderSize.Width > 0.0 && renderSize.Height > 0.0)
						{
							result = new System.Windows.Point(renderSize.Width / 2.0, renderSize.Height / 2.0);
						}
					}
					return result;
				}
			}

			public char Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(Caption);

			public UIElement AdornedElement => (UIElement)(((object)_menu.GetFileTabElement()) ?? ((object)_menu));

			public char DefaultPrefix => 'F';

			public bool CanAutoGenerateKeyTip => true;

			bool IKeyTipContainer.ReuseParentKeyTips => false;

			internal BackstageKeyTipProvider(ApplicationMenu2010 menuItem)
			{
				_menu = menuItem;
			}

			public bool Activate()
			{
				if (_menu.IsOpen)
				{
					if (Utilities.IsDescendantOf(_menu, Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject))
					{
						_menu.SelectedTab?.Focus();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_menu.Show();
				}
				_menu.UpdateLayout();
				return _menu.IsOpen;
			}

			public bool Equals(IKeyTip provider)
			{
				if (provider is BackstageKeyTipProvider)
				{
					return _menu == ((BackstageKeyTipProvider)provider)._menu;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public IKeyTipContainer GetContainer()
			{
				return this;
			}

			void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
			{
				if (!_menu.IsOpen)
				{
					return;
				}
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_menu);
				if (ribbon == null || !ribbon.KeyTipManager.IsHiding)
				{
					if (_menu.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						ApplicationMenu2010FileTab fileTabElement = _menu.GetFileTabElement();
						fileTabElement.Focus();
					}
					_menu.Close();
				}
			}

			IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
			{
				List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
				ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = _menu.ItemContainerGenerator;
				if (itemContainerGenerator != null)
				{
					foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)_menu.Items)
					{
						ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item = item as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
						if (applicationMenu2010Item == null)
						{
							applicationMenu2010Item = itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
						}
						applicationMenu2010Item?.AddKeyTipProviders(list);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		static ApplicationMenu2010()
		{
			BackButtonStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), "BackButtonStyleKey");
			CaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata());
			CaptionOverlayHeightPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CaptionOverlayHeight", typeof(double), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0));
			CaptionOverlayHeightProperty = CaptionOverlayHeightPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			HasCaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasCaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010));
			ImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Image", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			InitialSelectedTabItemProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InitialSelectedTabItem", typeof(object), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnInitialSelectedTabItemChanged));
			IsConstrainingElementProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.RegisterAttached("IsConstrainingElement", typeof(bool), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsOpenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsOpenChanged, CoerceIsOpen));
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010));
			SelectedTabPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("SelectedTab", typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedTabChanged));
			SelectedTabProperty = SelectedTabPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SelectedTabItemProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedTabItem", typeof(object), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedTabItemChanged));
			SlideTransformPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("SlideTransform", typeof(Transform), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			SlideTransformProperty = SlideTransformPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			TabAreaOverlayHeightPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("TabAreaOverlayHeight", typeof(double), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0));
			TabAreaOverlayHeightProperty = TabAreaOverlayHeightPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MenuProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.RegisterAttached("Menu", typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.OverridesInheritanceBehavior));
			ClosedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Closed", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010));
			OpenedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Opened", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			XamRibbon.RibbonProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnRibbonChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010), Keyboard.PreviewLostKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnPreviousLostKeyboardFocus));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FrameworkElement), Keyboard.PreviewGotKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnPreviousRootGotKeyboardFocus));
		}

			return new ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Escape:
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
				if (ribbon == null || ribbon.Mode != RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive)
				{
					Close();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case Key.Tab:
			{
				ModifierKeys modifiers = Keyboard.Modifiers;
				if ((modifiers & ~ModifierKeys.Shift) == ModifierKeys.Control && SelectNextTab((modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) == 0))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			base.ItemContainerGenerator.StatusChanged += OnGeneratorStatusChanged;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		private static object CoerceIsOpen(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			if (true.Equals(newValue))
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d);
				if (ribbon == null || !ribbon.IsLoaded || ribbon.ApplicationMenuMode != ApplicationMenuMode.Office2010)
				{
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnIsOpenChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = d as ApplicationMenu2010;
			if (applicationMenu._closeAnimationInProgress && (bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				applicationMenu._abortClose = true;
				applicationMenu._closeAnimationInProgress = false;
				applicationMenu.ClearValue(SlideTransformPropertyKey);
				ContentPresenter selectedTabContentHost = applicationMenu.SelectedTabContentHost;
				if (selectedTabContentHost != null)
				{
					DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
					doubleAnimation.From = 1.0;
					doubleAnimation.To = 1.0;
					doubleAnimation.Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1.0));
					doubleAnimation.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.HoldEnd;
					selectedTabContentHost.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, doubleAnimation);
				}
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(applicationMenu);
			if (true.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ribbon.CoerceValue(XamRibbon.AutoHideEnabledProperty);
					RibbonWindowContentHost contentHost = RibbonWindowContentHost.GetContentHost(ribbon);
					if (contentHost != null)
					{
						bool isOffice2013Theme = contentHost.IsOffice2013Theme;
						applicationMenu.SetValue(CaptionOverlayHeightPropertyKey, isOffice2013Theme ? contentHost.CaptionHeightResolved : 0.0);
						applicationMenu.SetValue(TabAreaOverlayHeightPropertyKey, isOffice2013Theme ? ribbon.RibbonTabControl.TabHeaderHeight : 0.0);
					}
				}
				applicationMenu.ReleaseFileTabCapture();
				applicationMenu.OnShow();
				applicationMenu.RaiseOpened(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
			else
			{
				applicationMenu.OnClose();
				applicationMenu.ReleaseFileTabCapture();
				applicationMenu.RaiseClosed(new RoutedEventArgs());
				ribbon?.CoerceValue(XamRibbon.AutoHideEnabledProperty);
			}
			bool flag = (bool)e.NewValue;
			bool oldValue = !flag;
			applicationMenu.RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged(oldValue, flag);
		}

		private static void OnSelectedTabChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = d as ApplicationMenu2010;
			ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item = e.NewValue as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
			ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item2 = e.OldValue as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
			object value = ((applicationMenu2010Item == null) ? null : applicationMenu.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(applicationMenu2010Item));
			applicationMenu.SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabItemProperty, value);
			applicationMenu2010Item2?.ClearValue(ApplicationMenu2010Item.IsSelectedTabPropertyKey);
			if (applicationMenu2010Item != null)
			{
				applicationMenu2010Item.SetValue(ApplicationMenu2010Item.IsSelectedTabPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				applicationMenu2010Item.TakeFocusIfAnotherItemIsFocused();
			}
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(applicationMenu) is ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer applicationMenu2010AutomationPeer)
			{
				applicationMenu2010AutomationPeer.RaiseSelectionEvents(applicationMenu2010Item2, applicationMenu2010Item);
			}
		}

		{

			if (applicationMenu.IsOpen)
			{
				applicationMenu.UpdateSelectedTab();
			}
		}

		private ApplicationMenu2010FileTab GetFileTabElement()
		{
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			ApplicationMenu2010FileTab result = null;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				ContentControl applicationMenuSite = ribbon.ApplicationMenuSite;
				if (applicationMenuSite != null)
				{
					result = applicationMenuSite.Content as ApplicationMenu2010FileTab;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ApplicationMenu2010Item GetTabToSelect(object preferredSelectedItem)
		{
			ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = base.ItemContainerGenerator;
			ApplicationMenu2010Item result = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = base.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (IsSelectableTab(i, out var item))
				{
					if (preferredSelectedItem == null)
					{
						result = item;
						break;
					}
					if (preferredSelectedItem == itemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(item))
					{
						result = item;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static bool IsLosingFocusToRootVisual(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (e.OldFocus is Visual visual)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.NewFocus as DependencyObject;
				if ((dependencyObject is Visual || dependencyObject is Visual3D) && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject) == null)
				{
					if (dependencyObject is Window && Window.GetWindow(visual) == dependencyObject)
					{
						result = true;
					}
					else if (visual.IsDescendantOf(dependencyObject))
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsSelectableTab(int index, out ApplicationMenu2010Item item)
		{
			item = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(index) as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
			if (item == null || item.ItemType != ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Tab)
			{
				return false;
			}
			item.VerifyCanExecute();
			if (!item.IsEnabled || item.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnClose()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsOffice2013Theme)
			{
				ContentPresenter selectedTabContentHost = SelectedTabContentHost;
				if (selectedTabContentHost != null)
				{
					DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
					doubleAnimation.From = 1.0;
					doubleAnimation.To = 0.1;
					doubleAnimation.Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(150.0));
					doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = new CubicEase();
					doubleAnimation.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.HoldEnd;
					doubleAnimation.Completed += OnCloseAnimationCompleted;
					flag = true;
					selectedTabContentHost.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, doubleAnimation);
				}
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation2 = new DoubleAnimation();
				doubleAnimation2.From = 0.0;
				doubleAnimation2.To = -100.0;
				doubleAnimation2.Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200.0));
				doubleAnimation2.EasingFunction = new CubicEase();
				doubleAnimation2.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
				SetValue(SlideTransformPropertyKey, translateTransform);
				if (!flag)
				{
					doubleAnimation2.Completed += OnCloseAnimationCompleted;
					flag = true;
				}
				_closeAnimationInProgress = true;
				_abortClose = false;
				translateTransform.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.XProperty, doubleAnimation2);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(SlideTransformPropertyKey);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				ProcessClose();
			}
		}

		private void OnCloseAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_closeAnimationInProgress = false;
			if (!_abortClose)
			{
				ProcessClose();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessClose()
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) is BackstageAdorner backstageAdorner && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(backstageAdorner) is AdornerLayer adornerLayer)
			{
				adornerLayer.Remove(backstageAdorner);
			}
			RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_previousSelectedTab) as RibbonTabItem;
			_previousSelectedTab = null;
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				if (ribbon.SelectedTab == null && ribbonTabItem != null && ribbon.TabsInView.Contains(ribbonTabItem))
				{
					ribbon.RibbonTabControl.PreviouslySelectedItem = ribbonTabItem;
				}
				ribbon.RibbonTabControl.AllowNullSelectedItem = false;
				ribbon.VerifyQatVisibility();
			}
			if (!IsOpen)
			{
				SelectedTabItem = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnGeneratorStatusChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status == GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				UpdateSelectedTab();
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviousLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = sender as ApplicationMenu2010;
			if (IsLosingFocusToRootVisual(e))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviousRootGotKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource == e.Source)
			{
				OnPreviousRootGotKeyboardFocusImpl(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviousRootGotKeyboardFocusImpl(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldFocus is DependencyObject d)
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010 menu = GetMenu(d);
				if (menu != null && IsLosingFocusToRootVisual(e) && menu.ShouldPreventLostFocus(e.NewFocus as DependencyObject))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = d as ApplicationMenu2010;
			d.CoerceValue(IsOpenProperty);
		}

		private void OnShow()
		{
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The ApplicationMenu2010 must be associated with a XamRibbon in order to be displayed.");
			}
			RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost = ((ribbon.RibbonWindow != null) ? ribbon.RibbonWindow.ContentHost : null);
			UIElement uIElement = null;
			AdornerLayer adornerLayer = null;
			if (ribbonWindowContentHost == null)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(ribbon);
				while (parent != null && !GetIsConstrainingElement(parent))
				{
					parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(parent);
				}
				uIElement = parent as UIElement;
			}
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(uIElement);
			}
			UIElement elementToAdorn;
			if (adornerLayer != null)
			{
				elementToAdorn = uIElement;
			}
			else
			{
				adornerLayer = Utilities.GetRootAdornerLayer(ribbon, out elementToAdorn);
			}
			if (adornerLayer == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The XamRibbon requires an AdornerLayer in order for the ApplicationMenu2010 to be displayed. There must be an AdornerDecorator or ScrollContentPresenter somewhere above the xamRibbon in the visual tree.");
			}
			adornerLayer.Add(new BackstageAdorner(this, uIElement, elementToAdorn, ribbon));
			UpdateSelectedTab();
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				XamTabControl ribbonTabControl = ribbon.RibbonTabControl;
				if (ribbonTabControl.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					_previousSelectedTab = new WeakReference(ribbonTabControl.SelectedItem);
				}
				else
				{
					_previousSelectedTab = null;
				}
				ribbonTabControl.AllowNullSelectedItem = true;
				ribbonTabControl.SelectedItem = null;
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, (XamRibbon.MethodInvoker)delegate
			{
				if (IsOpen && SelectedTab != null)
				{
					SelectedTab.Focus();
				}
			});
		}

		private void RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is ApplicationMenu2010AutomationPeer applicationMenu2010AutomationPeer)
			{
				applicationMenu2010AutomationPeer.RaiseExpandCollapseStateChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseFileTabCapture()
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = Mouse.Captured as DependencyObject;
			while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
			{
				dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010FileTab fileTabElement = GetFileTabElement();
				if (fileTabElement != null && fileTabElement.IsAncestorOf(dependencyObject))
				{
					Mouse.Captured.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool SelectNextTab(bool next)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010Item selectedTab = SelectedTab;
			if (selectedTab == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = base.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(selectedTab);
			int num2 = (next ? GetNextTab(num) : GetPreviousTab(num));
			if (num2 == num || num2 < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SelectedTabItem = base.Items[num2];
			return true;
		}

		private int GetPreviousTab(int start)
		{
			int count = base.Items.Count;
			start += count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				int num2 = (num + start) % count;
				if (IsSelectableTab(num2, out var _))
				{
					return num2;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int GetNextTab(int start)
		{
			int count = base.Items.Count;
			start++;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int num = (i + start) % count;
				if (IsSelectableTab(num, out var _))
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private bool ShouldPreventLostFocus(DependencyObject newFocus)
		{
			if (!base.IsVisible || !base.IsEnabled || !IsOpen)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedTab()
		{
			GeneratorStatus status = base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status;
			if (status == GeneratorStatus.NotStarted || status == GeneratorStatus.GeneratingContainers)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = SelectedTabItem ?? InitialSelectedTabItem;
			ApplicationMenu2010Item tabToSelect = GetTabToSelect(obj);
			if (tabToSelect == null && obj != null)
			{
				tabToSelect = GetTabToSelect(null);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			IInputElement focusedElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement;
			if (tabToSelect != SelectedTab)
			{
				ContentPresenter selectedTabContentHost = SelectedTabContentHost;
				if (selectedTabContentHost != null && selectedTabContentHost.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			SetValue(SelectedTabPropertyKey, tabToSelect);
			if (tabToSelect != null && flag && tabToSelect == SelectedTab && Keyboard.FocusedElement == focusedElement)
			{
				tabToSelect.Focus();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ClosedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnClosed(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this)?.VerifyQatVisibility();
			args.RoutedEvent = OpenedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnOpened(args);
		}

		ToolLocation IRibbonToolLocationEx.GetLocation(object descendant)
		{
			return ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu2010;
		}
	}
