		private class ItemKeyTipProvider : IKeyTip, IKeyTipContainer
		{
			private ApplicationMenu2010Item _item;

			KeyTipAlignment IKeyTip.Alignment
			{
				get
				{
					if (_item.HasImage)
					{
						return KeyTipAlignment.BottomLeft;
					}
					return KeyTipAlignment.BottomRight;
				}
			}

			string IKeyTip.AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

			public string Caption
			{
				get
				{
					if (_item.Header == null)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return _item.Header.ToString();
				}
			}

			KeyTipActivationBehavior IKeyTip.ActivationBehavior
			{
				get
				{
					if (_item.ItemType == ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button)
					{
						return KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers;
					}
					return KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips;
				}
			}

			bool IKeyTip.IsEnabled => _item.IsEnabled;

			bool IKeyTip.IsVisible => _item.IsVisible;

			string IKeyTip.KeyTipValue => _item.KeyTip ?? GetElementKeyTip(_item);

			System.Windows.Point IKeyTip.Location
			{
				get
				{
					Rect empty = Rect.Empty;
					if (_item.HasImage)
					{
						empty = XamRibbon.GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(KeyTipPlacementType.SmallImage, _item, _item);
						if (!empty.IsEmpty)
						{
							return new System.Windows.Point(empty.X + empty.Width / 2.0, empty.Y + empty.Height / 2.0);
						}
					}
					empty = XamRibbon.GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(KeyTipPlacementType.Caption, _item, _item);
					if (!empty.IsEmpty)
					{
						return new System.Windows.Point(empty.X, empty.Y + empty.Height / 2.0);
					}
					return ToolKeyTipProvider.GetToolKeyTipLocation(_item, ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu2010, RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal);
				}
			}

			char IKeyTip.Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(Caption);

			UIElement IKeyTip.AdornedElement => _item;

			char IKeyTip.DefaultPrefix => 'I';

			bool IKeyTip.CanAutoGenerateKeyTip => true;

			bool IKeyTipContainer.ReuseParentKeyTips => false;

			internal ItemKeyTipProvider(ApplicationMenu2010Item item)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(item);
				_item = item;
			}

			bool IKeyTip.Activate()
			{
				if (_item.ItemType == ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button)
				{
					_item.RaiseClick(preventShiftFocus: false);
					return true;
				}
				_item.SelectThisTab();
				_item.RaiseClick(preventShiftFocus: true);
				_item.UpdateLayout();
				if (_item.IsSelectedTab)
				{
					ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(_item) as ApplicationMenu2010;
					ContentPresenter selectedTabContentHost = applicationMenu.SelectedTabContentHost;
					if (!ElementKeyTipProvider.HasDescendantKeyTips(selectedTabContentHost))
					{
						selectedTabContentHost?.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
					}
				}
				return _item.IsSelectedTab;
			}

			bool IKeyTip.Equals(IKeyTip provider)
			{
				if (provider is ItemKeyTipProvider)
				{
					return ((ItemKeyTipProvider)provider)._item == _item;
				}
				return false;
			}

			IKeyTipContainer IKeyTip.GetContainer()
			{
				if (_item.ItemType == ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return this;
			}

			void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
			{
			}

			IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
			{
				if (_item.IsSelectedTab)
				{
					ContentPresenter contentPresenter = ((ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(_item) is ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu) ? applicationMenu.SelectedTabContentHost : null);
					if (contentPresenter != null)
					{
						return ElementKeyTipProvider.GetDescendantKeyTips(contentPresenter);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

			IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsMouseOverTab", typeof(bool), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnIsMouseOverTabChanged));
			IsMouseOverTabProperty = IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsSelectedTabPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsSelectedTab", typeof(bool), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsSelectedTabProperty = IsSelectedTabPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

			ItemTypeProperty = ItemTypePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

			ClickEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Click", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item)));
			HeaderedContentControl.HeaderProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceHeader));

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this) is ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu)
			{
				applicationMenu.OnItemKeyboardFocusChanged(this);
			}
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			Key key = e.Key;
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Return:
			case Key.Space:
				if (base.IsKeyboardFocused)
				{
					RaiseClick(preventShiftFocus: false);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Right:
			{
				if (!base.IsKeyboardFocused)
				{
					break;
				}
				bool flag = key == Key.Right;
				if (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					flag = !flag;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ApplicationMenu2010 menu = ApplicationMenu2010.GetMenu(this);
					if (menu != null && menu == ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this))
					{
						ContentPresenter selectedTabContentHost = menu.SelectedTabContentHost;
						if (selectedTabContentHost != null)
						{
							selectedTabContentHost.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
							e.Handled = true;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				TakeFocusIfAnotherItemIsFocused();
				if (ItemType == ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button)
				{
					CaptureMouse();
					return;
				}
				SelectThisTab();
				RaiseClick(preventShiftFocus: true);
			}
		}

		private void SelectThisTab()
		{
			if (ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this) is ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu)
			{
				applicationMenu.SelectThisTab(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)

		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (Mouse.Captured == this)
			{
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(this);
				bool flag = position.X >= 0.0 && position.X < base.ActualWidth && position.Y >= 0.0 && position.Y < base.ActualHeight;
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
				if (flag)
				{
					RaiseClick(preventShiftFocus: false);
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			VerifyIsMouseOverTab(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Property == ContentControl.HasContentProperty || e.Property == ContentControl.ContentProperty)
			{
				bool flag = base.HasContent;
				if (flag && LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(this) == null && GetBindingExpression(ContentControl.ContentProperty) == null && DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(this, ContentControl.ContentProperty).BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Local)
				{
					object obj = ((ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this) is ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu) ? applicationMenu.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(this) : null);
					if (obj == base.Content)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				SetValue(ItemTypePropertyKey, flag ? ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Tab : ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button);
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		private static void OnCloseWhenClickedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = true.Equals(e.NewValue);
			RoutedEvent routedEvent = null;
			if (d is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase)
			{
				routedEvent = System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.ClickEvent;
			}
			else if (d is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem)
			{
				routedEvent = System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.ClickEvent;
			}
			else if (d is Hyperlink)
			{
				routedEvent = Hyperlink.ClickEvent;
			}
			else if (d is ApplicationMenu2010Item)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (routedEvent != null)
			{
				if (d is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						uIElement.AddHandler(routedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnCloseElementClick), handledEventsToo: true);
					}
					else
					{
						uIElement.RemoveHandler(routedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnCloseElementClick));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ContentElement contentElement = d as ContentElement;
					if (flag)
					{
						contentElement.AddHandler(routedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnCloseElementClick), handledEventsToo: true);
					}
					else
					{
						contentElement.RemoveHandler(routedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnCloseElementClick));
					}
				}
			}
			if (CoreUtilities.IsDebuggerLogging())
			{
				CoreUtilities.DebuggerLog(40, "Global", "Unrecognized element for ApplicationMenu2010.CloseWhenClicked - " + d.GetType());
			}
		}

		private static void OnCloseElementClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource == sender)
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010.GetMenu(sender as DependencyObject)?.Close();
			}
		}

		private static void OnCommandChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item = (ApplicationMenu2010Item)d;
			applicationMenu2010Item.OnCommandChanged(e.OldValue as ICommand, e.NewValue as ICommand);
		}

		private void OnCommandChanged(ICommand oldCommand, ICommand newCommand)
		{
			if (_weakCanExecuteChanged != null)
			{
				_weakCanExecuteChanged.Detach();
				_menuCanExecuteHandler = null;
				_weakCanExecuteChanged = null;
			}
			if (newCommand != null)
			{
				_weakCanExecuteChanged = new WeakEventHandler<ApplicationMenu2010Item, ICommand, EventArgs>(this, newCommand, delegate(ApplicationMenu2010Item m, object o, EventArgs e)
				{
					m.DirtyCanExecute();
				}, delegate(WeakEventHandler<ApplicationMenu2010Item, ICommand, EventArgs> w, ICommand c)
				{
					c.CanExecuteChanged -= w.OnEvent;
					if (w.Instance != null)
					{
						w.Instance._menuCanExecuteHandler = null;
					}
				});
				_menuCanExecuteHandler = _weakCanExecuteChanged.OnEvent;
				newCommand.CanExecuteChanged += _menuCanExecuteHandler;
			}
			DirtyCanExecute();
			CoerceValue(HeaderedContentControl.HeaderProperty);
		}

		private static void OnCommandParameterChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item = (ApplicationMenu2010Item)d;
			if (applicationMenu2010Item.Command != null)
			{
				applicationMenu2010Item.DirtyCanExecute();
			}
		}

				applicationMenu2010Item.DirtyCanExecute();
			}
		}

		internal void DoDefaultAction()
		{
			if (ItemType == ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button)
			{
				RaiseClick(preventShiftFocus: false);
				return;
			}
			SelectThisTab();
			RaiseClick(preventShiftFocus: true);
		}

		internal void TakeFocusIfAnotherItemIsFocused()
		{
			if (!base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
				ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item = (dependencyObject as ApplicationMenu2010Item) ?? (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Item), allowSubclassOfType: true) as ApplicationMenu2010Item);
				if (applicationMenu2010Item != null && ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this) == ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(applicationMenu2010Item))
				{
					Focus();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCanExecute()
		{
			if (!_canExecute.HasValue)
			{
				ICommand command = Command;
				if (command == null)
				{
					_canExecute = true;
				}
				else if (command is RoutedCommand)
				{
					RoutedCommand routedCommand = command as RoutedCommand;
					_canExecute = routedCommand.CanExecute(CommandParameter, CommandTarget ?? this);
				}
				else
				{
					_canExecute = command.CanExecute(CommandParameter);
				}
				CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceHeader(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item = (ApplicationMenu2010Item)d;
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				if (applicationMenu2010Item.Command is RoutedUICommand routedUICommand)
				{
					return routedUICommand.Text;
				}
			}
			else if (newValue is RoutedUICommand)
			{
				RoutedUICommand routedUICommand2 = newValue as RoutedUICommand;
				ItemsControl itemsControl = ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(applicationMenu2010Item);
				if (itemsControl != null && itemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(applicationMenu2010Item) == newValue)
				{
					return routedUICommand2.Text;
				}
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private void DirtyCanExecute()
		{
			_canExecute = null;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private static void OnAccessKeyPressed(object sender, AccessKeyPressedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010Item target = sender as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
			if (!e.Handled && e.Scope == null && e.Target == null)
			{
				e.Target = target;
			}
		}

		private static void OnGotMouseCaptureWithin(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((ApplicationMenu2010Item)sender).VerifyIsMouseOverTab(e);
		}

		private static void OnIsEnabledChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010Item applicationMenu2010Item = d as ApplicationMenu2010Item;
			if (applicationMenu2010Item.IsSelectedTab && false.Equals(e.NewValue) && ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(applicationMenu2010Item) is ApplicationMenu2010 { IsOpen: not false } applicationMenu)
			{
				applicationMenu.VerifySelectedTabItem();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseClick(bool preventShiftFocus)
		{
			RoutedEventArgs args = new RoutedEventArgs(ClickEvent, this);
			bool skipClickFocusShift = _skipClickFocusShift;
			try
			{
				_skipClickFocusShift = preventShiftFocus;
				OnClick(args);
			}
			finally
			{
				_skipClickFocusShift = skipClickFocusShift;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyIsMouseOverTab(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Mouse.Captured != null && !base.IsMouseCaptureWithin)
			{
				ClearValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey);
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				ClearValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey);
				return;
			}
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(this, e.GetPosition(this));
			if (hitTestResult != null && hitTestResult.VisualHit != null)
			{
				SetValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(IsMouseOverTabPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
			Utilities.ExecuteCommand(this);
			if (ItemType == ApplicationMenu2010ItemType.Button)
			{
				if (!_skipClickFocusShift && GetCloseWhenClicked(this) && ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this) is ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu)
				{
					applicationMenu.Close();
				}
			}
			else if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter = ((ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this) is ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu2) ? applicationMenu2.SelectedTabContentHost : null);
				if (contentPresenter != null && !_skipClickFocusShift)
				{
					contentPresenter.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ApplicationMenu2010Separator : Separator
	{
		static ApplicationMenu2010Separator()
		{
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Separator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu2010Separator)));
		}
	}
	public class ElementKeyTipProvider
	{
		private class ElementKeyTip : IKeyTip, IKeyTipContainer
		{
			private FrameworkElement _element;

			public KeyTipAlignment Alignment { get; set; }

			public FrameworkElement Element => _element;

			public System.Windows.Point Location { get; set; }

			public Func<ElementKeyTip, bool> ActivateAction { get; set; }

			public KeyTipActivationBehavior ActivationBehavior { get; set; }

			public Action<ElementKeyTip> DeactivateAction { get; set; }

			public Func<ElementKeyTip, IKeyTip[]> GetKeyTipProvidersAction { get; set; }

			public string PreferredKeyTip { get; set; }

			KeyTipAlignment IKeyTip.Alignment => Alignment;

			string IKeyTip.AutoGeneratePrefix => "Y";

			string IKeyTip.Caption => GetDefaultCaption(_element);

			KeyTipActivationBehavior IKeyTip.ActivationBehavior => ActivationBehavior;

			bool IKeyTip.IsEnabled => _element.IsEnabled;

			bool IKeyTip.IsVisible => _element.IsVisible;

			string IKeyTip.KeyTipValue
			{
				get
				{
					string text = PreferredKeyTip;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = ApplicationMenu2010Item.GetElementKeyTip(_element);
					}
					return text;
				}
			}

			System.Windows.Point IKeyTip.Location => Location;

			char IKeyTip.Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(((IKeyTip)this).Caption);

			UIElement IKeyTip.AdornedElement => _element;

			char IKeyTip.DefaultPrefix => '\0';

			bool IKeyTip.CanAutoGenerateKeyTip => true;

			bool IKeyTipContainer.ReuseParentKeyTips => false;

			public ElementKeyTip(FrameworkElement element)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(element, "element");
				_element = element;
			}

			private static string GetDefaultCaption(object o)
			{
				if (o is HeaderedContentControl)
				{
					return GetDefaultCaption(((HeaderedContentControl)o).Header);
				}
				if (o is HeaderedItemsControl)
				{
					return GetDefaultCaption(((HeaderedItemsControl)o).Header);
				}
				if (o is ContentControl)
				{
					return GetDefaultCaption(((ContentControl)o).Content);
				}
				if (o is TextBlock)
				{
					return ((TextBlock)o).Text;
				}
				return o?.ToString();
			}

			bool IKeyTip.Activate()
			{
				if (GetKeyTipProvidersAction != null || ActivationBehavior != KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers)
				{
					_element.BringIntoView();
				}
				return ActivateAction?.Invoke(this) ?? true;
			}

			bool IKeyTip.Equals(IKeyTip provider)
			{
				if (provider is ElementKeyTip)
				{
					return ((ElementKeyTip)provider)._element == _element;
				}
				return false;
			}

			IKeyTipContainer IKeyTip.GetContainer()
			{
				if (GetKeyTipProvidersAction == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return this;
			}

			void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
			{
				if (DeactivateAction != null)
				{
					DeactivateAction(this);
				}
			}

			IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
			{
				IKeyTip[] array = null;
				if (GetKeyTipProvidersAction != null)
				{
					array = GetKeyTipProvidersAction(this);
				}
				return array ?? new IKeyTip[0];
			}
		}

		private string _keyTip;

		private static readonly MethodInfo _buttonOnClickMethod;

		public string KeyTip
		{
			get
			{
				return _keyTip;
			}
			set
			{
				RibbonToolHelper.ValidateKeyTip(value);
				_keyTip = value;
			}
		}

		static ElementKeyTipProvider()
		{
			try
			{
				_buttonOnClickMethod = typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase).GetMethod("AutomationButtonBaseClick", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual IKeyTip[] GetKeyTips(DependencyObject d)
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			AddDefaultKeyTips(list, d, KeyTip);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static IKeyTip[] GetDescendantKeyTips(DependencyObject source)
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			if (source != null)
			{
				AddDescendantKeyTips(source, list);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static bool HasDescendantKeyTips(DependencyObject source)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				return AddDescendantKeyTips(source, null);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, XamComboEditor cbo, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			if (cbo.IsEditable)
			{
				providers.Add(Create(cbo, FocusElement, KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips, preferredKeyTip));
				return;
			}
			ElementKeyTip item = Create(cbo, delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
			{
				t.Element.SetCurrentValue(XamComboEditor.IsDropDownOpenProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				t.Element.Focus();
				return true;
			}, KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips, preferredKeyTip);
			providers.Add(item);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, XamMaskedEditor ed, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(ed, preferredKeyTip);
			XamDateTimeEditor xamDateTimeEditor = ed as XamDateTimeEditor;
			if (ed.SpinButtonVisibilityResolved == Visibility.Visible || (xamDateTimeEditor != null && xamDateTimeEditor.AllowDropDown))
			{
				elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = FocusElement;
				elementKeyTip.GetKeyTipProvidersAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
				{
					t.Element.UpdateLayout();
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase spinDown;
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase dropDown;
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase spinUp = (spinDown = (dropDown = null));
					Utilities.GetTemplateChild(t.Element, delegate(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase e)
					{
						ICommand command = e.Command;
						if (command == MaskedEditorCommands.SpinUp)
						{
							spinUp = e;
						}
						else if (command == MaskedEditorCommands.SpinDown)
						{
							spinDown = e;
						}
						else if (command == MaskedEditorCommands.ToggleDropDown || e.Name == "PART_DropDownButton")
						{
							dropDown = e;
						}
						return false;
					});
					List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
					int num = 0;
					if (spinUp != null)
					{
						ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip2 = new ElementKeyTip(spinUp);
						int num2 = num + 1;
						num = num2;
						elementKeyTip2.PreferredKeyTip = num2.ToString();
						elementKeyTip2.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.BottomCenter;
						elementKeyTip2.Location = new System.Windows.Point(spinDown.ActualWidth / 2.0, spinDown.ActualHeight);
						elementKeyTip2.ActivationBehavior = KeyTipActivationBehavior.KeepCurrentKeyTips;
						elementKeyTip2.ActivateAction = (ElementKeyTip k) => ed.ExecuteCommand(MaskedEditorCommands.SpinUp);
						list.Add(elementKeyTip2);
					}
					if (spinDown != null)
					{
						ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip3 = new ElementKeyTip(spinDown);
						int num2 = num + 1;
						num = num2;
						elementKeyTip3.PreferredKeyTip = num2.ToString();
						elementKeyTip3.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter;
						elementKeyTip3.Location = new System.Windows.Point(spinDown.ActualWidth / 2.0, 0.0);
						elementKeyTip3.ActivationBehavior = KeyTipActivationBehavior.KeepCurrentKeyTips;
						elementKeyTip3.ActivateAction = (ElementKeyTip k) => ed.ExecuteCommand(MaskedEditorCommands.SpinDown);
						list.Add(elementKeyTip3);
					}
					if (dropDown != null)
					{
						ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip4 = new ElementKeyTip(dropDown);
						int num2 = num + 1;
						num = num2;
						elementKeyTip4.PreferredKeyTip = num2.ToString();
						elementKeyTip4.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter;
						elementKeyTip4.Location = CalculateDefaultLocation(dropDown, KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter);
						elementKeyTip4.ActivationBehavior = KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips;
						elementKeyTip4.ActivateAction = (ElementKeyTip k) => ed.ExecuteCommand(MaskedEditorCommands.ToggleDropDown);
						list.Add(elementKeyTip4);
					}
					return list.ToArray();
				};
			}
			else
			{
				elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = FocusElement;
				elementKeyTip.ActivationBehavior = KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips;
			}
			providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, Expander ex, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(ex, preferredKeyTip);
			elementKeyTip.GetKeyTipProvidersAction = (ElementKeyTip t) => GetDescendantKeyTips(t.Element);
			elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
			{
				t.Element.SetCurrentValue(Expander.IsExpandedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				t.Element.Focus();
				t.Element.UpdateLayout();
				return true;
			};
			providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, TabItem tab, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(tab, preferredKeyTip);
			switch (tab.TabStripPlacement)
			{
			case Dock.Top:
				elementKeyTip.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter;
				elementKeyTip.Location = new System.Windows.Point(tab.ActualWidth / 2.0, tab.ActualHeight);
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				elementKeyTip.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.BottomCenter;
				elementKeyTip.Location = new System.Windows.Point(tab.ActualWidth / 2.0, 0.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				elementKeyTip.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.MiddleLeft;
				elementKeyTip.Location = new System.Windows.Point(tab.ActualWidth, tab.ActualHeight / 2.0);
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				elementKeyTip.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.MiddleRight;
				elementKeyTip.Location = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, tab.ActualHeight / 2.0);
				break;
			}
			elementKeyTip.GetKeyTipProvidersAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
			{
				ContentPresenter templateChild = Utilities.GetTemplateChild(ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(t.Element), (ContentPresenter e) => e.IsVisible && (e.Name == "PART_SelectedContentHost" || e.Name == "PART_SelectedContentHostMinimized"));
				return GetDescendantKeyTips(templateChild);
			};
			elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
			{
				t.Element.SetCurrentValue(TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				t.Element.Focus();
				t.Element.UpdateLayout();
				return true;
			};
			providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, ItemsControl ic, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(preferredKeyTip))
			{
				preferredKeyTip = ApplicationMenu2010Item.GetElementKeyTip(ic);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(preferredKeyTip))
			{
				ElementKeyTip item = new ElementKeyTip(ic)
				{
					Location = new System.Windows.Point(4.0, 8.0),
					PreferredKeyTip = preferredKeyTip,
					Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.BottomRight,
					GetKeyTipProvidersAction = GetItemKeyTips
				};
				providers.Add(item);
				return;
			}
			ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = ic.ItemContainerGenerator;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = ic.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) is FrameworkElement d)
				{
					ElementKeyTipProvider keyTipProvider = ApplicationMenu2010Item.GetKeyTipProvider(d);
					if (keyTipProvider != null)
					{
						providers.AddRange(keyTipProvider.GetKeyTips(d));
					}
					else
					{
						AddDefaultKeyTips(providers, d, null);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, Slider slider, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(slider, preferredKeyTip);
			elementKeyTip.GetKeyTipProvidersAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
			{
				Track templateChild = Utilities.GetTemplateChild(t.Element, (Track e) => e.Name == "PART_Track");
				if (templateChild == null)
				{
					return GetDescendantKeyTips(t.Element);
				}
				List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
				bool flag = templateChild.Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
				Add(list, templateChild.DecreaseRepeatButton, "1", KeyTipActivationBehavior.KeepCurrentKeyTips, flag ? KeyTipAlignment.MiddleLeft : KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter);
				Add(list, templateChild.IncreaseRepeatButton, "2", KeyTipActivationBehavior.KeepCurrentKeyTips, flag ? KeyTipAlignment.MiddleRight : KeyTipAlignment.BottomCenter);
				return list.ToArray();
			};
			providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase btn, string preferredKeyTip, KeyTipActivationBehavior activationBehavior = KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips, KeyTipAlignment alignment = KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(btn, preferredKeyTip);
			elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = InvokeClick;
			elementKeyTip.ActivationBehavior = activationBehavior;
			elementKeyTip.Alignment = alignment;
			elementKeyTip.Location = CalculateDefaultLocation(btn, alignment);
			providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, ListBoxItem mi, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(mi, preferredKeyTip);
			elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
			{
				if (!(ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(t.Element) is System.Windows.Controls.ListBox { SelectionMode: System.Windows.Controls.SelectionMode.Single } listBox))
				{
					t.Element.SetCurrentValue(ListBoxItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					listBox.SetCurrentValue(Selector.SelectedItemProperty, listBox.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(t.Element));
				}
				t.Element.Focus();
				return true;
			};
			providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem mi, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(mi, preferredKeyTip);
			MenuItemRole role = mi.Role;
			if (role == MenuItemRole.TopLevelHeader || role == MenuItemRole.SubmenuHeader)
			{
				elementKeyTip.GetKeyTipProvidersAction = GetItemKeyTips;
				elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
				{
					t.Element.SetCurrentValue(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsSubmenuOpenProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					return true;
				};
				elementKeyTip.DeactivateAction = delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
				{
					t.Element.SetCurrentValue(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsSubmenuOpenProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				};
			}
			else
			{
				elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = InvokeClick;
				elementKeyTip.ActivationBehavior = ((!mi.StaysOpenOnClick) ? KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers : KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips);
			}
			providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox cbo, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			if (cbo.IsEditable)
			{
				providers.Add(Create(cbo, FocusElement, KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips, preferredKeyTip));
				return;
			}
			ElementKeyTip item = Create(cbo, delegate(ElementKeyTip t)
			{
				t.Element.SetCurrentValue(System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox.IsDropDownOpenProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				t.Element.Focus();
				return true;
			}, KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips, preferredKeyTip);
			providers.Add(item);
		}

		private static void Add(List<IKeyTip> providers, FrameworkElement fe, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			providers.Add(Create(fe, FocusElement, KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips, preferredKeyTip));
		}

		private static void AddDefaultKeyTips(List<IKeyTip> providers, DependencyObject d, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = d as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as System.Windows.Controls.ComboBox, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is XamMaskedEditor)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as XamMaskedEditor, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is XamComboEditor)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as XamComboEditor, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is Slider)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as Slider, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is TabItem)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as TabItem, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is ListBoxItem)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as ListBoxItem, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.TabControl || frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.ListBox || frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.Menu)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as ItemsControl, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is Expander)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement as Expander, preferredKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.GroupBox || frameworkElement is System.Windows.Controls.Panel || frameworkElement is Border)
			{
				ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(frameworkElement, preferredKeyTip);
				elementKeyTip.GetKeyTipProvidersAction = (ElementKeyTip t) => GetDescendantKeyTips(t.Element);
				elementKeyTip.Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.BottomRight;
				elementKeyTip.Location = new System.Windows.Point(4.0, 8.0);
				providers.Add(elementKeyTip);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.Focusable)
			{
				Add(providers, frameworkElement, preferredKeyTip);
			}
		}

		private static bool AddDescendantKeyTips(DependencyObject source, List<IKeyTip> providers)
		{
			if (!Utilities.IsUIElementOrUIElement3D(source))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(source); i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(source, i);
				if (child == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ElementKeyTipProvider keyTipProvider = ApplicationMenu2010Item.GetKeyTipProvider(child);
				if (keyTipProvider != null)
				{
					if (providers == null)
					{
						return true;
					}
					providers.AddRange(keyTipProvider.GetKeyTips(child));
				}
				else if (AddDescendantKeyTips(child, providers) && providers == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Point CalculateDefaultLocation(FrameworkElement fe, KeyTipAlignment alignment)
		{
			double x;
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case KeyTipAlignment.TopLeft:
			case KeyTipAlignment.MiddleLeft:
			case KeyTipAlignment.BottomLeft:
				x = 0.0;
				break;
			case KeyTipAlignment.TopRight:
			case KeyTipAlignment.MiddleRight:
			case KeyTipAlignment.BottomRight:
				x = fe.ActualWidth;
				break;
			default:
				x = fe.ActualWidth / 2.0;
				break;
			}
			double y;
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case KeyTipAlignment.BottomLeft:
			case KeyTipAlignment.BottomCenter:
			case KeyTipAlignment.BottomRight:
				y = fe.ActualHeight;
				break;
			case KeyTipAlignment.TopLeft:
			case KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter:
			case KeyTipAlignment.TopRight:
				y = 0.0;
				break;
			default:
				y = fe.ActualHeight / 2.0;
				break;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		private static ElementKeyTip Create(FrameworkElement element, Func<ElementKeyTip, bool> action, KeyTipActivationBehavior activationBehavior, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			ElementKeyTip elementKeyTip = Create(element, preferredKeyTip);
			elementKeyTip.ActivateAction = action;
			elementKeyTip.ActivationBehavior = activationBehavior;
			return elementKeyTip;
		}

		private static ElementKeyTip Create(FrameworkElement element, string preferredKeyTip)
		{
			return new ElementKeyTip(element)
			{
				PreferredKeyTip = preferredKeyTip,
				Alignment = KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter,
				Location = CalculateDefaultLocation(element, KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter)
			};
		}

		private static bool FocusElement(ElementKeyTip k)
		{
			k.Element.Focus();
			return k.Element.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
		}

		private static IKeyTip[] GetItemKeyTips(ElementKeyTip k)
		{
			ItemsControl ic = k.Element as ItemsControl;
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			Add(list, ic, null);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static bool InvokeClick(ElementKeyTip k)
		{
			FocusElement(k);
			if (_buttonOnClickMethod != null && k.Element is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase obj = k.Element as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase;
				_buttonOnClickMethod.Invoke(obj, null);
				return true;
			}
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(k.Element);
			if (automationPeer != null)
			{
				if (automationPeer.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Invoke) is IInvokeProvider invokeProvider)
				{
					try
					{
						invokeProvider.Invoke();
						return true;
					}
					catch (ElementNotEnabledException)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (automationPeer.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Toggle) is IToggleProvider toggleProvider)
				{
					try
					{
						toggleProvider.Toggle();
						return true;
					}
					catch (ElementNotEnabledException)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)

				if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)

					finalRect.Width = uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			UIElement uIElement = null;
			UIElement uIElement2 = null;
			System.Windows.Size result = default(System.Windows.Size);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement3 = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement3 != null && uIElement3.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					uIElement = uIElement3;
					break;
				}
			}
			for (int num = internalChildren.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UIElement uIElement4 = internalChildren[num];
				if (uIElement4 != null && uIElement4.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					uIElement2 = uIElement4;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (uIElement != _firstVisibleTool)
			{
				if (_firstVisibleTool != null)
				{
					_firstVisibleTool.ClearValue(IsFirstInButtonGroupPropertyKey);
				}
				_firstVisibleTool = uIElement;
				if (_firstVisibleTool != null)
				{
					_firstVisibleTool.SetValue(IsFirstInButtonGroupPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
			}
			if (uIElement2 != _lastVisibleTool)
			{
				if (_lastVisibleTool != null)
				{
					_lastVisibleTool.ClearValue(IsLastInButtonGroupPropertyKey);
				}
				_lastVisibleTool = uIElement2;
				if (_lastVisibleTool != null)
				{
					_lastVisibleTool.SetValue(IsLastInButtonGroupPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
			}
			int j = 0;
			for (int count2 = internalChildren.Count; j < count2; j++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement5 = internalChildren[j];
				if (uIElement5 != null && uIElement5.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)

					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement5.DesiredSize;
					result.Width += desiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, desiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)

				visualAdded.SetValue(IsInButtonGroupPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				visualAdded.CoerceValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty);
			}

	public class ContextualTabBaseColorToHoverBrushConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (targetType == null || !typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush).IsAssignableFrom(targetType))
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			if (!(value is System.Windows.Media.Color))
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			string text = (parameter as string) ?? "Blue";
			System.Windows.Media.Color baseColor = (System.Windows.Media.Color)value;
			switch (text)
			{
			case "Black":
			case "Silver":
				return GenerateSilverBrush(baseColor);
			default:
				return GenerateBlueBrush(baseColor);
			}
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}

		private RadialGradientBrush GenerateBlueBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color baseColor)
		{
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = new RadialGradientBrush();
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = baseColor;
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = baseColor;
			color.A = 0;
			color2.A = 190;
			GradientStop value = new GradientStop(color, 0.332);
			GradientStop value2 = new GradientStop(color2, 1.0);
			radialGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value);
			radialGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value2);
			ScaleTransform value3 = new ScaleTransform(2.083, 2.06, 0.5, 0.5);
			TranslateTransform value4 = new TranslateTransform(-0.008, -0.371);
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value3);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value4);
			radialGradientBrush.RelativeTransform = transformGroup;
			return radialGradientBrush;
		}

		private LinearGradientBrush GenerateSilverBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color baseColor)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, -0.004);
			linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(38, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue);
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = baseColor;
			System.Windows.Media.Color color3 = baseColor;
			color2.A = 69;
			color3.A = 150;
			GradientStop value = new GradientStop(color, 0.0);
			GradientStop value2 = new GradientStop(color2, 0.477);
			GradientStop value3 = new GradientStop(color3, 1.0);
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value);
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value2);
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value3);
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class DropDownToggle : ContentControl
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static DropDownToggle s_toggleWithLastMousePress;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDroppedDownProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsPressedPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsPressedProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool IsDroppedDown
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsDroppedDownProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsDroppedDownProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public bool IsPressed => (bool)GetValue(IsPressedProperty);

		static DropDownToggle()
		{
			IsDroppedDownProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDroppedDown", typeof(bool), typeof(DropDownToggle), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, OnIsDroppedDownChanged));
			IsPressedPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsPressed", typeof(bool), typeof(DropDownToggle), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsPressedProperty = IsPressedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(DropDownToggle), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(UIElement), Mouse.PreviewMouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseDown_ClassHandler), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(UIElement), Mouse.PreviewMouseUpEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseUp_ClassHandler), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(UIElement), Mouse.GotMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnGotMouseCapture_ClassHandler), handledEventsToo: true);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new DropDownToggleAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			if (this == s_toggleWithLastMousePress)
			{
				SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				ProcessMouseDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (Mouse.Captured == this)
			{
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
				SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				ResetToggleWithLastMousePress();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsDroppedDownChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is DropDownToggle dropDownToggle)
			{
				dropDownToggle.SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				bool? newValue = (bool?)e.NewValue;
				bool? oldValue = (bool?)e.OldValue;
				dropDownToggle.RaiseAutomationToggleStatePropertyChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		private static DropDownToggle GetDropDownToggleUnderMouse(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Popup popup = sender as Popup;
			if (popup == null)
			{
				if (!(e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(frameworkElement) != null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				popup = frameworkElement.Parent as Popup;
				if (popup == null || popup.StaysOpen)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = popup.TemplatedParent as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement2 == null)
			{
				frameworkElement2 = popup.PlacementTarget as FrameworkElement;
			}
			if (frameworkElement2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(frameworkElement2.InputHitTest(e.GetPosition(frameworkElement2)) is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			DropDownToggle dropDownToggle = dependencyObject as DropDownToggle;
			if (dropDownToggle == null)
			{
				dropDownToggle = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(DropDownToggle), allowSubclassOfType: true) as DropDownToggle;
			}
			return dropDownToggle;
		}

		private static void OnGotMouseCapture_ClassHandler(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			DropDownToggle dropDownToggle = Mouse.Captured as DropDownToggle;
			if (dropDownToggle == null)
			{
				ResetToggleWithLastMousePress();
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviewMouseDown_ClassHandler(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			ResetToggleWithLastMousePress();
			DropDownToggle dropDownToggleUnderMouse = GetDropDownToggleUnderMouse(sender, e);
			if (dropDownToggleUnderMouse != null && dropDownToggleUnderMouse.IsDroppedDown)
			{
				dropDownToggleUnderMouse.ProcessMouseDown(e);
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviewMouseUp_ClassHandler(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			ResetToggleWithLastMousePress();
			DropDownToggle dropDownToggleUnderMouse = GetDropDownToggleUnderMouse(sender, e);
			if (dropDownToggleUnderMouse != null && dropDownToggleUnderMouse.IsDroppedDown)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(IsDroppedDown = !IsDroppedDown))
			{
				CaptureMouse();
			}
			if (Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && Mouse.Captured == null && base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				s_toggleWithLastMousePress = this;
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void RaiseAutomationToggleStatePropertyChanged(bool? oldValue, bool? newValue)
		{
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is DropDownToggleAutomationPeer dropDownToggleAutomationPeer)
			{
				dropDownToggleAutomationPeer.RaiseToggleStatePropertyChangedEvent(oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		private static void ResetToggleWithLastMousePress()
		{
			if (Mouse.Captured is DropDownToggle dropDownToggle)
			{
				dropDownToggle.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
			if (s_toggleWithLastMousePress != null)
			{
				s_toggleWithLastMousePress.SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				s_toggleWithLastMousePress = null;
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class OuterGlowDecorator : Decorator
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GlowColorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GlowColor", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color), typeof(OuterGlowDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Colors.White, OnGlowSettingsChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GlowOpacityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GlowOpacity", typeof(double), typeof(OuterGlowDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.6, OnGlowSettingsChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsGlowVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsGlowVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(OuterGlowDecorator), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnGlowSettingsChanged));

		[Bindable(true)]
		public System.Windows.Media.Color GlowColor
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Color)GetValue(GlowColorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GlowColorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns or sets the opacity used for the glow.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Bindable(true)]
		public double GlowOpacity
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(GlowOpacityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GlowOpacityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool IsGlowVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsGlowVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsGlowVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			InvalidateVisual();
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeSize);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (IsGlowVisible)
			{
				DrawGlow(drawingContext);
			}
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
		}

		private void DrawGlow(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			UIElement child = Child;
			if (child == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect descendantBounds = VisualTreeHelper.GetDescendantBounds(child);
			if (descendantBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = descendantBounds.Size;
			if (size.Width < 1.0 || size.Height < 1.0 || GetValue(UIElement.BitmapEffectProperty) is OuterGlowBitmapEffect)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color glowColor = GlowColor;
			if (glowColor.A == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect rect = Rect.Inflate(descendantBounds, 6.0, 6.0);
			size = rect.Size;
			double glowOpacity = GlowOpacity;
			glowOpacity = Math.Max(glowOpacity * 0.9, 0.0);
			GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new GradientStopCollection(2);
			gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Offset = 0.0,
				Color = glowColor
			});
			gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Offset = 1.0,
				Color = Colors.Transparent
			});
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				Opacity = glowOpacity,
				GradientStops = gradientStopCollection
			};
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = new RadialGradientBrush
			{
				Opacity = glowOpacity,
				GradientStops = gradientStopCollection,
				RadiusX = 1.0,
				RadiusY = 1.0
			};
			double num = Math.Min(size.Height / 2.0, 12.0);
			double num2 = Math.Min(size.Width / 2.0, 12.0);
			double num3 = Math.Max(rect.Width - num2 * 2.0, 0.0);
			double num4 = Math.Max(rect.Height - num * 2.0, 0.0);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(rect.X, rect.Y, num2, num);
			GuidelineSet guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(rect.Left);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(rect.Left + num2);
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(rect.Right - num2);
			}
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(rect.Right);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(rect.Top);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(rect.Top + num);
			if (num4 > 0.0)
			{
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(rect.Bottom - num);
			}
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(rect.Bottom);
			drawingContext.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush2 = radialGradientBrush;
			System.Windows.Point center = (radialGradientBrush.GradientOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0));
			radialGradientBrush2.Center = center;
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(radialGradientBrush, null, rect2);
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(linearGradientBrush, null, new Rect(rect.X + num2, rect.Y, num3, num));
			}
			radialGradientBrush = radialGradientBrush.Clone();
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush3 = radialGradientBrush;
			center = (radialGradientBrush.GradientOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0));
			radialGradientBrush3.Center = center;
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(radialGradientBrush, null, Rect.Offset(rect2, size.Width - num2, 0.0));
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				linearGradientBrush = linearGradientBrush.Clone();
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(linearGradientBrush, null, new Rect(rect.X, rect.Y + num, num2, num4));
				if (num4 > 0.0)
				{
					drawingContext.DrawRectangle(new SolidColorBrush
					{
						Color = glowColor,
						Opacity = glowOpacity
					}, null, new Rect(rect.X + num2, rect.Y + num, num3, num4));
				}
				linearGradientBrush = linearGradientBrush.Clone();
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(linearGradientBrush, null, new Rect(rect.Right - num2, rect.Y + num, num2, num4));
			}
			radialGradientBrush = radialGradientBrush.Clone();
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush4 = radialGradientBrush;
			center = (radialGradientBrush.GradientOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0));
			radialGradientBrush4.Center = center;
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(radialGradientBrush, null, Rect.Offset(rect2, 0.0, size.Height - num));
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				linearGradientBrush = linearGradientBrush.Clone();
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(linearGradientBrush, null, new Rect(rect.X + num2, rect.Bottom - num, Math.Max(rect.Width - num2 * 2.0, 0.0), num));
			}
			radialGradientBrush = radialGradientBrush.Clone();
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush5 = radialGradientBrush;
			center = (radialGradientBrush.GradientOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			radialGradientBrush5.Center = center;
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(radialGradientBrush, null, Rect.Offset(rect2, size.Width - num2, size.Height - num));
			drawingContext.Pop();
		}

		private static void OnGlowSettingsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OuterGlowDecorator outerGlowDecorator = d as OuterGlowDecorator;
			outerGlowDecorator.VerifyOuterGlowBitmapEffect();
		}

		private void VerifyOuterGlowBitmapEffect()
		{
			if (!IsGlowVisible)
			{
				ClearValue(UIElement.BitmapEffectProperty);
			}
			else if (Environment.Version.Major < 4 && !BrowserInteropHelper.IsBrowserHosted)
			{
				try
				{
					OuterGlowBitmapEffect outerGlowBitmapEffect = new OuterGlowBitmapEffect();
					outerGlowBitmapEffect.Opacity = GlowOpacity;
					outerGlowBitmapEffect.GlowColor = GlowColor;
					SetValue(UIElement.BitmapEffectProperty, outerGlowBitmapEffect);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PopupOwnerProxy : DependencyObject
	{
		private class ClosePopupHelper
		{
			private DispatcherOperation _cancelSuppressOperation;

			private FrameworkElement _rootVisual;

			private XamRibbon _ribbon;

			private ClosePopupHelper(FrameworkElement rootVisual, XamRibbon ribbon)
			{
				_rootVisual = rootVisual;
				_ribbon = ribbon;
			}

			internal static void SuppressWindowMouseDown(XamRibbon ribbon)
			{
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Window.GetWindow(ribbon) ?? ribbon.TopLevelVisual;
					if (frameworkElement != null)
					{
						ClosePopupHelper closePopupHelper = new ClosePopupHelper(frameworkElement, ribbon);
						closePopupHelper.Initialize();
					}
				}
			}

			private void CancelSuppress()
			{
				_rootVisual.RemoveHandler(Mouse.PreviewMouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseDown));
				if (_cancelSuppressOperation.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Pending)
				{
					_cancelSuppressOperation.Abort();
				}
				_cancelSuppressOperation = null;
			}

			private void Initialize()
			{
				_rootVisual.AddHandler(Mouse.PreviewMouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseDown));
				_cancelSuppressOperation = _rootVisual.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new XamRibbon.MethodInvoker(CancelSuppress));
			}

			private void OnPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (sender == _rootVisual && (!(e.OriginalSource is DependencyObject d) || XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d) != _ribbon))
				{
					CancelSuppress();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private IRibbonPopupOwner _popupOwner;

		private FrameworkElement _popupTarget;

		private bool _restoreDocumentFocusOnClose;

		private Popup _hookedPopup;

		private PopupOpeningReason _openingReason;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsKeyboardFocusWithinProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsKeyboardFocusWithin", typeof(bool), typeof(PopupOwnerProxy), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsFocusWithinTargetChanged));

		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsKeyboardFocusWithinPopupProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsKeyboardFocusWithinPopup", typeof(bool), typeof(PopupOwnerProxy), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsFocusWithinTargetChanged));

		private Popup HookedPopup
		{
			get
			{
				return _hookedPopup;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_hookedPopup != value)
				{
					if (_hookedPopup != null)
					{
						_hookedPopup.KeyDown -= OnPopupKeyDown;
					}
					_hookedPopup = value;
					if (_hookedPopup != null)
					{
						_hookedPopup.KeyDown += OnPopupKeyDown;
						BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, IsKeyboardFocusWithinPopupProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithinProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _hookedPopup));
					}
					else
					{
						BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsKeyboardFocusWithinPopupProperty);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsOpen
		{
			get
			{
				return _popupOwner.IsOpen;
			}
			set
			{
				_popupOwner.IsOpen = value;
			}
		}

		private XamRibbon Ribbon => _popupOwner.Ribbon;

		public PopupOpeningReason OpeningReason => _openingReason;

		internal PopupOwnerProxy(IRibbonPopupOwner popupOwner)
		{
			if (popupOwner == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("popupOwner");
			}
			_popupOwner = popupOwner;
		}

		private static void OnIsFocusWithinTargetChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PopupOwnerProxy popupOwnerProxy = (PopupOwnerProxy)d;
			if (!false.Equals(e.NewValue) || !popupOwnerProxy.IsOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = popupOwnerProxy._popupTarget != null && popupOwnerProxy._popupTarget.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			bool flag2 = popupOwnerProxy._hookedPopup != null && popupOwnerProxy._hookedPopup.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				return;
			}
			Popup popup = ((Keyboard.FocusedElement is DependencyObject) ? (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) as Popup) : null);
			Popup popup2 = popup;
			UIElement popupTemplatedParent = popupOwnerProxy._popupOwner.PopupTemplatedParent;
			while (popup != null && popup.TemplatedParent != popupTemplatedParent)
			{
				popup2 = popup;
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(popup) ?? LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(popup) ?? popup.PlacementTarget;
				if (dependencyObject == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				popup = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) as Popup;
			}
			if (popup == null)
			{
				popup = popup2;
			}
			if (popup != null && popup.TemplatedParent == popupTemplatedParent)
			{
				if (popupOwnerProxy._hookedPopup == null && popupOwnerProxy._popupOwner.HookKeyDown)
				{
					popupOwnerProxy.HookedPopup = popup;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				popupOwnerProxy.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		private void FocusFirstItem()
		{
			_popupOwner.FocusFirstItem();
		}

		private void OnPopupKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessKeyDown(e);
		}

		private void OnPopupTargetKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessKeyDown(e);
		}

		private void OpenPopup(PopupOpeningReason reason)
		{
			try
			{
				_openingReason = reason;
				IsOpen = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				_openingReason = PopupOpeningReason.None;
			}
		}

		public static bool FocusFirstItem(ItemsControl itemsControl)
		{
			if (itemsControl == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("itemsControl");
			}
			ItemCollection items = itemsControl.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First);
			ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = itemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (!(dependencyObject is UIElement { IsVisible: not false } uIElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!uIElement.Focusable)
				{
					if (uIElement.MoveFocus(request))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (uIElement.IsEnabled)
				{
					return uIElement.Focus();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool FocusFirstItem(UIElementCollection children)
		{
			if (children == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("children");
			}
			int count = children.Count;
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[i];
				if (uIElement == null || !uIElement.IsVisible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!uIElement.Focusable)
				{
					if (uIElement.MoveFocus(request))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (uIElement.IsEnabled)
				{
					return uIElement.Focus();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool FocusFirstItem(DependencyObject ancestor)
		{
			if (ancestor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ancestor");
			}
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(ancestor);
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First);
			for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				if (!(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(ancestor, i) is UIElement { IsVisible: not false } uIElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!uIElement.Focusable)
				{
					if (uIElement.MoveFocus(request))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (uIElement.IsEnabled)
				{
					return uIElement.Focus();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool FocusLastItem(ItemsControl itemsControl)
		{
			if (itemsControl == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("itemsControl");
			}
			ItemCollection items = itemsControl.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First);
			ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = itemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(num);
				if (dependencyObject is UIElement { IsVisible: not false } uIElement)
				{
					if (!uIElement.Focusable)
					{
						if (uIElement.MoveFocus(request))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (uIElement.IsEnabled)
					{
						return uIElement.Focus();
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool FocusLastItem(UIElementCollection children)
		{
			if (children == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("children");
			}
			int count = children.Count;
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Last);
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[num];
				if (uIElement != null && uIElement.IsVisible)
				{
					if (!uIElement.Focusable)
					{
						if (uIElement.MoveFocus(request))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (uIElement.IsEnabled)
					{
						return uIElement.Focus();
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool FocusLastItem(DependencyObject ancestor)
		{
			if (ancestor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ancestor");
			}
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(ancestor);
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Last);
			for (int num = childrenCount - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(ancestor, num) is UIElement { IsVisible: not false } uIElement)
				{
					if (!uIElement.Focusable)
					{
						if (uIElement.MoveFocus(request))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (uIElement.IsEnabled)
					{
						return uIElement.Focus();
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Initialize(FrameworkElement popupTarget)
		{
			if (_popupTarget != null)
			{
				_popupTarget.KeyDown -= OnPopupTargetKeyDown;
			}
			_popupTarget = popupTarget;
			if (_popupTarget != null && _popupOwner.HookKeyDown)
			{
				_popupTarget.KeyDown += OnPopupTargetKeyDown;
			}
			if (_popupTarget != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, IsKeyboardFocusWithinProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithinProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, popupTarget));
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsKeyboardFocusWithinProperty);
			}
		}

		public void OnOpen()
		{
			if (_popupTarget != null)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = Ribbon;
				if (!_popupTarget.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					_popupTarget.Focus();
				}
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive)
				{
					(_popupOwner.ParentElementToFocus ?? _popupTarget)?.Focus();
				}
				if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(_popupTarget, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) is Popup d && XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d) == XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_popupTarget))
				{
					_restoreDocumentFocusOnClose = false;
				}
				else
				{
					_restoreDocumentFocusOnClose = ribbon != null && ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.Normal;
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnClose()
		{
			if (_popupTarget != null)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = Ribbon;
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					ClosePopupHelper.SuppressWindowMouseDown(ribbon);
					if (ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.Normal && _popupOwner.PopupTemplatedParent != null && _popupOwner.PopupTemplatedParent.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						_restoreDocumentFocusOnClose = true;
						if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(_popupTarget, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) is Popup d && XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d) == XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_popupTarget))
						{
							_restoreDocumentFocusOnClose = false;
						}
					}
					if (_restoreDocumentFocusOnClose)
					{
						ribbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
					}
				}
			}
			HookedPopup = null;
		}

		public void ProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Handled || _popupTarget == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			if (ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Tab:
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Up:
			case Key.Right:
			case Key.Down:
				if (IsOpen)
				{
					if (ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.Normal)
					{
						ribbon.EnterNavigationMode();
					}
					FrameworkElement parentElementToFocus = _popupOwner.ParentElementToFocus;
					if (parentElementToFocus != null && parentElementToFocus.IsKeyboardFocused)
					{
						FocusFirstItem();
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Key.System:
			{
				Key systemKey = e.SystemKey;
				if ((systemKey == Key.LeftAlt || systemKey == Key.RightAlt) && IsOpen)
				{
					IsOpen = false;
				}
				break;
			}
			case Key.Escape:
				if (IsOpen)
				{
					if (ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation && !_restoreDocumentFocusOnClose)
					{
						(_popupOwner.ParentElementToFocus ?? _popupTarget)?.Focus();
					}
					IsOpen = false;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Return:
			case Key.Space:
			case Key.F4:
				if (ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation)
				{
					FrameworkElement activeItem = ribbon.ActiveItem;
					if (_popupTarget == activeItem && _popupOwner.CanOpen && !IsOpen)
					{
						OpenPopup(PopupOpeningReason.Keyboard);
						FocusFirstItem();
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class RibbonButtonChrome : Decorator
	{
		[Flags]
		private enum RenderStates
		{
			Normal = 0,
			HotTracked = 1,
			Pressed = 2,
			Checked = 4,
			HotTrackedByOtherSegment = 8,
			Disabled = 0x10,
			IsOffice2013 = 0x20,
			IsMouseOverOtherSegment = 0x40
		}

		private class ChromeLayer
		{
			private DependencyProperty _brushProperty;

			private DependencyProperty _strokeProperty;

			private Rect _rect = Rect.Empty;

			private Geometry _geometry;

			private double _radius;

			private bool _allowRoundedCorners = true;

			public bool IsEmpty
			{
				get
				{
					if (_rect.IsEmpty)
					{
						return _geometry == null;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public bool AllowRoundedCorners
			{
				get
				{
					return _allowRoundedCorners;
				}
				set
				{
					_allowRoundedCorners = value;
				}
			}

			internal ChromeLayer(DependencyProperty brushProperty, DependencyProperty strokeProperty)
			{
				_brushProperty = brushProperty;
				_strokeProperty = strokeProperty;
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				_geometry = null;
				_rect = Rect.Empty;
			}

			public void Initialize(Rect elementRect, Thickness margins, double radius)
			{
				Initialize(elementRect, margins, radius, RoundedRectCorners.All);
			}

			public void Initialize(Rect elementRect, Thickness margins, double radius, RoundedRectCorners corners)
			{
				double edgeThickness = ((_strokeProperty != null) ? 1.0 : 0.0);
				Initialize(elementRect, margins, radius, corners, edgeThickness);
			}

			public void Initialize(Rect elementRect, Thickness margins, double radius, RoundedRectCorners corners, double edgeThickness)
			{
				Initialize(elementRect, margins, radius, corners, edgeThickness, RoundedRectSide.Left, RoundedRectSide.Left);
			}

			public void Initialize(Rect elementRect, Thickness margins, double radius, RoundedRectCorners corners, RoundedRectSide firstSide, RoundedRectSide lastSide)
			{
				double edgeThickness = ((_strokeProperty != null) ? 1.0 : 0.0);
				Initialize(elementRect, margins, radius, corners, edgeThickness, firstSide, lastSide);
			}

			public void Initialize(Rect elementRect, Thickness margins, double radius, RoundedRectCorners corners, double edgeThickness, RoundedRectSide firstSide, RoundedRectSide lastSide)
			{
				_rect = Subtract(elementRect, margins);
				_radius = radius;
				if (_allowRoundedCorners && ((corners != RoundedRectCorners.All && corners != RoundedRectCorners.None) || firstSide != lastSide))
				{
					_geometry = Utilities.CreateRoundedRectGeometry(_rect, corners, radius, radius, edgeThickness, firstSide, lastSide);
					if (_geometry != null && _geometry.CanFreeze)
					{
						_geometry.Freeze();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!_allowRoundedCorners || corners == RoundedRectCorners.None)
					{
						_radius = 0.0;
					}
					_geometry = null;
				}
			}

			public void Initialize(Geometry geometry)
			{
				_geometry = geometry;
				if (_geometry != null && _geometry.CanFreeze)
				{
					_geometry.Freeze();
				}
				_rect = Rect.Empty;
				_radius = 0.0;
			}

			public void Draw(DrawingContext drawingContext, RibbonButtonChrome chrome)
			{
				if (_rect.IsEmpty && _geometry == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ((_brushProperty != null) ? (chrome.GetValue(_brushProperty) as System.Windows.Media.Brush) : null);
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = ((_strokeProperty != null) ? (chrome.GetValue(_strokeProperty) as System.Windows.Media.Brush) : null);
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = ((brush2 != null) ? new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush2, 1.0) : null);
				if (pen == null && brush == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (_geometry == null)
				{
					Rect rectangle = _rect;
					if (pen != null)
					{
						double num = pen.Thickness / 2.0;
						rectangle = Rect.Inflate(_rect, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
					}
					if (_radius > 0.0)
					{
						drawingContext.DrawRoundedRectangle(brush, pen, rectangle, _radius, _radius);
					}
					else
					{
						drawingContext.DrawRectangle(brush, pen, rectangle);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					drawingContext.DrawGeometry(brush, pen, _geometry);
				}
			}
		}
