	[ContentProperty("Child")]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class GalleryPreviewScroller : FrameworkElement
	{
		private UIElement _child;

		private GalleryToolPreviewPresenter _containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter;

		private TranslateTransform _childTransform;

		private double _verticalOffset;

		private int _animationCount;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand DropdownGalleryCommand;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand ScrollUpCommand;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand ScrollDownCommand;

		private const double SCROLL_ANIMATION_DURATION_MILLISECONDS = 300.0;

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (_child != null)
				{
					return new SingleItemEnumerator(_child);
				}
				return EmptyEnumerator.Instance;
			}
		}

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_child == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public UIElement Child
		{
			get
			{
				return _child;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _child)
				{
					UIElement child = _child;
					if (_child != null)
					{
						RemoveVisualChild(_child);
						RemoveLogicalChild(_child);
						_child.RenderTransform = Transform.Identity;
						_childTransform = null;
						ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
					}
					_child = value;
					if (_child != null)
					{
						AddVisualChild(_child);
						AddLogicalChild(_child);
						_child.RenderTransform = (_childTransform = new TranslateTransform());
					}
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		private GalleryToolPreviewPresenter ContainingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter
		{
			get
			{
				if (_containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter == null)
				{
					_containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter = (GalleryToolPreviewPresenter)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(GalleryToolPreviewPresenter), allowSubclassOfType: true);
				}
				return _containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter;
			}
		}

		private double MaxVerticalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (_child is GalleryWrapPanel galleryWrapPanel && base.VerticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch)
				{
					double num = galleryWrapPanel.CalculateFullyVisibleRowAreaHeight(base.RenderSize);
					return Math.Max(Child.RenderSize.Height - num, 0.0);
				}
				if (Child != null)
				{
					return Child.RenderSize.Height - ScrollAmount;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		private double ScrollAmount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_child is GalleryWrapPanel && base.VerticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch)
				{
					return ((GalleryWrapPanel)_child).ItemHeight;
				}
				return base.ActualHeight;
			}
		}

		private double VerticalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (_childTransform == null)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return 0.0 - _verticalOffset;
			}
		}

		static GalleryPreviewScroller()
		{
			DropdownGalleryCommand = new RoutedCommand("DropdownGallery", typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller));
			ScrollUpCommand = new RoutedCommand("ScrollUp", typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller));
			ScrollDownCommand = new RoutedCommand("ScrollDown", typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), new CommandBinding(DropdownGalleryCommand, OnExecuteCommand, OnCanExecuteCommand));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassInputBinding(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), new InputBinding(DropdownGalleryCommand, new KeyGesture(Key.F4)));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), new CommandBinding(ScrollUpCommand, OnExecuteCommand, OnCanExecuteCommand));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), new CommandBinding(ScrollDownCommand, OnExecuteCommand, OnCanExecuteCommand));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), FrameworkElement.RequestBringIntoViewEvent, new RequestBringIntoViewEventHandler(OnRequestBringIntoView));
			UIElement.ClipToBoundsProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentCenterBox));
			FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryPreviewScroller), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentCenterBox));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (_child != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size desiredSize = _child.DesiredSize;
				Rect rect = new Rect(desiredSize);
				if (_child is GalleryWrapPanel galleryWrapPanel)
				{
					double num = galleryWrapPanel.CalculateFullyVisibleRowAreaHeight(finalSize);
					if (base.VerticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch)
					{
						rect.Y = (finalSize.Height - num) / 2.0;
						Rect rect2 = rect;
						rect2.Height = num;
						RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(rect2);
						rectangleGeometry.Freeze();
						base.Clip = rectangleGeometry;
					}
					else
					{
						ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
					}
				}
				_child.Arrange(rect);
				if (_childTransform != null && _animationCount == 0)
				{
					double num2 = VerticalOffset;
					if (num2 < 0.0)
					{
						num2 = 0.0;
					}
					else if (num2 > MaxVerticalOffset)
					{
						num2 = MaxVerticalOffset;
					}
					if (VerticalOffset != num2)
					{
						AnimateVerticalOffset(num2);
					}
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (_child == null || index != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			return _child;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = default(System.Windows.Size);
			if (_child != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(constraint.Width, double.PositiveInfinity);
				_child.Measure(availableSize);
				result = _child.DesiredSize;
				double num = double.NaN;
				if (_child is GalleryWrapPanel)
				{
					num = ((GalleryWrapPanel)_child).CalculateFullyVisibleRowAreaHeight(constraint);
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					result.Height = num;
					if (base.VerticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch && CoreUtilities.GreaterThan(result.Height, constraint.Height))
					{
						result.Height = constraint.Height;
					}
				}
				else if (constraint.Height < result.Height)
				{
					result.Height = constraint.Height;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void AnimateVerticalOffset(double newVerticalOffset)
		{
			if (_childTransform != null)
			{
				_verticalOffset = 0.0 - newVerticalOffset;
				_animationCount++;
				TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300.0);
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(0.0 - newVerticalOffset, new Duration(timeSpan));
				doubleAnimation.Completed += OnTransformAnimationCompleted;
				_childTransform.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, doubleAnimation, HandoffBehavior.Compose);
			}
		}

		private void CloseMenu()
		{
			GalleryToolPreviewPresenter containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter = ContainingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter;
			if (containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter != null)
			{
				MenuToolBase menuTool = containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter.MenuTool;
				if (menuTool != null && menuTool.IsOpen)
				{
					menuTool.IsOpen = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnCanExecuteCommand(object target, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!(target is GalleryPreviewScroller galleryPreviewScroller))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.Command == DropdownGalleryCommand)
			{
				GalleryToolPreviewPresenter containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter = galleryPreviewScroller.ContainingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter;
				if (containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter != null && containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter.MenuTool != null)
				{
					args.CanExecute = !containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter.MenuTool.IsOpen;
				}
				else
				{
					args.CanExecute = false;
				}
			}
			else if (args.Command == ScrollUpCommand)
			{
				args.CanExecute = galleryPreviewScroller.VerticalOffset != 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				if (args.Command != ScrollDownCommand)
				{
					return;
				}
				args.CanExecute = galleryPreviewScroller.VerticalOffset < galleryPreviewScroller.MaxVerticalOffset;
			}
			args.Handled = true;
		}

		private static void OnExecuteCommand(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!(target is GalleryPreviewScroller galleryPreviewScroller))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.Command == DropdownGalleryCommand)
			{
				GalleryToolPreviewPresenter containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter = galleryPreviewScroller.ContainingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter;
				if (containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter != null && containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter.MenuTool != null)
				{
					args.Handled = true;
					containingGalleryToolPreviewPresenter.MenuTool.IsOpen = true;
				}
			}
			else if (args.Command == ScrollUpCommand)
			{
				galleryPreviewScroller.CloseMenu();
				galleryPreviewScroller.AnimateVerticalOffset(Math.Max(galleryPreviewScroller.VerticalOffset - galleryPreviewScroller.ScrollAmount, 0.0));
				args.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (args.Command == ScrollDownCommand)
			{
				galleryPreviewScroller.CloseMenu();
				galleryPreviewScroller.AnimateVerticalOffset(Math.Min(galleryPreviewScroller.MaxVerticalOffset, galleryPreviewScroller.VerticalOffset + galleryPreviewScroller.ScrollAmount));
				args.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnRequestBringIntoView(object sender, RequestBringIntoViewEventArgs e)
		{
			GalleryPreviewScroller galleryPreviewScroller = sender as GalleryPreviewScroller;
			if (e.TargetObject is Visual visual && visual != galleryPreviewScroller && visual.IsDescendantOf(galleryPreviewScroller))
			{
				Rect rect = e.TargetRect;
				if (rect.IsEmpty && visual is UIElement)
				{
					rect = new Rect(((UIElement)visual).RenderSize);
				}
				rect = visual.TransformToAncestor(galleryPreviewScroller._child).TransformBounds(rect);
				double num = galleryPreviewScroller.VerticalOffset;
				double actualHeight = galleryPreviewScroller.ActualHeight;
				if (rect.Y < num)
				{
					num -= Math.Ceiling((num - rect.Y) / actualHeight) * actualHeight;
				}
				else if (rect.Bottom >= num + actualHeight)
				{
					num += Math.Ceiling((rect.Bottom - (num + actualHeight)) / actualHeight) * actualHeight;
				}
				if (rect.Bottom >= num + actualHeight)
				{
					num += rect.Bottom - (num + actualHeight);
				}
				if (rect.Y < num)
				{
					num -= num - rect.Y;
				}
				num = Math.Max(Math.Min(galleryPreviewScroller.MaxVerticalOffset, num), 0.0);
				if (num != galleryPreviewScroller.VerticalOffset)
				{
					galleryPreviewScroller.AnimateVerticalOffset(num);
					e.Handled = true;
					rect.Y += num;
					rect = galleryPreviewScroller._child.TransformToAncestor(galleryPreviewScroller).TransformBounds(rect);
					galleryPreviewScroller.BringIntoView(rect);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTransformAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_animationCount--;
			((AnimationClock)sender).Completed -= OnTransformAnimationCompleted;
			InvalidateVisual();
			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class GalleryToolDropDownPresenter : ItemsControl
	{
		internal enum ItemsType
		{
			None,
			Groups,
			Items
		}

		private GalleryTool _galleryTool;

		private ItemsType _itemsType;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsFirstInMenuPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFirstInMenuProperty;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsLastInMenuPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsLastInMenuProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey VerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty VerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty AllowResizeProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public bool IsFirstInMenu => (bool)GetValue(IsFirstInMenuProperty);

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public bool IsLastInMenu => (bool)GetValue(IsLastInMenuProperty);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[Bindable(true)]
		public ScrollBarVisibility VerticalScrollBarVisibility => (ScrollBarVisibility)GetValue(VerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty);

		internal ItemsType DropDownItemsType
		{
			get
			{
				return _itemsType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _itemsType)
				{
					_itemsType = value;
					SetItemsPanel();
				}
			}
		}

		internal GalleryTool GalleryTool => _galleryTool;

		internal GalleryToolDropDownPresenter(GalleryTool galleryTool)
		{
			_galleryTool = galleryTool;
			if (_galleryTool != null)
			{
				SetBinding(AllowResizeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(GalleryTool.AllowResizeDropDownProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, galleryTool));
			}
		}

		static GalleryToolDropDownPresenter()
		{
			IsFirstInMenuPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsFirstInMenu", typeof(bool), typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsFirstInMenuProperty = IsFirstInMenuPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsLastInMenuPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsLastInMenu", typeof(bool), typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsLastInMenuProperty = IsLastInMenuPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			VerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("VerticalScrollBarVisibility", typeof(ScrollBarVisibility), typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityVisibleBox));
			VerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty = VerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AllowResizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowResize", typeof(bool), typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, OnAllowResizeChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is GalleryItemPresenter)
			{
				((GalleryItemPresenter)element).ClearContainerForItem(item as GalleryItem);
			}
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			if (DropDownItemsType == ItemsType.Items)
			{
				return new GalleryItemPresenter(isInPreviewArea: false, _galleryTool, null);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), base.RenderSize);
			if (rect.Contains(hitTestParameters.HitPoint))
			{
				return new PointHitTestResult(this, hitTestParameters.HitPoint);
			}
			return base.HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			if (DropDownItemsType == ItemsType.Items)
			{
				return item is GalleryItemPresenter;
			}
			if (DropDownItemsType == ItemsType.Groups)
			{
				return item is GalleryItemGroup;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new GalleryToolDropDownPresenterAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnLostKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostKeyboardFocus(e);
			if (_galleryTool != null && e.Source == this)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.NewFocus as DependencyObject;
				while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
				{
					dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (dependencyObject == null || !IsAncestorOf(dependencyObject))
				{
					_galleryTool.OnMouseLeaveItemArea(this);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			if (GalleryTool != null)
			{
				GalleryTool.OnMouseEnterItemArea(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			if (GalleryTool != null)
			{
				GalleryTool.OnMouseLeaveItemArea(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is GalleryItemPresenter)
			{
				((GalleryItemPresenter)element).PrepareContainerForItem(item as GalleryItem);
			}
		}

		private static void OnAllowResizeChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is GalleryToolDropDownPresenter galleryToolDropDownPresenter)
			{
				if ((bool)e.NewValue)
				{
					galleryToolDropDownPresenter.ClearValue(VerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey);
				}
				else
				{
					galleryToolDropDownPresenter.SetValue(VerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityAutoBox);
				}
			}
		}

		internal GalleryItemPresenter GetFirstPresenterForItem(GalleryItem item)
		{
			Utilities.DependencyObjectSearchCallback<GalleryItemPresenter> callback = (GalleryItemPresenter presenter) => item == presenter.Item;
			return Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, allowSubclassOfType: true, callback);
		}

		private void SetItemsPanel()
		{
			FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(StackPanel));
			switch (DropDownItemsType)
			{
			case ItemsType.Groups:
				frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(StackPanel));
				break;
			case ItemsType.Items:
				frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(GalleryWrapPanel));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetBinding(GalleryWrapPanel.MinColumnsProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(GalleryTool.MinDropDownColumnsProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _galleryTool));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetBinding(GalleryWrapPanel.MaxColumnsProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(GalleryTool.MaxDropDownColumnsProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _galleryTool));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetBinding(GalleryWrapPanel.PreferredColumnsProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(GalleryTool.PreferredDropDownColumnsProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _galleryTool));
				break;
			}
			ItemsPanelTemplate itemsPanelTemplate = new ItemsPanelTemplate();
			itemsPanelTemplate.VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory;
			base.ItemsPanel = itemsPanelTemplate;
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_DropDownButton", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class GalleryToolPreviewPresenter : ItemsControl
	{
		private GalleryTool _galleryTool;

		internal double CalculateFullyVisibleRowAreaHeight(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (!base.IsMeasureValid)
			{
				Measure(constraint);
			}
			Thickness margin = base.Margin;
			constraint.Width -= margin.Left + margin.Right;
			constraint.Height -= margin.Top + margin.Bottom;
			double rowSpacing = RowSpacing;
			int num = Math.Min(_calcRowCount, Math.Max(1, (int)((constraint.Height + rowSpacing) / (_itemSize.Height + rowSpacing))));
			double num2 = (double)num * (_itemSize.Height + rowSpacing) - rowSpacing;
			return num2 + (margin.Top + margin.Bottom);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size DoLayout(int columnCount, System.Windows.Size itemSize, bool positionChildren, double availableHeight, out int rowCount)
		{
			return DoLayout(columnCount, itemSize, positionChildren, availableHeight, 0, int.MaxValue, double.NaN, out rowCount);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size DoLayout(int columnCount, System.Windows.Size itemSize, bool positionChildren, double availableHeight, int firstRowInView, int lastRowInView, double preferredFirstRowOffset, out int rowCount)
		{
			rowCount = 0;
			int num = 0;
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			double columnSpacing = ColumnSpacing;
			double rowSpacing = RowSpacing;
			int num2 = ((double.IsInfinity(availableHeight) || itemSize.Height == 0.0) ? int.MaxValue : ((int)((availableHeight + rowSpacing) / (itemSize.Height + rowSpacing))));
			double x = 0.0;
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(x, 0.0, itemSize.Width, itemSize.Height);
			GalleryTool galleryTool = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (galleryTool == null && uIElement is GalleryItemPresenter)
				{
					galleryTool = ((GalleryItemPresenter)uIElement).GalleryTool;
				}
				int num3 = (int)uIElement.GetValue(ColumnSpanProperty);
				if (num3 + num > columnCount)
				{
					rowCount++;
					num = 0;
					if (positionChildren)
					{
						finalRect.X = x;
						finalRect.Y += itemSize.Height + rowSpacing;
						if (rowCount == firstRowInView)
						{
							finalRect.Y = preferredFirstRowOffset;
						}
						else if (rowCount == lastRowInView + 1)
						{
							finalRect.Y = availableHeight + rowSpacing;
						}
					}
				}
				if (positionChildren)
				{
					finalRect.Width = itemSize.Width * (double)num3 + (double)(num3 - 1) * columnSpacing;
					uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
					finalRect.X += finalRect.Width + columnSpacing;
				}
				num += num3;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				rowCount++;
			}
			if (positionChildren && _isInDropDown && galleryTool != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size measuredItemSize = galleryTool.MeasuredItemSize;
				measuredItemSize.Width += Math.Max(galleryTool.DesiredSize.Width - base.DesiredSize.Width, 0.0);
				PopupResizerDecorator.Constraints constraints = PopupResizerDecorator.GetResizeConstraints(galleryTool);
				if (constraints == null)
				{
					constraints = new PopupResizerDecorator.Constraints();
					PopupResizerDecorator.SetResizeConstraints(galleryTool, constraints);
				}
				if (galleryTool.Groups.Count > 0 && ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this) is GalleryItemGroup galleryItemGroup)
				{
					measuredItemSize.Height += Math.Max(galleryItemGroup.DesiredSize.Height - base.DesiredSize.Height, 0.0);
				}
				constraints.MinimumWidth = measuredItemSize.Width;
				constraints.MinimumHeight = measuredItemSize.Height;
			}
			double width = (itemSize.Width + columnSpacing) * (double)columnCount - columnSpacing;
			double height = Math.Max((itemSize.Height + rowSpacing) * (double)rowCount - rowSpacing, 0.0);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private static bool ValidateIsPositiveInt(object value)
		{
			if (value is int)
			{
				return (int)value > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ValidateIsPositiveDouble(object value)
		{
			if (value is double num)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					return num > 0.0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ValidateIsAtLeastZero(object value)
		{
			if (value is double num)
			{
				return num >= 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ValidateIsAtLeastZeroInt(object value)
		{
			if (value is int num)
			{
				return num >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public GroupVariantResizeAction ResizeAction
		{
			get
			{
				return (GroupVariantResizeAction)GetValue(ResizeActionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ResizeActionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static GroupVariant()
		{
			PriorityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Priority", typeof(int), typeof(GroupVariant), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			ResizeActionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ResizeAction", typeof(GroupVariantResizeAction), typeof(GroupVariant), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(GroupVariantResizeAction.CollapseRibbonGroup));
		}

		public GroupVariant()
		{
		}

		private GroupVariant(GroupVariantResizeAction size)
		{
			ResizeAction = size;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(e.Property.Name);
		}

		internal static GroupVariant GetDefaultVariant(GroupVariantResizeAction size)
		{
			int num = (int)size;
			if (_cachedVariants == null)
			{
				_cachedVariants = new GroupVariant[Enum.GetValues(typeof(GroupVariantResizeAction)).Length];
			}
			if (num > _cachedVariants.Length)
			{
				size = GroupVariantResizeAction.CollapseRibbonGroup;
				num = (int)size;
			}
			if (_cachedVariants[num] == null)
			{
				_cachedVariants[num] = new GroupVariant(size);
			}
			return _cachedVariants[num];
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class KeyTip : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private KeyTipManager _keyTipManager;

		private Rect _rect = Rect.Empty;

		private IKeyTip _provider;

		private const string DefaultKeyTip = "O";

		private string _value = "O";

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsKeyTipVisiblePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsKeyTipVisibleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty;

		internal bool ShouldDisplayKeyTip
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_provider.IsVisible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_value))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return _value.StartsWith(_keyTipManager.CurrentKeyTipValue);
			}
		}

		internal IKeyTip Provider => _provider;

		internal Rect Rect
		{
			get
			{
				if (_rect.IsEmpty || !base.IsMeasureValid)
				{
					Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					_rect = GetRect(Provider.Location, base.DesiredSize, Provider.Alignment);
					if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) is Adorner adorner)
					{
						_rect = XamRibbon.TryTransformToVisual(Provider.AdornedElement, adorner.AdornedElement, _rect) ?? default(Rect);
					}
				}
				return _rect;
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static KeyTip()
		{
			IsKeyTipVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyUtilities.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("IsKeyTipVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(KeyTip), KnownBoxes.FalseBox, null);
			IsKeyTipVisibleProperty = IsKeyTipVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(string), typeof(KeyTip), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("O", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnValueChanged, CoerceValue));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(KeyTip), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(KeyTip)));
			UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(KeyTip), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			System.Windows.Controls.Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(KeyTip), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentCenterBox));
			System.Windows.Controls.Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(KeyTip), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentCenterBox));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(KeyTip), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		internal KeyTip(KeyTipManager keyTipManager, IKeyTip provider)
		{
			_keyTipManager = keyTipManager;
			_provider = provider;
			base.IsEnabled = provider.IsEnabled;
			Value = null;
			base.IsVisibleChanged += OnIsVisibleChanged;
		}

		public KeyTip()
		{
		}

		private void OnIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyIsKeyTipVisible();
		}

		private void VerifyIsKeyTipVisible()
		{
			bool isVisible = base.IsVisible;
			UIElement adornedElement = _provider.AdornedElement;
			if (adornedElement != null)
			{
				SetIsKeyTipVisible(adornedElement, isVisible);
			}
		}

		private static Rect GetRect(System.Windows.Point location, System.Windows.Size size, KeyTipAlignment alignment)
		{
			System.Windows.Point location2 = default(System.Windows.Point);
			int num = (int)alignment;
			if ((num & 0xF) != 0)
			{
				location2.Y = location.Y;
			}
			else if ((num & 0xF0) != 0)
			{
				location2.Y = location.Y - size.Height / 2.0;
				num >>= 4;
			}
			else
			{
				location2.Y = location.Y - size.Height;
				num >>= 8;
			}
			switch (num & 0xF)
			{
			case 1:
				location2.X = location.X;
				break;
			case 2:
				location2.X = location.X - size.Width / 2.0;
				break;
			default:
				location2.X = location.X - size.Width;
				break;
			}
			return new Rect(location2, size);
		}

		public static bool GetIsKeyTipVisible(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsKeyTipVisibleProperty);
		}

		private static void SetIsKeyTipVisible(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d.SetValue(IsKeyTipVisiblePropertyKey, value);
		}

		private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is KeyTip keyTip)
			{
				keyTip._value = (string)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceValue(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(newValue is string text))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			CultureInfo culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			if (d.GetValue(FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty) is XmlLanguage xmlLanguage)
			{
				try
				{
					culture = xmlLanguage.GetEquivalentCulture();
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
				}
			}
			return text.ToUpper(culture);
		}
	}
	internal class KeyTipAdorner : Adorner
	{
		private List<KeyTip> _keyTips;

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount => _keyTips.Count;

		internal KeyTipAdorner(UIElement adornedElement)
			: base(adornedElement)
		{
			_keyTips = new List<KeyTip>();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(finalSize);
			foreach (KeyTip keyTip in _keyTips)
			{
				Rect rect2 = keyTip.Rect;
				if (rect2.Bottom > rect.Bottom)
				{
					rect2.Y -= rect2.Bottom - rect.Bottom;
				}
				if (rect2.Y < rect.Top)
				{
					rect2.Y += rect.Top - rect2.Y;
				}
				if (rect2.Right > rect.Right)
				{
					rect2.X -= rect2.Right - rect.Right;
				}
				if (rect2.X < rect.Left)
				{
					rect2.X += rect.Left - rect2.Left;
				}
				keyTip.Arrange(rect2);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= _keyTips.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			return _keyTips[index];
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return base.AdornedElement.RenderSize;
		}

		internal void Add(KeyTip keyTip)
		{
			_keyTips.Add(keyTip);
			AddVisualChild(keyTip);
		}

		internal void RefreshKeyTipVisibility()
		{
			foreach (KeyTip keyTip in _keyTips)
			{
				if (keyTip.ShouldDisplayKeyTip)
				{
					keyTip.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					keyTip.SetValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class KeyTipCollection : ICollection<KeyTip>, IEnumerable<KeyTip>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class KeyTipComparer : IComparer<KeyTip>
		{
			int IComparer<KeyTip>.Compare(KeyTip keyTip1, KeyTip keyTip2)
			{
				if (keyTip1 == null && keyTip2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (keyTip2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (keyTip1 == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return string.Compare(keyTip1.Value, keyTip2.Value);
			}
		}

		private KeyTipManager owningManager;

		private List<KeyTip> keyTipList = new List<KeyTip>();

		private KeyTipComparer keyTipComparer = new KeyTipComparer();

		public KeyTip this[int index] => keyTipList[index];

		public int Count => keyTipList.Count;

		bool ICollection<KeyTip>.IsReadOnly => false;

		public KeyTipCollection(KeyTipManager owningManager)
		{
			this.owningManager = owningManager;
		}

		public int Add(KeyTip keyTip)
		{
			int count = Count;
			keyTipList.Add(keyTip);
			return count;
		}

		public KeyTipCollection Clone()
		{
			KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection = new KeyTipCollection(owningManager);
			keyTipCollection.keyTipList = new List<KeyTip>(keyTipList);
			return keyTipCollection;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int i)
		{
			keyTipList.RemoveAt(i);
		}

		internal KeyTip Search(IKeyTip provider)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					KeyTip keyTip = (KeyTip)enumerator.Current;
					if (keyTip.Provider.Equals(provider))
					{
						return keyTip;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			CoreUtilities.SortMergeGeneric(keyTipList, keyTipComparer);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return keyTipList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection<KeyTip>.Add(KeyTip item)
		{
			Add(item);
		}

		void ICollection<KeyTip>.Clear()
		{
			keyTipList.Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<KeyTip>.Contains(KeyTip item)
		{
			return keyTipList.Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<KeyTip>.CopyTo(KeyTip[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			keyTipList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		bool ICollection<KeyTip>.Remove(KeyTip item)
		{
			return keyTipList.Remove(item);
		}

		IEnumerator<KeyTip> IEnumerable<KeyTip>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return keyTipList.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class KeyTipManager
	{
		private IKeyTipContainer _currentKeyTipContainer;

		private KeyTipCollection _currentKeyTips;

		private List<KeyTipAdorner> _currentAdorners;

		private bool isHiding;

		private Stack<IKeyTipContainer> _parentContainers;

		private Stack<KeyTipCollection> _parentKeyTips;

		private Stack<List<KeyTipAdorner>> _parentAdorners;

		private IKeyTipContainer _startingKeyTipContainer;

		private XamRibbon _ribbon;

		private string _currentKeyTipValue = string.Empty;

		private IKeyTip _providerPendingActivation;

		private DispatcherTimer _showKeyTipsTimer;

		private object _minKeyTipWidth;

		private IKeyTipContainer _keyTipContainerBeingDeactivated;

		private HashSet _registeredAccessKeys = new HashSet();

		private int _accessKeyVersion;

		private int _processedAccessKeyVersion = -1;

		private const int ShowDelay = 1000;

		public List<KeyTipAdorner> CurrentAdorners
		{
			get
			{
				if (_currentAdorners == null)
				{
					_currentAdorners = new List<KeyTipAdorner>();
				}
				return _currentAdorners;
			}
		}

		public int CurrentContainerLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (_parentContainers != null)
				{
					return _parentContainers.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private KeyTipCollection CurrentKeyTips
		{
			get
			{
				if (_currentKeyTips == null)
				{
					_currentKeyTips = new KeyTipCollection(this);
					_accessKeyVersion++;
				}
				return _currentKeyTips;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_currentKeyTips != value)
				{
					_currentKeyTips = value;
					_accessKeyVersion++;
				}
			}
		}

		public string CurrentKeyTipValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentKeyTipValue;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (value != _currentKeyTipValue)
				{
					_currentKeyTipValue = value;
					_accessKeyVersion++;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsActive => _currentKeyTipContainer != null;

		public bool IsHiding => isHiding;

		public bool IsShowPending
		{
			get
			{
				if (_showKeyTipsTimer != null)
				{
					return _showKeyTipsTimer.IsEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public IKeyTip ProviderPendingActivation => _providerPendingActivation;

		public XamRibbon Ribbon => _ribbon;

		private DispatcherTimer ShowKeyTipsTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (_showKeyTipsTimer == null)
				{
					_showKeyTipsTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Normal, Ribbon.Dispatcher);
					_showKeyTipsTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000.0);
					_showKeyTipsTimer.Tick += OnShowKeyTipsTimerTick;
				}
				return _showKeyTipsTimer;
			}
		}

		private object MinKeyTipWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (_minKeyTipWidth == null)
				{
					_minKeyTipWidth = Ribbon.CalcKeyTipMinWidth();
				}
				return _minKeyTipWidth;
			}
		}

		private Stack<List<KeyTipAdorner>> ParentAdorners
		{
			get
			{
				if (_parentAdorners == null)
				{
					_parentAdorners = new Stack<List<KeyTipAdorner>>();
				}
				return _parentAdorners;
			}
		}

		private Stack<IKeyTipContainer> ParentContainers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_parentContainers == null)
				{
					_parentContainers = new Stack<IKeyTipContainer>();
				}
				return _parentContainers;
			}
		}

		private Stack<KeyTipCollection> ParentKeyTips
		{
			get
			{
				if (_parentKeyTips == null)
				{
					_parentKeyTips = new Stack<KeyTipCollection>();
				}
				return _parentKeyTips;
			}
		}

		internal KeyTipManager(IKeyTipContainer startingKeyTipContainer, XamRibbon ribbon)
		{
			_startingKeyTipContainer = startingKeyTipContainer;
			_ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		public void ActivateKeyTipProvider(IKeyTip provider)
		{
			ActivateKeyTipProvider(provider, verifyProviderExists: true);
		}

		public void ActivateKeyTipProviderIfNotPending(IKeyTipContainer container)
		{
			IKeyTip keyTip = null;
			if (_currentKeyTips == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyTip currentKeyTip in CurrentKeyTips)
			{
				if (currentKeyTip.Provider.GetContainer() == container)
				{
					keyTip = currentKeyTip.Provider;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (keyTip != null && ProviderPendingActivation != keyTip)
			{
				ActivateKeyTipProvider(keyTip);
			}
		}

		public void DeactivateKeyTipContainer(IKeyTipContainer container)
		{
			if (IsActive && !isHiding && _currentKeyTipContainer == container && _keyTipContainerBeingDeactivated != container)
			{
				BackUpToParentContainer(deactivateCurrentContainer: true);
				if (_currentKeyTipContainer != null)
				{
					ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer();
				}
				RefreshAccessKeys();
			}
		}

		public void HideKeyTips()
		{
			HideKeyTips(deactivateParentContainers: false, resetMode: false);
		}

		public static void NotifyPopupOpened(PopupOpeningReason reason, DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (reason == PopupOpeningReason.None || reason == PopupOpeningReason.Mouse)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d);
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.HasKeyTipManager && ribbon.KeyTipManager.IsActive)
				{
					ribbon.KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips(deactivateParentContainers: false, resetMode: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ProcessEscKey()
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				BackUpToParentContainer(deactivateCurrentContainer: true);
				if (_currentKeyTipContainer != null)
				{
					ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer();
				}
				RefreshAccessKeys();
			}
		}

		public bool ProcessKey(char charCode, bool beepOnFail)
		{
			return EvaluateKey(charCode, beepOnFail, processKey: true);
		}

		public bool EvaluateKeyDuringPendingShow(char charCode)
		{
			VerifyKeyTipsAreInitialized();
			CancelPendingShow();
			if (EvaluateKey(charCode, beepOnFail: false, processKey: false))
			{
				return true;
			}
			HideCurrentAdorners();
			return false;
		}

		public void ShowKeyTips()
		{
			CancelPendingShow();
			VerifyKeyTipsAreInitialized();
			if (_ribbon != null && _ribbon.IsApplicationMenu2010Open)
			{
				ActivateKeyTipProvider(_ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010.KeyTipProvider);
			}
			ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer(showKeyTipWindow: true);
		}

		internal void ShowKeyTipsAfterDelay()
		{
			if (!ShowKeyTipsTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				ShowKeyTipsTimer.Start();
				VerifyKeyTipsAreInitialized();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateVisibleKeyTips()
		{
			if (_currentAdorners != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _currentAdorners.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					_currentAdorners[i].RefreshKeyTipVisibility();
				}
			}
		}

		public void ActivateKeyTipProvider(IKeyTip provider, bool verifyProviderExists)
		{
			if (verifyProviderExists && (_currentKeyTips == null || CurrentKeyTips.Search(provider) == null))
			{
				return;
			}
			IKeyTipContainer container = provider.GetContainer();
			KeyTipActivationBehavior activationBehavior = provider.ActivationBehavior;
			if ((container != null || activationBehavior != KeyTipActivationBehavior.KeepCurrentKeyTips) && _currentAdorners != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyTipAdorner currentAdorner in _currentAdorners)
				{
					currentAdorner.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
			if (container == null && activationBehavior != KeyTipActivationBehavior.KeepCurrentKeyTips)
			{
				HideKeyTips(activationBehavior == KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers, resetMode: true);
			}
			bool flag = provider.Activate();
			if (provider == _providerPendingActivation)
			{
				_providerPendingActivation = null;
			}
			if (flag && container != null && _ribbon.Mode != RibbonMode.Normal)
			{
				ShowKeyTipsInContainer(container);
			}
		}

		private void BackUpToParentContainer(bool deactivateCurrentContainer)
		{
			if (deactivateCurrentContainer)
			{
				IKeyTipContainer keyTipContainerBeingDeactivated = _keyTipContainerBeingDeactivated;
				_keyTipContainerBeingDeactivated = _currentKeyTipContainer;
				try
				{
					_currentKeyTipContainer.Deactivate();
				}
				finally
				{
					_keyTipContainerBeingDeactivated = keyTipContainerBeingDeactivated;
				}
			}
			RemoveCurrentAdorners();
			if (_parentContainers == null || _parentContainers.Count == 0)
			{
				_minKeyTipWidth = null;
				CurrentKeyTips = null;
				_currentKeyTipContainer = null;
				_currentAdorners = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_currentKeyTipContainer = ParentContainers.Pop();
				CurrentKeyTips = ParentKeyTips.Pop();
				_currentAdorners = ParentAdorners.Pop();
			}
		}

		private static void Beep()
		{
			SystemSounds.Beep.Play();
		}

		private void CancelPendingShow()
		{
			if (_showKeyTipsTimer != null && _showKeyTipsTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				_showKeyTipsTimer.IsEnabled = false;
			}
		}

		private void CreateKeyTipsForContainer(IKeyTipContainer container)
		{
			IKeyTip[] keyTips = container.GetKeyTips();
			foreach (IKeyTip provider in keyTips)
			{
				CurrentKeyTips.Add(new KeyTip(this, provider));
			}
			if (container.ReuseParentKeyTips)
			{
				ReuseKeyTipsInParent();
			}
			InitializeKeyTipsUsingKeyTips();
			if (Ribbon.AutoGenerateKeyTips)
			{
				InitializeKeyTipsUsingMnemonics();
				InitializeKeyTipsUsingCaptions();
				InitializeRemainingKeyTips();
			}
			RemoveInvalidKeyTips();
			ResolveConflicts();
			if (_currentKeyTips != null && _currentKeyTips.Count == 0)
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = _ribbon.ApplicationMenu2010;
				if (applicationMenu != null && applicationMenu.IsOpen)
				{
					HideKeyTips(deactivateParentContainers: false, resetMode: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateAdornersForKeyTips()
		{
			Dictionary<AdornerLayer, KeyTipAdorner> dictionary = new Dictionary<AdornerLayer, KeyTipAdorner>();
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = CurrentKeyTips.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				UIElement adornedElement = keyTip.Provider.AdornedElement;
				keyTip.SetValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, MinKeyTipWidth);
				AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(adornedElement);
				KeyTipAdorner value = null;
				if (adornerLayer != null)
				{
					AdornerLayer adornerLayer2 = null;
					while (adornerLayer != null && adornerLayer != adornerLayer2)
					{
						adornerLayer2 = adornerLayer;
						if (!(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(adornerLayer) is Visual visual))
						{
							break;
						}
						adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(visual);
						Visual visual2 = ((adornerLayer != null) ? (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(adornerLayer) as Visual) : null);
						if (visual2 != null)
						{
							ScrollViewer scrollViewer = (visual as ScrollViewer) ?? (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(visual, typeof(ScrollViewer), allowSubclassOfType: true, visual2) as ScrollViewer);
							if (scrollViewer != null && (scrollViewer.ViewportHeight < scrollViewer.ExtentHeight || scrollViewer.ViewportWidth < scrollViewer.ExtentWidth))
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					adornerLayer = adornerLayer2;
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(adornerLayer, out value))
					{
						UIElement elementToAdorn = GetElementToAdorn(adornerLayer, adornedElement);
						if (elementToAdorn != null)
						{
							value = new KeyTipAdorner(elementToAdorn);
							value.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
							if (_ribbon.RibbonWindow == null && XamRibbon.GetRibbon(adornerLayer) != _ribbon)
							{
								value.Resources = _ribbon.Resources;
							}
							CurrentAdorners.Add(value);
							dictionary.Add(adornerLayer, value);
							adornerLayer.Add(value);
						}
					}
				}
				value?.Add(keyTip);
			}
		}

		private bool EvaluateKey(char charCode, bool beepOnFail, bool processKey)
		{
			if ((Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != ModifierKeys.None)
			{
				if (beepOnFail)
				{
					Beep();
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (char.IsControl(charCode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsValidKeyTipChar(charCode))
			{
				if (beepOnFail)
				{
					Beep();
				}
				return false;
			}
			string text = _currentKeyTipValue + charCode;
			text = text.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (KeyTip currentKeyTip in CurrentKeyTips)
			{
				if (!currentKeyTip.Provider.IsEnabled)
				{
					continue;
				}
				UIElement adornedElement = currentKeyTip.Provider.AdornedElement;
				if (adornedElement != null && adornedElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (currentKeyTip.Value == text)
				{
					if (processKey)
					{
						_providerPendingActivation = currentKeyTip.Provider;
						ActivateKeyTipProvider(_providerPendingActivation, verifyProviderExists: false);
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (currentKeyTip.Value.StartsWith(text))
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (beepOnFail)
				{
					Beep();
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (processKey)
			{
				CurrentKeyTipValue = text;
				RefreshAccessKeys();
				UpdateVisibleKeyTips();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static UIElement GetElementToAdorn(AdornerLayer layer, UIElement adornedElement)
		{
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(layer);
			int i = 0;
			for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent); i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i) is Visual visual && visual.IsAncestorOf(adornedElement))
				{
					return visual as UIElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(IKeyTip provider)
		{
			string autoGeneratePrefix = provider.AutoGeneratePrefix;
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (autoGeneratePrefix == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			char[] array = autoGeneratePrefix.ToCharArray();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = array[i];
				if (text.Length == 2)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (IsValidKeyTipChar(c))
				{
					text += c;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void HideCurrentAdorners()
		{
			if (_currentAdorners == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyTipAdorner currentAdorner in _currentAdorners)
			{
				currentAdorner.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void HideKeyTips(bool deactivateParentContainers, bool resetMode)
		{
			CancelPendingShow();
			if (!isHiding)
			{
				isHiding = true;
				while (_currentKeyTipContainer != null)
				{
					BackUpToParentContainer(deactivateParentContainers);
				}
				isHiding = false;
				RefreshAccessKeys();
				Ribbon.OnKeyTipsHidden(deactivateParentContainers, resetMode);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeKeyTipsUsingCaptions()
		{
			KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection = new KeyTipCollection(this);
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(keyTip.Value) && keyTip.Provider.CanAutoGenerateKeyTip)
				{
					string caption = keyTip.Provider.Caption;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption))
					{
						keyTipCollection.Add(keyTip);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < keyTipCollection.Count; j++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip2 = keyTipCollection[j];
				string validAutoGeneratePrefix = GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(keyTip2.Provider);
				string text = string.Empty;
				string caption2 = keyTip2.Provider.Caption;
				int num = 0;
				while (num < caption2.Length)
				{
					char c = caption2[num++];
					if (!IsValidKeyTipChar(c))
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text2 = (validAutoGeneratePrefix + c).ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					if (text.Length == 0)
					{
						text = text2;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (KeyTip currentKeyTip in CurrentKeyTips)
					{
						if (currentKeyTip.Value != null && currentKeyTip.Value.StartsWith(text2))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						keyTip2.Value = text2;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (keyTip2.Value == null)
				{
					if (text.Length == 0)
					{
						keyTip2.Value = validAutoGeneratePrefix;
					}
					else
					{
						keyTip2.Value = text;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeKeyTipsUsingKeyTips()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(keyTip.Value))
				{
					string keyTipValue = keyTip.Provider.KeyTipValue;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(keyTipValue))
					{
						keyTip.Value = keyTipValue;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeKeyTipsUsingMnemonics()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(keyTip.Value) && keyTip.Provider.CanAutoGenerateKeyTip)
				{
					string validAutoGeneratePrefix = GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(keyTip.Provider);
					char mnemonic = keyTip.Provider.Mnemonic;
					if (IsValidKeyTipChar(mnemonic))
					{
						keyTip.Value = validAutoGeneratePrefix + mnemonic;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeRemainingKeyTips()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(keyTip.Value) || !keyTip.Provider.CanAutoGenerateKeyTip)
				{
					continue;
				}
				keyTip.Value = GetValidAutoGeneratePrefix(keyTip.Provider);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(keyTip.Value))
				{
					char defaultPrefix = keyTip.Provider.DefaultPrefix;
					if (IsValidKeyTipChar(defaultPrefix))
					{
						keyTip.Value = new string(defaultPrefix, 1);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsValidKeyTipChar(char c)
		{
			if (!char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) && !char.IsPunctuation(c) && (!char.IsSeparator(c) || char.IsWhiteSpace(c)))
			{
				return char.IsSymbol(c);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnKeyTipAccessKeyPressed(object sender, AccessKeyPressedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Scope == null && e.Target == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.Key) && (IsActive || IsShowPending) && _registeredAccessKeys.Exists(e.Key))
			{
				e.Target = _ribbon;
			}
		}

		private void RefreshAccessKeys()
		{
			if (_accessKeyVersion == _processedAccessKeyVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_registeredAccessKeys.Count > 0)
			{
				AccessKeyManager.RemoveAccessKeyPressedHandler(_ribbon, OnKeyTipAccessKeyPressed);
				foreach (string registeredAccessKey in _registeredAccessKeys)
				{
					AccessKeyManager.Unregister(registeredAccessKey, _ribbon);
				}
			}
			_registeredAccessKeys.Clear();
			int num = ((_currentKeyTipValue != null) ? _currentKeyTipValue.Length : 0);
			if (_currentKeyTips == null || _currentKeyTips.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyTip currentKeyTip in CurrentKeyTips)
			{
				if (!currentKeyTip.ShouldDisplayKeyTip || !currentKeyTip.IsEnabled)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string value = currentKeyTip.Value;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && value.Length > num)
				{
					string text = value.Substring(num, 1);
					if (!_registeredAccessKeys.Exists(text))
					{
						_registeredAccessKeys.Add(text);
						AccessKeyManager.Register(text, _ribbon);
					}
				}
			}
			if (_registeredAccessKeys.Count > 0)
			{
				AccessKeyManager.AddAccessKeyPressedHandler(_ribbon, OnKeyTipAccessKeyPressed);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveCurrentAdorners()
		{
			if (_currentAdorners == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyTipAdorner currentAdorner in _currentAdorners)
			{
				if (currentAdorner.Parent is AdornerLayer adornerLayer)
				{
					adornerLayer.Remove(currentAdorner);
				}
				if (currentAdorner.Resources == _ribbon.Resources)
				{
					currentAdorner.Resources = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveInvalidKeyTips()
		{
			for (int num = CurrentKeyTips.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[num];
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(keyTip.Value))
				{
					CurrentKeyTips.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResolveConflicts()
		{
			KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection = CurrentKeyTips.Clone();
			int num = 0;
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				flag = false;
				keyTipCollection.Sort();
				List<KeyTip> list = null;
				for (int i = num; i < keyTipCollection.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					KeyTip keyTip = keyTipCollection[i];
					KeyTip keyTip2 = keyTipCollection[i + 1];
					if (keyTip.Value == keyTip2.Value)
					{
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = new List<KeyTip>();
						}
						else
						{
							list.Clear();
						}
						list.Add(keyTip);
						list.Add(keyTip2);
						for (i += 2; i < keyTipCollection.Count; i++)
						{
							KeyTip keyTip3 = keyTipCollection[i];
							if (keyTip3.Value != keyTip.Value)
							{
								break;
							}
							list.Add(keyTip3);
						}
						int length = (list.Count - 1).ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture).Length;
						string text = new string('0', length);
						for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
						{
							KeyTip keyTip4 = list[j];
							string text2 = (j + 1).ToString(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
							if (text2.Length > length)
							{
								text2 = text2.Substring(text2.Length - length);
							}
							keyTip4.Value += text2;
						}
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (keyTip2.Value.StartsWith(keyTip.Value))
					{
						keyTip.Value += 1.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					num = i + 1;
				}
			}
			while (flag);
		}

		private void ReuseKeyTipsInParent()
		{
			if (_parentKeyTips == null || _parentKeyTips.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			KeyTipCollection keyTipCollection = _parentKeyTips.Peek();
			if (keyTipCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < CurrentKeyTips.Count; i++)
			{
				KeyTip keyTip = CurrentKeyTips[i];
				if (keyTip.Value == null)
				{
					KeyTip keyTip2 = keyTipCollection.Search(keyTip.Provider);
					if (keyTip2 != null)
					{
						keyTip.Value = keyTip2.Value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInContainer(IKeyTipContainer container)
		{
			ShowKeyTipsInContainer(container, showKeyTipWindow: true);
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInContainer(IKeyTipContainer container, bool showKeyTipWindow)
		{
			if (_currentKeyTipContainer != null)
			{
				ParentContainers.Push(_currentKeyTipContainer);
				ParentKeyTips.Push(_currentKeyTips);
				ParentAdorners.Push(_currentAdorners);
				CurrentKeyTips = null;
				_currentAdorners = null;
			}
			_currentKeyTipContainer = container;
			CreateKeyTipsForContainer(_currentKeyTipContainer);
			CreateAdornersForKeyTips();
			ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer(showKeyTipWindow);
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer()
		{
			ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer(showKeyTipWindow: true);
		}

		private void ShowKeyTipsInCurrentContainer(bool showKeyTipWindow)
		{
			CurrentKeyTipValue = string.Empty;
			RefreshAccessKeys();
			if (!showKeyTipWindow || _currentAdorners == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyTipAdorner currentAdorner in _currentAdorners)
			{
				currentAdorner.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				currentAdorner.RefreshKeyTipVisibility();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyKeyTipsAreInitialized()
		{
			if (_currentKeyTips == null || (_currentKeyTips.Count == 0 && _currentKeyTipContainer == null))
			{
				ShowKeyTipsInContainer(_startingKeyTipContainer, showKeyTipWindow: false);
			}
		}

		private void OnShowKeyTipsTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending)
			{
				ShowKeyTips();
			}
			ShowKeyTipsTimer.IsEnabled = false;
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Line1", Type = typeof(TextBlock))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Line2", Type = typeof(TextBlock))]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class LargeToolCaptionPresenter : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private struct WordInfo
		{
			internal string Word;

			internal System.Windows.Size Size;

			internal WordInfo(string word, System.Windows.Size size)
			{
				Word = word;
				Size = size;
			}
		}

		private TextBlock _textBlockPrivate = new TextBlock();

		private TextBlock _line1;

		private TextBlock _line2;

		private List<WordInfo> _wordInfos;

		private bool _cachedWordInfoDirty = true;

		private bool _cachedGlyphInfoDirty = true;

		private InlineUIContainer _glyphInlineUIContainer;

		private System.Windows.Size _glyphSize = System.Windows.Size.Empty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GlyphProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public object Text
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(TextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		public UIElement Glyph
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(GlyphProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GlyphProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static LargeToolCaptionPresenter()
		{
			TextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Text", typeof(object), typeof(LargeToolCaptionPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnTextChanged));
			GlyphProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Glyph", typeof(UIElement), typeof(LargeToolCaptionPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnGlyphChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(LargeToolCaptionPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(LargeToolCaptionPresenter)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(LargeToolCaptionPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if ((_line1 == null) | (_line2 == null))
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(1.0, 1.0);
			}
			if (_cachedWordInfoDirty)
			{
				string text = ((Text is string) ? ((string)Text) : string.Empty);
				string[] array = text.Split(new string[1] { " " }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				_wordInfos = new List<WordInfo>(array.Length);
				foreach (string text2 in array)
				{
					_wordInfos.Add(new WordInfo(text2, MeasureText(text2)));
				}
				_cachedWordInfoDirty = false;
			}
			if (_cachedGlyphInfoDirty)
			{
				System.Windows.Size empty = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
				if (_glyphInlineUIContainer != null)
				{
					_glyphInlineUIContainer.Child = null;
					_glyphInlineUIContainer = null;
				}
				if (Glyph != null)
				{
					Glyph.Measure(availableSize);
					_glyphSize = Glyph.DesiredSize;
					if (_glyphInlineUIContainer == null)
					{
						_glyphInlineUIContainer = new InlineUIContainer(Glyph);
						_glyphInlineUIContainer.SetBinding(ContentElement.IsEnabledProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
					}
				}
				_cachedGlyphInfoDirty = false;
			}
			double width = MeasureText(" ").Width;
			_line1.Inlines.Clear();
			_line2.Inlines.Clear();
			TextBlock line = _line1;
			string text3 = (_line2.Text = "");
			line.Text = text3;
			if (_wordInfos.Count == 0)
			{
				if (_glyphSize != System.Windows.Size.Empty)
				{
					_line1.Inlines.Add(new Run("\ufeff"));
					_line1.Inlines.Add(_glyphInlineUIContainer);
				}
			}
			else if (_wordInfos.Count == 1)
			{
				WordInfo wordInfo = _wordInfos[0];
				System.Windows.Size size = wordInfo.Size;
				_line1.Text = wordInfo.Word;
				if (_glyphSize != System.Windows.Size.Empty)
				{
					_line2.Inlines.Add(new Run("\ufeff"));
					_line2.Inlines.Add(_glyphInlineUIContainer);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num = _wordInfos.Count / 2;
				if (num * 2 != _wordInfos.Count)
				{
					num++;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(100);
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					WordInfo wordInfo2 = _wordInfos[j];
					System.Windows.Size size2 = wordInfo2.Size;
					stringBuilder.Append(wordInfo2.Word);
					if (j < num - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(" ");
					}
				}
				_line1.Text = stringBuilder.ToString();
				stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(100);
				double num2 = _wordInfos.Count;
				for (int k = num; (double)k < num2; k++)
				{
					WordInfo wordInfo3 = _wordInfos[k];
					System.Windows.Size size3 = wordInfo3.Size;
					stringBuilder.Append(wordInfo3.Word);
					stringBuilder.Append(" ");
				}
				_line2.Text = stringBuilder.ToString();
				if (_glyphSize != System.Windows.Size.Empty)
				{
					_line2.Inlines.Add(_glyphInlineUIContainer);
				}
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_line1 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Line1") as TextBlock;
			_line2 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Line2") as TextBlock;
		}

		private static void OnTextChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is LargeToolCaptionPresenter largeToolCaptionPresenter)
			{
				largeToolCaptionPresenter._cachedWordInfoDirty = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnGlyphChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is LargeToolCaptionPresenter largeToolCaptionPresenter)
			{
				largeToolCaptionPresenter._cachedGlyphInfoDirty = true;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size MeasureText(Inline[] inlines)
		{
			_textBlockPrivate.Inlines.Clear();
			_textBlockPrivate.Inlines.AddRange(inlines);
			_textBlockPrivate.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			return _textBlockPrivate.DesiredSize;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size MeasureText(string text)
		{
			_textBlockPrivate.Text = text;
			_textBlockPrivate.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			return _textBlockPrivate.DesiredSize;
		}

		private string TrimTextToLength(string text, double trimToLength)
		{
			double num = Math.Max(trimToLength, 0.0);
			string text2 = text;
			double width = MeasureText(text2).Width;
			while (width != 0.0 && width > trimToLength)
			{
				text2 = text2.Substring(0, text2.Length - 1);
				width = MeasureText(text2).Width;
			}
			return text2;
		}
	}
	public class ApplicationMenuButtonTransformConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		object IMultiValueConverter.Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (values == null || values.Length != 3 || targetType != typeof(Transform))
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			if (values[0] is bool)
			{
				flag = (bool)values[0];
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = values[1] as FrameworkElement;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = values[2] as FrameworkElement;
				if (frameworkElement == null || frameworkElement2 == null)
				{
					return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
				}
				if (!flag && (!frameworkElement.IsInitialized || !frameworkElement.IsLoaded))
				{
					return frameworkElement2.RenderTransform;
				}
				System.Windows.Point point;
				try
				{
					point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement, default(System.Windows.Point));
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
					return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
				}
				point = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(frameworkElement2, point);
				if (frameworkElement2.RenderTransform != Transform.Identity)
				{
					point = frameworkElement2.RenderTransform.Transform(point);
				}
				return new TranslateTransform(point.X, point.Y);
			}
			return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}

		object[] IMultiValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return new object[1] { System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing };
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class MenuButtonArea : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private System.Windows.Size _lastArrangeSize;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey HasImagePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HasImageProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsActivePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsActiveProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsCheckablePropertyKey;

		static MenuButtonArea()
		{
			HasImagePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasImage", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HasImageProperty = HasImagePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsActivePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsActive", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsActiveProperty = IsActivePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsCheckablePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsCheckable", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsCheckableProperty = IsCheckablePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsQuickCustomizeMenuPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsQuickCustomizeMenu", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsQuickCustomizeMenuProperty = IsQuickCustomizeMenuPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsSegmentedPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsSegmented", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsSegmentedProperty = IsSegmentedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			LocationPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Location", typeof(ToolLocation), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationUnknownBox));
			LocationProperty = LocationPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MenuToolPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("MenuTool", typeof(MenuTool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			MenuToolProperty = MenuToolPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MenuToolPresenterPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("MenuToolPresenter", typeof(MenuToolPresenter), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			MenuToolPresenterProperty = MenuToolPresenterPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SizingModePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("SizingMode", typeof(RibbonToolSizingMode), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageOnlyBox));
			SizingModeProperty = SizingModePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			HasImageInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HasImageInternal", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnHasImageInternalChanged));
			IsActiveInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsActiveInternal", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsActiveInternalChanged));
			IsCheckableInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsCheckableInternal", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsCheckableInternalChanged));
			IsSegmentedInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSegmentedInternal", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsSegmentedInternalChanged));
			LocationInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LocationInternal", typeof(ToolLocation), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationUnknownBox, OnLocationInternalChanged));
			SizingModeInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SizingModeInternal", typeof(RibbonToolSizingMode), typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageOnlyBox, OnSizingModeInternalChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(MenuButtonArea)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuButtonArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		{
			_lastArrangeSize = arrangeBounds;
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuTool menuTool = MenuTool;
			if (menuTool != null && menuTool.ButtonType != MenuToolButtonType.DropDown && !menuTool.CanExecuteSegmentedButton())
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(MenuTool), allowSubclassOfType: true) is MenuTool menuTool)
			{
				SetValue(MenuToolPropertyKey, menuTool);
				SetBinding(IsActiveInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, menuTool));
				SetBinding(SizingModeInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, menuTool));
				SetBinding(RibbonGroupPanel.SizingModeVersionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonGroupPanel.SizingModeVersionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, menuTool));
				SetBinding(LocationInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.LocationProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, menuTool));
				SetBinding(HasImageInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonToolHelper.HasImageProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, menuTool));
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MenuTool.ButtonTypeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, menuTool);
				binding.Converter = MenuTool.ButtonTypeToIsCheckableConverter.Instance;
				SetBinding(IsCheckableInternalProperty, binding);
				if (menuTool.Location == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar || menuTool.Location == ToolLocation.Unknown)
				{
					QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this)?.QuickAccessToolbar;
					if (quickAccessToolbar != null && menuTool == quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu)
					{
						SetValue(IsQuickCustomizeMenuPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					}
				}
			}
			if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(MenuToolPresenter), allowSubclassOfType: true) is MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter)
			{
				SetValue(MenuToolPresenterPropertyKey, menuToolPresenter);
				SetBinding(IsSegmentedInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolMenuItem.IsSegmentedProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, menuToolPresenter));
			}
		}
