	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public abstract class ToolbarOverflowPanelBase : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		private ToolbarWithOverflow _toolbar;

		internal virtual System.Windows.Size? DefaultItemSize => null;

		internal ToolbarWithOverflow Toolbar
		{
			get
			{
				return _toolbar;
			}
			set
			{
				_toolbar = value;
			}
		}

		internal ToolbarOverflowPanelBase()
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			UIElementCollection children = base.Children;
			int count = children.Count;
			System.Windows.Size? defaultItemSize = DefaultItemSize;
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, defaultItemSize.HasValue ? defaultItemSize.Value.Height : base.DesiredSize.Height);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[i];
				double num = (finalRect.Width = Math.Round(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width));
				uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += num;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override UIElementCollection CreateUIElementCollection(FrameworkElement logicalParent)
		{
			return new UIElementCollection(this, (base.TemplatedParent == null) ? logicalParent : null);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			UIElementCollection children = base.Children;
			int count = children.Count;
			double num = 0.0;
			System.Windows.Size? defaultItemSize = DefaultItemSize;
			double num2 = (defaultItemSize.HasValue ? defaultItemSize.Value.Height : 0.0);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = children[i];
				num += Math.Round(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width);
				if (!defaultItemSize.HasValue)
				{
					double height = uIElement.DesiredSize.Height;
					if (height > num2)
					{
						num2 = height;
					}
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel : ToolbarOverflowPanelBase
	{
		internal override System.Windows.Size? DefaultItemSize => XamRibbon.DEFAULT_QAT_TOOL_SIZE;

		static QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel()
		{
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public abstract class ToolbarPanelBase : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		private ToolbarWithOverflow _toolbar;

		private bool _generateChildrenCalled;

		private List<UIElement> _generatedChildren;

		private ItemContainerGenerator _itemContainerGenerator;

		private UIElementCollection _privateChildren;

		private System.Windows.Size _lastMeasureSize = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_privateChildren == null)
				{
					return base.VisualChildrenCount;
				}
				return _privateChildren.Count;
			}
		}

		internal virtual System.Windows.Size? DefaultItemSize => null;

		internal List<UIElement> GeneratedChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (_generatedChildren == null)
				{
					_generatedChildren = new List<UIElement>();
				}
				return _generatedChildren;
			}
		}

		internal ToolbarWithOverflow Toolbar
		{
			get
			{
				return _toolbar;
			}
			set
			{
				_toolbar = value;
			}
		}

		internal ToolbarPanelBase()
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (_privateChildren == null)
			{
				return finalSize;
			}
			UIElementCollection privateChildren = _privateChildren;
			int count = privateChildren.Count;
			double num = Math.Round(finalSize.Width);
			System.Windows.Size? defaultItemSize = DefaultItemSize;
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, defaultItemSize.HasValue ? defaultItemSize.Value.Height : base.DesiredSize.Height);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = privateChildren[i];
				double num2 = Math.Round(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width);
				num -= num2;
				finalRect.Width = num2;
				uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += num2;
				if (num <= 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= VisualChildrenCount)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (_privateChildren == null)
			{
				return base.GetVisualChild(index);
			}
			return _privateChildren[index];
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			_lastMeasureSize = availableSize;
			return DoMeasureProcessing(availableSize);
		}

		protected override void OnIsItemsHostChanged(bool oldIsItemsHost, bool newIsItemsHost)
		{
			if (!newIsItemsHost)
			{
				if (_itemContainerGenerator != null)
				{
					_itemContainerGenerator.ItemsChanged -= OnItemsChanged;
				}
				((Toolbar != null) ? Toolbar.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal : null)?.Children.Clear();
				RemoveVisualChildren();
			}
			base.OnIsItemsHostChanged(oldIsItemsHost, newIsItemsHost);
		}

		private void GenerateChildren()
		{
			if (_generateChildrenCalled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.IsItemsHost && Toolbar != null)
			{
				if (_itemContainerGenerator == null)
				{
					_itemContainerGenerator = ((IItemContainerGenerator)Toolbar.ItemContainerGenerator).GetItemContainerGeneratorForPanel((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)this);
					_itemContainerGenerator.ItemsChanged += OnItemsChanged;
				}
				IItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = _itemContainerGenerator;
				itemContainerGenerator.RemoveAll();
				if (_privateChildren == null)
				{
					_privateChildren = CreateUIElementCollection(null);
				}
				else
				{
					_privateChildren.Clear();
				}
				GeneratedChildren.Clear();
				Toolbar.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal?.Children.Clear();
				using (itemContainerGenerator.StartAt(new GeneratorPosition(-1, 0), GeneratorDirection.Forward))
				{
					while (itemContainerGenerator.GenerateNext() is UIElement uIElement)
					{
						GeneratedChildren.Add(uIElement);
						_privateChildren.Add(uIElement);
						itemContainerGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(uIElement);
					}
				}
				_generateChildrenCalled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				_privateChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsChanged(object sender, ItemsChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				_generateChildrenCalled = false;
				GenerateChildren();
				break;
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void SetOverflowButtonVisibility(Visibility visibility)
		{
			if (Toolbar.OverflowButtonVisibility == visibility)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (this is QuickAccessToolbarPanel)
			{
				Toolbar.SetValue(ToolbarWithOverflow.OverflowButtonVisibilityPropertyKey, visibility);
				return;
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, (Action)delegate
			{
				Toolbar.SetValue(ToolbarWithOverflow.OverflowButtonVisibilityPropertyKey, visibility);
			});
		}

		internal virtual double AdjustAvailableWidth(double measureWidth)
		{
			return measureWidth;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size DoMeasureProcessing()
		{
			return DoMeasureProcessing(_lastMeasureSize);
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size DoMeasureProcessing(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (Toolbar == null)
			{
				return availableSize;
			}
			availableSize.Width = AdjustAvailableWidth(availableSize.Width);
			GenerateChildren();
			if (Toolbar.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString(Toolbar.OverflowPanelMissingResourceId));
			}
			Toolbar.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal.Children.Clear();
			List<UIElement> generatedChildren = GeneratedChildren;
			UIElementCollection privateChildren = _privateChildren;
			UIElementCollection children = Toolbar.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal.Children;
			int count = generatedChildren.Count;
			double num = Math.Round(availableSize.Width);
			double num2 = num;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			System.Windows.Size? defaultItemSize = DefaultItemSize;
			double num4 = (defaultItemSize.HasValue ? defaultItemSize.Value.Height : 0.0);
			ToolbarOverflowPanelBase toolbarOverflowPanelInternal = Toolbar.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal;
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = Toolbar as QuickAccessToolbar;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = generatedChildren[i];
				uIElement.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, defaultItemSize.HasValue ? defaultItemSize.Value.Height : availableSize.Height));
				double num5 = Math.Round(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width);
				if (num5 >= num2)
				{
					if (!children.Contains(uIElement))
					{
						privateChildren.Remove(uIElement);
						if (quickAccessToolbar != null && children.Contains(quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu))
						{
							children.Insert(children.IndexOf(quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu), uIElement);
						}
						else
						{
							children.Add(uIElement);
						}
					}
					num2 = 0.0;
					continue;
				}
				if (!privateChildren.Contains(uIElement))
				{
					privateChildren.Add(uIElement);
				}
				num2 -= num5;
				num3 += num5;
				if (!defaultItemSize.HasValue)
				{
					double height = uIElement.DesiredSize.Height;
					if (height > num4)
					{
						num4 = height;
					}
				}
			}
			if (children.Count > 0)
			{
				SetOverflowButtonVisibility(Visibility.Visible);
				if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
				{
					if (quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenuSite.Content == quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu)
					{
						quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenuSite.Content = null;
					}
					if (!children.Contains(quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu))
					{
						children.Add(quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetOverflowButtonVisibility(Visibility.Collapsed);
				if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
				{
					if (children.Contains(quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu))
					{
						children.Remove(quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu);
					}
					if (quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenuSite.Content != quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu)
					{
						quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenuSite.Content = quickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu;
					}
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num3, num4);
		}

		internal void RemoveVisualChildren()
		{
			UIElementCollection privateChildren = _privateChildren;
			if (_privateChildren != null)
			{
				int count = privateChildren.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					RemoveVisualChild(privateChildren[i]);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		internal override System.Windows.Size? DefaultItemSize => XamRibbon.DEFAULT_QAT_TOOL_SIZE;
	}

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ApplicationMenu : MenuToolBase, IRibbonTool, IRibbonToolLocation, IRibbonToolLocationEx
	{
		protected class ApplicationMenuProxy : MenuToolBaseProxy
		{
			internal new static readonly MenuToolBaseProxy Instance = new ApplicationMenuProxy();

			public override bool CanAddToQat => false;

			internal override IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(MenuToolBase tool, ToolMenuItem menuItem)
			{
				if (!(tool is ApplicationMenu menu) || menuItem != null)
				{
					return base.GetKeyTipProviders(tool, menuItem);
				}
				return new IKeyTip[1]
				{
					new ApplicationMenuKeyTipProvider(menu)
				};
			}
		}

		private class ApplicationMenuKeyTipProvider : ToolKeyTipProvider, IKeyTip
		{
			private ApplicationMenu _menu;

			public override KeyTipAlignment Alignment => KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter;

			public override string KeyTipValue
			{
				get
				{
					string text = RibbonToolHelper.GetKeyTip(_menu);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = XamRibbon.GetString("ApplicationMenuDefaultKeyTip");
					}
					return text;
				}
			}

			public override System.Windows.Point Location
			{
				get
				{
					System.Windows.Size renderSize = _menu.RenderSize;
					if (renderSize.Width <= 0.0 || renderSize.Height <= 0.0)
					{
						return default(System.Windows.Point);
					}
					return new System.Windows.Point(renderSize.Width / 2.0, renderSize.Height / 2.0);
				}
			}

			internal ApplicationMenuKeyTipProvider(ApplicationMenu menu)
				: base(menu, null)
			{
				_menu = menu;
			}
		}

		private class ApplicationMenuRecentItems : ObservableCollectionExtended<object>
		{
			private ApplicationMenu _menu;

			protected override bool NotifyItemsChanged => true;

			internal ApplicationMenuRecentItems(ApplicationMenu menu)
			{
				_menu = menu;
			}

			protected override void OnItemAdded(object itemAdded)
			{
				base.OnItemAdded(itemAdded);
				_menu.AddLogicalChild(itemAdded);
			}

			protected override void OnItemRemoved(object itemRemoved)
			{
				base.OnItemRemoved(itemRemoved);
				_menu.RemoveLogicalChild(itemRemoved);
			}

			protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
					_menu.VerifyReparentedItems();
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private class ApplicationMenuItems : PropertyChangeNotifier, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
		{
			private ItemCollection _items;

			private ObservableCollection<object> _recentItems;

			private ApplicationMenu _applicationMenu;

			private object _syncRoot;

			private static readonly object EmptyMenuItemId = new object();

			private ToolMenuItem _emptyMenuItem;

			private NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler _notifyHandler;

			private bool IsEmpty => _items.Count + _recentItems.Count == 0;

			private ToolMenuItem EmptyMenuItem
			{
				get
				{
					if (_emptyMenuItem == null)
					{
						_emptyMenuItem = new ToolMenuItem();
						_emptyMenuItem.Name = "EmptyItem";
						_emptyMenuItem.Tag = EmptyMenuItemId;
						_emptyMenuItem.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					return _emptyMenuItem;
				}
			}

			bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

			bool IList.IsReadOnly => true;

			object IList.this[int index]
			{
				get
				{
					if (index == 0 && IsEmpty)
					{
						return EmptyMenuItem;
					}
					if (index < _items.Count)
					{
						return _items[index];
					}
					index -= _items.Count;
					return _recentItems[index];
				}
				set
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
			}

			int ICollection.Count
			{
				get
				{
					int count = _items.Count;
					count += _recentItems.Count;
					if (count == 0)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return count;
				}
			}

			bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

			object ICollection.SyncRoot
			{
				get
				{
					if (_syncRoot == null)
					{
						IEnumerable sourceCollection = _items.SourceCollection;
						if (sourceCollection != null)
						{
							try
							{
								_syncRoot = ((ICollection)_items).SyncRoot;
							}
							catch
							{
							}
						}
						if (_syncRoot == null)
						{
							Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _syncRoot, new object(), null);
						}
					}
					return _syncRoot;
				}
			}

			event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler INotifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged
			{
				add
				{
					_notifyHandler = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_notifyHandler, value);
				}
				remove
				{
					_notifyHandler = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_notifyHandler, value);
				}
			}

			internal ApplicationMenuItems(ApplicationMenu owner)
			{
				_applicationMenu = owner;
				_recentItems = owner.RecentItems;
				_items = owner.Items;
				_syncRoot = new object();
				_recentItems.CollectionChanged += OnRecentItemsChanged;
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)_items).CollectionChanged += OnAppItemsChanged;
			}

			private void OnAppItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Item[]");
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Count");
				if (_notifyHandler != null)
				{
					_notifyHandler(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
				}
			}

			private void OnRecentItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Item[]");
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent("Count");
				if (_notifyHandler != null)
				{
					_notifyHandler(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
				}
			}

			int IList.Add(object value)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			void IList.Clear()
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			bool IList.Contains(object value)
			{
				if (_items.Contains(value))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (_recentItems.Contains(value))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (IsEmpty && value == EmptyMenuItem)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IList.IndexOf(object value)
			{
				int num = _items.IndexOf(value);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = _recentItems.IndexOf(value);
				}
				if (num < 0 && value == EmptyMenuItem && IsEmpty)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return num;
			}

			void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			void IList.Remove(object value)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
			{
				_items.CopyTo(array, index);
				index += _items.Count;
				((ICollection)_recentItems).CopyTo(array, index);
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					array.SetValue(EmptyMenuItem, index);
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					return new SingleItemEnumerator(EmptyMenuItem);
				}
				IEnumerator enumerator = ((IEnumerable)_items).GetEnumerator();
				if (_recentItems != null)
				{
					return new MultiSourceEnumerator(enumerator, ((IEnumerable)_recentItems).GetEnumerator());
				}
				return enumerator;
			}
		}

		private ApplicationMenuRecentItems _recentItems;

		static ApplicationMenu()
		{
			FooterToolbarProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FooterToolbar", typeof(ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar), typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnFooterToolbarChanged));
			HasRecentItemsHeaderPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasRecentItemsHeader", typeof(bool), typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HasRecentItemsHeaderProperty = HasRecentItemsHeaderPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Image", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			RecentItemsHeaderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RecentItemsHeader", typeof(object), typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnRecentItemsHeaderChanged));
			RecentItemsHeaderTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RecentItemsHeaderTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			RecentItemsHeaderTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RecentItemsHeaderTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu)));
			MenuToolBase.UseLargeImagesProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ApplicationMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsActiveChanged));
		}

		protected override ToolMenuItem CreateMenuToolPresenter()
		{
			return new ApplicationMenuPresenter();
		}

		internal override IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			list.AddRange(base.GetKeyTipProviders());
			ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar footerToolbar = FooterToolbar;
			if (footerToolbar != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = footerToolbar.RegisteredTools.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					IRibbonTool ribbonTool = footerToolbar.RegisteredTools[i];
					RibbonToolProxy toolProxy = ribbonTool.ToolProxy;
					if (toolProxy != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(toolProxy.GetKeyTipProviders(ribbonTool as FrameworkElement));
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ToolMenuItem presenter = base.Presenter;
			if (presenter != null)
			{
				ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar footerToolbar = FooterToolbar;
				if (footerToolbar != null)
				{
					presenter.AddLogicalChildInternal(footerToolbar);
					presenter.SetValue(ApplicationMenuPresenter.HasFooterToolbarPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					presenter.ClearValue(ApplicationMenuPresenter.HasFooterToolbarPropertyKey);
				}
			}
			SynchronizePresenterIsActive();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ApplicationMenuAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDoubleClick(e);
			if (e.Handled || e.ChangedButton != MouseButton.Left)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon == null || !ribbon.IsWithinRibbonWindow)
			{
				return;
			}
			Utilities.DependencyObjectSearchCallback<FrameworkElement> callback = (FrameworkElement fe) => fe.Name == "PART_WindowIcon" && fe.IsVisible;
			if (Utilities.GetTemplateChild(ribbon, callback) != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(this);
			if (new Rect(base.RenderSize).Contains(position))
			{
				RoutedCommand closeCommand = RibbonWindowCommands.CloseCommand;
				if (closeCommand.CanExecute(null, this))
				{
					closeCommand.Execute(null, this);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnFooterToolbarChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(target is ApplicationMenu { Presenter: var presenter } applicationMenu))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.OldValue is ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar applicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				applicationMenuFooterToolbar.Initialize(null);
				presenter?.RemoveLogicalChildInternal(applicationMenuFooterToolbar);
			}
			ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar applicationMenuFooterToolbar2 = e.NewValue as ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar;
			if (applicationMenuFooterToolbar2 != null)
			{
				applicationMenuFooterToolbar2.Initialize(applicationMenu);
				presenter?.AddLogicalChildInternal(applicationMenuFooterToolbar2);
			}
			if (presenter != null)
			{
				if (applicationMenuFooterToolbar2 != null)
				{
					presenter.SetValue(ApplicationMenuPresenter.HasFooterToolbarPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					presenter.ClearValue(ApplicationMenuPresenter.HasFooterToolbarPropertyKey);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeRecentItems()
		{
			return _recentItems.Count > 0;
		}

		private static void OnRecentItemsHeaderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			d.SetValue(HasRecentItemsHeaderPropertyKey, (e.NewValue == null) ? KnownBoxes.FalseBox : KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
		}

		private static void OnIsActiveChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ApplicationMenu)d).SynchronizePresenterIsActive();
		}

		private void SynchronizePresenterIsActive()
		{
			if (base.Presenter != null)
			{
				base.Presenter.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey, GetValue(XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty));
			}
		}

		ToolLocation IRibbonToolLocationEx.GetLocation(object descendant)
		{
			if (_recentItems.Contains(descendant))
			{
				return ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems;
			}
			return ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu;
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class RibbonCaptionPanel : FrameworkElement

		private class ContextualTabVisibiltyMultiConverter : IMultiValueConverter
		{
			internal static ContextualTabVisibiltyMultiConverter Instance = new ContextualTabVisibiltyMultiConverter();

			public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (values.Length == 2 && values[0] is bool && values[1] is bool)
				{
					if (!(bool)values[0] || !(bool)values[1])
					{
						return KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox;
					}
					return KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox;
				}
				return KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox;
			}

			public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return new object[2]
				{
					System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing,
					System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing
				};
			}
		}

		private QuickAccessToolbar _qat;

		private ContentControl _captionElement;

		private List<object> _logicalChildren;

		private List<System.Windows.Controls.Button> _tabGroupPresenters;

		private static IValueConverter _boolToVisConverter;

		private bool _isInArrange;

		private static readonly Rect OutOfViewTabGroupRect;

		private Rect _arrangeTabGroupRect = Rect.Empty;

		private RibbonTabItem _arrangeFirstTabItem;

		private RibbonTabItem _arrangeLastTabItem;

		private static readonly Style TabGroupButtonStyle;

		private Rect captionRectLeft;

		private Rect captionRectRight;

		private Rect captionRectActual;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsQatVisiblePropertyKey;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty IsQatVisibleProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsGlassActiveProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty;

		public static readonly ResourceKey CaptionStyleKey;

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => _logicalChildren.GetEnumerator();

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount
		{

				if (_qat != null)

					num++;
				}
				if (_captionElement != null)

					num++;
				}
				return num + _tabGroupPresenters.Count;
			}
		}

		static RibbonCaptionPanel()
		{
			_boolToVisConverter = new BooleanToVisibilityConverter();
			OutOfViewTabGroupRect = new Rect(-1000.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			IsQatVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsQatVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonCaptionPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));

			IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsWithinRibbonWindow", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonCaptionPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsWithinRibbonWindowChanged));
			CaptionStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(RibbonCaptionPanel), "CaptionStyleKey");
			XamRibbon.RibbonProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonCaptionPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnRibbonChanged));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(RibbonCaptionPanel), new CommandBinding(ContextualTabGroup.SelectFirstTabCommand, OnExecuteCommand));
			Style style = new Style(typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Button));
			FrameworkElementFactory visualTree = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ContentPresenter));

			{
				VisualTree = visualTree

			style.Setters.Add(new Setter(System.Windows.Controls.Control.TemplateProperty, value));
			style.Setters.Add(new Setter(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BackgroundProperty, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent));
			style.Setters.Add(new Setter(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty, default(Thickness)));
			style.Setters.Add(new Setter(System.Windows.Controls.Control.PaddingProperty, default(Thickness)));
			style.Setters.Add(new Setter(UIElement.FocusableProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			style.Seal();
			TabGroupButtonStyle = style;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			bool isInArrange = _isInArrange;
			try
			{
				_isInArrange = true;
				return ArrangeOverrideImpl(finalSize);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isInArrange = isInArrange;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverrideImpl(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(finalSize);
			Rect rect2 = Rect.Empty;
			bool flag = !AreTabItemsScrolling;
			Rect rect3 = Rect.Empty;
			_arrangeFirstTabItem = (_arrangeLastTabItem = null);
			_arrangeTabGroupRect = Rect.Empty;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (_qat != null)
			{
				num = Math.Max(Math.Min(rect.Width, _qat.MinWidth), 0.0);
				rect.X += num;
				rect.Width -= num;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _tabGroupPresenters.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Button button = _tabGroupPresenters[i];
				if (button.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Rect rect4 = Rect.Empty;
				ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = (ContextualTabGroup)button.Content;
				if (flag)
				{
					RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = (RibbonTabItem)contextualTabGroup.GetValue(ContextualTabGroup.FirstVisibleTabItemProperty);
					RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem2 = (RibbonTabItem)contextualTabGroup.GetValue(ContextualTabGroup.LastVisibleTabItemProperty);
					if (ribbonTabItem != null && ribbonTabItem2 != null)
					{
						RibbonTabItem arrangeFirstTabItem = _arrangeFirstTabItem;
						RibbonTabItem arrangeLastTabItem = _arrangeLastTabItem;
						if (_arrangeFirstTabItem == null)
						{
							_arrangeFirstTabItem = ribbonTabItem;
						}
						_arrangeLastTabItem = ribbonTabItem2;
						if (ribbonTabItem.IsArrangeValid && ribbonTabItem2.IsArrangeValid)
						{
							Rect rect5;
							Rect rect6;
							try
							{
								rect5 = ribbonTabItem.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(new Rect(ribbonTabItem.RenderSize));
								rect6 = ribbonTabItem2.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(new Rect(ribbonTabItem2.RenderSize));
							}
							catch (InvalidOperationException)
							{
								_arrangeFirstTabItem = arrangeFirstTabItem;
								_arrangeLastTabItem = arrangeLastTabItem;
								continue;
							}
							rect4 = Rect.Union(rect5, rect6);
							if (_arrangeTabGroupRect.IsEmpty)
							{
								_arrangeTabGroupRect = rect4;
							}
							else
							{
								_arrangeTabGroupRect.Union(rect4);
							}
							rect4.Y = rect.Y;
							rect4.Height = rect.Height;
							rect4.Intersect(rect);
							if (rect3.IsEmpty && rect4.Width > 0.0)
							{
								rect3 = rect4;
							}
							else
							{
								rect3.Union(rect4);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				button.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, finalSize.Height));
				if (contextualTabGroup != null)
				{
					contextualTabGroup.PreferredExtent = button.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (!rect4.IsEmpty && CoreUtilities.GreaterThan(button.DesiredSize.Width, rect4.Width))
				{
					button.Measure(rect4.Size);
				}
				if (rect4.IsEmpty)
				{
					button.Arrange(OutOfViewTabGroupRect);
				}
				else
				{
					button.Arrange(rect4);
				}
			}
			if (!rect3.IsEmpty)
			{
				rect.Width = rect3.X - num;
				rect2 = rect;
				rect2.X = rect3.Right;
				rect2.Width = finalSize.Width - rect2.X;
			}
			if (_qat != null)
			{
				rect.Width += num;
				rect.X -= num;
				Rect finalRect = rect;
				if (_captionElement != null && finalRect.Width > 1.0)
				{
					finalRect.Width--;
				}
				if (finalRect.Width < _qat.DesiredSize.Width)
				{
					_qat.Measure(finalRect.Size);
				}
				finalRect.Width = Math.Min(finalRect.Width, _qat.DesiredSize.Width);
				_qat.Arrange(finalRect);
				rect.X += finalRect.Width;
				rect.Width -= finalRect.Width;
			}
			captionRectLeft = rect;
			captionRectRight = rect2;
			captionRectActual = GetCaptionRect();
			if (_captionElement != null)
			{
				Rect finalRect2 = captionRectActual;
				if (finalRect2.Width < _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width)
				{
					_captionElement.Measure(finalRect2.Size);
				}
				_captionElement.Arrange(finalRect2);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (_qat != null)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return _qat;
				}
				index--;
			}
			if (_captionElement != null)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return _captionElement;
				}
				index--;
			}
			if (index < _tabGroupPresenters.Count)
			{
				return _tabGroupPresenters[index];
			}
			index -= _tabGroupPresenters.Count;
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = default(System.Windows.Size);
			if (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				if (_qat != null)
				{
					_qat.Measure(availableSize);
					result.Width += _qat.DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, _qat.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
				if (_captionElement != null)
				{
					_captionElement.Measure(availableSize);
					result.Width += _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, _captionElement.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = availableSize;
				availableSize2.Width = Math.Max(availableSize2.Width - 50.0, 0.0);
				if (_qat != null)
				{
					_qat.Measure(availableSize2);
					result.Width += _qat.DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, _qat.DesiredSize.Height);
					availableSize2.Width = Math.Max(availableSize.Width -= result.Width, 0.0);
				}
				if (_captionElement != null)
				{
					_captionElement.Measure(availableSize2);
					result.Width += _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, _captionElement.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(UIElement child)

				base.OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(child);
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsWithinRibbonWindowChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

			if (true.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				ribbonCaptionPanel.CaptionElement.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject("RibbonWindow.Title", BindingMode.OneWay, XamRibbon.GetRibbon(ribbonCaptionPanel)));

			else if (ribbonCaptionPanel._captionElement != null)

		private void AddTabGroup(ContextualTabGroup tabGroup)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Button button = CreateButton(tabGroup);
			AddVisualChild(button);
			tabGroup.CaptionElement = button;
			_tabGroupPresenters.Add(button);
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button CreateButton(ContextualTabGroup tabGroup)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Button button = new System.Windows.Controls.Button();
			button.Content = tabGroup;
			button.Style = TabGroupButtonStyle;
			button.Command = ContextualTabGroup.SelectFirstTabCommand;
			MultiBinding multiBinding = new MultiBinding();
			multiBinding.Converter = ContextualTabVisibiltyMultiConverter.Instance;
			multiBinding.FallbackValue = KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox;
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(Utilities.CreateBindingObject("IsVisible", BindingMode.OneWay, tabGroup));
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(Utilities.CreateBindingObject(IsQatVisibleProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
			button.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, multiBinding);
			button.SetBinding(ToolTipService.ShowDurationProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToolTipService.ShowDurationProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tabGroup));
			button.AddHandler(System.Windows.Controls.Control.MouseDoubleClickEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnTabGroupDoubleClick));
			return button;
		}

		private Rect GetCaptionRect()
		{
			if (_captionElement == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect rect = captionRectLeft;
			Rect rect2 = captionRectRight;
			Rect rect3 = rect;
			Rect rect4 = (rect2.IsEmpty ? rect3 : Rect.Union(rect2, rect));
			if (_captionElement.HorizontalContentAlignment == System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					double num = ribbon.ActualWidth / 2.0;
					if (rect4.Left <= num && num <= rect4.Right)
					{
						try
						{
							num = ribbon.TransformToDescendant(this).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0)).X;
							double num2 = num - _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
							double num3 = num2 + _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width;
							if (rect.Left <= num2 && num2 <= rect.Right && rect.Left <= num3 && num3 <= rect.Right)
							{
								return new Rect(num2, rect4.Y, _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width, rect4.Height);
							}
							if (!rect2.IsEmpty && rect2.Left <= num2 && num2 <= rect2.Right && rect2.Left <= num3 && num3 <= rect2.Right)
							{
								return new Rect(num2, rect4.Y, _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width, rect4.Height);
							}
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!rect2.IsEmpty)
			{
				rect3 = new Rect(rect4.X, rect4.Y, _captionElement.DesiredSize.Width, rect4.Height);
				rect3.X += (rect4.Width - rect3.Width) / 2.0;
				if (!rect2.Contains(rect3))
				{
					if (rect3.Width <= rect.Width || rect.Width > rect2.Width)
					{
						rect3 = rect;
					}
					else
					{
						rect3.X = rect2.X + 1.0;
						rect3.Intersect(rect2);
					}
				}
			}
			return rect3;
		}

		private void OnContextualTabGroupChanged(object sender, ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (propertyName == "Tabs" || propertyName == "IsVisible")
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private void OnContextualTabGroupsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				foreach (ContextualTabGroup newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					AddTabGroup(newItem);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				foreach (ContextualTabGroup oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					RemoveTabGroup(oldItem);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				foreach (ContextualTabGroup oldItem2 in e.OldItems)
				{
					RemoveTabGroup(oldItem2);
				}
				foreach (ContextualTabGroup newItem2 in e.NewItems)
				{
					AddTabGroup(newItem2);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				RefreshTabGroups();
				break;
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private static void OnExecuteCommand(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RibbonCaptionPanel ribbonCaptionPanel = (RibbonCaptionPanel)target;
			if (args.Command == ContextualTabGroup.SelectFirstTabCommand)
			{
				((args.OriginalSource is System.Windows.Controls.Button button) ? (button.Content as ContextualTabGroup) : null)?.SelectFirstTab();
				args.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdate(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsArrangeValid)
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonTabItem arrangeFirstTabItem = _arrangeFirstTabItem;
			RibbonTabItem arrangeLastTabItem = _arrangeLastTabItem;
			if (arrangeFirstTabItem != null && arrangeLastTabItem != null)
			{
				try
				{
					Rect rect = arrangeFirstTabItem.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(new Rect(arrangeFirstTabItem.RenderSize));
					Rect rect2 = arrangeLastTabItem.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(new Rect(arrangeLastTabItem.RenderSize));
					Rect rect3 = Rect.Union(rect, rect2);
					if (rect3 != _arrangeTabGroupRect)
					{
						InvalidateArrange();
					}
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
				}
			}
			Rect captionRect = GetCaptionRect();
			if (captionRect != captionRectActual)
			{
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Loaded -= OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdate;
		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonCaptionPanel ribbonCaptionPanel = (RibbonCaptionPanel)d;
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = e.OldValue as XamRibbon;
			if (e.NewValue is XamRibbon xamRibbon2)
			{
				ribbonCaptionPanel.SetBinding(IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, xamRibbon2));
				ribbonCaptionPanel.SetBinding(IsGlassActiveProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.IsGlassActiveProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, xamRibbon2));
				ribbonCaptionPanel.SetBinding(AreTabItemsScrollingProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamTabControl.IsTabItemPanelScrollingProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, xamRibbon2.RibbonTabControl));
				xamRibbon2.ContextualTabGroups.CollectionChanged += ribbonCaptionPanel.OnContextualTabGroupsChanged;
				xamRibbon2.ContextualTabGroups.ItemPropertyChanged += ribbonCaptionPanel.OnContextualTabGroupChanged;
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(ribbonCaptionPanel, IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(ribbonCaptionPanel, AreTabItemsScrollingProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(ribbonCaptionPanel, IsGlassActiveProperty);
				if (xamRibbon != null)
				{
					xamRibbon.ContextualTabGroups.CollectionChanged -= ribbonCaptionPanel.OnContextualTabGroupsChanged;
					xamRibbon.ContextualTabGroups.ItemPropertyChanged -= ribbonCaptionPanel.OnContextualTabGroupChanged;
				}
			}
			ribbonCaptionPanel.RefreshTabGroups();
		}

		private void OnTabGroupDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedButton != MouseButton.Left)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsWithinRibbonWindow)
			{
				RoutedCommand routedCommand = ((ribbon.RibbonWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized) ? RibbonWindowCommands.RestoreCommand : RibbonWindowCommands.MaximizeCommand);
				IInputElement target = sender as IInputElement;
				if (routedCommand.CanExecute(null, target))
				{
					routedCommand.Execute(null, target);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded -= OnUnloaded;
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdate;
		}

		private void RefreshTabGroups()
		{
			Dictionary<ContextualTabGroup, System.Windows.Controls.Button> dictionary = new Dictionary<ContextualTabGroup, System.Windows.Controls.Button>();
			foreach (System.Windows.Controls.Button tabGroupPresenter in _tabGroupPresenters)
			{
				dictionary.Add((ContextualTabGroup)tabGroupPresenter.Content, tabGroupPresenter);
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			ContextualTabGroupCollection contextualTabGroupCollection = ((ribbon != null) ? ribbon.ContextualTabGroups : new ContextualTabGroupCollection());
			List<System.Windows.Controls.Button> list = new List<System.Windows.Controls.Button>();
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = contextualTabGroupCollection.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = contextualTabGroupCollection[i];
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(contextualTabGroup, out var value))
				{
					dictionary.Remove(contextualTabGroup);
				}
				else
				{
					value = CreateButton(contextualTabGroup);
					AddVisualChild(value);
					contextualTabGroup.CaptionElement = value;
				}
				list.Add(value);
			}
			foreach (System.Windows.Controls.Button value2 in dictionary.Values)
			{
				if (value2.Content is ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup2 && contextualTabGroup2.CaptionElement == value2)
				{
					contextualTabGroup2.CaptionElement = null;
				}
				RemoveVisualChild(value2);
			}
			_tabGroupPresenters = list;
		}

		private void RemoveTabGroup(ContextualTabGroup tabGroup)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _tabGroupPresenters.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Button button = _tabGroupPresenters[i];
				if (button.Content == tabGroup)
				{
					_tabGroupPresenters.RemoveAt(i);
					RemoveVisualChild(button);
					tabGroup.CaptionElement = null;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class RibbonContextMenu : System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu, IRibbonToolLocation
	{
		ToolLocation IRibbonToolLocation.Location => ToolLocation.Menu;

		static RibbonContextMenu()
		{
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonContextMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(RibbonContextMenu)));
			Grid.IsSharedSizeScopeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonContextMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = element as ToolMenuItem;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item as FrameworkElement;
			if (toolMenuItem != null && frameworkElement != null && item is IRibbonTool { ToolProxy: var toolProxy })
			{
				if (toolProxy == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_IRibbonToolProxyIsNull"));
				}
				toolProxy.ClearToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new ToolMenuItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is ToolMenuItem;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			MenuToolBase.VerifyTypeOfChildren(this);
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				MenuToolBase.VerifyTypeOfChildren(this);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				for (int i = e.NewStartingIndex; i < e.NewStartingIndex + e.NewItems.Count; i++)
				{
					MenuToolBase.VerifyTypeOfChild(base.Items[i]);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (element is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
			{
				toolMenuItem.SetValue(ToolMenuItem.ToolPropertyKey, item as IRibbonTool);
			}
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element == item && element is ToolMenuItem && ((ToolMenuItem)element).RibbonTool != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)element).DataContext = null;
			}
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem2 = element as ToolMenuItem;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item as FrameworkElement;
			if (toolMenuItem2 == null || frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (item is IRibbonTool { ToolProxy: var toolProxy })
			{
				if (toolProxy == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_IRibbonToolProxyIsNull"));
				}
				toolProxy.PrepareToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem2, frameworkElement);
			}
			toolMenuItem2.SetValue(XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationMenuBox);
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class RibbonGroupPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel, IScrollInfo
	{
		internal class ScrollData
		{
			internal ScrollViewer _scrollOwner;

			internal System.Windows.Size _extent;

			internal System.Windows.Size _viewport;

			internal Vector _offset;

			internal bool _canHorizontallyScroll;

			internal bool _canVerticallyScroll;

			internal void Reset()
			{
				_offset = default(Vector);
				_extent = default(System.Windows.Size);
				_viewport = default(System.Windows.Size);
			}

			internal void VerifyScrollData(System.Windows.Size viewPort, System.Windows.Size extent)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Width))
				{
					viewPort.Width = extent.Width;
				}
				if (double.IsInfinity(viewPort.Height))
				{
					viewPort.Height = extent.Height;
				}
				bool flag = !AreClose(_viewport.Width, viewPort.Width) || !AreClose(_viewport.Height, viewPort.Height) || !AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width) || !AreClose(_extent.Width, extent.Width);
				_viewport = viewPort;
				_extent = extent;
				flag |= VerifyOffset();
				if (_scrollOwner != null && flag)
				{
					_scrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				}
			}

			private bool VerifyOffset()
			{
				double x = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.X, _extent.Width - _viewport.Width), 0.0);
				double y = Math.Max(Math.Min(_offset.Y, _extent.Height - _viewport.Height), 0.0);
				Vector offset = _offset;
				_offset = new Vector(x, y);
				if (AreClose(_offset.X, offset.X))
				{
					return !AreClose(_offset.Y, offset.Y);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private class GroupIndex
		{
			internal RibbonGroup Group;

			internal int Index;

			internal double ExtraCaptionWidth;

			internal double AmountToRemove;

			internal double NewDesiredWidth => Group.DesiredSize.Width - AmountToRemove;

			internal bool CanReduceSize => AmountAvailableForReduce > 0.0;

			internal double AmountAvailableForReduce => ExtraCaptionWidth - AmountToRemove;

			internal GroupIndex(RibbonGroup group, int index, double extraCaptionWidth)
			{
				Index = index;
				Group = group;
				ExtraCaptionWidth = extraCaptionWidth;
				AmountToRemove = 0.0;
			}
		}

		private const double InterGroupSpacing = 0.0;

		private bool _isInMeasure;

		private Dictionary<RibbonGroup, RibbonTabItem> _groupsToRestore = new Dictionary<RibbonGroup, RibbonTabItem>();

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ExtraCaptionExtentPropertyKey;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty ExtraCaptionExtentProperty;

			ExtraCaptionExtentProperty = ExtraCaptionExtentPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsRibbonGroupResizingEnabledProperty = XamRibbon.IsRibbonGroupResizingEnabledProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroupPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsRibbonGroupResizingEnabledChanged));
			RibbonGroupSizeVersionProperty = XamRibbon.RibbonGroupSizeVersionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroupPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnRibbonGroupSizeVersionChanged));
			SizingModeVersionProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("SizingModeVersion", typeof(int), typeof(RibbonGroupPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0, OnSizingModeVersionChanged));

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			ScrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(finalSize, ScrollDataInfo._extent);
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(finalSize);
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			finalRect.Location = new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - ScrollDataInfo._offset.X, 0.0 - ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					finalRect.Width = _groupExtents[i];
					uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
					finalRect.X += finalRect.Width + 0.0;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			bool isInMeasure = _isInMeasure;
			try
			{
				_isInMeasure = true;
				return MeasureOverrideImpl(availableSize);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isInMeasure = isInMeasure;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size MeasureOverrideImpl(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			UIElement[] array = new UIElement[internalChildren.Count];
			internalChildren.CopyTo(array, 0);
			bool flag = _variantManager.IsVariantInfoDirty || double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Width);
			if (flag)
			{
				_variantManager.ResetVariantInfo();
			}
			int num = (int)GetValue(RibbonGroupSizeVersionProperty);
			MeasureChildren(array, availableSize2, out var desiredSizeMax, out var desiredSizeMin);
			int num2 = (int)GetValue(RibbonGroupSizeVersionProperty);
			if (num2 != num)
			{
				flag = true;
				_variantManager.ResetVariantInfo();
				MeasureChildren(array, availableSize2, out desiredSizeMax, out desiredSizeMin);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_variantManager.CacheTotalExtent(desiredSizeMin.Width);
			}
			if (!double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) && true.Equals(GetValue(IsRibbonGroupResizingEnabledProperty)))
			{
				double num3 = availableSize.Width - desiredSizeMin.Width;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (num3 < 0.0)
				{
					bool isNewOperation;
					while (num3 < 0.0 && _variantManager.ProcessVariantChange(decrease: true, out isNewOperation))
					{
						double num4;
						if (isNewOperation)
						{
							MeasureChildren(array, availableSize2, out desiredSizeMax, out desiredSizeMin);
							num4 = availableSize.Width - desiredSizeMin.Width;
							flag2 = false;
						}
						else
						{
							num4 = availableSize.Width - _variantManager.CurrentTotalExtent;
							flag2 = true;
						}
						if (num4 <= num3)
						{
							if (isNewOperation)
							{
								_variantManager.DisableCurrentVariant();
								flag2 = true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (isNewOperation)
							{
								_variantManager.CacheTotalExtent(desiredSizeMin.Width);
							}
							num3 = num4;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (num3 > 0.0)
				{
					while (_variantManager.CanIncreaseInSize && !(_variantManager.ExtentIfIncreased - availableSize.Width >= 0.0))
					{
						bool isNewOperation2;
						bool flag3 = _variantManager.ProcessVariantChange(decrease: false, out isNewOperation2);
						flag2 = flag2 || flag3;
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					MeasureChildren(array, availableSize2, out desiredSizeMax, out desiredSizeMin);
				}
			}
			_groupExtents.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				_groupExtents.Add(array[i].DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			if (desiredSizeMax.Width > desiredSizeMin.Width)
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) || availableSize.Width >= desiredSizeMax.Width)
				{
					desiredSizeMin.Width = desiredSizeMax.Width;
				}
				else if (desiredSizeMin.Width < availableSize.Width)
				{
					double excess = desiredSizeMax.Width - availableSize.Width;
					desiredSizeMin.Width = availableSize.Width;
					AdjustGroupsForCaption(excess, array);
				}
				else
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						UIElement uIElement = array[j];
						object obj = uIElement?.ReadLocalValue(ExtraCaptionExtentProperty);
						if (obj is double)
						{
							System.Windows.Size availableSize3 = new System.Windows.Size(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width - (double)obj, availableSize2.Height);
							uIElement.Measure(availableSize3);
							_groupExtents[j] = availableSize3.Width;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ScrollDataInfo.VerifyScrollData(availableSize, desiredSizeMin);
			if (availableSize.Width < desiredSizeMin.Width)
			{
				desiredSizeMin.Width = availableSize.Width;
			}
			if (availableSize.Height < desiredSizeMin.Height)
			{
				desiredSizeMin.Height = availableSize.Height;
			}
			return desiredSizeMin;
		}

		protected override void OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(UIElement child)
		{
			bool flag = !base.IsLoaded || child.GetValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty) == XamRibbon.RibbonGroupForResizingTag;
			if (!flag)
			{
				int num = base.Children.IndexOf(child);
				flag = num < 0 || num >= _groupExtents.Count || child.DesiredSize.Width != _groupExtents[num];
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_variantManager.InvalidateVariantInfo();
			}
			base.OnChildDesiredSizeChanged(child);
		}

		protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
		{
			base.OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = visualAdded as RibbonGroup;
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2 = visualRemoved as RibbonGroup;
			if (ribbonGroup != null)
			{
				_variantManager.AddGroup(ribbonGroup);
				if (ribbonGroup.IsLoaded && !base.IsLoaded && ribbonGroup.Parent is RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem)
				{
					_groupValues[ribbonGroup] = new TempValueReplacement(ribbonGroup, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
					ribbonTabItem.RemoveLogicalChildHelper(ribbonGroup);
					_groupsToRestore[ribbonGroup] = ribbonTabItem;
				}
			}
			if (ribbonGroup2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_variantManager.RemoveGroup(ribbonGroup2);
			if (_groupsToRestore.TryGetValue(ribbonGroup2, out var value))
			{
				_groupsToRestore.Remove(ribbonGroup2);
				if (ribbonGroup2.Parent == null)
				{
					value.AddLogicalChildHelper(ribbonGroup2);
				}
				if (_groupValues.TryGetValue(ribbonGroup2, out var value2))
				{
					_groupValues.Remove(ribbonGroup2);
					value2.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnSizingModeVersionChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d.ReadLocalValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			do
			{
				if (d is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				d = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(d);
			}
			while (d != null && !(d is RibbonGroupPanel) && e.NewValue != d.GetValue(SizingModeVersionProperty));
		}

		private void AdjustGroupsForCaption(double excess, UIElement[] children)
		{
			List<GroupIndex> list = new List<GroupIndex>();
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
			{
				if (children[i] is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
				{
					double extraCaptionExtent = GetExtraCaptionExtent(ribbonGroup);
					if (0.0 != extraCaptionExtent)
					{
						list.Add(new GroupIndex(ribbonGroup, i, extraCaptionExtent));
					}
				}
			}
			list.Sort(delegate(GroupIndex a, GroupIndex b)
			{
				int num21 = b.Group.DesiredSize.Width.CompareTo(a.Group.DesiredSize.Width);
				if (num21 == 0)
				{
					num21 = b.Index.CompareTo(a.Index);
				}
				return num21;
			});
			int count = list.Count;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = -1;
			int num3 = -1;
			while (excess > 0.0)
			{
				for (; num < count && !list[num].CanReduceSize; num++)
				{
				}
				double newDesiredWidth = list[num].NewDesiredWidth;
				int num4 = count;
				double num5 = 0.0;
				int num6 = 1;
				for (int num7 = num + 1; num7 < count; num7++)
				{
					GroupIndex groupIndex = list[num7];
					if (groupIndex.CanReduceSize)
					{
						if (!AreClose(groupIndex.NewDesiredWidth, newDesiredWidth))
						{
							num4 = num7;
							num5 = groupIndex.NewDesiredWidth;
							break;
						}
						num6++;
					}
				}
				if (num == num2 && num4 == num3)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 = num;
				num3 = num4;
				double num8 = 0.0;
				double val = newDesiredWidth - num5;
				double num9 = double.MaxValue;
				for (int num10 = num; num10 < num4; num10++)
				{
					GroupIndex groupIndex2 = list[num10];
					if (groupIndex2.CanReduceSize)
					{
						double num11 = Math.Min(val, groupIndex2.AmountAvailableForReduce);
						if (num9 > num11)
						{
							num9 = num11;
						}
						num8 += num11;
					}
				}
				if (num8 <= excess)
				{
					for (int num12 = num; num12 < num4; num12++)
					{
						GroupIndex groupIndex3 = list[num12];
						if (groupIndex3.CanReduceSize)
						{
							groupIndex3.AmountToRemove += Math.Min(val, groupIndex3.AmountAvailableForReduce);
						}
					}
					excess -= num8;
					continue;
				}
				if (num9 * (double)num6 >= excess)
				{
					double num13 = excess / (double)num6;
					double num14 = excess - num13 * (double)num6;
					for (int num15 = num; num15 < num4; num15++)
					{
						GroupIndex groupIndex4 = list[num15];
						if (groupIndex4.CanReduceSize)
						{
							double num16 = num13;
							if (num14 > 0.0)
							{
								double num17 = Math.Min(1.0, num14);
								num16 += num17;
								num14 -= num17;
							}
							groupIndex4.AmountToRemove += num16;
						}
					}
					excess = 0.0;
					continue;
				}
				double num18 = num9;
				while (excess > 0.0)
				{
					for (int num19 = num; num19 < num4; num19++)
					{
						GroupIndex groupIndex5 = list[num19];
						if (!groupIndex5.CanReduceSize)
						{
							if (num19 == num)
							{
								num++;
							}
							else if (num19 == num4)
							{
								num4--;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							groupIndex5.AmountToRemove += num18;
							if (!groupIndex5.CanReduceSize)
							{
								num6--;
							}
							excess -= num18;
						}
					}
					num18 = ((num6 != 1) ? 1.0 : excess);
				}
			}
			for (int num20 = 0; num20 < count; num20++)
			{
				GroupIndex groupIndex6 = list[num20];
				if (groupIndex6.AmountToRemove != 0.0)
				{
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = groupIndex6.Group.DesiredSize;
					desiredSize.Width = groupIndex6.NewDesiredWidth;
					_groupExtents[groupIndex6.Index] = groupIndex6.NewDesiredWidth;
					groupIndex6.Group.Measure(desiredSize);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ApplyTemplateRecursively(DependencyObject dependencyObject)
		{
			if (dependencyObject is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.ApplyTemplate();
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(dependencyObject); i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(dependencyObject, i);
				if (child != null)
				{
					ApplyTemplateRecursively(child);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreClose(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (value1 == value2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < 1E-10;
		}

		internal static void BumpSizingModeVersion(DependencyObject d)
		{
			d.SetValue(SizingModeVersionProperty, 1 + (int)d.GetValue(SizingModeVersionProperty));
		}

		internal static void EnsureIsANumber(double number)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(number))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("number", number, XamRibbon.GetString("LE_DoubleNanNotAllowed"));
			}
		}

		internal static void InvalidateMeasure(UIElement descendant, UIElement ancestor)
		{
			while (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(descendant) is UIElement uIElement && uIElement != ancestor)
			{
				uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				descendant = uIElement;
			}
		}

		private void MeasureChildren(UIElement[] children, System.Windows.Size availableSize, out System.Windows.Size desiredSizeMax, out System.Windows.Size desiredSizeMin)
		{
			desiredSizeMax = default(System.Windows.Size);
			desiredSizeMin = default(System.Windows.Size);
			foreach (UIElement uIElement in children)
			{
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
				System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
				if (desiredSizeMax.Width > 0.0)
				{
					desiredSizeMax.Width += 0.0;
					desiredSizeMin.Width += 0.0;
				}
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = uIElement as RibbonGroup;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((ribbonGroup != null && !ribbonGroup.IsCollapsed) ? ribbonGroup.CaptionElement : null);
				Visibility visibility = ((frameworkElement != null) ? ribbonGroup.CaptionElement.Visibility : Visibility.Collapsed);
				if (visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					object obj = frameworkElement.ReadLocalValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
					frameworkElement.SetValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
					InvalidateMeasure(ribbonGroup.CaptionElement, this);
					uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
					double width = uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
					desiredSizeMin.Width += width;
					double num = desiredSize.Width - width;
					if (num == 0.0)
					{
						uIElement.ClearValue(ExtraCaptionExtentPropertyKey);
					}
					else
					{
						uIElement.SetValue(ExtraCaptionExtentPropertyKey, num);
					}
					InvalidateMeasure(ribbonGroup.CaptionElement, this);
					if (obj is Visibility)
					{
						frameworkElement.SetValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, obj);
					}
					else if (obj is BindingBase)
					{
						frameworkElement.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, (BindingBase)obj);
					}
					else
					{
						frameworkElement.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
					}
					uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
				}
				else
				{
					desiredSizeMin.Width += desiredSize.Width;
					uIElement.ClearValue(ExtraCaptionExtentPropertyKey);
				}
				desiredSizeMax.Width += desiredSize.Width;
				desiredSizeMax.Height = Math.Max(desiredSizeMax.Height, desiredSize.Height);
				desiredSizeMin.Height = desiredSizeMax.Height;
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_groupsToRestore.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<RibbonGroup, RibbonTabItem> groupsToRestore = _groupsToRestore;
			_groupsToRestore = new Dictionary<RibbonGroup, RibbonTabItem>();
			Dictionary<RibbonGroup, TempValueReplacement> groupValues = _groupValues;
			_groupValues = new Dictionary<RibbonGroup, TempValueReplacement>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<RibbonGroup, RibbonTabItem> item in groupsToRestore)
			{
				if (item.Key.Parent == null)
				{
					item.Value.AddLogicalChildHelper(item.Key);
				}
				if (groupValues.TryGetValue(item.Key, out var value))
				{
					value.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonGroupPanel ribbonGroupPanel = d as RibbonGroupPanel;
			if (ribbonGroupPanel != null && e.NewValue is XamRibbon)
			{
				ribbonGroupPanel.SetBinding(RibbonGroupSizeVersionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.RibbonGroupSizeVersionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, e.NewValue));
				ribbonGroupPanel.SetBinding(IsRibbonGroupResizingEnabledProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.IsRibbonGroupResizingEnabledProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, e.NewValue));
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonGroupPanel.ClearValue(RibbonGroupSizeVersionProperty);
				ribbonGroupPanel.ClearValue(IsRibbonGroupResizingEnabledProperty);
			}
		}

		internal void OutputResizeMessage(string message)
		{
		}

		internal void PrepareCollapsedRibbonGroup(RibbonGroup group)
