		private void AdjustVerticalOffset(double adjustment)
		{
			((IScrollInfo)this).SetVerticalOffset(adjustment + ((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset);
		}

		private void AdjustHorizontalOffset(double adjustment)
		{
			((IScrollInfo)this).SetHorizontalOffset(adjustment + ((IScrollInfo)this).HorizontalOffset);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(-16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(-16.0);
		}

		Rect IScrollInfo.MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty || visual == null || !IsAncestorOf(visual))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect rect = visual.TransformToAncestor(this).TransformBounds(rectangle);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
			Rect rect3 = Rect.Intersect(rect, rect2);
			if (rect3.Width != rect.Width)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (rect.Right > rect2.Right)
				{
					num = rect.Right - rect2.Right;
				}
				if (rect.Left - num - rect2.Left < 0.0)
				{
					num += rect.Left - num - rect2.Left;
				}
				rect.X -= num;
				num += ((IScrollInfo)this).HorizontalOffset;
				((IScrollInfo)this).SetHorizontalOffset(num);
			}
			if (rect3.Height != rect.Height)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (rect.Bottom > rect2.Bottom)
				{
					num2 = rect.Bottom - rect2.Bottom;
				}
				if (rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top < 0.0)
				{
					num2 += rect.Top - num2 - rect2.Top;
				}
				rect.Y -= num2;
				num2 += ((IScrollInfo)this).VerticalOffset;
				((IScrollInfo)this).SetVerticalOffset(num2);
			}
			return rect;
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset((double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset((double)(-SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines) * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset((double)SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset((double)(-SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines) * 16.0);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageDown()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(0.0 - ((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportHeight);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageLeft()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(0.0 - ((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportWidth);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageRight()
		{
			AdjustHorizontalOffset(((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportWidth);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageUp()
		{
			AdjustVerticalOffset(((IScrollInfo)this).ViewportHeight);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			EnsureIsANumber(offset);
			offset = Math.Max(offset, 0.0);
			if (!AreClose(offset, ScrollDataInfo._offset.X))
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.X = offset;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			EnsureIsANumber(offset);
			offset = Math.Max(offset, 0.0);
			if (!AreClose(offset, ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y))
			{
				ScrollDataInfo._offset.Y = offset;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class VariantManager : IComparer<RibbonGroupVariant>
	{
		private NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler _groupVariantsCollectionHandler;

		private EventHandler<ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs> _groupVariantsItemPropChangeHandler;

		private List<RibbonGroup> _groups = new List<RibbonGroup>();

		private int _lastVariantProcessed = -1;

		private RibbonGroupPanel _owner;

		private GroupVariantResizeHistory _resizeHistory;

		private Dictionary<RibbonGroup, List<GroupVariantAction>> _groupHistories;

		private List<GroupActionFactory> _variantActions;

		internal bool CanIncreaseInSize => _resizeHistory.CanUndo();

		internal double CurrentTotalExtent => _resizeHistory.CurrentExtent;

		internal double ExtentIfIncreased => _resizeHistory.NextLargerExtent;

		internal bool IsVariantInfoDirty => _variantActions == null;

		internal VariantManager(RibbonGroupPanel owner)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_groupVariantsCollectionHandler = OnGroupVariantsChanged;
			_groupVariantsItemPropChangeHandler = OnGroupVariantsItemPropChanged;
			_resizeHistory = new GroupVariantResizeHistory(owner);
		}

		internal void AddGroup(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			if (group != null)
			{
				_groups.Add(group);
				InvalidateVariantInfo();
				group.Variants.CollectionChanged += _groupVariantsCollectionHandler;
				group.Variants.ItemPropertyChanged += _groupVariantsItemPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void CacheTotalExtent(double totalExtent)
		{
			double nextLargerExtent = _resizeHistory.NextLargerExtent;
			_resizeHistory.NextLargerExtent = _resizeHistory.CurrentExtent;
			_resizeHistory.CurrentExtent = totalExtent;
			GroupVariantAction undoActionOnQueue = _resizeHistory.UndoActionOnQueue;
			if (undoActionOnQueue != null)
			{
				undoActionOnQueue.ResultingExtent = _resizeHistory.NextLargerExtent;
				undoActionOnQueue.NextLargerExtent = nextLargerExtent;
				_groupHistories[undoActionOnQueue.Group].Add(undoActionOnQueue);
			}
		}

		internal void DisableCurrentVariant()
		{
			bool flag = _resizeHistory.Undo();
			_resizeHistory.ClearRedo();
			if (_lastVariantProcessed >= 0 && _lastVariantProcessed < _variantActions.Count)
			{
				_variantActions[_lastVariantProcessed].InvalidateLastAction();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeVariantInfo()
		{
			_lastVariantProcessed = 0;
			_variantActions = new List<GroupActionFactory>();
			List<RibbonGroupVariant> list = new List<RibbonGroupVariant>();
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (RibbonGroup group in _groups)
			{
				if (group.Variants.Count > 0)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				list.Clear();
				Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(GroupVariantResizeAction));
				foreach (GroupVariantResizeAction item in values)
				{
					GroupVariant defaultVariant = GroupVariant.GetDefaultVariant(item);
					for (int num = _groups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						list.Add(new RibbonGroupVariant(_groups[num], defaultVariant, num));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _groups.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = _groups[i];
					foreach (GroupVariant variant in ribbonGroup.Variants)
					{
						list.Add(new RibbonGroupVariant(ribbonGroup, variant, i));
					}
				}
				list.Sort(this);
				Dictionary<RibbonGroup, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<RibbonGroup, bool>();
				int j = 0;
				for (int num2 = list.Count; j < num2; j++)
				{
					RibbonGroupVariant ribbonGroupVariant = list[j];
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(ribbonGroupVariant.Group, out var value))
					{
						if (value)
						{
							list.RemoveAt(j);
							j--;
							num2--;
						}
					}
					else if (ribbonGroupVariant.Variant.ResizeAction == GroupVariantResizeAction.CollapseRibbonGroup)
					{
						dictionary.Add(ribbonGroupVariant.Group, value: true);
					}
				}
			}
			GroupVariantResizeAction groupVariantResizeAction = (GroupVariantResizeAction)(-1);
			foreach (RibbonGroupVariant item2 in list)
			{
				if (item2.Variant.ResizeAction == groupVariantResizeAction)
				{
					_variantActions[_variantActions.Count - 1].AddGroup(item2.Group);
					continue;
				}
				groupVariantResizeAction = item2.Variant.ResizeAction;
				_variantActions.Add(new GroupActionFactory(groupVariantResizeAction, item2.Group, _resizeHistory));
			}
			_groupHistories = new Dictionary<RibbonGroup, List<GroupVariantAction>>();
			foreach (RibbonGroup group2 in _groups)
			{
				_groupHistories.Add(group2, new List<GroupVariantAction>());
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateVariantInfo()
		{
			_variantActions = null;
			_lastVariantProcessed = -1;
			_resizeHistory.Clear();
			_resizeHistory.NextLargerExtent = double.NaN;
			_resizeHistory.CurrentExtent = double.NaN;
			_owner.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void OnGroupVariantsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateVariantInfo();
		}

		private void OnGroupVariantsItemPropChanged(object sender, ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateVariantInfo();
		}

		internal void PrepareCollapsedRibbonGroup(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			if (_groupHistories == null || !_groupHistories.TryGetValue(group, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isDropDown = group.IsDropDown;
			int num = (isDropDown ? (value.Count - 1) : 0);
			int num2 = (isDropDown ? (-1) : value.Count);
			int num3 = ((!isDropDown) ? 1 : (-1));
			for (int i = num; i != num2; i += num3)
			{
				GroupVariantAction groupVariantAction = value[i];
				if (!(groupVariantAction is GalleryPreviewColumnAction) && !(groupVariantAction is CollapseGroupAction))
				{
					groupVariantAction.ReplayGroupAction(!isDropDown);
				}
			}
			RibbonGroupPanel.BumpSizingModeVersion(group);
		}

		internal bool ProcessVariantChange(bool decrease, out bool isNewOperation)
		{
			isNewOperation = false;
			VerifyVariantInfo();
			if (_variantActions.Count > 0)
			{
				if (decrease)
				{
					if (_resizeHistory.CanRedo() && _resizeHistory.Redo())
					{
						return true;
					}
					while (_lastVariantProcessed < _variantActions.Count)
					{
						GroupVariantAction groupVariantAction = _variantActions[_lastVariantProcessed].CreateAction();
						if (groupVariantAction == null)
						{
							_lastVariantProcessed++;
							continue;
						}
						_resizeHistory.PerformAction(groupVariantAction, null);
						isNewOperation = true;
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (_resizeHistory.CanUndo())
				{
					return _resizeHistory.Undo();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetVariantInfo()
		{
			InvalidateVariantInfo();
			foreach (RibbonGroup group in _groups)
			{
				ResetVariantInfo(group, isOnQat: false, _owner);
			}
			VerifyVariantInfo();
		}

		internal static void ResetVariantInfo(RibbonGroup group, bool isOnQat, UIElement ancestor)
		{
			group.ClearValue(RibbonGroup.IsCollapsedPropertyKey);
			foreach (IRibbonToolPanel registeredPanel in group.RegisteredPanels)
			{
				if (!(registeredPanel is System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel))
				{
					continue;
				}
				RibbonToolSizingMode maximumSize = RibbonGroup.GetMaximumSize(panel);
				foreach (UIElement child in panel.Children)
				{
					if (child == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					RibbonToolSizingMode ribbonToolSizingMode = RibbonGroup.GetMaximumSize(child);
					if (ribbonToolSizingMode > maximumSize)
					{
						ribbonToolSizingMode = maximumSize;
						RibbonToolSizingMode minimumSize = RibbonGroup.GetMinimumSize(child);
						if (minimumSize > ribbonToolSizingMode)
						{
							ribbonToolSizingMode = minimumSize;
						}
					}
					if (RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(child) != ribbonToolSizingMode)
					{
						child.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.FromValue(ribbonToolSizingMode));
						RibbonGroupPanel.BumpSizingModeVersion(child);
						RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(child, ancestor);
					}
				}
				if (panel is ToolHorizontalWrapPanel toolHorizontalWrapPanel)
				{
					toolHorizontalWrapPanel.SetValue(ToolHorizontalWrapPanel.RowCountPropertyKey, toolHorizontalWrapPanel.MinRows);
					RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(toolHorizontalWrapPanel, ancestor);
				}
			}
			foreach (MenuTool registeredMenu in group.RegisteredMenus)
			{
				if (!registeredMenu.HasGalleryPreview && isOnQat)
				{
					registeredMenu.ApplyTemplate();
				}
				registeredMenu.ClearValue(MenuTool.HideGalleryPreviewProperty);
				if (!registeredMenu.HasGalleryPreview)
				{
					continue;
				}
				MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter = registeredMenu.MenuToolPresenter;
				if (menuToolPresenter != null)
				{
					if (isOnQat)
					{
						menuToolPresenter.ApplyTemplate();
					}
					UIElement uIElement2 = menuToolPresenter;
					if (!isOnQat)
					{
						menuToolPresenter.ClearValue(MenuToolPresenter.ResizedColumnCountProperty);
					}
					else if (menuToolPresenter.GalleryToolForPreview != null)
					{
						menuToolPresenter.SetValue(MenuToolPresenter.ResizedColumnCountProperty, menuToolPresenter.GalleryToolForPreview.MinPreviewColumns);
					}
					RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(menuToolPresenter, ancestor);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveGroup(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			if (group != null)
			{
				group.Variants.CollectionChanged -= _groupVariantsCollectionHandler;
				group.Variants.ItemPropertyChanged -= _groupVariantsItemPropChangeHandler;
				InvalidateVariantInfo();
				_groups.Remove(group);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyVariantInfo()
		{
			if (IsVariantInfoDirty)
			{
				InitializeVariantInfo();
			}
		}

		int IComparer<RibbonGroupVariant>.Compare(RibbonGroupVariant x, RibbonGroupVariant y)
		{
			if (x.Variant != y.Variant)
			{
				if (x.Variant.Priority != y.Variant.Priority)
				{
					return x.Variant.Priority.CompareTo(y.Variant.Priority);
				}
				if (x.Variant.ResizeAction != y.Variant.ResizeAction)
				{
					return x.Variant.ResizeAction.CompareTo(y.Variant.ResizeAction);
				}
			}
			return y.GroupIndex.CompareTo(x.GroupIndex);
		}
	}
	internal class RibbonGroupVariant
	{
		internal RibbonGroup Group;

		internal GroupVariant Variant;

		internal int GroupIndex;

		internal RibbonGroupVariant(RibbonGroup group, GroupVariant variant, int groupIndex)
		{
			Group = group;
			Variant = variant;
			GroupIndex = groupIndex;
		}
	}
	internal class GroupActionFactory
	{
		private bool _initialized;

		private GroupVariantResizeAction _variantResizeAction;

		private List<RibbonGroup> _groups;

		private List<MenuTool> _menus;

		private List<IRibbonToolPanel> _panels;

		private int _currentGroupIndex;

		private int _currentMenuIndex;

		private int _currentPanelIndex;

		private bool _isComplete;

		private GroupVariantAction _lastAction;

		private int _horizontalRowCount = 2;

		private GroupVariantResizeHistory _history;

		public GroupVariantResizeAction VariantResizeAction => _variantResizeAction;

		internal GroupActionFactory(GroupVariantResizeAction variantResizeAction, RibbonGroup group, GroupVariantResizeHistory history)
		{
			_variantResizeAction = variantResizeAction;
			_history = history;
			_groups = new List<RibbonGroup>();
			_groups.Add(group);
		}

		internal void AddGroup(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			if (_initialized)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			_groups.Add(group);
		}

		internal GroupVariantAction CreateAction()
		{
			if (!_initialized)
			{
				_initialized = true;
				Initialize();
			}
			GroupVariantAction groupVariantAction = null;
			if (!_isComplete)
			{
				switch (VariantResizeAction)
				{
				default:
				{
					RibbonGroup nextGroup = GetNextGroup();
					if (nextGroup != null)
					{
						groupVariantAction = new CollapseGroupAction(nextGroup, isCollapsed: true, _history);
					}
					break;
				}
				case GroupVariantResizeAction.HideGalleryPreview:
				{
					for (MenuTool nextMenu = GetNextMenu(); nextMenu != null; nextMenu = GetNextMenu())
					{
						if (nextMenu.HasGalleryPreview)
						{
							groupVariantAction = new GalleryPreviewVisibilityAction(nextMenu, isPreviewVisible: false, _history);
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case GroupVariantResizeAction.ReduceGalleryPreviewItems:
				{
					int currentColumnCount;
					MenuTool nextGalleryColumnMenu = GetNextGalleryColumnMenu(out currentColumnCount);
					if (nextGalleryColumnMenu != null)
					{
						groupVariantAction = new GalleryPreviewColumnAction(nextGalleryColumnMenu, currentColumnCount, currentColumnCount - 1, _history);
					}
					break;
				}
				case GroupVariantResizeAction.IncreaseHorizontalWrapRowCount:
				{
					ToolHorizontalWrapPanel nextHorizontalPanel = GetNextHorizontalPanel();
					if (nextHorizontalPanel != null)
					{
						groupVariantAction = new HorizontalWrapRowCountAction(nextHorizontalPanel, _horizontalRowCount - 1, _horizontalRowCount, _history);
					}
					break;
				}
				case GroupVariantResizeAction.ReduceImageAndTextLargeTools:
					groupVariantAction = CreateToolResizeAction(RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal, RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge);
					break;
				case GroupVariantResizeAction.ReduceImageAndTextNormalTools:
					groupVariantAction = CreateToolResizeAction(RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly, RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal);
					break;
				}
				_lastAction = groupVariantAction;
				_isComplete = groupVariantAction == null;
			}
			return groupVariantAction;
		}

		internal void InvalidateLastAction()
		{
			if (_lastAction != null)
			{
				if (_lastAction is ToolSizingModeAction)
				{
					_panels.Remove(((ToolSizingModeAction)_lastAction).Panel);
				}
				else if (_lastAction is GalleryPreviewColumnAction)
				{
					_menus.Remove(((GalleryPreviewColumnAction)_lastAction).Menu);
				}
				_lastAction = null;
			}
		}

		private MenuTool GetNextGalleryColumnMenu(out int currentColumnCount)
		{
			MenuTool nextMenu = GetNextMenu();
			currentColumnCount = 0;
			while (nextMenu != null)
			{
				if (nextMenu.HasGalleryPreview)
				{
					GalleryToolPreviewPresenter galleryToolPreviewPresenter = nextMenu.MenuToolPresenter?.GalleryToolPreviewPresenter;
					if (galleryToolPreviewPresenter != null)
					{
						int num = galleryToolPreviewPresenter.MaxColumns;
						if (num == 0)
						{
							num = (int)galleryToolPreviewPresenter.GalleryTool.GetValue(GalleryTool.MaxPossiblePreviewColumnsProperty);
						}
						if (num > galleryToolPreviewPresenter.MinColumns)
						{
							currentColumnCount = num;
							return nextMenu;
						}
					}
				}
				_menus.RemoveAt(_currentMenuIndex);
				nextMenu = GetNextMenu();
			}
			if (_menus.Count > 0)
			{
				_currentMenuIndex = _menus.Count;
				return GetNextGalleryColumnMenu(out currentColumnCount);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ToolHorizontalWrapPanel GetNextHorizontalPanel()
		{
			for (IRibbonToolPanel nextPanel = GetNextPanel(); nextPanel != null; nextPanel = GetNextPanel())
			{
				if (nextPanel is ToolHorizontalWrapPanel toolHorizontalWrapPanel && toolHorizontalWrapPanel.MaxRows >= _horizontalRowCount)
				{
					return toolHorizontalWrapPanel;
				}
			}
			if (_horizontalRowCount < 3)
			{
				_currentPanelIndex = _panels.Count;
				_horizontalRowCount++;
				return GetNextHorizontalPanel();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ToolSizingModeAction CreateToolResizeAction(RibbonToolSizingMode newSizingMode, RibbonToolSizingMode oldSizingMode)
		{
			ToolSizingModeAction result = null;
			for (IRibbonToolPanel nextPanel = GetNextPanel(); nextPanel != null; nextPanel = GetNextPanel())
			{
				IList<FrameworkElement> resizableTools = nextPanel.GetResizableTools(newSizingMode);
				if (resizableTools != null && resizableTools.Count > 0)
				{
					result = new ToolSizingModeAction(nextPanel, resizableTools, newSizingMode, oldSizingMode, _history);
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private RibbonGroup GetNextGroup()
		{
			_currentGroupIndex++;
			if (_currentGroupIndex >= _groups.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _groups[_currentGroupIndex];
		}

		private MenuTool GetNextMenu()
		{
			_currentMenuIndex--;
			if (_currentMenuIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _menus[_currentMenuIndex];
		}

		private IRibbonToolPanel GetNextPanel()
		{
			_currentPanelIndex--;
			if (_currentPanelIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _panels[_currentPanelIndex];
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			switch (VariantResizeAction)
			{
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.ReduceGalleryPreviewItems:
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.HideGalleryPreview:
			{
				_menus = new List<MenuTool>();
				for (int num2 = _groups.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					_menus.AddRange(_groups[num2].RegisteredMenus);
				}
				break;
			}
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.IncreaseHorizontalWrapRowCount:
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.ReduceImageAndTextLargeTools:
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.ReduceImageAndTextNormalTools:
			{
				_panels = new List<IRibbonToolPanel>();
				for (int num = _groups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					_panels.AddRange(_groups[num].RegisteredPanels);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			switch (VariantResizeAction)
			{
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.IncreaseHorizontalWrapRowCount:
			{
				for (int num4 = _panels.Count - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
				{
					if (!(_panels[num4] is ToolHorizontalWrapPanel))
					{
						_panels.RemoveAt(num4);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.ReduceGalleryPreviewItems:
			case GroupVariantResizeAction.HideGalleryPreview:
			{
				for (int num3 = _menus.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					if (!_menus[num3].HasGalleryPreview)
					{
						_menus.RemoveAt(num3);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			_currentGroupIndex = -1;
			_currentMenuIndex = ((_menus != null) ? _menus.Count : 0);
			_currentPanelIndex = ((_panels != null) ? _panels.Count : 0);
		}
	}
	internal class GroupVariantResizeHistory : ActionHistory
	{
		internal static object UndoContextId = new object();

		internal static object RedoContextId = new object();

		private double currentCachedExtent = double.NaN;

		private double nextLargerExtent = double.NaN;

		private RibbonGroupPanel _panel;

		protected override object RedoContext => RedoContextId;

		protected override object UndoContext => UndoContextId;

		protected override int MaxUndoDepth => 0;

		internal double CurrentExtent
		{
			get
			{
				return currentCachedExtent;
			}
			set
			{
				currentCachedExtent = value;
			}
		}

		internal double NextLargerExtent
		{
			get
			{
				return nextLargerExtent;
			}
			set
			{
				nextLargerExtent = value;
			}
		}

		internal RibbonGroupPanel Panel => _panel;

		internal GroupVariantAction RedoActionOnQueue => PeekRedo() as GroupVariantAction;

		internal GroupVariantAction UndoActionOnQueue => PeekUndo() as GroupVariantAction;

		internal GroupVariantResizeHistory(RibbonGroupPanel panel)
		{
			_panel = panel;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class GroupVariantAction : ActionHistory.ActionBase
	{
		private double _resultingExtent;

		private double _nextLargerExtent;

		private GroupVariantResizeHistory _history;

		private RibbonGroup _group;

		public RibbonGroup Group => _group;

		protected GroupVariantResizeHistory History => _history;

		internal double NextLargerExtent
		{
			get
			{
				return _nextLargerExtent;
			}
			set
			{
				_nextLargerExtent = value;
			}
		}

		internal double ResultingExtent
		{
			get
			{
				return _resultingExtent;
			}
			set
			{
				_resultingExtent = value;
			}
		}

		protected GroupVariantAction(RibbonGroup associatedGroup, GroupVariantResizeHistory history)
		{
			_history = history;
			_group = associatedGroup;
		}

		protected internal sealed override ActionHistory.ActionBase Perform(object context)
		{
			GroupVariantAction groupVariantAction = CreateUndoAction();
			double resultingExtent = _resultingExtent;
			double nextLargerExtent = _nextLargerExtent;
			groupVariantAction._resultingExtent = _history.CurrentExtent;
			groupVariantAction._nextLargerExtent = _history.NextLargerExtent;
			PerformAction(context);
			if (context == GroupVariantResizeHistory.UndoContextId || context == GroupVariantResizeHistory.RedoContextId)
			{
				_history.CurrentExtent = resultingExtent;
				_history.NextLargerExtent = nextLargerExtent;
			}
			return groupVariantAction;
		}

		protected abstract void PerformAction(object context);

		protected virtual GroupVariantAction CreateUndoAction()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public void ReplayGroupAction(bool invertAction)
		{
			GroupVariantAction groupVariantAction = ((!invertAction) ? this : CreateUndoAction());
			object context = (invertAction ? GroupVariantResizeHistory.RedoContextId : GroupVariantResizeHistory.UndoContextId);
			groupVariantAction?.PerformAction(context);
		}
	}
	internal class CollapseGroupAction : GroupVariantAction
	{
		private bool _isCollapsed;

		internal CollapseGroupAction(RibbonGroup group, bool isCollapsed, GroupVariantResizeHistory history)
			: base(group, history)
		{
			_isCollapsed = isCollapsed;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			bool flag = ((context == GroupVariantResizeHistory.UndoContextId) ? (!_isCollapsed) : _isCollapsed);
			base.Group.SetValue(RibbonGroup.IsCollapsedPropertyKey, flag);
			if (!flag)
			{
				foreach (MenuTool registeredMenu in base.Group.RegisteredMenus)
				{
					if (registeredMenu.HasGalleryPreview)
					{
						MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter = registeredMenu.MenuToolPresenter;
						if (menuToolPresenter != null)
						{
							UIElement uIElement = menuToolPresenter.GalleryToolPreviewSite ?? menuToolPresenter;
							uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
							RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(uIElement, base.Group);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			RibbonGroupPanel.BumpSizingModeVersion(base.Group);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Change RibbonGroup IsCollapsed of '{1}' to {0}", _isCollapsed, base.Group);
		}
	}
	internal class GalleryPreviewVisibilityAction : GroupVariantAction
	{
		private MenuTool _menuTool;

		private bool _isPreviewVisible;

		internal GalleryPreviewVisibilityAction(MenuTool menu, bool isPreviewVisible, GroupVariantResizeHistory history)
			: base(RibbonGroup.GetContainingGroup(menu), history)
		{
			_menuTool = menu;
			_isPreviewVisible = isPreviewVisible;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return _menuTool.HasGalleryPreview;
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			if ((context == GroupVariantResizeHistory.UndoContextId) ? (!_isPreviewVisible) : _isPreviewVisible)
			{
				_menuTool.ClearValue(MenuTool.HideGalleryPreviewProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				_menuTool.SetValue(MenuTool.HideGalleryPreviewProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			UIElement descendant = (UIElement)(((object)_menuTool.MenuToolPresenter) ?? ((object)_menuTool));
			RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(descendant, base.History.Panel);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Change GalleryPreviewVisibility of '{1}' to {0}", _isPreviewVisible, _menuTool);
		}
	}
	internal class HorizontalWrapRowCountAction : GroupVariantAction
	{
		private ToolHorizontalWrapPanel _panel;

		private int _newRowCount;

		private int _oldRowCount;

		internal HorizontalWrapRowCountAction(ToolHorizontalWrapPanel panel, int oldRowCount, int newRowCount, GroupVariantResizeHistory history)
			: base(RibbonGroup.GetContainingGroup(panel), history)
		{
			_panel = panel;
			_newRowCount = newRowCount;
			_oldRowCount = oldRowCount;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			if (_newRowCount <= _panel.MaxRows)
			{
				return _newRowCount >= _panel.MinRows;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			int num = ((context == GroupVariantResizeHistory.UndoContextId) ? _oldRowCount : _newRowCount);
			_panel.SetValue(ToolHorizontalWrapPanel.RowCountPropertyKey, num);
			RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(_panel, base.History.Panel);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Change ToolHorizontalWrapPanel RowCount of '{2}' From {0} to {1}", _oldRowCount, _newRowCount, _panel);
		}
	}
	internal class GalleryPreviewColumnAction : GroupVariantAction
	{
		private MenuTool _menu;

		private int _oldColumnCount;

		private int _newColumnCount;

		internal MenuTool Menu => _menu;

		internal GalleryPreviewColumnAction(MenuTool menu, int oldColumnCount, int newColumnCount, GroupVariantResizeHistory history)
			: base(RibbonGroup.GetContainingGroup(menu), history)
		{
			_menu = menu;
			_oldColumnCount = oldColumnCount;
			_newColumnCount = newColumnCount;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return _menu.HasGalleryPreview;
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			int num = ((context == GroupVariantResizeHistory.UndoContextId) ? _oldColumnCount : _newColumnCount);
			MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter = _menu.MenuToolPresenter;
			if (menuToolPresenter != null)
			{
				menuToolPresenter.SetValue(MenuToolPresenter.ResizedColumnCountProperty, num);
				RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(menuToolPresenter, base.History.Panel);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Change GalleryPreviewColumns For {2} From {0} to {1}", _oldColumnCount, _newColumnCount, _menu);
		}
	}
	internal class ToolSizingModeAction : GroupVariantAction
	{
		private IList<FrameworkElement> _tools;

		private RibbonToolSizingMode _newSizingMode;

		private RibbonToolSizingMode _previousSizingMode;

		private IRibbonToolPanel _panel;

		private RibbonToolSizingMode[] _originalSizingModes;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PreviousSizingModeProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("PreviousSizingMode", typeof(RibbonToolSizingMode?), typeof(ToolSizingModeAction), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)null));

		internal IRibbonToolPanel Panel => _panel;

		internal ToolSizingModeAction(IRibbonToolPanel panel, IList<FrameworkElement> tools, RibbonToolSizingMode newSizingMode, RibbonToolSizingMode oldSizingMode, GroupVariantResizeHistory history)
			: base(RibbonGroup.GetContainingGroup((DependencyObject)panel), history)
		{
			_tools = tools;
			_newSizingMode = newSizingMode;
			_previousSizingMode = oldSizingMode;
			_panel = panel;
			_originalSizingModes = new RibbonToolSizingMode[tools.Count];
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = tools.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				_originalSizingModes[i] = RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(tools[i]);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
		{
			return _tools.Count > 0;
		}

		protected override void PerformAction(object context)
		{
			bool flag = context == GroupVariantResizeHistory.UndoContextId;
			RibbonToolSizingMode value = (flag ? _previousSizingMode : _newSizingMode);
			object value2 = RibbonKnownBoxes.FromValue(value);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _tools.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _tools[i];
				object obj = RibbonKnownBoxes.FromValue(_originalSizingModes[i]);
				if (flag)
				{
					value2 = obj;
					obj = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
				}
				frameworkElement.SetValue(PreviousSizingModeProperty, obj);
				frameworkElement.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey, value2);
				RibbonGroupPanel.BumpSizingModeVersion(frameworkElement);
			}
			if (_tools.Count > 0)
			{
				RibbonGroupPanel.InvalidateMeasure(_tools[0], base.History.Panel);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Change Tool Sizing of {2} tools in RibbonGroup '{3}' From {0} to {1}", _previousSizingMode, _newSizingMode, _tools.Count, base.Group);
		}

		public static RibbonToolSizingMode? GetPreviousSizingMode(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (RibbonToolSizingMode?)d.GetValue(PreviousSizingModeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetPreviousSizingMode(DependencyObject d, RibbonToolSizingMode? value)
		{
			d.SetValue(PreviousSizingModeProperty, value);
		}
	}
	internal static class RibbonKnownBoxes
	{
		public static readonly object RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextLargeBox = RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge;

		public static readonly object RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextNormalBox = RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal;

		public static readonly object RibbonToolSizingModeImageOnlyBox = RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationApplicationMenuBox = ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationApplicationMenuFooterToolbarBox = ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationApplicationMenuRecentItemsBox = ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationApplicationMenuSubMenuBox = ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuSubMenu;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationMenuBox = ToolLocation.Menu;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationQuickAccessToolbarBox = ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationRibbonBox = ToolLocation.Ribbon;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationTabItemAreaToolbarBox = ToolLocation.TabItemAreaToolbar;

		public static readonly object ToolLocationUnknownBox = ToolLocation.Unknown;

		internal static readonly object DoubleNanBox = double.NaN;

		internal static readonly object DoubleZeroBox = 0.0;

		public static object FromValue(RibbonToolSizingMode value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal => RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextNormalBox, 
				RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly => RibbonToolSizingModeImageOnlyBox, 
				_ => RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextLargeBox, 
			};
		}

		public static object FromValue(ToolLocation value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar => ToolLocationApplicationMenuFooterToolbarBox, 
				ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems => ToolLocationApplicationMenuRecentItemsBox, 
				ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuSubMenu => ToolLocationApplicationMenuSubMenuBox, 
				ToolLocation.Menu => ToolLocationMenuBox, 
				ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar => ToolLocationQuickAccessToolbarBox, 
				ToolLocation.Ribbon => ToolLocationRibbonBox, 
				ToolLocation.TabItemAreaToolbar => ToolLocationTabItemAreaToolbarBox, 
				ToolLocation.Unknown => ToolLocationUnknownBox, 
				_ => ToolLocationApplicationMenuBox, 
			};
		}
	}

			}
			else
			{
				target.ClearValue(HasCaptionPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		private static void OnIdChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = d as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement is IRibbonTool && !(frameworkElement is ApplicationMenu))
			{
				XamRibbon xamRibbon = (XamRibbon)frameworkElement.GetValue(XamRibbon.RibbonProperty);
				if (xamRibbon != null && xamRibbon.ToolInstanceManager.IsRegistered(frameworkElement, (string)e.OldValue))
				{
					xamRibbon.ToolInstanceManager.ChangeToolInstanceRegistrationId(frameworkElement, (string)e.OldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool ValidateKeyTip(object newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				string text = (string)newValue;
				if (text.Length > 3)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_KeyTipTooLong"));
				}
				string text2 = text;
				foreach (char c in text2)
				{
					if (!KeyTipManager.IsValidKeyTipChar(c))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidKeyTipCharacters"));
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableWhenAttributePresent(typeof(RibbonToolAttribute))]

		private static object CoerceSizingMode(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			IRibbonToolSizingContainer ribbonToolSizingContainer = Utilities.GetParent(d, includeLogicalParent: false) as IRibbonToolSizingContainer;
			if (ribbonToolSizingContainer == null && XamRibbon.GetLocation(d) == ToolLocation.Ribbon)
			{
				RibbonToolSizingMode maximumSize = RibbonGroup.GetMaximumSize(d);
				RibbonToolSizingMode minimumSize = RibbonGroup.GetMinimumSize(d);
				return RibbonKnownBoxes.FromValue((minimumSize < maximumSize) ? maximumSize : minimumSize);
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnSizingModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateImageProperties(d);
		}

		}

		private static void OnUseLargeImagesOnMenuChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateImageProperties(d);
		}

		internal static void UpdateImageProperties(DependencyObject target)
		{
			if (!(target is ToolMenuItem))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				switch (XamRibbon.GetLocation(target))
				{
				case ToolLocation.Menu:
				case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu:
				case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuSubMenu:
					flag = (bool)target.GetValue(UseLargeImagesOnMenuProperty);
					break;
				case ToolLocation.Ribbon:
					flag = GetSizingMode(target) == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge;
					break;
				}
				object obj = null;
				DependencyProperty dp = (flag ? LargeImageProperty : SmallImageProperty);
				obj = target.GetValue(dp);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					DependencyProperty dp2 = (flag ? SmallImageProperty : LargeImageProperty);
					obj = target.GetValue(dp2);
				}
				if (obj != null)
				{
					target.SetValue(ImageResolvedPropertyKey, obj);
					target.SetValue(HasImagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					target.ClearValue(ImageResolvedPropertyKey);
					target.ClearValue(HasImagePropertyKey);
				}
				target.SetValue(ToolMenuItem.UseLargeImagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(flag));
			}
		}

		internal static void SetToolVisualState(System.Windows.Controls.Control tool, bool useTransitions, bool? isActive)
		{
			if (isActive.HasValue)
			{
				if (!tool.IsEnabled)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(tool, "Disabled", useTransitions);
				}
				else if (tool.IsMouseOver)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(tool, "MouseOver", useTransitions);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(tool, "Normal", useTransitions);
				}
				if (isActive.Value)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(tool, "Active", useTransitions);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(tool, "Inactive", useTransitions);
				}
			}
			string text = null;
			switch (XamRibbon.GetLocation(tool))
			{
			default:
				return;
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu:
				text = "AppMenu";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar:
				text = "AppMenuFooterToolbar";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems:
				text = "AppMenuRecentItems";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuSubMenu:
				text = "AppMenuSubMenu";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.Menu:
				text = "Menu";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar:
				text = "QAT";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.Ribbon:
				text = "Ribbon";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.TabItemAreaToolbar:
				text = "TabItemAreaToolbar";
				break;
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu2010:
				return;
			}
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(tool, text, useTransitions);
		}
	}
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class RibbonWindowBorder : Border
	{
		private RibbonWindowContentHost _contentHost;

		private IRibbonWindow _window;

		private bool? _isScenicTheme;

		private const int ScenicRoundedCornerRadius = 7;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner1BrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner1Brush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner1BrushActiveProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner1BrushActive", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner1ShadowBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner1ShadowBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner1ShadowBrushActiveProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner1ShadowBrushActive", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner2BrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner2Brush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner2BrushActiveProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner2BrushActive", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner3BrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner3Brush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty Inner3BrushActiveProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Inner3BrushActive", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(RibbonWindowBorder), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		internal System.Windows.Media.Brush Inner1Brush

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			Thickness borderThickness = base.BorderThickness;
			if (borderThickness.Top < 1.0 && borderThickness.Bottom < 1.0 && borderThickness.Left < 1.0 && borderThickness.Right < 1.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_contentHost == null)
			{
				_contentHost = base.TemplatedParent as RibbonWindowContentHost;
				if (_contentHost == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidRibbonWindowBorderParent"));
				}
				_window = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(_contentHost, typeof(IRibbonWindow), allowSubclassOfType: true) as IRibbonWindow;
				if (_window != null)
				{
					_window.Activated += OnWindowActivationChanged;
					_window.Deactivated += OnWindowActivationChanged;
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_window != null)
			{
				flag = _window.IsScenicThemeInternal;
			}
			if (!_isScenicTheme.HasValue || _isScenicTheme.Value != flag)
			{
				_isScenicTheme = flag;
				if (flag)
				{
					SetResourceReference(Inner1BrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicWindowBorderInner1BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner1ShadowBrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicWindowBorderInner1ShadowBrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner2BrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicWindowBorderInner2BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner3BrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicWindowBorderInner3BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner1BrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicActiveWindowBorderInner1BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner1ShadowBrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicActiveWindowBorderInner1ShadowBrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner2BrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicActiveWindowBorderInner2BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner3BrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicActiveWindowBorderInner3BrushKey);
				}
				else
				{
					SetResourceReference(Inner1BrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.WindowBorderInner1BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner2BrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.WindowBorderInner2BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner3BrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.WindowBorderInner3BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner1BrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ActiveWindowBorderInner1BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner2BrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ActiveWindowBorderInner2BrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(Inner3BrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ActiveWindowBorderInner3BrushKey);
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush3;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush4;
			if (_window != null && _window.IsActive)
			{
				brush = Inner1BrushActive;
				brush2 = Inner1ShadowBrushActive;
				brush3 = Inner2BrushActive;
				brush4 = Inner3BrushActive;
			}
			else
			{
				brush = Inner1Brush;
				brush2 = Inner1ShadowBrush;
				brush3 = Inner2Brush;
				brush4 = Inner3Brush;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			Rect rect = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
			Rect rect2 = rect;
			rect.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
			if (rect.Width >= borderThickness.Left && rect.Height >= borderThickness.Top)
			{
				Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
				Rect rect3 = new Rect(rect.Size);
				rect3.X += borderThickness.Left;
				rect3.Y += borderThickness.Top;
				rect3.Width = Math.Max(rect3.Width - (borderThickness.Left + borderThickness.Right), 1.0);
				rect3.Height = Math.Max(rect3.Height - (borderThickness.Top + borderThickness.Bottom), 1.0);
				geometry = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, geometry, new RectangleGeometry(rect3));
				geometry.Freeze();
				dc.PushClip(geometry);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			dc.DrawRectangle(brush, null, rect);
			if (flag && brush2 != null && brush2 != brush)
			{
				Geometry geometry2 = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
				Geometry geometry3 = new RectangleGeometry(Rect.Offset(rect, -1.0, -1.0));
				geometry2 = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, geometry2, geometry3);
				geometry2.Freeze();
				dc.PushClip(geometry2);
				dc.DrawRectangle(brush2, null, rect);
				dc.Pop();
			}
			rect.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
			dc.DrawRectangle(brush3, null, rect);
			rect.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
			dc.DrawRectangle(brush4, null, rect);
			if (flag2)
			{
				dc.Pop();
			}
			if (!flag || _window == null || _contentHost == null || _contentHost.IsClassicOSTheme)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush outerBorderBrush = _window.OuterBorderBrush;
			rect = rect2;
			rect.Width += 100.0;
			rect.Height += 100.0;
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(outerBorderBrush, 1.0);
			if (pen.CanFreeze)
			{
				pen.Freeze();
			}
			dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(null, pen, rect, 7.0, 7.0);
			rect.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen2 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, 1.0);
			if (pen2.CanFreeze)
			{
				pen2.Freeze();
			}
			dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(null, pen2, rect, 7.0, 7.0);
			rect = rect2;
			if (rect.Width > 7.0 && rect.Height >= borderThickness.Top)
			{
				rect.Height += 100.0;
				Geometry geometry4 = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
				Geometry geometry5 = new RectangleGeometry(Rect.Offset(rect, -4.0, 0.0));
				geometry4 = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, geometry4, geometry5);
				dc.PushClip(geometry4);
				System.Windows.Media.Brush outerShadowBrush = _window.OuterShadowBrush;
				pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(outerShadowBrush, 1.0);
				if (pen.CanFreeze)
				{
					pen.Freeze();
				}
				dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(null, pen, rect, 7.0, 7.0);
				rect.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
				pen2 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush2, 1.0);
				if (pen2.CanFreeze)
				{
					pen2.Freeze();
				}
				dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(null, pen2, rect, 7.0, 7.0);
				dc.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowActivationChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Window window = sender as Window;
			if (window.WindowState != WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				InvalidateVisual();
				if (_window != null)
				{
					_window.InvalidateVisual();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_XamRibbonCaption") is FrameworkElement source)
			{
				SetBinding(CaptionHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(CaptionHeightProperty);
			}
			_contentElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") as FrameworkElement;
			VerifyContentElementVisibility();
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			SetResourceReference(SystemCaptionHeightProperty, SystemParameters.CaptionHeightKey);
			SetResourceReference(SystemCaptionButtonHeightProperty, SystemParameters.WindowCaptionButtonHeightKey);
			SetResourceReference(SystemCaptionButtonWidthProperty, SystemParameters.WindowCaptionButtonWidthKey);
			SetResourceReference(StatusBarItemStyleInternalProperty, StatusBarItemStyleKey);
			SetResourceReference(StatusBarSeparatorStyleInternalProperty, StatusBarSeparatorStyleKey);
			_ribbonWindow = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(IRibbonWindow), allowSubclassOfType: true) as IRibbonWindow;
			if (_ribbonWindow != null)
			{
				VerifyCaptionVisibility();
				_ribbonWindow.InitializeContentHost(this);
				SyncApplicationAccentColor(this, _ribbonWindow as Window);
			}
			Ribbon?.InitializeRibbonWindow(_ribbonWindow);
		}

		private static void OnApplicationAccentColorChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is IRibbonWindow { ContentHost: var contentHost } ribbonWindow)
			{
				if (contentHost != null)
				{
					SyncApplicationAccentColor(contentHost, ribbonWindow as FrameworkElement);
					SyncRibbonAndStatusBarAccentColor(contentHost, (System.Windows.Media.Color)e.NewValue);
				}
				WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(ribbonWindow as Window);
				NativeWindowMethods.NotifyFrameChange(windowInteropHelper.Handle);
			}
			else if (target is RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost)
			{
				SyncRibbonAndStatusBarAccentColor(ribbonWindowContentHost, (System.Windows.Media.Color)e.NewValue);
				if (ribbonWindowContentHost._ribbonWindow != null)
				{
					SyncApplicationAccentColor(ribbonWindowContentHost, ribbonWindowContentHost._ribbonWindow as FrameworkElement);
				}
			}
			else if (target is XamRibbon { RibbonWindow: var ribbonWindow2 } xamRibbon)
			{
				if (ribbonWindow2 != null)
				{
					SyncApplicationAccentColor(xamRibbon, ribbonWindow2 as FrameworkElement);
				}
				else if (xamRibbon.Parent is RibbonWindowContentHost element)
				{
					SyncApplicationAccentColor(xamRibbon, element);
				}
				xamRibbon.VerifyAccentColorResourceDictionary(forceRebuildResources: true);
			}
			else if (target is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar { Parent: RibbonWindowContentHost parent } statusBar && DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(statusBar, ApplicationAccentColorProperty).BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default)
			{
				statusBar.SetCurrentValue(ApplicationAccentColorProperty, GetApplicationAccentColor(parent));
			}
		}

		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow = null;
			if (!(target is RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost))
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = e.NewValue as XamRibbon;
			if (xamRibbon != null)
			{
				SyncApplicationAccentColor(xamRibbon, ribbonWindowContentHost);
				xamRibbon.IsRenderingMinimizedWindow = ribbonWindowContentHost.IsRenderingMinimizedWindow;
			}
			ribbonWindow = ribbonWindowContentHost._ribbonWindow;
			if (ribbonWindow != null)
			{
				ribbonWindow.SynchronizeIsGlassActive();
				ribbonWindow.SynchronizeIsScenicTheme();
			}
			if (xamRibbon != null)
			{
				bool isInHighContrastMode = xamRibbon.IsInHighContrastMode;
				if (isInHighContrastMode)
				{
					xamRibbon.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsInHighContrastModePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
				ribbonWindowContentHost.AddLogicalChild(xamRibbon);
				ribbonWindowContentHost._logicalChildren.Add(xamRibbon);
				if (ribbonWindow != null)
				{
					xamRibbon.InitializeRibbonWindow(ribbonWindow);
				}
				if (isInHighContrastMode)
				{
					xamRibbon.VerifyHighContrast();
				}
				ribbonWindowContentHost.SetBinding(RibbonAutoHideStateProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.AutoHideStateProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, xamRibbon));
				ribbonWindowContentHost.SetBinding(RibbonVisibilityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, xamRibbon));
				ribbonWindowContentHost.SetBinding(TabHeaderHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.TabHeaderHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, xamRibbon));
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonWindowContentHost.ClearValue(RibbonAutoHideStateProperty);
				ribbonWindowContentHost.ClearValue(RibbonVisibilityProperty);
				ribbonWindowContentHost.ClearValue(TabHeaderHeightProperty);
			}
			if (e.OldValue is XamRibbon { IsInHighContrastMode: var isInHighContrastMode2 } xamRibbon2)
			{
				if (isInHighContrastMode2)
				{
					xamRibbon2.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsInHighContrastModePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
				ribbonWindowContentHost._logicalChildren.Remove(xamRibbon2);
				ribbonWindowContentHost.RemoveLogicalChild(xamRibbon2);
				xamRibbon2.InitializeRibbonWindow(null);
				if (e.NewValue == null)
				{
					ribbonWindowContentHost.ResetCaptionInfo();
				}
				xamRibbon2.ClearValue(XamRibbon.IsRenderingMinimizedWindowProperty);
				if (isInHighContrastMode2)
				{
					xamRibbon2.VerifyHighContrast();
				}
			}
			ribbonWindowContentHost.VerifyCaptionVisibility();
			if (e.NewValue == null)
			{
				ribbonWindowContentHost.ClearValue(IsApplicationMenu2010OpenProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonWindowContentHost.SetBinding(IsApplicationMenu2010OpenProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ApplicationMenu2010.IsOpen")
				{
					Source = e.NewValue,
					FallbackValue = KnownBoxes.FalseBox
				});
			}
			ribbonWindow?.OnRibbonChanged();
		}

		private static void OnStatusBarChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow = null;
			if (!(target is RibbonWindowContentHost { _ribbonWindow: var ribbonWindow2 } ribbonWindowContentHost))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.OldValue is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar statusBar)
			{
				if (ribbonWindowContentHost._statusBarResources != null)
				{
					if (statusBar.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Contains(ribbonWindowContentHost._statusBarResources))
					{
						statusBar.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Remove(ribbonWindowContentHost._statusBarResources);
					}
					ribbonWindowContentHost._statusBarResources = null;
				}
				ribbonWindowContentHost.RemoveLogicalChild(statusBar);
				ribbonWindowContentHost._logicalChildren.Remove(statusBar);
				ribbonWindowContentHost.ClearValue(StatusBarVisibilityProperty);
			}
			if (e.NewValue is System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar statusBar2)
			{
				if (ribbonWindow2 != null)
				{
					ribbonWindow2.SynchronizeIsGlassActive();
					ribbonWindow2.SynchronizeIsScenicTheme();
				}
				ribbonWindowContentHost.AddLogicalChild(statusBar2);
				ribbonWindowContentHost._logicalChildren.Add(statusBar2);
				ribbonWindowContentHost.SetBinding(StatusBarVisibilityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, statusBar2));
				BaseValueSource baseValueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(statusBar2, FrameworkElement.StyleProperty).BaseValueSource;
				if (baseValueSource <= BaseValueSource.ImplicitStyleReference)
				{
					statusBar2.SetResourceReference(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, StatusBarStyleKey);
				}
				statusBar2.SetValue(FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty, StatusBarStyleKey);
				SyncApplicationAccentColor(statusBar2, ribbonWindowContentHost);
				ribbonWindowContentHost.UpdateStatusBarResources();
			}
		}

		private static void OnCaptionHeightResolvedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RibbonWindowContentHost { _ribbonWindow: { } ribbonWindow })
			{
				ribbonWindow.ExtendGlassIntoClientArea();
				ribbonWindow.UpdateWindowClipRegion();
			}
		}

		}

		}

			}
		}

		{

			if (ribbonWindowContentHost._ribbonWindow != null && ribbonWindowContentHost.Ribbon == null)

				if (ribbonWindowContentHost._ribbonWindow is Window window)

				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnThemeChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost = target as RibbonWindowContentHost;

			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				ribbon.SetCurrentValue(ThemeProperty, e.NewValue);
				if (ribbon.Theme == null && e.NewValue != null)

					return;

			}
			XamRibbon.UpdateThemeResources(e.NewValue as string, ribbon, ribbonWindowContentHost);
		}

		private static void OnUseScenicApplicationMenuInternalChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost = d as RibbonWindowContentHost;
			ribbonWindowContentHost.CalculateMargins(refreshGlass: true);
		}

		internal static void SyncApplicationAccentColor(FrameworkElement element1, FrameworkElement element2)
		{
			if (GetApplicationAccentColor(element1) == GetApplicationAccentColor(element2))
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueSource valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(element1, ApplicationAccentColorProperty);
			ValueSource valueSource2 = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(element2, ApplicationAccentColorProperty);
			FrameworkElement d;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement;
			if (valueSource.BaseValueSource == valueSource2.BaseValueSource)
			{
				if (valueSource.BaseValueSource >= BaseValueSource.Style)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar).IsAssignableFrom(element1.GetType()))
				{
					d = element2;
					frameworkElement = element1;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar).IsAssignableFrom(element2.GetType()))
					{
						return;
					}
					d = element1;
					frameworkElement = element2;
				}
			}
			else if (valueSource.BaseValueSource > valueSource2.BaseValueSource)
			{
				d = element1;
				frameworkElement = element2;
			}
			else
			{
				d = element2;
				frameworkElement = element1;
			}
			frameworkElement.SetCurrentValue(ApplicationAccentColorProperty, GetApplicationAccentColor(d));
		}

		internal void CalculateMargins()
		{
			CalculateMargins(refreshGlass: false);
		}

		internal void CalculateMargins(bool refreshGlass)
		{
			CalculateMarginsImpl();
			if (refreshGlass && _ribbonWindow != null && _ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal)
			{
				_ribbonWindow.ExtendGlassIntoClientArea();
			}
		}

		private void CalculateMarginsImpl()
		{
			if (_ribbonWindow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsOffice2013Theme)
			{
				ClearValue(BackgroundAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(CaptionAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(ContentAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(RibbonAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(StatusBarAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				return;
			}
			bool isGlassActiveInternal = _ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal;
			Thickness borderThickness = base.BorderThickness;
			bool flag = isGlassActiveInternal;
			if (_ribbonWindow == null || flag || borderThickness.Equals(default(Thickness)))
			{
				ClearValue(CaptionAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(RibbonAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(StatusBarAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(ContentAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(BackgroundAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				return;
			}
			bool isScenicThemeInternal = _ribbonWindow.IsScenicThemeInternal;
			SetValue(value: (StatusBarVisibility != Visibility.Collapsed || isScenicThemeInternal) ? new Thickness(borderThickness.Left, 2.0, borderThickness.Right, 0.0) : new Thickness(borderThickness.Left, 2.0, borderThickness.Right, borderThickness.Bottom - 1.0), key: ContentAreaMarginPropertyKey);
			SetValue(value: new Thickness(borderThickness.Left, 1.0, borderThickness.Right, borderThickness.Bottom), key: BackgroundAreaMarginPropertyKey);
			if (!isScenicThemeInternal)
			{
				ClearValue(CaptionAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				SetValue(RibbonAreaMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, -1.0));
				if (UseScenicApplicationMenuInternal)
				{
					double bottom = ((_ribbonWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized) ? 0.0 : borderThickness.Bottom);
					SetValue(StatusBarAreaMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(borderThickness.Left, 0.0, borderThickness.Right, bottom));
				}
				else
				{
					SetValue(StatusBarAreaMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0));
				}
				return;
			}
			SetValue(CaptionAreaMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, -2.0));
			SetValue(RibbonAreaMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, -2.0));
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(borderThickness.Left, 0.0, borderThickness.Right, borderThickness.Bottom);
			if (_ribbonWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				thickness.Bottom = 0.0;
			}
			SetValue(StatusBarAreaMarginPropertyKey, thickness);
		}

		internal void ResetCaptionInfo()
		{
			ClearValue(CaptionButtonAreaWidthPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(CaptionButtonHeightPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(CaptionButtonWidthPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(MinCaptionHeightPropertyKey);
		}

		private static void SyncRibbonAndStatusBarAccentColor(RibbonWindowContentHost host, System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			FrameworkElement element = host;
			if (host._ribbonWindow != null)
			{
				ValueSource valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(host, ApplicationAccentColorProperty);
				if (DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(host._ribbonWindow.Window, ApplicationAccentColorProperty).BaseValueSource > valueSource.BaseValueSource)
				{
					element = host._ribbonWindow.Window;
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar statusBar = host.StatusBar;
			if (statusBar != null)
			{
				SyncApplicationAccentColor(element, statusBar);
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = host.Ribbon;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				SyncApplicationAccentColor(element, ribbon);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateStatusBarResources()
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar statusBar = StatusBar;
			if (statusBar == null)
			{
				_statusBarResources = null;
				return;
			}
			if (_statusBarResources != null)
			{
				if (statusBar.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Contains(_statusBarResources))
				{
					statusBar.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Remove(_statusBarResources);
				}
				_statusBarResources = null;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsScenicTheme)
			{
				return;
			}
			Style statusBarItemStyleInternal = StatusBarItemStyleInternal;
			Style statusBarSeparatorStyleInternal = StatusBarSeparatorStyleInternal;
			if (statusBarItemStyleInternal != null || statusBarSeparatorStyleInternal != null)
			{
				_statusBarResources = new ResourceDictionary();
				if (statusBarItemStyleInternal != null)
				{
					_statusBarResources.Add(typeof(StatusBarItem), statusBarItemStyleInternal);
				}
				if (statusBarSeparatorStyleInternal != null)
				{
					_statusBarResources.Add(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar.SeparatorStyleKey, statusBarSeparatorStyleInternal);
				}
				statusBar.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(_statusBarResources);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyCaptionVisibility()
		{
			DependencyObject source;
			if (Ribbon == null || RibbonAutoHideState == RibbonAutoHideState.Hidden || RibbonVisibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				SetValue(CaptionVisibilityPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
				source = this;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(CaptionVisibilityPropertyKey);
				source = Ribbon;
			}
			SetBinding(CaptionHeightResolvedProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(CaptionHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
		}

		private void VerifyContentElementVisibility()
		{
			if (_contentElement != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (IsApplicationMenu2010Open && HwndHostTracker.GetHasHwndHost(_contentElement))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					_contentElement.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityHiddenBox);
				}
				else
				{
					_contentElement.InvalidateProperty(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class HwndHostTracker
	{
		private WeakSet<HwndHost> _hosts;

		private bool _needCompact;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty HwndHostProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("HwndHost", typeof(HwndHostTracker), typeof(HwndHostTracker), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.OverridesInheritanceBehavior, OnHwndHostChanged));

		internal bool HasHwndHost
		{
			get
			{
				if (_needCompact)
				{
					_needCompact = false;
					_hosts.Compact();
				}
				return _hosts.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		internal HwndHostTracker()
		{
			_hosts = new WeakSet<HwndHost>();
		}

		internal static HwndHostTracker GetHwndHost(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (HwndHostTracker)d.GetValue(HwndHostProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetHwndHost(DependencyObject d, HwndHostTracker value)
		{
			d.SetValue(HwndHostProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnHwndHostChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HwndHost item)
			{
				HwndHostTracker hwndHostTracker = e.OldValue as HwndHostTracker;
				HwndHostTracker hwndHostTracker2 = e.NewValue as HwndHostTracker;
				if (hwndHostTracker != null)
				{
					hwndHostTracker._needCompact = true;
					hwndHostTracker._hosts.Remove(item);
				}
				hwndHostTracker2?._hosts.Add(item);
			}
		}

		internal static bool GetHasHwndHost(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (d.GetValue(HwndHostProperty) is HwndHostTracker hwndHostTracker)
			{
				return hwndHostTracker.HasHwndHost;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ScenicRibbonCaptionArea : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey RoundCornersPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RoundCornersProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public bool IsWithinRibbonWindow
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public bool RoundCorners => (bool)GetValue(RoundCornersProperty);

		static ScenicRibbonCaptionArea()
		{
			IsWithinRibbonWindowProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsWithinRibbonWindow", typeof(bool), typeof(ScenicRibbonCaptionArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			RoundCornersPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("RoundCorners", typeof(bool), typeof(ScenicRibbonCaptionArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			RoundCornersProperty = RoundCornersPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ScenicRibbonCaptionArea), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ScenicRibbonCaptionArea)));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SyncRoundedCorners();
		}

		private static void OnIsWithinRibbonWindowChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ScenicRibbonCaptionArea scenicRibbonCaptionArea)
			{
				scenicRibbonCaptionArea.SyncRoundedCorners();
			}
		}

		private void SyncRoundedCorners()
		{
			bool flag = IsWithinRibbonWindow;
			if (flag)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow = ribbon.RibbonWindow;
					if (ribbonWindow != null)
					{
						flag = !ribbonWindow.IsClassicOSThemeInternal;
					}
				}
			}
			SetValue(RoundCornersPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(flag));
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TabItemAreaToolbarPanel", Type = typeof(TabItemAreaToolbarPanel))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TabItemAreaToolbarOverflowPanel", Type = typeof(TabItemAreaToolbarOverflowPanel))]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class TabItemAreaToolbar : ToolbarWithOverflow, IRibbonToolLocation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabItemAreaMinWidthProperty;

		internal override string OverflowButtonKeyTipResourceId => "TabItemAreaToolbarOverflowButtonKeyTip";

		internal override string OverflowPanelMissingResourceId => "LE_TabItemAreaToolbarOverflowPanelMissing";

		public double TabItemAreaMinWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(TabItemAreaMinWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TabItemAreaMinWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal override bool ContainsId(string toolId)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					string text = frameworkElement.GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty) as string;
					if (text == toolId)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool ContainsToolInstance(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (tool == items[i])
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ValidateMinWdth(object newValue)
		{

		private struct ItemRowGrouping : IComparable<ItemRowGrouping>
		{
			public ItemRow[] Rows;

			public double GroupWidth;

			internal ItemRowGrouping(int rowCount)
			{
				Rows = new ItemRow[rowCount];
				GroupWidth = 0.0;
			}

			public int CompareTo(ItemRowGrouping other)
			{
				int num = GroupWidth.CompareTo(other.GroupWidth);
				if (num == 0)
				{
					num = Rows.Length.CompareTo(other.Rows.Length);
					if (num == 0)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Rows.Length; i++)
						{
							num = other.Rows[i].Count.CompareTo(Rows[i].Count);
							if (num != 0)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceRowCount(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			ToolHorizontalWrapPanel toolHorizontalWrapPanel = (ToolHorizontalWrapPanel)d;
			int num = (int)value;
			if (num < toolHorizontalWrapPanel.MinRows)
			{
				return toolHorizontalWrapPanel.MinRows;
			}
			if (num > toolHorizontalWrapPanel.MaxRows)
			{
				return toolHorizontalWrapPanel.MaxRows;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static bool OnValidateRowCount(object value)
		{
			int num = ((value is int) ? ((int)value) : 0);
			if (num >= 1)
			{
				return num <= 3;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static int GetSortOrder(DependencyObject d)

		{
			d.SetValue(SortOrderProperty, value);

		private void Sort(List<UIElement> elements)
		{
			if (elements.Count <= 0 || MinRows >= MaxRows || RowCount == MinRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			long[] array = new long[elements.Count];
			int num = (int)SortOrderProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
			bool flag = false;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = elements.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				int sortOrder = GetSortOrder(elements[i]);
				long num2 = i + ((long)sortOrder << 32);
				array[i] = num2;
				if (!flag && i > 0 && sortOrder < num)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				num = sortOrder;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Array.Sort(array);
				UIElement[] array2 = new UIElement[elements.Count];
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					int index = (int)(array[j] & 0xFFFFFFFFu);
					array2[j] = elements[index];
				}
				elements.Clear();
				elements.AddRange(array2);
			}
		}

		IList<FrameworkElement> IRibbonToolPanel.GetResizableTools(RibbonToolSizingMode destinationSize)
		{
			List<FrameworkElement> list = null;
			if (destinationSize == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly && _smallTools != null)
			{
				if (!base.IsMeasureValid)
				{
					Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
				list = new List<FrameworkElement>();
				foreach (UIElement smallTool in _smallTools)
				{
					if (smallTool is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(frameworkElement) == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal && RibbonGroup.GetMinimumSize(frameworkElement) == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly)
					{
						list.Add(frameworkElement);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

	public class ToolLocationToIsInMenuConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public static readonly ToolLocationToIsInMenuConverter Instance;

		static ToolLocationToIsInMenuConverter()
		{
			Instance = new ToolLocationToIsInMenuConverter();
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if ((targetType == typeof(bool) || targetType == typeof(object)) && value is ToolLocation)
			{
				switch ((ToolLocation)value)
				{
				case ToolLocation.Menu:
				case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu:
				case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems:
				case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuSubMenu:
					return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
				default:
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
			}
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
		}
	}

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ButtonTool : System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase, IRibbonTool
	{
		protected class ButtonToolProxy : RibbonToolProxy<ButtonTool>
		{
			internal static readonly ButtonToolProxy Instance;

			private static DependencyProperty[] _bindProperties;

			public override bool RetainFocusOnPerformAction => false;

			static ButtonToolProxy()
			{
				Instance = new ButtonToolProxy();
				_bindProperties = new DependencyProperty[4]
				{
					ContentControl.ContentProperty,
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandTargetProperty,
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandParameterProperty,
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandProperty
				};
				RibbonToolProxy.RegisterPropertiesToIgnore(typeof(ButtonToolProxy), System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandProperty, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandTargetProperty, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandParameterProperty);
			}

			protected override void Bind(ButtonTool sourceTool, ButtonTool targetTool)
			{
				base.Bind(sourceTool, targetTool);
				RibbonToolProxy.BindToolProperties(_bindProperties, sourceTool, targetTool);
			}

			protected override void OnMenuItemClick(ButtonTool tool)
			{
				tool.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
			}

			public override bool PerformAction(ButtonTool tool)
			{
				tool.OnClick();
				return true;
			}

			protected override void PrepareToolMenuItem(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, ButtonTool tool)
			{
				base.PrepareToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, tool);
				BindCommandProperties(toolMenuItem, tool);
			}

			protected override void RaiseToolEvent(ButtonTool sourceTool, RoutedEventArgs args)
			{
				sourceTool.OnRaiseToolEvent(args);
			}
		}
