		static ButtonTool()
		{
			CaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			HasCaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasCaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			HasImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			IdProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			ImageResolvedProperty = RibbonToolHelper.ImageResolvedProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			IsActiveProperty = XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			IsQatCommonToolProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsQatCommonToolProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			IsOnQatProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			LargeImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.LargeImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			SizingModeProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			SmallImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			ActivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.ActivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			ClonedEvent = MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			CloneDiscardedEvent = MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			DeactivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.DeactivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ButtonTool));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool)));
			RibbonGroup.MaximumSizeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextNormalBox));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Style()));
			ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			ContentControl.ContentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnContentChanged));
			XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey);
			XamRibbon.LocationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey);
			UIElement.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ButtonTool), UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnButtonLostMouseCapture), handledEventsToo: true);
		}

		protected override void OnAccessKey(AccessKeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnAccessKey(e);
			if (!e.IsMultiple)
			{
				XamRibbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon(this);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			OnButtonClick(this);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ButtonToolAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string caption = Caption;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption))
			{
				return caption;
			}
			if (base.Content is string)
			{
				caption = base.Content as string;
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRaiseToolEvent(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			RibbonToolHelper.SetToolVisualState(this, useTransitions, IsActive);
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ButtonTool buttonTool)
			{
				buttonTool.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal void AutomationButtonClick()
		{
			OnClick();
		}

		internal static void BindCommandProperties(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase tool)
		{
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandParameterProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandParameterProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandTargetProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandTargetProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
		}

		internal static void OnContentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue is string)
			{
				d.SetValue(CaptionProperty, e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnButtonClick(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase button)
		{
			if (button.ClickMode != ClickMode.Press || !button.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				XamRibbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbonHelper(button);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnButtonLostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase buttonBase = sender as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase;
			if (buttonBase.ClickMode == ClickMode.Press && !buttonBase.IsMouseCaptured && buttonBase.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				XamRibbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbonHelper(buttonBase);
			}
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_OverflowPopup", Type = typeof(Popup))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_OverflowButton", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public abstract class ToolbarWithOverflow : ToolbarBase, IRibbonPopupOwner
	{
		private class KeyTipProvider : IKeyTip, IKeyTipContainer
		{
			private ToolbarWithOverflow _toolbar;

			KeyTipAlignment IKeyTip.Alignment => KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter;

			string IKeyTip.AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

			string IKeyTip.Caption => null;

			public KeyTipActivationBehavior ActivationBehavior => KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers;

			bool IKeyTip.IsEnabled
			{
				get
				{
					if (_toolbar._overflowButton != null)
					{
						return _toolbar._overflowButton.IsEnabled;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			bool IKeyTip.IsVisible => _toolbar.OverflowButtonVisibility == Visibility.Visible;

			string IKeyTip.KeyTipValue => XamRibbon.GetString(_toolbar.OverflowButtonKeyTipResourceId);

			System.Windows.Point IKeyTip.Location
			{
				get
				{
					System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
					if (_toolbar._overflowButton != null)
					{
						result.X = _toolbar._overflowButton.ActualWidth / 2.0;
						result.Y = _toolbar._overflowButton.ActualHeight * 2.0 / 3.0;
					}
					return result;
				}
			}

			char IKeyTip.Mnemonic => '\0';

			UIElement IKeyTip.AdornedElement => _toolbar._overflowButton;

			char IKeyTip.DefaultPrefix => '\0';

			bool IKeyTip.CanAutoGenerateKeyTip => true;

			bool IKeyTipContainer.ReuseParentKeyTips => true;

			internal KeyTipProvider(ToolbarWithOverflow toolbar)
			{
				_toolbar = toolbar;
			}

			bool IKeyTip.Activate()
			{
				_toolbar.IsOverflowOpen = true;
				return _toolbar.IsOverflowOpen;
			}

			bool IKeyTip.Equals(IKeyTip provider)
			{
				return provider == this;
			}

			IKeyTipContainer IKeyTip.GetContainer()
			{
				return this;
			}

			void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
			{
				_toolbar.IsOverflowOpen = false;
				if (_toolbar.OverflowPopup != null && _toolbar.OverflowPopup.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && _toolbar._overflowButton != null && _toolbar._overflowButton.Focusable)
				{
					_toolbar._overflowButton.Focus();
				}
				if (_toolbar.OverflowPopup != null)
				{
					RequestBringIntoViewCancelHelper.CancelBringIntoView(_toolbar.OverflowPopup);
				}
			}

			IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
			{
				return _toolbar.GetKeyTipProviders(bumpedToolsOnly: true);
			}
		}

		private XamRibbon _ribbon;

		private ToolbarOverflowPanelBase _toolbarOverflowPanel;

		private ToolbarPanelBase _toolbarPanel;

		private Popup _overflowPopup;

		private IKeyTip _overflowKeyTipProvider;

		internal ArrayList _logicalChildren = new ArrayList(5);

		internal FrameworkElement _overflowButton;

		private PopupOwnerProxy _popupOwnerProxy;

		static ToolbarWithOverflow()
		{
			IsOverflowOpenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsOverflowOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolbarWithOverflow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, OnIsOverflowOpenChanged, OnCoerceIsOverflowOpen));
			OverflowButtonVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("OverflowButtonVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(ToolbarWithOverflow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox));
			OverflowButtonVisibilityProperty = OverflowButtonVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			XamRibbon.RibbonProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolbarWithOverflow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnRibbonChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToolbarWithOverflow), FrameworkElement.RequestBringIntoViewEvent, new RequestBringIntoViewEventHandler(OnRequestBringIntoView));
			ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolbarWithOverflow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceItemsSource));
		}

		internal ToolbarWithOverflow()
		{
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			VerifyParts();
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				VerifyItemsAreValid(e.NewItems);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				VerifyItemsAreValid(base.Items);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsOverflowOpenChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolbarWithOverflow toolbarWithOverflow = (ToolbarWithOverflow)d;
			if (toolbarWithOverflow.IsOverflowOpen)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(toolbarWithOverflow);
				if (ribbon.HasKeyTipManager)
				{
					KeyTipManager keyTipManager = ribbon.KeyTipManager;
					if (keyTipManager.IsActive && keyTipManager.ProviderPendingActivation != toolbarWithOverflow.OverflowKeyTipProvider)
					{
						keyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProvider(toolbarWithOverflow.OverflowKeyTipProvider);
					}
				}
				toolbarWithOverflow.PopupOwnerProxy.OnOpen();
			}
			else
			{
				toolbarWithOverflow.PopupOwnerProxy.OnClose();
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceIsOverflowOpen(DependencyObject target, object newValue)
		{
			if (target is ToolbarWithOverflow { OverflowButtonVisibility: not Visibility.Visible })
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		internal string GetKeyTipAtIndex(int index)
		{
			CultureInfo cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			if (GetValue(FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty) is XmlLanguage xmlLanguage)
			{
				try
				{
					cultureInfo = xmlLanguage.GetEquivalentCulture();
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
				}
			}
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = index + 1;
			if (num <= 9)
			{
				return num.ToString(cultureInfo);
			}
			if (num <= 18)
			{
				return (19 - num).ToString("00", cultureInfo);
			}
			char c = Convert.ToChar(65 + (num - 19));
			if (!char.IsLetter(c))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return 0.ToString(cultureInfo) + c;
		}

		internal IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(bool bumpedToolsOnly)
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			if (base.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				IEnumerable enumerable = null;
				if (!bumpedToolsOnly)
				{
					enumerable = base.Items;
				}
				else if (ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal != null)
				{
					enumerable = ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal.Children;
				}
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						FrameworkElement targetElement = GetTargetElement(item);
						if (targetElement == null || targetElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (targetElement is RibbonGroup)
						{
							list.Add((RibbonGroup)targetElement);
						}
						else if (targetElement is IRibbonTool)
						{
							RibbonToolProxy toolProxy = ((IRibbonTool)targetElement).ToolProxy;
							if (toolProxy != null)
							{
								list.AddRange(toolProxy.GetKeyTipProviders(targetElement));
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (!bumpedToolsOnly && OverflowButtonVisibility == Visibility.Visible && _overflowButton != null)
				{
					list.Add(OverflowKeyTipProvider);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal abstract ToolbarOverflowPanelBase GetOverflowPanel();

		internal virtual FrameworkElement GetTargetElement(object item)
		{
			return item as FrameworkElement;
		}

		internal abstract ToolbarPanelBase GetToolbarPanel();

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ToolbarWithOverflow toolbarWithOverflow)
			{
				toolbarWithOverflow._ribbon = e.NewValue as XamRibbon;
			}
		}

		internal abstract void VerifyItemIsValid(object item);

		internal virtual void VerifyParts()
		{
			ToolbarPanelBase toolbarPanel = _toolbarPanel;
			ToolbarOverflowPanelBase toolbarOverflowPanel = _toolbarOverflowPanel;
			_toolbarPanel = GetToolbarPanel();
			_toolbarOverflowPanel = GetOverflowPanel();
			_overflowPopup = GetTemplateChild("PART_OverflowPopup") as Popup;
			_overflowButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_OverflowButton") as FrameworkElement;
			PopupOwnerProxy.Initialize(_overflowButton);
		}

		private static object CoerceItemsSource(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(d) && (newValue is string || newValue is IList<string>))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnRequestBringIntoView(object sender, RequestBringIntoViewEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolbarWithOverflow toolbarWithOverflow = sender as ToolbarWithOverflow;
			if (e.TargetObject is Visual visual && toolbarWithOverflow.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal != null && toolbarWithOverflow.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal.Children.Count > 0 && !toolbarWithOverflow.IsOverflowOpen)
			{
				bool flag = toolbarWithOverflow.OverflowPopup != null && Utilities.IsDescendantOf(toolbarWithOverflow.OverflowPopup, visual);
				if (!flag && visual != toolbarWithOverflow.ToolbarPanelInternal && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(toolbarWithOverflow.ToolbarPanelInternal, visual) && toolbarWithOverflow._overflowButton != visual && (toolbarWithOverflow._overflowButton == null || !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(toolbarWithOverflow._overflowButton, visual)))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag && !RequestBringIntoViewCancelHelper.ShouldIgnoreBringIntoView(toolbarWithOverflow.OverflowPopup))
				{
					toolbarWithOverflow.IsOverflowOpen = true;
					toolbarWithOverflow.UpdateLayout();
					toolbarWithOverflow.OverflowPopup.UpdateLayout();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyItemsAreValid(IList items)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
			{
				VerifyItemIsValid(items[i]);
			}
		}

		bool IRibbonPopupOwner.FocusFirstItem()
		{
			return PopupOwnerProxy.FocusFirstItem(_toolbarOverflowPanel.Children);
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_QuickAccessToolbarPanel", Type = typeof(QuickAccessToolbarPanel))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel", Type = typeof(QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_QuickCustomizeMenuSite", Type = typeof(ContentControl))]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class QuickAccessToolbar : ToolbarWithOverflow, IRibbonToolLocation
	{
		private ContentControl _quickCustomizeMenuSite;

		private MenuTool _quickCustomizeMenu;

		private double? _calculatedMinWidthOnTop;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsBelowRibbonPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsBelowRibbonProperty;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent QuickCustomizeMenuOpeningEvent;

		internal override string OverflowButtonKeyTipResourceId => "QuickCustomizeOverflowButtonKeyTip";

		internal override string OverflowPanelMissingResourceId => "LE_QatOverflowPanelMissing";

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public bool IsBelowRibbon => (bool)GetValue(IsBelowRibbonProperty);

		internal ContentControl QuickCustomizeMenuSite => _quickCustomizeMenuSite;

		internal MenuTool QuickCustomizeMenu
		{
			get
			{
				if (_quickCustomizeMenu == null)
				{
					_quickCustomizeMenu = new MenuTool();
					_quickCustomizeMenu.ButtonType = MenuToolButtonType.DropDown;
					_quickCustomizeMenu.PreOpening += OnQuickCustomizeMenuPreOpening;
					_quickCustomizeMenu.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageOnlyBox);
					_quickCustomizeMenu.Items.Add("dummy");
				}
				return _quickCustomizeMenu;
			}
		}

		internal QuickAccessToolbarPanel ToolbarPanel => base.ToolbarPanelInternal as QuickAccessToolbarPanel;

		internal QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel ToolbarOverflowPanel => base.ToolbarOverflowPanelInternal as QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel;

		ToolLocation IRibbonToolLocation.Location => ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar;

		public event EventHandler<ToolOpeningEventArgs> QuickCustomizeMenuOpening
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(QuickCustomizeMenuOpeningEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(QuickCustomizeMenuOpeningEvent, value);
			}
		}

		static QuickAccessToolbar()
		{
			IsBelowRibbonPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsBelowRibbon", typeof(bool), typeof(QuickAccessToolbar), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsBelowRibbonChanged));
			IsBelowRibbonProperty = IsBelowRibbonPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			QuickCustomizeMenuOpeningEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("QuickCustomizeMenuOpening", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ToolOpeningEventArgs>), typeof(QuickAccessToolbar));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(QuickAccessToolbar), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(QuickAccessToolbar)));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(QuickAccessToolbar), System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CheckedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnMenuItemCheckedChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(QuickAccessToolbar), System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.UncheckedEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnMenuItemCheckedChanged));
			FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(QuickAccessToolbar), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceMinWidth));
		}

		internal override bool ContainsId(string toolId)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] is QatPlaceholderTool { Target: not null } qatPlaceholderTool)
				{
					string text = qatPlaceholderTool.Target.GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty) as string;
					if (text == toolId)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool ContainsToolInstance(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!(items[i] is SeparatorTool))
				{
					if (tool is QatPlaceholderTool && tool == items[i])
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (items[i] is QatPlaceholderTool qatPlaceholderTool && qatPlaceholderTool.Target == tool)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override ToolbarOverflowPanelBase GetOverflowPanel()
		{
			QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel quickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel") as QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel;
			if (quickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel != null)
			{
				quickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel.Toolbar = this;
			}
			return quickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel;
		}

		internal override FrameworkElement GetTargetElement(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is QatPlaceholderTool qatPlaceholderTool))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return qatPlaceholderTool.Target;
		}

		internal override ToolbarPanelBase GetToolbarPanel()
		{
			QuickAccessToolbarPanel quickAccessToolbarPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_QuickAccessToolbarPanel") as QuickAccessToolbarPanel;
			if (quickAccessToolbarPanel != null)
			{
				quickAccessToolbarPanel.Toolbar = this;
			}
			return quickAccessToolbarPanel;
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new QuickAccessToolbarAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		internal override void VerifyItemIsValid(object item)
		{
			if (item is QatPlaceholderTool || item is SeparatorTool)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidQatItemType", item.GetType().FullName));
		}

		internal override void VerifyParts()
		{
			base.VerifyParts();
			if (_quickCustomizeMenuSite != null)
			{
				_logicalChildren.Remove(QuickCustomizeMenu);
				RemoveLogicalChild(QuickCustomizeMenu);
				_quickCustomizeMenuSite.Content = null;
			}
			_quickCustomizeMenuSite = GetTemplateChild("PART_QuickCustomizeMenuSite") as ContentControl;
			if (_quickCustomizeMenuSite != null)
			{
				_quickCustomizeMenuSite.Focusable = false;
				_logicalChildren.Add(QuickCustomizeMenu);
				AddLogicalChild(QuickCustomizeMenu);
				_quickCustomizeMenuSite.Content = QuickCustomizeMenu;
			}
			_calculatedMinWidthOnTop = null;
			DelayVerifyMinWidth();
		}

		private static void OnIsBelowRibbonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = d as QuickAccessToolbar;
			quickAccessToolbar.DelayVerifyMinWidth();
		}

		internal QatPlaceholderTool GetPlaceholderToolForItem(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (item is QatPlaceholderTool && item == items[i])
				{
					return item as QatPlaceholderTool;
				}
				if (items[i] is QatPlaceholderTool qatPlaceholderTool && qatPlaceholderTool.Target == item)
				{
					return qatPlaceholderTool;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void RemoveRibbonGroup(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] is QatPlaceholderTool qatPlaceholderTool && qatPlaceholderTool.Target is RibbonGroup && (qatPlaceholderTool.Target == group || qatPlaceholderTool.Target == group.CloneFromGroup))
				{
					base.Items.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveTool(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				QatPlaceholderTool qatPlaceholderTool = items[i] as QatPlaceholderTool;
				if (tool == items[i] || (qatPlaceholderTool != null && qatPlaceholderTool.Target == tool))
				{
					base.Items.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveToolId(string toolId)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] is QatPlaceholderTool { Target: not null } qatPlaceholderTool)
				{
					string text = qatPlaceholderTool.Target.GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty) as string;
					if (text == toolId)
					{
						items.RemoveAt(i);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal int VisibleIndexOf(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			int num = 0;
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!(items[i] is SeparatorTool) && items[i] is QatPlaceholderTool { Target: not null, Visibility: not Visibility.Collapsed } qatPlaceholderTool)
				{
					if (qatPlaceholderTool.Target == tool)
					{
						break;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void CalculateMinWidthOnTop()
		{
			if (_calculatedMinWidthOnTop.HasValue || IsBelowRibbon)
			{
				return;
			}
			QuickAccessToolbarPanel toolbarPanel = ToolbarPanel;
			if (toolbarPanel != null)
			{
				if (base.MinWidth > 0.0)
				{
					CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
				}
				object obj = toolbarPanel.ReadLocalValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				toolbarPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				_calculatedMinWidthOnTop = base.DesiredSize.Width;
				if (obj is Visibility)
				{
					toolbarPanel.SetValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, obj);
				}
				else if (obj is BindingBase)
				{
					toolbarPanel.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, (BindingBase)obj);
				}
				else
				{
					toolbarPanel.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				}
			}
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
		}

		private static object CoerceMinWidth(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = d as QuickAccessToolbar;
			if (!quickAccessToolbar.IsBelowRibbon && (newValue == null || (double)newValue == 0.0) && quickAccessToolbar._calculatedMinWidthOnTop.HasValue)
			{
				return quickAccessToolbar._calculatedMinWidthOnTop;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnMenuItemCheckedChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar) || !(e.OriginalSource is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem { Tag: IRibbonTool, Tag: FrameworkElement tag2 } menuItem))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!menuItem.IsChecked)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
				if (XamRibbon.GetLocation(tag2) != ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					IEnumerator allInstancesWithId = quickAccessToolbar.Ribbon.ToolInstanceManager.GetAllInstancesWithId(RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tag2));
					allInstancesWithId.Reset();
					while (allInstancesWithId.MoveNext())
					{
						if (allInstancesWithId.Current is FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 && XamRibbon.GetLocation(frameworkElement2) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
						{
							frameworkElement = frameworkElement2;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					quickAccessToolbar.Ribbon.RemoveToolFromQat(frameworkElement);
				}
			}
			else if (!RibbonToolHelper.GetIsOnQat(tag2))
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.Ribbon.AddToolToQat(tag2);
			}
		}

		private void OnQuickCustomizeMenuPreOpening(object sender, ToolOpeningEventArgs originalEventArgs)
		{
			if (!(sender is MenuTool menuTool))
			{
				return;
			}
			menuTool.Items.Clear();
			LabelTool labelTool = new LabelTool();
			labelTool.Content = XamRibbon.GetString("Qat_QuickCustomizeMenu_Title");
			menuTool.Items.Add(labelTool);
			Dictionary<string, FrameworkElement> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, FrameworkElement>(50);
			ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement> allToolInstances = base.Ribbon.ToolInstanceManager.AllToolInstances;
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem;
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in allToolInstances)
			{
				if (RibbonToolHelper.GetIsQatCommonTool(item) && item.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && item is IRibbonTool ribbonTool && ribbonTool.ToolProxy.CanAddToQat)
				{
					string id = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(item);
					if (id != null && id != string.Empty && !dictionary.ContainsKey(id))
					{
						toolMenuItem = new ToolMenuItem();
						toolMenuItem.Tag = item;
						toolMenuItem.Header = RibbonToolHelper.GetCaption(item);
						toolMenuItem.IsCheckable = true;
						toolMenuItem.IsChecked = RibbonToolHelper.GetIsOnQat(item);
						menuTool.Items.Add(toolMenuItem);
						dictionary.Add(id, item);
					}
				}
			}
			if (dictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				SeparatorTool newItem = new SeparatorTool();
				menuTool.Items.Add(newItem);
			}
			toolMenuItem = new ToolMenuItem();
			if (base.Ribbon.QuickAccessToolbarLocation == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon)
			{
				toolMenuItem.Header = XamRibbon.GetString("Qat_QuickCustomizeMenu_ShowBelowRibbon");
			}
			else
			{
				toolMenuItem.Header = XamRibbon.GetString("Qat_QuickCustomizeMenu_ShowAboveRibbon");
			}
			toolMenuItem.Command = RibbonCommands.ToggleQatLocation;
			toolMenuItem.CommandTarget = base.Ribbon;
			menuTool.Items.Add(toolMenuItem);
			if (base.Ribbon.AllowMinimize)
			{
				SeparatorTool newItem = new SeparatorTool();
				menuTool.Items.Add(newItem);
				toolMenuItem = base.Ribbon.CreateMinimizeMenuItem("Qat_QuickCustomizeMenu_MinimizeRibbon");
				menuTool.Items.Add(toolMenuItem);
			}
			ToolOpeningEventArgs args = new ToolOpeningEventArgs(originalEventArgs.Tool);
			RaiseQuickCustomizeMenuOpening(args);
		}

		private void DelayVerifyMinWidth()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, new XamRibbon.MethodInvoker(VerifyMinWidth));
		}

		private void VerifyMinWidth()
		{
			CalculateMinWidthOnTop();
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnQuickCustomizeMenuOpening(ToolOpeningEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		private void RaiseQuickCustomizeMenuOpening(ToolOpeningEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = QuickCustomizeMenuOpeningEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnQuickCustomizeMenuOpening(args);
		}
	}

		[DefaultValue(0)]
		public int ActivationActionDelay
		{
			get
			{
				return _activationActionDelay;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _activationActionDelay)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("ActivationActionDelay", XamRibbon.GetString("LE_ArgumentLessThanZero"));
					}
					_activationActionDelay = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		public int ActivationInitialActionDelay
		{
			get
			{
				return _activationInitialActionDelay;

				{
					if (value < -1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("ActivationInitialActionDelay", XamRibbon.GetString("LE_ArgumentLessThanZero"));

			}
		}

		static GalleryTool()
		{
			AllowResizeDropDownProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowResizeDropDown", typeof(bool), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			ItemBehaviorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemBehavior", typeof(GalleryToolItemBehavior), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(GalleryToolItemBehavior.Button));
			ItemSettingsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemSettings", typeof(GalleryItemSettings), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnItemSettingsChanged));
			MaxDropDownColumnsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxDropDownColumns", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			MaxPreviewColumnsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxPreviewColumns", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			MinDropDownColumnsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinDropDownColumns", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1));
			MinPreviewColumnsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinPreviewColumns", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1));
			PreferredDropDownColumnsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PreferredDropDownColumns", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1));
			PreviewItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("PreviewItems", typeof(ReadOnlyObservableCollection<GalleryItem>), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			PreviewItemsProperty = PreviewItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SelectedItemProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedItem", typeof(GalleryItem), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedItemChanged, OnCoerceSelectedItem));
			CaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			HasCaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasCaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			HasImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			IdProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			ImageResolvedProperty = RibbonToolHelper.ImageResolvedProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			IsActiveProperty = XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			IsQatCommonToolProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsQatCommonToolProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			IsOnQatProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			LargeImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.LargeImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			SizingModeProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			SmallImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			ItemSettingsVersionPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ItemSettingsVersion", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			ItemSettingsVersionProperty = ItemSettingsVersionPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MaxColumnSpanPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("MaxColumnSpan", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1));
			MaxColumnSpanProperty = MaxColumnSpanPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MaxPossiblePreviewColumnsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("MaxPossiblePreviewColumns", typeof(int), typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0));
			MaxPossiblePreviewColumnsProperty = MaxPossiblePreviewColumnsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ActivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.ActivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			ClonedEvent = MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			CloneDiscardedEvent = MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			DeactivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.DeactivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(GalleryTool));
			ItemActivatedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ItemActivated", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<GalleryItemEventArgs>), typeof(GalleryTool));
			ItemClickedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ItemClicked", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<GalleryItemEventArgs>), typeof(GalleryTool));
			ItemSelectedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ItemSelected", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<GalleryItemEventArgs>), typeof(GalleryTool));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool)));
			RibbonGroup.MaximumSizeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextLargeBox));
			RibbonGroup.MinimumSizeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextLargeBox));
			KeyboardNavigation.IsTabStopProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey);
			XamRibbon.LocationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey);
			UIElement.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(GalleryTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));

		}

		}

			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = this;
			bool flag = false;
			while (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				if (parent != null && parent is ToolMenuItem)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				dependencyObject = parent;
			}
			if (!flag && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_1"));
			}
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject parent2 = base.Parent;
			if (!(parent2 is MenuTool) && !(parent2 is ToolMenuItem.LogicalContainer) && !(parent2 is ToolMenuItem))
			{
				DependencyObject ancestorFromType = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(MenuTool), allowSubclassOfType: true);
				if (ancestorFromType == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_1"));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnItemSettingsChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is GalleryTool galleryTool)
			{
				if (e.OldValue != null)
				{
					((GalleryItemSettings)e.OldValue).PropertyChanged -= galleryTool.OnItemSettingsPropertyChanged;
				}
				if (e.NewValue != null)
				{
					((GalleryItemSettings)e.NewValue).PropertyChanged += galleryTool.OnItemSettingsPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceSelectedItem(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnSelectedItemChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			GalleryTool galleryTool = target as GalleryTool;
			GalleryItem galleryItem = e.NewValue as GalleryItem;
			if (e.OldValue is GalleryItem galleryItem2)
			{
				galleryItem2.IsSelected = false;
			}
			if (galleryTool != null && galleryItem != null && !galleryTool._ignoreSelectedItemChanged)
			{
				galleryTool.SetSelectedItem(galleryItem, null, null, force: true);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private void ClearIsHighlighted()
		{
			if (_currentActiveItemPresenter != null)
			{
				_currentActiveItemPresenter.SetIsHighlighted(value: false);
				_currentActiveItemPresenter = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnGroupsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < e.NewItems.Count; i++)
				{
					((GalleryItemGroup)e.NewItems[i]).GalleryToolInternal = this;
				}
			}
			SetDropDownPresenterItemsSource();
		}

		private void OnItemActivationDelayTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			IsInInitialActivationState = false;
			ItemActivationDelayTimer.Stop();
			GalleryItemEventArgs args = new GalleryItemEventArgs(this, ItemPresenterAwaitingActivation.GalleryItemGroup, ItemPresenterAwaitingActivation.Item, ItemActivationDelayTimer.Tag as GalleryItemPresenter);
			RaiseItemActivated(args);
		}

		private void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				flag = false;
				int num = 1;
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = e.NewItems.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					GalleryItem galleryItem = (GalleryItem)e.NewItems[j];
					_previewItemsInternal.Insert(e.NewStartingIndex + j, galleryItem);
					if (galleryItem.ColumnSpan > num)
					{
						num = galleryItem.ColumnSpan;
					}
					if (galleryItem.IsSelected)
					{
						SetSelectedItem(galleryItem, null, null);
					}
					galleryItem.GalleryToolInternal = this;
				}
				if (num > (int)GetValue(MaxColumnSpanProperty))
				{
					SetValue(MaxColumnSpanPropertyKey, num);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			{
				flag = false;
				int l = 0;
				for (int count4 = e.NewItems.Count; l < count4; l++)
				{
					_previewItemsInternal.RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					_previewItemsInternal.Insert(e.NewStartingIndex + l, (GalleryItem)e.NewItems[l]);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				int m = 0;
				for (int count5 = e.OldItems.Count; m < count5; m++)
				{
					_previewItemsInternal.RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				int k = 0;
				for (int count3 = e.NewItems.Count; k < count3; k++)
				{
					_previewItemsInternal[e.NewStartingIndex + k] = (GalleryItem)e.NewItems[k];
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
			{
				_previewItemsInternal.Clear();
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					_previewItemsInternal.Add(_items[i]);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				VerifyMaxColumnSpan();
			}
		}

		private void OnItemPropertyChanged(object sender, ItemPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "ColumnSpan")
			{
				VerifyMaxColumnSpan();
			}
		}

		private void OnItemSettingsPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			int num = (int)GetValue(ItemSettingsVersionProperty);
			int num2 = ++num;
			SetValue(ItemSettingsVersionPropertyKey, num2);
		}

		private void SetDropDownPresenterItemsSource()
		{
			if (_dropDownPresenter != null)
			{
				if (Groups.Count > 0)
				{
					_dropDownPresenter.DropDownItemsType = GalleryToolDropDownPresenter.ItemsType.Groups;
					_dropDownPresenter.ItemsSource = Groups;
				}
				else
				{
					_dropDownPresenter.DropDownItemsType = GalleryToolDropDownPresenter.ItemsType.Items;
					_dropDownPresenter.ItemsSource = Items;
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartItemActivationDelayTimer(GalleryItemPresenter galleryItemPresenter)
		{
			if (ItemActivationDelayTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				ItemActivationDelayTimer.Stop();
			}
			if (IsInInitialActivationState)
			{
				ItemActivationDelayTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(ActivationInitialActionDelayResolved);
			}
			else
			{
				ItemActivationDelayTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(ActivationActionDelay);
			}
			ItemActivationDelayTimer.Tag = galleryItemPresenter;
			ItemActivationDelayTimer.Start();
		}

		private void VerifyMaxColumnSpan()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 1;
			if (_items != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					int columnSpan = _items[i].ColumnSpan;
					if (columnSpan > num)
					{
						num = columnSpan;
					}
				}
			}
			SetValue(MaxColumnSpanPropertyKey, num);
		}

		private void VerifyParts()
		{
			if (_dropDownPresenterSite != null && _dropDownPresenterSite.Content == _dropDownPresenter)
			{
				_dropDownPresenterSite.Content = null;
			}
			_dropDownPresenterSite = GetTemplateChild("PART_DropDownPresenterSite") as ContentControl;
			if (_dropDownPresenterSite != null && _dropDownPresenterSite.Content == null)
			{
				_dropDownPresenterSite.Focusable = false;
				_dropDownPresenterSite.Content = DropDownPresenter;
				SetDropDownPresenterItemsSource();
			}
		}

		internal void ClearActiveItem(GalleryItemPresenter presenter)
		{
			ClearIsHighlighted();
			if (_currentActiveItem != null && !_ignoreNextMouseLeaveItemArea && _itemActivatedEventFired)
			{
				RaiseItemActivated(new GalleryItemEventArgs(this, null, null, presenter));
			}
			_isInInitialActivationState = false;
			_currentActiveItemArea = null;
			_currentActiveItem = null;
			_ignoreNextMouseLeaveItemArea = false;
			_itemActivatedEventFired = false;
		}

		internal void OnItemClicked(GalleryItem galleryItem, GalleryItemGroup galleryItemGroup, GalleryItemPresenter presenter)
		{
			XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this)?.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
			GalleryItemEventArgs args = new GalleryItemEventArgs(this, galleryItemGroup, galleryItem, presenter);
			RaiseItemClicked(args);
		}

		internal void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinItemChanged(GalleryItemPresenter galleryItemPresenter)
		{
			if (galleryItemPresenter.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && _currentActiveItem != galleryItemPresenter.Item)
			{
				ClearIsHighlighted();
				_currentActiveItem = galleryItemPresenter.Item;
				_currentActiveItemPresenter = galleryItemPresenter;
				_currentActiveItemPresenter.SetIsHighlighted(value: true);
				GalleryItemEventArgs args = new GalleryItemEventArgs(this, _currentActiveItemPresenter.GalleryItemGroup, _currentActiveItem, galleryItemPresenter);
				RaiseItemActivated(args);
			}
		}

		internal void OnMenuClosed()
		{
			ClearActiveItem(_currentActiveItemPresenter);
			ResetIgnoreMouseEnter();
			_itemActivatedEventFiredOnceDuringDropdown = false;
		}

		internal void OnMouseEnterItem(GalleryItemPresenter galleryItemPresenter)
		{
			if (!_ignoreMouseEnter)
			{
				if (_currentActiveItem == null)
				{
					_isInInitialActivationState = true;
				}
				ClearIsHighlighted();
				_currentActiveItem = galleryItemPresenter.Item;
				_currentActiveItemPresenter = galleryItemPresenter;
				_currentActiveItemPresenter.SetIsHighlighted(value: true);
				if (!_currentActiveItemPresenter.IsInPreviewArea)
				{
					Keyboard.Focus(_currentActiveItemPresenter);
				}
				StartItemActivationDelayTimer(galleryItemPresenter);
			}
		}

		internal void OnMouseEnterItemArea(ItemsControl galleryItemArea)
		{
			_isInInitialActivationState = true;
			_currentActiveItemArea = galleryItemArea;
		}

		internal void OnMouseLeaveItem(GalleryItemPresenter galleryItemPresenter)
		{
			ItemActivationDelayTimer.Stop();
		}

		internal void OnMouseLeaveItemArea(ItemsControl galleryItemArea)
		{
			if (_currentActiveItemPresenter != null && _currentActiveItemPresenter.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !_currentActiveItemPresenter.IsInPreviewArea && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(_currentActiveItemPresenter, typeof(ToolMenuItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
			{
				toolMenuItem.Focus();
			}
			ClearActiveItem(_currentActiveItemPresenter);
		}

		internal void SetFirstLastProps(bool isFirstInMenu, bool isLastInMenu)
		{
			if (isFirstInMenu != _isFirstInMenu)
			{
				_isFirstInMenu = isFirstInMenu;
				if (_dropDownPresenter != null)
				{
					if (_isFirstInMenu)
					{
						_dropDownPresenter.SetValue(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter.IsFirstInMenuPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					}
					else
					{
						_dropDownPresenter.ClearValue(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter.IsFirstInMenuPropertyKey);
					}
				}
			}
			if (isLastInMenu == _isLastInMenu)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isLastInMenu = isLastInMenu;
			if (_dropDownPresenter != null)
			{
				if (_isLastInMenu)
				{
					_dropDownPresenter.SetValue(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter.IsLastInMenuPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					_dropDownPresenter.ClearValue(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter.IsLastInMenuPropertyKey);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetSelectedItem(GalleryItem galleryItem, GalleryItemGroup galleryItemGroup, GalleryItemPresenter galleryItemPresenter)
		{
			SetSelectedItem(galleryItem, galleryItemGroup, galleryItemPresenter, force: false);
		}

		private void SetSelectedItem(GalleryItem galleryItem, GalleryItemGroup galleryItemGroup, GalleryItemPresenter galleryItemPresenter, bool force)
		{
			if (galleryItem == SelectedItem && !force)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ignoreSelectedItemChanged = true;
			SelectedItem = galleryItem;
			_ignoreSelectedItemChanged = false;
			if (galleryItem != null)
			{
				galleryItem.IsSelected = true;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				if (galleryItemPresenter != null)
				{
					if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(galleryItemPresenter, typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), allowSubclassOfType: true, XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this)) is GalleryToolDropDownPresenter)
					{
						_ignoreNextMouseLeaveItemArea = true;
						ribbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
						_ignoreNextMouseLeaveItemArea = false;
					}
					else
					{
						ribbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ribbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
				}
			}
			GalleryItemEventArgs args = new GalleryItemEventArgs(this, galleryItemGroup, galleryItem, galleryItemPresenter);
			RaiseItemSelected(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemActivated(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseItemActivated(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ItemActivatedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnItemActivated(args);
			_itemActivatedEventFired = true;
			_itemActivatedEventFiredOnceDuringDropdown = true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemClicked(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseItemClicked(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ItemClickedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnItemClicked(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemSelected(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseItemSelected(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ItemSelectedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnItemSelected(args);
		}
	}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string caption = Caption;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption))
			{
				return caption;
			}
			if (base.Content is string)
			{
				caption = base.Content as string;
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is LabelTool labelTool)
			{
				labelTool.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class MenuTool : MenuToolBase, IRibbonTool, ICommandSource
	{
		protected class MenuToolProxy : MenuToolBaseProxy
		{
			internal new static readonly MenuToolProxy Instance;

			private static DependencyProperty[] _bindProperties;

			static MenuToolProxy()
			{
				Instance = new MenuToolProxy();
				_bindProperties = new DependencyProperty[5] { IsCheckedProperty, ButtonTypeProperty, CommandTargetProperty, CommandParameterProperty, CommandProperty };
				RibbonToolProxy.RegisterPropertiesToIgnore(typeof(MenuToolProxy), CommandProperty, CommandTargetProperty, CommandParameterProperty);
			}

			protected override void Bind(MenuToolBase sourceTool, MenuToolBase targetTool)
			{
				base.Bind(sourceTool, targetTool);
				RibbonToolProxy.BindToolProperties(_bindProperties, sourceTool, targetTool);
			}

			internal override IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(MenuToolBase tool, ToolMenuItem menuItem)
			{
				MenuTool menuTool = tool as MenuTool;
				if (menuTool != null && menuTool.IsGalleryPreviewVisible)
				{
					return new IKeyTip[1]
					{
						new GalleryPreviewKeyTipProvider(menuTool)
					};
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (menuTool != null && menuTool.ButtonType != MenuToolButtonType.DropDown)
				{
					ToolLocation location = XamRibbon.GetLocation(tool);
					if (location == ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu || (location != ToolLocation.TabItemAreaToolbar && location != ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(menuTool.KeyTipForSegmentedButton)))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
					list.Add(new SegmentedMenuKeyTipProvider(menuTool, menuItem, isButton: false));
					list.Add(new SegmentedMenuKeyTipProvider(menuTool, menuItem, isButton: true));
					return list.ToArray();
				}
				return base.GetKeyTipProviders(tool, menuItem);
			}

			protected override bool IsActivatable(MenuToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tool.Presenter is MenuToolPresenter { IsMenuButtonAreaEnabled: false })
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.IsActivatable(tool);
			}

			protected override void PrepareToolMenuItem(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, MenuToolBase tool)
			{
				base.PrepareToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, tool);
				if (tool is MenuTool menuTool)
				{
					menuTool.BindIsSegmented(toolMenuItem);
					menuTool.BindCheckState(toolMenuItem);
					BindCommandProperties(toolMenuItem, menuTool);
				}
			}
		}

		private class SegmentedMenuKeyTipProvider : ToolKeyTipProvider
		{
			private bool _isButton;

			public override KeyTipActivationBehavior ActivationBehavior
			{
				get
				{
					if (_isButton)
					{
						return KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers;
					}
					return base.ActivationBehavior;
				}
			}

			public override bool IsEnabled
			{
				get
				{
					if (_isButton)
					{
						bool flag = base.Tool.IsEnabled;
						if (flag)
						{
							if (base.Tool is ICommandSource { Command: not null } commandSource)
							{
								flag = Utilities.CanExecuteCommand(commandSource);
							}
							if (flag && base.Tool is IRibbonTool ribbonTool && !ribbonTool.ToolProxy.IsActivateable(base.Tool))
							{
								flag = false;
							}
						}
						return flag;
					}
					return base.IsEnabled;
				}
			}

			public override string KeyTipValue
			{
				get
				{
					if (_isButton)
					{
						return ((MenuTool)base.Tool).KeyTipForSegmentedButton;
					}
					return base.KeyTipValue;
				}
			}

			public override System.Windows.Point Location
			{
				get
				{
					ToolLocation location = XamRibbon.GetLocation(base.Tool);
					bool flag = RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(base.Tool) == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge;
					XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(base.Tool);
					UIElement uIElement = base.MenuItem ?? base.Tool;
					System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
					if (location == ToolLocation.Ribbon && flag)
					{
						result.X = uIElement.RenderSize.Width / 2.0;
						if (ribbon != null)
						{
							result.Y = ribbon.GetRibbonGroupToolVerticalOffset((!_isButton) ? 2 : 0, uIElement);
						}
						else
						{
							result.Y = (_isButton ? 0.0 : uIElement.RenderSize.Height);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						KeyTipPlacementType placementType = ((!_isButton) ? KeyTipPlacementType.DropDownButton : KeyTipPlacementType.SmallImage);
						Rect rect = XamRibbon.GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(placementType, uIElement, uIElement);
						bool flag2 = !rect.IsEmpty;
						if (!flag2)
						{
							rect = new Rect(uIElement.RenderSize);
						}
						result.X = (flag2 ? ((rect.Left + rect.Right) / 2.0) : (_isButton ? rect.Left : rect.Right));
						result.Y = (rect.Top + rect.Bottom) / 2.0;
					}
					return result;
				}
			}

			internal SegmentedMenuKeyTipProvider(MenuTool menu, ToolMenuItem menuItem, bool isButton)
				: base(menu, menuItem)
			{
				_isButton = isButton;
			}

			public override bool Activate()
			{
				if (_isButton)
				{
					((MenuTool)base.Tool).OnSegmentedButtonClick();
					return true;
				}
				return base.Activate();
			}

			public override bool Equals(IKeyTip provider)
			{
				if (provider is SegmentedMenuKeyTipProvider segmentedMenuKeyTipProvider && segmentedMenuKeyTipProvider._isButton == _isButton)
				{
					return segmentedMenuKeyTipProvider.Tool == base.Tool;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override IKeyTipContainer GetContainer()
			{
				if (_isButton)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.GetContainer();
			}
		}

		private class GalleryPreviewKeyTipProvider : ToolKeyTipProvider
		{
			public override System.Windows.Point Location
			{
				get
				{
					System.Windows.Point location = base.Location;
					Rect keyTipPlacementElementRect = XamRibbon.GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(KeyTipPlacementType.DropDownButton, base.Tool, base.Tool);
					if (!keyTipPlacementElementRect.IsEmpty)
					{
						location.X = (keyTipPlacementElementRect.Left + keyTipPlacementElementRect.Right) / 2.0;
					}
					return location;
				}
			}

			public override KeyTipAlignment Alignment => KeyTipAlignment.MiddleLeft;

			internal GalleryPreviewKeyTipProvider(MenuTool menu)
				: base(menu, null)
			{
			}
		}

		internal class ButtonTypeToIsCheckableConverter : IValueConverter
		{
			internal static ButtonTypeToIsCheckableConverter Instance = new ButtonTypeToIsCheckableConverter();

			private ButtonTypeToIsCheckableConverter()
			{
			}

			object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (targetType == typeof(bool) && value is MenuToolButtonType && (MenuToolButtonType)value == MenuToolButtonType.SegmentedState)
				{
					return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
				}
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}

			object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
			}
		}

		internal class ButtonTypeToIsSegmentedConverter : IValueConverter
		{
			internal static ButtonTypeToIsSegmentedConverter Instance = new ButtonTypeToIsSegmentedConverter();

			private ButtonTypeToIsSegmentedConverter()
			{
			}

			object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (targetType == typeof(bool) && value is MenuToolButtonType)
				{
					if ((MenuToolButtonType)value == MenuToolButtonType.DropDown)
					{
						return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
					}
					return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
				}
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}

			object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
			}
		}

		static MenuTool()
		{
			CheckedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Checked", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(MenuTool));
			ClickEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Click", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(MenuTool));
			UncheckedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Unchecked", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(MenuTool));
			ButtonTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ButtonType", typeof(MenuToolButtonType), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(MenuToolButtonType.DropDown));
			CommandProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Command", typeof(ICommand), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnCommandChanged));
			CommandParameterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CommandParameter", typeof(object), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			CommandTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CommandTarget", typeof(IInputElement), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			IsCheckedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsChecked", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Journal, OnIsCheckedChanged));
			KeyTipForSegmentedButtonProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("KeyTipForSegmentedButton", typeof(string), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null), RibbonToolHelper.ValidateKeyTip);
			MenuItemDropDownArrowStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MenuTool), "MenuItemDropDownArrowStyleKey");
			MenuToolDropDownArrowStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MenuTool), "MenuToolDropDownArrowStyleKey");
			QuickCustomizeMenuDropDownArrowStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MenuTool), "QuickCustomizeMenuDropDownArrowStyleKey");
			ShouldDisplayGalleryPreviewProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShouldDisplayGalleryPreview", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, OnShouldDisplayGalleryPreviewChanged));
			HasImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuTool));
			ImageResolvedProperty = RibbonToolHelper.ImageResolvedProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuTool));
			LargeImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.LargeImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuTool));
			SmallImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			HideGalleryPreviewProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HideGalleryPreview", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnHideGalleryPreviewCallback));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(MenuTool)));
			XamRibbon.RibbonProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnRibbonChanged));
			XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnLocationChanged));
			RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnSizingModeChanged));
			SegmentedButtonCommand = new RoutedCommand("SegmentedButton", typeof(MenuTool));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(MenuTool), new CommandBinding(SegmentedButtonCommand, OnExecuteCommand, OnCanExecuteCommand));

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			if (base.IsInitialized)
			{
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
					VerifyOnlyOneGalleryTool(synchronizeOnChange: true);
					VerifyChildrenCache();
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
					VerifyOnlyOneGalleryTool(synchronizeOnChange: true);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

				_galleryTool.OnMenuClosed();
			}
		}

		private static void OnCommandChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuTool menuTool = d as MenuTool;
			ICommand command = e.OldValue as ICommand;
			ICommand command2 = e.NewValue as ICommand;
			if (command != null && menuTool._canExecuteHandler != null)
			{
				command.CanExecuteChanged -= menuTool._canExecuteHandler;
			}
			if (command2 == null)
			{
				menuTool._canExecuteHandler = null;
			}
			else
			{
				menuTool._canExecuteHandler = menuTool.OnCanExecuteChanged;
				command2.CanExecuteChanged += menuTool._canExecuteHandler;
			}
			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_lastCanExecuteState != CanExecuteSegmentedButton())
			{
				CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
			}
			if (base.Presenter is MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter)
			{
				menuToolPresenter.CoerceValue(MenuToolPresenter.IsMenuButtonAreaEnabledProperty);
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsCheckedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuTool menuTool = (MenuTool)d;
			if (menuTool != null)
			{
				if ((bool)e.NewValue)
				{
					menuTool.RaiseChecked(new RoutedEventArgs());
				}
				else
				{
					menuTool.RaiseUnchecked(new RoutedEventArgs());
				}
				bool? newValue = (bool?)e.NewValue;
				bool? oldValue = (bool?)e.OldValue;
				menuTool.RaiseAutomationToggleStatePropertyChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnShouldDisplayGalleryPreviewChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is MenuTool menuTool)
			{
				menuTool._shouldDisplayGalleryPreview = (bool)e.NewValue;
				menuTool.SynchronizePreviewInPresenter();
			}
		}

		private static void OnHideGalleryPreviewCallback(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuTool menuTool = d as MenuTool;
			menuTool.SynchronizePreviewInPresenter();
		}

		internal static void BindCommandProperties(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, MenuTool tool)
		{
			if (tool != null && tool.ButtonType == MenuToolButtonType.DropDown)
			{
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandParameterProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(CommandParameterProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandTargetProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(CommandTargetProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(CommandProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(toolMenuItem, System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(toolMenuItem, System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandTargetProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(toolMenuItem, System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandParameterProperty);
			}
		}

		internal bool CanExecuteSegmentedButton()
		{
			_lastCanExecuteState = CanExecuteSegmentedButtonImpl();
			return _lastCanExecuteState.Value;
		}

		private bool CanExecuteSegmentedButtonImpl()
		{
			if (ButtonType == MenuToolButtonType.DropDown)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ICommand command = Command;
			if (command != null)
			{
				RoutedCommand routedCommand = command as RoutedCommand;
				object commandParameter = CommandParameter;
				if (routedCommand != null)
				{
					object obj = CommandTarget;
					if (obj == null)
					{
						IInputElement presenter = base.Presenter;
						obj = presenter ?? this;
					}
					if (!routedCommand.CanExecute(commandParameter, (IInputElement)obj))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (routedCommand == null && !command.CanExecute(commandParameter))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (base.Presenter is MenuToolPresenter { IsMenuButtonAreaEnabled: false })
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void InitializePreviewGalleryVisibility(bool visible)
		{
			MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter = MenuToolPresenter;
			if (menuToolPresenter != null)
			{
				if (visible)
				{
					menuToolPresenter.SetValue(MenuToolPresenter.PreviewGalleryVisibilityPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
				}
				else
				{
					menuToolPresenter.ClearValue(MenuToolPresenter.PreviewGalleryVisibilityPropertyKey);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnSegmentedButtonClick()
		{
			switch (ButtonType)
			{
			case MenuToolButtonType.DropDown:
				break;
			case MenuToolButtonType.Segmented:
			case MenuToolButtonType.SegmentedState:
				OnClick(new RoutedEventArgs(ClickEvent));
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseClick(bool allowToggleState)
		{
			RaiseClick(allowToggleState, new RoutedEventArgs(ClickEvent, this));
		}

		private void RaiseClick(bool allowToggleState, RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (allowToggleState && ButtonType == MenuToolButtonType.SegmentedState)
			{
				OnToggle();
			}
			RaiseEvent(args);
			Utilities.ExecuteCommand(this);
			FrameworkElement fe = this;
			if (base.Presenter == null)
			{
				ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = MenuToolBase.GetToolMenuItem(this);
				if (toolMenuItem != null)
				{
					if (toolMenuItem.StaysOpenOnClick)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (toolMenuItem.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						fe = toolMenuItem;
					}
				}
			}
			XamRibbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbonHelper(fe);
		}

		internal void SetIsChecked(bool newValue)
		{
			SetCurrentValue(IsCheckedProperty, KnownBoxes.FromValue(newValue));
		}

		private void BindCheckState(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ButtonTypeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this);
			binding.Converter = ButtonTypeToIsCheckableConverter.Instance;
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ToolMenuItem.IsCheckableInternalProperty, binding);
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsCheckedProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(IsCheckedProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
		}

		private void BindIsSegmented(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ButtonTypeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this);
			binding.Converter = ButtonTypeToIsSegmentedConverter.Instance;
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ToolMenuItem.IsSegmentedInternalProperty, binding);
		}

		private void ExecuteCommand()
		{
			ICommand command = Command;
			if (command == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object commandParameter = CommandParameter;
			IInputElement inputElement = CommandTarget;
			if (command is RoutedCommand)
			{
				if (inputElement == null)
				{
					inputElement = this;
				}
				if (((RoutedCommand)command).CanExecute(commandParameter, inputElement))
				{
					((RoutedCommand)command).Execute(commandParameter, inputElement);
				}
			}
			else if (command.CanExecute(commandParameter))
			{
				command.Execute(commandParameter);
			}
		}

		private static void OnCanExecuteCommand(object target, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is MenuTool menuTool && args.Command == SegmentedButtonCommand)
			{
				args.CanExecute = menuTool.CanExecuteSegmentedButton();
				args.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnChildElement_IsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is UIElement)
			{
				if ((bool)e.NewValue)
				{
					_totalEnabledChildren++;
				}
				else
				{
					_totalEnabledChildren--;
				}
				if (base.Presenter is MenuToolPresenter)
				{
					base.Presenter.CoerceValue(MenuToolPresenter.IsMenuButtonAreaEnabledProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnExecuteCommand(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is MenuTool menuTool && args.Command == SegmentedButtonCommand)
			{
				menuTool.OnSegmentedButtonClick();
				args.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnLocationChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MenuTool menuTool)
			{
				menuTool.SynchronizePreviewInPresenter();
			}
		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MenuTool menuTool)
			{
				menuTool.SynchronizePreviewInPresenter();
			}
		}

		private static void OnSizingModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			MenuTool menuTool = d as MenuTool;
			menuTool.SynchronizePreviewInPresenter();
		}

		private void OnToggle()
		{
			object value = (IsChecked ? KnownBoxes.FalseBox : KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			SetCurrentValue(IsCheckedProperty, value);
		}

		private void RaiseAutomationToggleStatePropertyChanged(bool? oldValue, bool? newValue)
		{
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is MenuToolAutomationPeer menuToolAutomationPeer)
			{
				menuToolAutomationPeer.RaiseToggleStatePropertyChangedEvent(oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizePreviewInPresenter()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			ToolLocation location = XamRibbon.GetLocation(this);
			MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter = MenuToolPresenter;
			if (menuToolPresenter != null)
			{
				if (HasGalleryPreview && ribbon != null && location == ToolLocation.Ribbon && !(bool)GetValue(HideGalleryPreviewProperty) && RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(this) == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge)
				{
					menuToolPresenter.GalleryToolForPreview = _galleryTool;
					menuToolPresenter.SetValue(MenuToolPresenter.PreviewGalleryVisibilityPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
				}
				else
				{
					menuToolPresenter.GalleryToolForPreview = null;
					menuToolPresenter.ClearValue(MenuToolPresenter.PreviewGalleryVisibilityPropertyKey);
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyChildrenCache()
		{
			if (!(base.Presenter is MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter))
			{
				return;
			}
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			if (_childrenCache != null)
			{
				int count2 = _childrenCache.Count;
				if (count2 > 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < count2; i++)
					{
						object obj = _childrenCache[i];
						hashtable.Add(obj, obj);
					}
					_childrenCache.Clear();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_childrenCache = new ArrayList();
			}
			int totalEnabledChildren = _totalEnabledChildren;
			_totalEnabledChildren = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				if (items[j] is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					if (hashtable.ContainsKey(uIElement))
					{
						hashtable.Remove(uIElement);
					}
					else
					{
						if (uIElement is ToolMenuItem)
						{
							(uIElement as ToolMenuItem).ShouldHandleCanExecute = true;
						}
						uIElement.IsEnabledChanged += OnChildElement_IsEnabledChanged;
					}
					_childrenCache.Add(uIElement);
					if (uIElement.IsEnabled)
					{
						_totalEnabledChildren++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_totalEnabledChildren++;
				}
			}
			count = hashtable.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				foreach (DictionaryEntry item in hashtable)
				{
					if (item.Value is UIElement uIElement2)
					{
						uIElement2.IsEnabledChanged -= OnChildElement_IsEnabledChanged;
						if (uIElement2 is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
						{
							toolMenuItem.ShouldHandleCanExecute = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (totalEnabledChildren < 1)
			{
				menuToolPresenter.OnMenuTool_IsEnabledChanged();
			}
			else if (_totalEnabledChildren < 1)
			{
				menuToolPresenter.OnMenuTool_IsEnabledChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyOnlyOneGalleryTool(bool synchronizeOnChange)
		{
			GalleryTool galleryTool = null;
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			bool isFirstInMenu = true;
			bool isLastInMenu = false;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = items[i] as UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null || uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					if (galleryTool != null)
					{
						isLastInMenu = false;
					}
					num++;
				}
				if (uIElement is GalleryTool)
				{
					if (galleryTool != null)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_OnlyOneGalleryToolAllowed"));
					}
					galleryTool = uIElement as GalleryTool;
					isLastInMenu = true;
					if (num > 1)
					{
						isFirstInMenu = false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (galleryTool != _galleryTool)
			{
				if (_galleryTool != null)
				{
					_galleryTool.SetFirstLastProps(isFirstInMenu: false, isLastInMenu: false);
				}
				_galleryTool = galleryTool;
				if (_galleryTool != null)
				{
					_galleryTool.SetFirstLastProps(isFirstInMenu, isLastInMenu);
				}
				if (synchronizeOnChange)
				{
					SynchronizePreviewInPresenter();
				}
			}
		}
	}
