	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Active", GroupName = "ActiveStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Inactive", GroupName = "ActiveStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Menu", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Ribbon", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "QAT", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenu", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenuFooterToolbar", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenuRecentItems", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenuSubMenu", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "TabItemAreaToolbar", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_MenuToolPresenterSite", Type = typeof(ContentPresenter))]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public abstract class MenuToolBase : ItemsControl, IRibbonTool, IRibbonToolLocation, IKeyTipContainer, IRibbonPopupOwner
	{
		internal class MenuToolMenu : System.Windows.Controls.Menu
		{
			private MenuToolBase _menuTool;

			private static DependencyProperty _showKeyboardCuesProperty;

			internal static DependencyProperty ShowKeyboardCuesProperty => _showKeyboardCuesProperty;

			static MenuToolMenu()
			{
				FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(MenuToolMenu)));
				FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(Border));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(Border.BorderThicknessProperty, new TemplateBindingExtension(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BorderThicknessProperty));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(Border.BorderBrushProperty, new TemplateBindingExtension(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BorderThicknessProperty));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(Border.PaddingProperty, new TemplateBindingExtension(System.Windows.Controls.Control.PaddingProperty));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(Border.BackgroundProperty, new TemplateBindingExtension(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BackgroundProperty));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(UIElement.SnapsToDevicePixelsProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory2 = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ItemsPresenter));
				frameworkElementFactory2.SetValue(UIElement.SnapsToDevicePixelsProperty, new TemplateBindingExtension(UIElement.SnapsToDevicePixelsProperty));
				frameworkElementFactory.AppendChild(frameworkElementFactory2);
				ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate(typeof(MenuToolMenu));
				controlTemplate.VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory;
				controlTemplate.Seal();
				System.Windows.Controls.Control.TemplateProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(controlTemplate));
				System.Windows.Controls.Menu.IsMainMenuProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
				FrameworkElementFactory root = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(CardPanel));
				ItemsControl.ItemsPanelProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new ItemsPanelTemplate(root)));
				EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(MenuToolMenu), Mouse.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnLostMouseCapture));
				EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(MenuToolMenu), Mouse.PreviewMouseDownOutsideCapturedElementEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseDownOutsideCaptured));
				KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolMenu), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Continue));
				try
				{
					BindingFlags bindingAttr = BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
					FieldInfo field = typeof(KeyboardNavigation).GetField("ShowKeyboardCuesProperty", bindingAttr);
					_showKeyboardCuesProperty = field.GetValue(null) as DependencyProperty;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			internal MenuToolMenu(MenuToolBase menuTool)
			{
				_menuTool = menuTool;
			}

			protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Up:
				case Key.Down:
					return;
				case Key.Escape:
					if (base.Items.Count > 0 && !(base.Items[0] is ToolMenuItem { IsSubmenuOpen: not false }))
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
				base.OnKeyDown(e);
			}

			protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
				if (true.Equals(e.NewValue) && _showKeyboardCuesProperty != null)
				{
					SetValue(_showKeyboardCuesProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
			}

			protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
				if (_showKeyboardCuesProperty == null && e.Property.Name == "ShowKeyboardCues")
				{
					_showKeyboardCuesProperty = e.Property;
				}
			}

			private static void OnLostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				if (sender is MenuToolMenu menuToolMenu)
				{
					menuToolMenu.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new XamRibbon.MethodInvoker(menuToolMenu.VerifyCapture));
				}
			}

			private static void OnPreviewMouseDownOutsideCaptured(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				MenuToolMenu menuToolMenu = (MenuToolMenu)sender;
				if (Mouse.Captured != menuToolMenu || menuToolMenu._menuTool == null || menuToolMenu._menuTool.Location == ToolLocation.Unknown)
				{
					return;
				}
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = menuToolMenu;
				while (true)
				{
					DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
					if (parent == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (parent is XamRibbon)
					{
						return;
					}
					dependencyObject = parent;
				}
				if (dependencyObject is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					IInputElement inputElement = uIElement.InputHitTest(e.GetPosition(uIElement));
					if (inputElement is DependencyObject && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(menuToolMenu, (DependencyObject)inputElement) && menuToolMenu.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						uIElement.Focus();
					}
				}
			}

			private void VerifyCapture()
			{
				MenuToolMenu menuToolMenu = Mouse.Captured as MenuToolMenu;
				if (menuToolMenu != this)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				if (base.Items.Count == 1 && base.Items[0] is DependencyObject element && ContainerFromElement(element) is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem { IsSubmenuOpen: not false })
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (Keyboard.FocusedElement is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
				{
					ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = dependencyObject as ToolMenuItem;
					if (toolMenuItem == null)
					{
						toolMenuItem = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(ToolMenuItem), allowSubclassOfType: true, null, typeof(Popup)) as ToolMenuItem;
					}
					if (toolMenuItem != null && !(toolMenuItem is ApplicationMenuPresenter))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		internal class UseLargeImagesToDoubleConverter : IValueConverter
		{
			private static readonly object LargeSize;

			private static readonly object SmallSize;

			internal static readonly UseLargeImagesToDoubleConverter Instance;

			private UseLargeImagesToDoubleConverter()
			{
			}

			static UseLargeImagesToDoubleConverter()
			{
				LargeSize = 32;
				SmallSize = 16;
				Instance = new UseLargeImagesToDoubleConverter();
			}

			object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (targetType == typeof(double) && value is bool && (bool)value)
				{
					return LargeSize;
				}
				return SmallSize;
			}

			object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return System.Windows.Data.Binding.DoNothing;
			}
		}

		internal class FilteringEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private IEnumerator _sourceEnumerator;

			private ArrayList _filteredOutItems;

			private bool _endReached;

			private object _currentItem;

			private static object UnsetObjectMarker = new object();

			public object Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (_currentItem == UnsetObjectMarker)
					{
						if (_endReached)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
						}
						throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_3"));
					}
					return _currentItem;
				}
			}

			internal FilteringEnumerator(IEnumerator sourceEnumerator, ICollection filteredOutItems)
			{
				if (sourceEnumerator == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("sourceEnumerator");
				}
				if (filteredOutItems == null)
				{
					_filteredOutItems = new ArrayList(1);
				}
				else
				{
					_filteredOutItems = new ArrayList(filteredOutItems);
				}
				_sourceEnumerator = sourceEnumerator;
				_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (_endReached)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
				}
				if (!_sourceEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return false;
				}
				_currentItem = _sourceEnumerator.Current;
				if (_filteredOutItems.Contains(_currentItem))
				{
					return MoveNext();
				}
				return true;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_endReached = false;
				_currentItem = UnsetObjectMarker;
				_sourceEnumerator.Reset();
			}
		}

		protected class MenuToolBaseProxy : RibbonToolProxy<MenuToolBase>
		{
			internal static readonly MenuToolBaseProxy Instance;

			static MenuToolBaseProxy()
			{
				Instance = new MenuToolBaseProxy();
				RibbonToolProxy.RegisterPropertiesToIgnore(typeof(MenuToolBaseProxy), IsOpenProperty);
			}

			protected override void Bind(MenuToolBase sourceTool, MenuToolBase targetTool)
			{
				base.Bind(sourceTool, targetTool);
				targetTool.ItemsSource = sourceTool.Items;
			}

			public override bool PerformAction(MenuToolBase tool)
			{
				if (tool._presenter != null)
				{
					tool.SetReparentedToolsOwner(tool._presenter);
					MenuItemRole role = tool._presenter.Role;
					if (role == MenuItemRole.TopLevelItem || role == MenuItemRole.SubmenuItem)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (base.PerformAction(tool))
				{
					tool.OpenMenu(PopupOpeningReason.KeyTips);
					if (tool.IsOpen)
					{
						System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem = tool._presenter ?? GetToolMenuItem(tool);
						if (menuItem != null)
						{
							PopupOwnerProxy.FocusFirstItem(menuItem);
						}
					}
					return tool.IsOpen;
				}
				return false;
			}

			protected override void PrepareToolMenuItem(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, MenuToolBase tool)
			{
				base.PrepareToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, tool);
				toolMenuItem.ItemsSource = tool.Items;
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsSubmenuOpenProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(IsOpenProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemTemplateProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ItemsControl.ItemTemplateProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemTemplateSelectorProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ItemsControl.ItemTemplateSelectorProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleSelectorProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleSelectorProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ItemsControl.DisplayMemberPathProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ItemsControl.DisplayMemberPathProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemsPanelProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ItemsControl.ItemsPanelProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				if (ItemsControlItemStringFormatProperty != null)
				{
					toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ItemsControlItemStringFormatProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject("ItemStringFormat", BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				}
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ScrollViewer.CanContentScrollProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ScrollViewer.CanContentScrollProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
			}

			protected override void RaiseToolEvent(MenuToolBase sourceTool, RoutedEventArgs args)
			{
				if (args is ToolCloneDiscardedEventArgs { ClonedTool: MenuToolBase clonedTool })
				{
					if (clonedTool.GetReparentedToolsOwner() == GetToolMenuItem(clonedTool) && RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(clonedTool) is MenuToolBase d && GetToolMenuItem(d) != null)
					{
						clonedTool.SetReparentedToolsOwner(GetToolMenuItem(d));
					}
					clonedTool.ClearValue(ToolMenuItemProperty);
				}
				sourceTool.OnRaiseToolEvent(args);
			}
		}

				{
					if (_popupOwnerProxy != null)
					{
						openingReason = _popupOwnerProxy.OpeningReason;
					}
					if (openingReason == PopupOpeningReason.None)
					{
						ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = GetToolMenuItem(this);
						if (toolMenuItem != null)
						{
							openingReason = toolMenuItem.OpeningReason;
						}
					}
				}
				return openingReason;
			}

		static MenuToolBase()
		{
			ActivatedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Activated", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ItemActivatedEventArgs>), typeof(MenuToolBase));
			ClonedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Cloned", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ToolClonedEventArgs>), typeof(MenuToolBase));
			CloneDiscardedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("CloneDiscarded", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ToolCloneDiscardedEventArgs>), typeof(MenuToolBase));
			DeactivatedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Deactivated", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ItemDeactivatedEventArgs>), typeof(MenuToolBase));
			ClosedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Closed", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(MenuToolBase));
			OpenedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Opened", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(MenuToolBase));
			OpeningEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Opening", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ToolOpeningEventArgs>), typeof(MenuToolBase));
			IsOpenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, OnIsOpenChanged, CoerceIsOpened));
			MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MenuItemDescriptionMinWidth", typeof(double), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(200.0));
			SubmenuHeaderTemplateKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MenuToolBase), "SubmenuHeaderTemplateKey");
			SubmenuItemTemplateKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(MenuToolBase), "SubmenuItemTemplateKey");
			UseLargeImagesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UseLargeImages", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			CaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			HasCaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasCaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			IdProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			IsActiveProperty = XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			IsQatCommonToolProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsQatCommonToolProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			IsOnQatProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			SizingModeProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(MenuToolBase));
			HasMenuItemDescriptionPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("HasMenuItemDescription", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HasMenuItemDescriptionProperty = HasMenuItemDescriptionPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MenuItemDescriptionProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MenuItemDescription", typeof(object), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnMenuItemDescriptionChanged));
			InputGestureTextProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("InputGestureText", typeof(string), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			StaysOpenOnClickProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("StaysOpenOnClick", typeof(bool), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
			ToolMenuItemProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ToolMenuItem", typeof(ToolMenuItem), typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnToolMenuItemChanged));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Style()));
			XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsActiveChanged));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuToolBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			ItemsPanelTemplate itemsPanelTemplate = new ItemsPanelTemplate(new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(MenuToolPanel)));

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = element as ToolMenuItem;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item as FrameworkElement;
			if (toolMenuItem != null && frameworkElement != null && item is IRibbonTool { ToolProxy: var toolProxy })
			{
				if (toolProxy == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_IRibbonToolProxyIsNull"));
				}
				toolProxy.ClearToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, frameworkElement);
			}
			if (_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed != null)
			{
				_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed.ClearContainerForItemBase(element, item);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearContainerForItemInternal(ToolMenuItem parentMenuItem, DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed = parentMenuItem;
			ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (item is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(ToolMenuItemProperty);
				if (RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this) is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
				{
					DependencyObject parent = frameworkElement.Parent;
					if (parent is ToolMenuItem.LogicalContainer)
					{
						parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(parent);
					}
					if (parent == parentMenuItem && menuToolBase._reparentedTools != null && parentMenuItem == menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner)
					{
						XamRibbon.GetRibbon(menuToolBase)?.VerifyMenuToolChildrenAsync(menuToolBase);
					}
				}
				ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = element as ToolMenuItem;
				MenuToolBase menuToolBase2 = frameworkElement as MenuToolBase;
				if (toolMenuItem.ItemsSource != null && menuToolBase2 != null)
				{
					toolMenuItem.ItemsSource = null;
				}
			}
			_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed = null;
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new ToolMenuItem();
		}

		internal DependencyObject GetContainerForItemInternal(ToolMenuItem parentMenuItem)
		{
			_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed = parentMenuItem;
			DependencyObject containerForItemOverride = GetContainerForItemOverride();
			_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed = null;
			return containerForItemOverride;
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is ToolMenuItem;
		}

		internal bool IsItemItsOwnContainerInternal(object item)
		{
			return IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			VerifyTypeOfChildren(this);
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_MenuToolPresenterSite") as ContentPresenter;
			if (_presenterSite != contentPresenter)
			{
				if (_presenterSite != null)
				{
					_presenterSite.ClearValue(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty);
				}
				_presenterSite = contentPresenter;
				if (_menu != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Controls.Menu menu = _menu;
					_menu = null;
					RemoveLogicalChild(menu);
					menu.Items.Clear();
				}
				if (_presenterSite != null)
				{
					if (_menu == null)
					{
						_menu = new MenuToolMenu(this);
						AddLogicalChild(_menu);
					}
					else
					{
						_menu.Items.Clear();
					}
					_menu.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
					EnsurePresenterIsInitialized();
					_menu.Items.Add(_presenter);
					_presenterSite.Content = _menu;
				}
			}
			if (_popupOwnerProxy == null && _presenter != null)
			{
				_popupOwnerProxy = new PopupOwnerProxy(this);
			}
			if (_popupOwnerProxy != null)
			{
				if (_presenter != null && _menu != null)
				{
					_popupOwnerProxy.Initialize(this);
				}
				else
				{
					_popupOwnerProxy.Initialize(null);
				}
			}
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override void OnGotKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotKeyboardFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_menu != null && true.Equals(e.NewValue) && !base.IsKeyboardFocused && base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && Keyboard.FocusedElement is DependencyObject descendant && Utilities.IsDescendantOf(this, descendant))
			{
				DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(this);
				if (focusScope != null)
				{
					FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(focusScope, null);
				}
			}
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				VerifyReparentedItems();
				break;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				VerifyTypeOfChildren(this);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				for (int i = e.NewStartingIndex; i < e.NewStartingIndex + e.NewItems.Count; i++)
				{
					VerifyTypeOfChild(base.Items[i]);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (_popupOwnerProxy != null)
			{
				_popupOwnerProxy.ProcessKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (_presenter != null)
			{
				if (e.Property == XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty)
				{
					_presenter.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey, e.NewValue);
				}
				else if (e.Property == XamRibbon.LocationProperty)
				{
					_presenter.SetValue(XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey, e.NewValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (element is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
			{
				toolMenuItem.SetValue(ToolMenuItem.ToolPropertyKey, item as IRibbonTool);
			}
			if (_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed != null)
			{
				_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed.PrepareContainerForItemBase(element, item);
			}
			else
			{
				base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			}
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem2 = element as ToolMenuItem;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item as FrameworkElement;
			SetLocation(element, item);
			if (toolMenuItem2 != null && frameworkElement != null)
			{
				if (frameworkElement != toolMenuItem2)
				{
					toolMenuItem2.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, frameworkElement));
				}
				if (item is IRibbonTool { ToolProxy: var toolProxy } ribbonTool)
				{
					if (toolProxy == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_IRibbonToolProxyIsNull"));
					}
					if (!toolProxy.IsActivateable(frameworkElement))
					{
						toolMenuItem2.Focusable = false;
					}
					toolProxy.PrepareToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem2, frameworkElement);
					if (ribbonTool is FrameworkElement && toolProxy.GetMenuItemDisplayMode((FrameworkElement)ribbonTool) != RibbonToolProxy.ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.EmbedToolInCaptionArea)
					{
						toolMenuItem2.SetBinding(MenuItemDescriptionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MenuItemDescriptionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, ribbonTool));
					}
				}
			}
			if (item is System.Windows.Controls.Panel element2)
			{
				KeyboardNavigation.SetDirectionalNavigation(element2, KeyboardNavigationMode.Contained);
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareContainerForItemInternal(ToolMenuItem parentMenuItem, DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed = parentMenuItem;
			if (item is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				if (element is ToolMenuItem)
				{
					frameworkElement.SetValue(ToolMenuItemProperty, element);
				}
				DependencyObject parent = frameworkElement.Parent;
				if (parent != parentMenuItem && parentMenuItem != null && (parent is MenuToolBase || parent == null))
				{
					MenuToolBase menuToolBase = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this) as MenuToolBase;
					XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
					ribbon?.SuspendToolRegistration();
					try
					{
						using (new TempValueReplacement(frameworkElement, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty))
						{
							if (parent != null)
							{
								((MenuToolBase)parent).RemoveLogicalChild(frameworkElement);
							}
							parentMenuItem.AddLogicalChildInternal(frameworkElement);
						}
						if (menuToolBase._reparentedTools == null)
						{
							menuToolBase._reparentedTools = new ArrayList(5);
						}
						menuToolBase._reparentedTools.Add(frameworkElement);
					}
					finally
					{
						ribbon?.ResumeToolRegistration();
					}
				}
			}
			PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			_parentMenuItemBeingProcessed = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ClosedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnClosed(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = OpenedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnOpened(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpening(ToolOpeningEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		private void RaiseOpening(ToolOpeningEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = OpeningEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			if (this.PreOpening != null)
			{
				this.PreOpening(this, args);
			}
			OnOpening(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseOpeningEvent()
		{
			if (_bypassRaisingNextOpeningEvent || IsOpen)
			{
				_bypassRaisingNextOpeningEvent = false;
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement rootSourceTool = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this);
			ToolOpeningEventArgs args = new ToolOpeningEventArgs((rootSourceTool == null) ? this : rootSourceTool);
			RaiseOpening(args);
			_bypassRaisingNextOpeningEvent = true;
		}

		private static object CoerceIsOpened(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (value is bool && (bool)value && target is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
			{
				if (menuToolBase.Presenter is MenuToolPresenter { IsMenuButtonAreaEnabled: false })
				{
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
				menuToolBase.RaiseOpeningEvent();
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnIsOpenChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(target is MenuToolBase menuToolBase) || !(e.NewValue is bool))
			{
				return;
			}
			menuToolBase.CoerceValue(ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty);
			bool flag = (bool)e.NewValue;
			RoutedEventArgs args = new RoutedEventArgs();
			menuToolBase._bypassRaisingNextOpeningEvent = false;
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(menuToolBase);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (menuToolBase._presenter != null && !menuToolBase._presenter.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					menuToolBase._presenter.Focus();
				}
				KeyTipManager.NotifyPopupOpened(menuToolBase.OpeningReasonResolved, menuToolBase);
				if (menuToolBase._popupOwnerProxy != null)
				{
					menuToolBase._popupOwnerProxy.OnOpen();
				}
				if (menuToolBase is ApplicationMenu && ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.Normal)
				{
					ribbon.EnterNavigationMode();
				}
				menuToolBase.RaiseOpened(args);
			}
			else
			{
				if (menuToolBase._selectedMenuItem != null && Selector.GetIsSelected(menuToolBase._selectedMenuItem))
				{
					menuToolBase._selectedMenuItem.ClearValue(Selector.IsSelectedProperty);
				}
				menuToolBase._selectedMenuItem = null;
				if (menuToolBase._popupOwnerProxy != null)
				{
					menuToolBase._popupOwnerProxy.OnClose();
				}
				menuToolBase.RaiseClosed(args);
			}
			bool flag2 = (bool)e.NewValue;
			bool oldValue = !flag2;
			menuToolBase.RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged(oldValue, flag2);
		}

		internal void SetReparentedToolsOwner(ToolMenuItem newOwner)
		{
			bool isReparenting = _isReparenting;
			_isReparenting = true;
			try
			{
				SetReparentedToolsOwnerImpl(newOwner);
			}
			finally
			{
				_isReparenting = isReparenting;
			}
		}

		private void SetReparentedToolsOwnerImpl(ToolMenuItem newOwner)
		{
			if (newOwner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolMenuItem reparentedToolsOwner = GetReparentedToolsOwner();
			if (this is MenuTool)
			{
				((MenuTool)this).VerifyOnlyOneGalleryTool(synchronizeOnChange: false);
			}
			if (reparentedToolsOwner == newOwner || !(RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this) is MenuToolBase menuToolBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			ribbon?.SuspendToolRegistration();
			try
			{
				if (menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner != null)
				{
					menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner.ItemsSource = null;
				}
				menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner = newOwner;
				if (menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner != null)
				{
					menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner.ItemsSource = ItemsToBind;
				}
				menuToolBase.TransferReparentedItems(newOwner);
			}
			finally
			{
				ribbon?.ResumeToolRegistration();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyReparentedToolsContainer()
		{
			if (!(RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this) is MenuToolBase { _reparentedTools: not null } menuToolBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToolMenuItem currentReparentedToolsOwner = menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner;
			bool flag = !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(ribbon, currentReparentedToolsOwner, preferLogicalTree: true) && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(ribbon, currentReparentedToolsOwner, preferLogicalTree: false);
			for (int num = menuToolBase._reparentedTools.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (menuToolBase._reparentedTools[num] is FrameworkElement { Parent: var parent } frameworkElement)
				{
					if (parent is ToolMenuItem.LogicalContainer)
					{
						parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(parent);
					}
					if (parent == _currentReparentedToolsOwner && (flag || (!Utilities.IsDescendantOf(ribbon, frameworkElement, preferLogicalTree: true) && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(ribbon, frameworkElement, preferLogicalTree: false))))
					{
						using (new TempValueReplacement(frameworkElement, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty))
						{
							currentReparentedToolsOwner.RemoveLogicalChildInternal(frameworkElement);
							menuToolBase._reparentedTools.RemoveAt(num);
							menuToolBase.AddLogicalChild(frameworkElement);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

			IList list2 = list;
			int count = list2.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				VerifyTypeOfChild(list2[i]);
			}
		}

			_presenter.SetBinding(RibbonGroupPanel.SizingModeVersionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonGroupPanel.SizingModeVersionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
			_presenter.SetBinding(HeaderedItemsControl.HeaderProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));

			_presenter.SetBinding(ItemsControl.IsTextSearchCaseSensitiveProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ItemsControl.IsTextSearchCaseSensitiveProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));

			if (ItemsControlItemStringFormatProperty != null)

			}
			_presenter.SetBinding(ScrollViewer.CanContentScrollProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ScrollViewer.CanContentScrollProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
			MenuToolBase menuToolBase = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this) as MenuToolBase;
			if (menuToolBase == null || menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner == _presenter || (menuToolBase == this && menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner == null))
			{
				if (menuToolBase != null)

					menuToolBase._currentReparentedToolsOwner = _presenter;

				_presenter.ItemsSource = ItemsToBind;

			_presenter.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsSubmenuOpenProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(IsOpenProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			InitializeMenuToolPresenter(_presenter);

		private void SetLocation(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			object value;
			if (!(this is ApplicationMenu))
			{
				value = ((Location != ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu) ? RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationMenuBox : RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationApplicationMenuSubMenuBox);
			}
			else
			{
				int num = Presenter.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(element);
				value = ((num < base.Items.Count) ? RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationApplicationMenuBox : RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationApplicationMenuRecentItemsBox);
			}
			element.SetValue(XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey, value);
			if (item is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				dependencyObject.SetValue(XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		private void TransferReparentedItems(ToolMenuItem newOwner)
		{
			if (_reparentedTools == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = _reparentedTools.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			ribbon?.SuspendToolRegistration();
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = _reparentedTools[i] as FrameworkElement;
					DependencyObject parent = frameworkElement.Parent;
					if (parent is ToolMenuItem.LogicalContainer)
					{
						parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(parent);
					}
					if (!(parent is ToolMenuItem) && parent != null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					using (new TempValueReplacement(frameworkElement, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty))
					{
						if (parent is ToolMenuItem)
						{
							((ToolMenuItem)parent).RemoveLogicalChildInternal(frameworkElement);
						}
						if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(frameworkElement, typeof(ToolMenuItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem && toolMenuItem.DataContext == frameworkElement)
						{
							toolMenuItem.DataContext = null;
						}
						newOwner.AddLogicalChildInternal(frameworkElement);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ribbon?.ResumeToolRegistration();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyReparentedItems()
		{
			if (_reparentedTools == null || this != RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = _reparentedTools.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList itemsToBind = ItemsToBind;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (_reparentedTools[num] is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && !itemsToBind.Contains(frameworkElement))
				{
					_reparentedTools.RemoveAt(num);
					ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = frameworkElement.Parent as ToolMenuItem;
					if (toolMenuItem == null && frameworkElement.Parent is ToolMenuItem.LogicalContainer)
					{
						toolMenuItem = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(frameworkElement.Parent) as ToolMenuItem;
					}
					toolMenuItem?.RemoveLogicalChildInternal(frameworkElement);
				}
			}
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
			IsOpen = false;
		}

		IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
		{
			return GetKeyTipProviders();
		}

		bool IRibbonPopupOwner.FocusFirstItem()
		{
			return PopupOwnerProxy.FocusFirstItem(_presenter);
		}
	}

		private static object CoerceIsMenuButtonAreaEnabled(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (target is MenuToolPresenter menuToolPresenter && (bool)value)

				if (menuTool != null)

					if (!menuTool.IsEnabled)

				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public FrameworkElement Target => (FrameworkElement)GetValue(TargetProperty);

		private XamRibbon Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ribbon == null)
				{
					_ribbon = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(XamRibbon), allowSubclassOfType: true) as XamRibbon;
				}
				return _ribbon;
			}
		}

		public QatPlaceholderTool()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

			: this()

			TargetId = associatedTargetId;
		}

			: this()
		{
			TargetId = associatedTargetId;
			TargetType = targetType;
		}

		static QatPlaceholderTool()
		{
			TargetPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Target", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(QatPlaceholderTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			TargetProperty = TargetPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			TargetIdProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TargetId", typeof(string), typeof(QatPlaceholderTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnTargetIdChanged));
			TargetTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TargetType", typeof(QatPlaceholderToolType), typeof(QatPlaceholderTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(QatPlaceholderToolType.Tool, OnTargetTypeChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(QatPlaceholderTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(QatPlaceholderTool)));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (Target != null)
			{
				Target.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Target == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (index > 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Target;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (Target != null)
			{
				Target.Measure(availableSize);
				return Target.DesiredSize;
			}
			return XamRibbon.DEFAULT_QAT_TOOL_SIZE;
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this);
			if (parent != null && !(parent is QuickAccessToolbarPanel) && !(parent is QuickAccessToolbarOverflowPanel))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidQatPlaceholderParent"));
			}
			VerifyAssociatedTarget();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Target != null)
			{
				return Target.ToString();
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		private static void OnTargetIdChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is QatPlaceholderTool qatPlaceholderTool)
			{
				qatPlaceholderTool.VerifyAssociatedTarget();
			}
		}

		private static void OnTargetTypeChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is QatPlaceholderTool qatPlaceholderTool)
			{
				qatPlaceholderTool.VerifyAssociatedTarget();
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyAssociatedTarget();
		}

		private void VerifyAssociatedRibbonGroup()
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = Ribbon.GetRibbonGroup(TargetId);
			if (ribbonGroup == null)
			{
				if (base.IsLoaded)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_QatItemWithTargetNotInRibbon", TargetId));
				}
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement value = ribbonGroup.CloneForQat();
			SetValue(TargetPropertyKey, value);
			if (Target != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(Target);
				AddVisualChild(Target);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyAssociatedTarget()
		{
			if (Target != null)
			{
				if (object.Equals(RibbonToolHelper.GetId(Target), TargetId) && ((TargetType == QatPlaceholderToolType.RibbonGroup && Target is RibbonGroup) || (TargetType == QatPlaceholderToolType.Tool && !(Target is RibbonGroup))))
				{
					return;
				}
				RemoveLogicalChild(Target);
				RemoveVisualChild(Target);
				ClearValue(TargetPropertyKey);
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(TargetId) && Ribbon != null)
			{
				object target = Target;
				if (TargetType == QatPlaceholderToolType.Tool)
				{
					VerifyAssociatedTool();
				}
				else
				{
					VerifyAssociatedRibbonGroup();
				}
				if (!object.Equals(target, Target))
				{
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyAssociatedTool()
		{
			FrameworkElement toolInstanceFromToolId = Ribbon.ToolInstanceManager.GetToolInstanceFromToolId(TargetId);
			if (toolInstanceFromToolId != null || base.IsLoaded)
			{
				toolInstanceFromToolId = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(toolInstanceFromToolId);
				if (toolInstanceFromToolId == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_QatItemWithTargetNotInRibbon", TargetId));
				}
				if (!(toolInstanceFromToolId is IRibbonTool { ToolProxy: var toolProxy }))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_QatToolNotIRibbonTool"));
				}
				if (toolProxy == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_IRibbonToolProxyIsNull"));
				}
				if (!toolProxy.CanAddToQat)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_CannotAddToolToQat", toolInstanceFromToolId.GetType().FullName));
				}
				FrameworkElement value = toolProxy.Clone(toolInstanceFromToolId);
				SetValue(TargetPropertyKey, value);
				if (Target != null && Target is IRibbonTool { ToolProxy: { } toolProxy2 })
				{
					toolProxy2.Bind(toolInstanceFromToolId, Target);
					Target.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty, TargetId);
					Target.SetValue(XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationQuickAccessToolbarBox);
					Target.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageOnlyBox);
					AddLogicalChild(Target);
					AddVisualChild(Target);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{
			internal static readonly RadioButtonToolProxy Instance;

			private static DependencyProperty[] _bindProperties;

			public override bool RetainFocusOnPerformAction => false;

			static RadioButtonToolProxy()
			{
				Instance = new RadioButtonToolProxy();
				_bindProperties = new DependencyProperty[5]
				{
					ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty,
					ContentControl.ContentProperty,
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandTargetProperty,
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandParameterProperty,
					System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandProperty
				};
				RibbonToolProxy.RegisterPropertiesToIgnore(typeof(RadioButtonToolProxy), System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandProperty, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandTargetProperty, System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.CommandParameterProperty);
			}

			protected override void Bind(RadioButtonTool sourceTool, RadioButtonTool targetTool)
			{
				base.Bind(sourceTool, targetTool);
				RibbonToolProxy.BindToolProperties(_bindProperties, sourceTool, targetTool);
			}

			protected override void OnMenuItemClick(RadioButtonTool tool)
			{
				tool.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
			}

				tool.OnClick();

			}

			{
				base.PrepareToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, tool);
				toolMenuItem.IsCheckable = true;
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsCheckedProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, tool));
				ButtonTool.BindCommandProperties(toolMenuItem, tool);
			}

			protected override void RaiseToolEvent(RadioButtonTool sourceTool, RoutedEventArgs args)
			{
				sourceTool.OnRaiseToolEvent(args);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override void OnChecked(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(this) != this)
			{
				RaiseEvent(e);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnChecked(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)

			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string caption = Caption;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption))
			{
				return caption;
			}
			if (base.Content is string)
			{
				caption = base.Content as string;
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is RadioButtonTool radioButtonTool)
			{
				radioButtonTool.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

	public enum RibbonStates : long

	public class RibbonCommands : Commands<XamRibbon>
	{
		private const ModifierKeys AllCtrlShiftModifiers = ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand NotACommand;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand ToggleRibbonMinimizedState;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand ToggleQatLocation;

		public static readonly RoutedCommand CloseApplicationMenu;

		private static RibbonCommands g_instance;

		internal static RibbonCommands Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (g_instance == null)
				{
					g_instance = new RibbonCommands();
				}
				return g_instance;
			}
		}

		private static CommandWrapper[] GetCommandWrappers()
		{
			return new CommandWrapper[3]
			{
				new CommandWrapper(ToggleRibbonMinimizedState, 0L, 8L, new InputGesture[1]
				{
					new KeyGesture(Key.M, ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift)
				}, ModifierKeys.None),
				new CommandWrapper(ToggleQatLocation, 0L, 0L, new InputGesture[1]
				{
					new KeyGesture(Key.L, ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift)
				}, ModifierKeys.None),
				new CommandWrapper(CloseApplicationMenu, 0L, 0L)
			};
		}

		static RibbonCommands()
		{
			NotACommand = ApplicationCommands.NotACommand;
			ToggleRibbonMinimizedState = new IGRoutedCommand("ToggleRibbonMinimizedState", typeof(RibbonCommands), 0L, 8L);
			ToggleQatLocation = new IGRoutedCommand("ToggleQatLocation", typeof(RibbonCommands), 0L, 0L);
			CloseApplicationMenu = new IGRoutedCommand("CloseApplicationMenu", typeof(RibbonCommands), 0L, 0L);
			Commands<XamRibbon>.Initialize(GetCommandWrappers());
		}

		public static void LoadCommands()
		{
		}

		private static InputGestureCollection CreateGestureCombinations(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			InputGestureCollection inputGestureCollection = new InputGestureCollection();
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.None);
			return inputGestureCollection;
		}

		private static void AddGesture(InputGestureCollection gestures, Key key, ModifierKeys gestureModifiers, ModifierKeys modifierToCheck)
		{
			if ((gestureModifiers & modifierToCheck) == modifierToCheck)
			{
				gestures.Add(new KeyGesture(key, modifierToCheck));
			}
		}
	}

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class RibbonGroup : ItemsControl, IRibbonToolLocation, IKeyTip, IKeyTipContainer, IRibbonPopupOwner
	{
		private class ItemContentPresenter : ContentPresenter, IRibbonToolSizingContainer
		{
			static ItemContentPresenter()
			{
				RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ItemContentPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnSizingModeChanged));
			}

			protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
			{
				if (visualRemoved != null)
				{
					ClearValue(MinimumSizeProperty);
					ClearValue(MaximumSizeProperty);
					visualRemoved.ClearValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey);
				}
				if (visualAdded != null)
				{
					SetBinding(MinimumSizeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MinimumSizeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, visualAdded));
					SetBinding(MaximumSizeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MaximumSizeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, visualAdded));
					visualAdded.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey, GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty));
				}
				base.OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
			}

			private static void OnSizingModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				ItemContentPresenter itemContentPresenter = d as ItemContentPresenter;
				if (itemContentPresenter.VisualChildrenCount == 1)
				{
					Visual visualChild = itemContentPresenter.GetVisualChild(0);
					visualChild.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModePropertyKey, itemContentPresenter.GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty));
				}
			}
		}

		string IKeyTip.KeyTipValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (XamRibbon.GetLocation(this) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this)?.QuickAccessToolbar;
					if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
					{
						int index = quickAccessToolbar.VisibleIndexOf(this);
						return quickAccessToolbar.GetKeyTipAtIndex(index);
					}
				}
				return RibbonToolHelper.GetKeyTip(this);
			}
		}

		System.Windows.Point IKeyTip.Location
		{
			get
			{
				if (XamRibbon.GetLocation(this) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					return ToolKeyTipProvider.GetToolKeyTipLocation(this, ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar, RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(this));
				}
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
				return new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left + rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Bottom);
			}
		}

		static RibbonGroup()
		{
			ContainingGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("ContainingGroup", typeof(RibbonGroup), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnContainingGroupChanged));
			ContainingGroupProperty = ContainingGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsDialogBoxLauncherToolPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("IsDialogBoxLauncherTool", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsDialogBoxLauncherToolProperty = IsDialogBoxLauncherToolPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MaximumSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MaximumSize", typeof(RibbonToolSizingMode), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextLargeBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, OnMinMaxSizeChanged));
			MinimumSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MinimumSize", typeof(RibbonToolSizingMode), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageOnlyBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, OnMinMaxSizeChanged));
			ReplacedByGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("ReplacedByGroup", typeof(RibbonGroup), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ReplacedByGroupProperty = ReplacedByGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup));
			CollapsedGroupButtonStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(RibbonGroup), "CollapsedGroupButtonStyleKey");
			ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ContextualTabGroup", typeof(ContextualTabGroup), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnContextualTabGroupChanged));
			ContextualTabGroupProperty = ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DialogBoxLauncherToolProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DialogBoxLauncherTool", typeof(ButtonTool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnDialogBoxLauncherToolChanged, OnCoerceDialogBoxLauncherTool));
			DialogBoxLauncherToolTemplateKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(RibbonGroup), "DialogBoxLauncherToolTemplateKey");
			HasDialogBoxLauncherToolPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasDialogBoxLauncherTool", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HasDialogBoxLauncherToolProperty = HasDialogBoxLauncherToolPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			HighlightContentPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HighlightContent", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
			HighlightContentProperty = HighlightContentPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IdProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnIdChanged));
			IsActiveProperty = XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup));
			IsCollapsedPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsCollapsed", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnIsCollapsedChanged));
			IsCollapsedProperty = IsCollapsedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsInContextualTabGroup", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsInContextualTabGroupChanged));
			IsInContextualTabGroupProperty = IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsMouseCaptureWithinContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsMouseCaptureWithinContent", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnHighlightContentCriteriaChanged));
			IsMouseOverContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsMouseOverContent", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnHighlightContentCriteriaChanged));
			IsOpenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, OnIsOpenChanged, CoerceIsOpened));
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup));
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup));
			QuickAccessToolbarGroupButtonStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(RibbonGroup), "QuickAccessToolbarGroupButtonStyleKey");
			SmallImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup));
			CloneFromGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CloneFromGroup", typeof(RibbonGroup), typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			CloneFromGroupProperty = CloneFromGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ActivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.ActivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup));
			DeactivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.DeactivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonGroup));
			ClosedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Closed", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(RibbonGroup));
			OpenedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Opened", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(RibbonGroup));
			OpeningEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Opening", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<RibbonGroupOpeningEventArgs>), typeof(RibbonGroup));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup)));
			ItemsPanelTemplate itemsPanelTemplate = new ItemsPanelTemplate(new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ToolVerticalWrapPanel)));
			itemsPanelTemplate.Seal();
			ItemsControl.ItemsPanelProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(itemsPanelTemplate));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Style()));
			XamRibbon.RibbonProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnRibbonChanged));
			XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnLocationChanged));
			XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsActiveChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(RibbonGroup), FrameworkElement.RequestBringIntoViewEvent, new RequestBringIntoViewEventHandler(OnRequestBringIntoView));
			UIElement.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new ItemContentPresenter();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			_captionElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_Caption") as FrameworkElement;
			_headerElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_Header") as FrameworkElement;
			_itemsPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_Items") as ItemsPresenter;
			_groupPresenterCollapsed = GetTemplateChild("PART_PopupRibbonGroupSite") as ContentControl;
			_groupPresenterNormal = GetTemplateChild("PART_RibbonGroupSite") as ContentControl;
			_groupButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_RibbonGroupButton") as DropDownToggle;
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_Popup") is Popup popup)
			{
				popup.Placement = PlacementMode.Custom;
				popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallback = GetCustomPopupPlacement;
			}
			if (_groupButton != null)
			{
				_groupButton.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey, GetValue(XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty));
				_groupButton.SetValue(IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, GetValue(IsInContextualTabGroupProperty));
			}
			SynchronizeItemsHeight();
			UpdateHighlightContentBindings(IsDropDown ? _groupPresenterCollapsed : _groupPresenterNormal);
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new RibbonGroupAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			Key key = e.Key;
			if (key == Key.Up)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Ribbon?.ActiveItem;
				if (!IsOpen && frameworkElement != null && IsAncestorOf(frameworkElement))
				{
					UIElement uIElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement as UIElement;
					RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = base.Parent as RibbonTabItem;
					if (uIElement != null && ribbonTabItem != null)
					{
						DependencyObject dependencyObject = uIElement.PredictFocus(FocusNavigationDirection.Up);
						if (dependencyObject != ribbonTabItem && dependencyObject != null && !IsAncestorOf(dependencyObject))
						{
							ribbonTabItem.Focus();
							e.Handled = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			PopupOwnerProxy.ProcessKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			BumpItemsVersion();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		private static void OnContainingGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)e.OldValue;
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2 = (RibbonGroup)e.NewValue;
			if (ribbonGroup != null)
			{
				if (d is IRibbonToolPanel)
				{
					ribbonGroup._registeredPanels.Remove((IRibbonToolPanel)d);
				}
				else if (d is MenuTool)
				{
					ribbonGroup._registeredMenus.Remove((MenuTool)d);
				}
				if (d is IRibbonTool)
				{
					ribbonGroup._registeredTools.Remove((IRibbonTool)d);
				}
				ribbonGroup.BumpItemsVersion();
			}
			if (ribbonGroup2 != null)
			{
				if (d is IRibbonToolPanel)
				{
					ribbonGroup2._registeredPanels.Add((IRibbonToolPanel)d);
				}
				else if (d is MenuTool)
				{
					ribbonGroup2._registeredMenus.Add((MenuTool)d);
				}
				if (d is IRibbonTool)
				{
					ribbonGroup2._registeredTools.Add((IRibbonTool)d);
				}
				ribbonGroup2.BumpItemsVersion();
			}
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup3 = ribbonGroup2 ?? ribbonGroup;
			if (ribbonGroup3 != null && XamRibbon.GetLocation(ribbonGroup3) != ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				XamRibbon.GetRibbon(ribbonGroup3)?.BumpRibbonGroupSizeVersion();
			}
		}

		internal static RibbonGroup GetContainingGroup(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (RibbonGroup)d.GetValue(ContainingGroupProperty);
		}

		public static bool GetIsDialogBoxLauncherTool(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsDialogBoxLauncherToolProperty);
		}

		private static void OnMinMaxSizeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonGroup containingGroup = GetContainingGroup(d);
			if (containingGroup != null && containingGroup.IsVisible)
			{
				XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d)?.BumpRibbonGroupSizeVersion();
			}
			d.CoerceValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty);
		}
