		private static void OnContextualTabGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = d as RibbonGroup;
			bool flag = e.NewValue != null;
			if (ribbonGroup.IsInContextualTabGroup != flag)
			{
				if (ribbonGroup.IsInitialized)
				{
					ribbonGroup.ApplyTemplate();
				}
				ribbonGroup.SetValue(IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(flag));
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceDialogBoxLauncherTool(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = d as RibbonGroup;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = newValue as DependencyObject;
			if (ribbonGroup != null && dependencyObject != null && GetIsDialogBoxLauncherTool(dependencyObject))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_ToolIsAlreadyDialogBoxLauncherTool"));
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnDialogBoxLauncherToolChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
			{
				ButtonTool buttonTool = (ButtonTool)e.OldValue;
				ButtonTool buttonTool2 = (ButtonTool)e.NewValue;
				if (buttonTool != null)
				{
					ribbonGroup.RemoveLogicalChild(buttonTool);
					buttonTool.SetValue(IsDialogBoxLauncherToolPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
				ribbonGroup.SetValue(HasDialogBoxLauncherToolPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(buttonTool2 != null));
				if (buttonTool2 != null)
				{
					ribbonGroup.AddLogicalChild(buttonTool2);
					buttonTool2.SetValue(IsDialogBoxLauncherToolPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeHighlightContent()
		{
			bool value = true.Equals(GetValue(IsMouseOverContentProperty)) && false.Equals(GetValue(IsMouseCaptureWithinContentProperty));
			SetValue(HighlightContentPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(value));
		}

		private static void OnIdChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RibbonGroup { Ribbon: not null } ribbonGroup)
			{
				ribbonGroup.Ribbon.OnRibbonGroupIdChanged(ribbonGroup, e.OldValue as string, e.NewValue as string);
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsCollapsedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)d;
			if (ribbonGroup != null)
			{
				ribbonGroup.VerifyRibbonGroupSite();
				ribbonGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsInContextualTabGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)d;
			if (ribbonGroup._groupButton != null)
			{
				ribbonGroup._groupButton.SetValue(IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, e.NewValue);
				ribbonGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		private static void OnHighlightContentCriteriaChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonGroup)d).InitializeHighlightContent();
			((RibbonGroup)d).UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		private static object CoerceIsOpened(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (value is bool && (bool)value && target is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
			{
				if (!ribbonGroup.IsDropDown)
				{
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
				RibbonGroup cloneFromGroup = ribbonGroup.CloneFromGroup;
				if (cloneFromGroup != null)
				{
					if (ribbonGroup._itemsVersion != cloneFromGroup._itemsVersion)
					{
						if (ribbonGroup._clonedTools != null)
						{
							ribbonGroup._clonedTools.Clear();
						}
						ribbonGroup.Items.Clear();
						ribbonGroup._clonedTools = ribbonGroup._clonedTools ?? new List<FrameworkElement>();
						IList<object> list = RibbonToolProxy.CloneItems(cloneFromGroup.Items, bindRibbonTools: true, ribbonGroup._clonedTools);
						foreach (object item in list)
						{
							ribbonGroup.Items.Add(item);
						}
						ribbonGroup._itemsVersion = cloneFromGroup._itemsVersion;
					}
					FrameworkElement rootSourceTool = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(cloneFromGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool);
					FrameworkElement rootSourceTool2 = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool);
					if (rootSourceTool != rootSourceTool2)
					{
						if (cloneFromGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool != null)
						{
							IList<object> list2 = RibbonToolProxy.CloneItems(new ButtonTool[1] { cloneFromGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool }, bindRibbonTools: true, null);
							ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool = list2[0] as ButtonTool;
						}
						else
						{
							ribbonGroup.DialogBoxLauncherTool = null;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!ribbonGroup.RaiseOpeningEvent())
				{
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnIsOpenChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(target is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup) || !(e.NewValue is bool))
			{
				return;
			}
			ribbonGroup.VerifyRibbonGroupSite();
			bool flag = (bool)e.NewValue;
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(ribbonGroup);
			if (flag && XamRibbon.GetLocation(ribbonGroup) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar && ribbonGroup._groupPresenterCollapsed != null)
			{
				if (ribbonGroup.CloneFromGroup != null)
				{
					ribbon?.ForcePendingToolRegistrations();
				}
				ribbonGroup._groupPresenterCollapsed.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				VariantManager.ResetVariantInfo(ribbonGroup, isOnQat: true, ribbonGroup);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.HasKeyTipManager)
				{
					KeyTipManager keyTipManager = ribbon.KeyTipManager;
					if (keyTipManager.IsActive && keyTipManager.ProviderPendingActivation != ribbonGroup)
					{
						keyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProvider(ribbonGroup);
					}
				}
				ribbonGroup.PopupOwnerProxy.OnOpen();
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonGroup.PopupOwnerProxy.OnClose();
			}
			RoutedEventArgs args = new RoutedEventArgs();
			if (flag)
			{
				ribbonGroup.RaiseOpened(args);
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonGroup.RaiseClosed(args);
			}
			bool flag2 = (bool)e.NewValue;
			bool oldValue = !flag2;
			ribbonGroup.RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged(oldValue, flag2);
			ribbonGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		private RibbonGroup Clone()
		{
			IList<DependencyProperty> list = null;
			list = new DependencyProperty[5]
			{
				DialogBoxLauncherToolProperty,
				IsOpenProperty,
				FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty,
				FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty,
				FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty
			};
			return (RibbonGroup)new ToolCloneManager(list, cloneItems: false, skipRoot: true, cloneAndBindTools: true, null).Clone(this);
		}

		internal RibbonGroup CloneForQat()
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = Clone();
			ribbonGroup.SetValue(CloneFromGroupPropertyKey, this);
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(IdProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(IdProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			ribbonGroup.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
			RoutedEventManager.CopyAllEventHandlers(this, ribbonGroup);
			ribbonGroup.ClearValue(IsCollapsedPropertyKey);
			ribbonGroup.SetValue(XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationQuickAccessToolbarBox);
			SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			ribbonGroup.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			return ribbonGroup;
		}

		internal double GetToolRowVerticalOffset(int rowNumber)
		{
			rowNumber = Math.Min(3, Math.Max(0, rowNumber));
			ContentControl currentContentSite = CurrentContentSite;
			if (currentContentSite != null)
			{
				if (rowNumber == 3)
				{
					return currentContentSite.ActualHeight;
				}
				if (_itemsPresenter != null)
				{
					double y = _itemsPresenter.ActualHeight / 2.0 * (double)rowNumber;
					GeneralTransform generalTransform = null;
					try
					{
						generalTransform = _itemsPresenter.TransformToAncestor(currentContentSite);
					}
					catch (ArgumentException)
					{
					}
					catch (InvalidOperationException)
					{
					}
					if (generalTransform != null)
					{
						return generalTransform.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, y)).Y;
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ActualHeight / 3.0 * (double)rowNumber;
		}

		internal void ProcessPendingRegistrationChange(XamRibbon ribbon, bool isRegistering)
		{
			if (ribbon == null || isRegistering || !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(ribbon, this, preferLogicalTree: true))
			{
				XamRibbon oldRibbon = (isRegistering ? null : ribbon);
				XamRibbon newRibbon = (isRegistering ? ribbon : null);
				OnRibbonChanged(oldRibbon, newRibbon);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			bool isMouseOver = base.IsMouseOver;
			if (!base.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (HighlightContent)
			{
				if (isMouseOver)
				{
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Highlight", "MouseOver", "Normal");
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Highlight", "Normal");
				}
			}
			else if (isMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "MouseOver", "Normal");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
			}
			if (IsActive)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Active", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Inactive", useTransitions);
			}
			if (IsInContextualTabGroup)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Contextual", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "NonContextual", useTransitions);
			}
			if (IsCollapsed)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Collapsed", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Expanded", useTransitions);
			}
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				if (IsOpen)
				{
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "FocusedDropDown", "Focused");
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Focused", useTransitions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unfocused", useTransitions);
			}
			if (Location == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "QAT", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Ribbon", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
			{
				ribbonGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private void BumpItemsVersion()
		{
			if (CloneFromGroup == null)
			{
				_itemsVersion++;
			}
		}

		internal virtual CustomPopupPlacement[] GetCustomPopupPlacement(System.Windows.Size popupSize, System.Windows.Size targetSize, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			Popup popup = GetTemplateChild("PART_Popup") as Popup;
			bool flag = ((FrameworkElement)(((object)popup) ?? ((object)this))).FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight;
			List<CustomPopupPlacement> list = new List<CustomPopupPlacement>();
			double x = (flag ? 0.0 : (0.0 - popupSize.Width));
			list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(x, targetSize.Height), PopupPrimaryAxis.Horizontal));
			list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0 - popupSize.Height), PopupPrimaryAxis.Horizontal));
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static void OnIsActiveChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RibbonGroup { _groupButton: not null } ribbonGroup)
			{
				ribbonGroup._groupButton.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey, e.NewValue);
				ribbonGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		private static void OnLocationChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
			{
				ribbonGroup.VerifyRibbonGroupSite();
				ribbonGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		private static void OnRequestBringIntoView(object sender, RequestBringIntoViewEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = sender as RibbonGroup;
			if (e.TargetObject is Visual descendant && ribbonGroup.IsDropDown && !ribbonGroup.IsOpen)
			{
				bool flag = (ribbonGroup._groupPresenterCollapsed != null && ribbonGroup._groupPresenterCollapsed.IsAncestorOf(descendant)) || (ribbonGroup._groupPresenterNormal != null && ribbonGroup._groupPresenterNormal.IsAncestorOf(descendant));
				if (!flag && !ribbonGroup.IsAncestorOf(descendant))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag && !RequestBringIntoViewCancelHelper.ShouldIgnoreBringIntoView(ribbonGroup))
				{
					ribbonGroup.BringIntoView();
					ribbonGroup.IsOpen = true;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup && XamRibbon.GetRibbon(ribbonGroup) == e.NewValue)
			{
				XamRibbon xamRibbon = e.OldValue as XamRibbon;
				XamRibbon xamRibbon2 = e.NewValue as XamRibbon;
				if (xamRibbon != null && xamRibbon.IsToolRegistrationSuspended)
				{
					xamRibbon.AddToPendingToolRegistrations(ribbonGroup, isRegistering: false);
				}
				else if (xamRibbon2 != null && xamRibbon2.IsToolRegistrationSuspended)
				{
					xamRibbon2.AddToPendingToolRegistrations(ribbonGroup, isRegistering: true);
				}
				else
				{
					ribbonGroup.OnRibbonChanged(xamRibbon, xamRibbon2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnRibbonChanged(XamRibbon oldRibbon, XamRibbon newRibbon)
		{
			XamRibbon registeredOwner = XamRibbon.GetRegisteredOwner(this);
			if (registeredOwner != null && oldRibbon != registeredOwner && registeredOwner != newRibbon)
			{
				registeredOwner.ForcePendingToolRegistrations();
			}
			if (oldRibbon != null)
			{
				oldRibbon.RemovePendingToolRegistration(this, isRegistering: false);
				oldRibbon.UnregisterGroup(this);
				if (CloneFromGroup != null)
				{
					RoutedEventManager.ClearAllEventHandlers(this);
					CloneFromGroup.ClearValue(RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatPropertyKey);
					ClearValue(RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatPropertyKey);
				}
				if (RibbonToolHelper.GetIsOnQat(this))
				{
					oldRibbon.QuickAccessToolbar.RemoveRibbonGroup(this);
				}
			}
			_ribbon = newRibbon;
			if (newRibbon != null)
			{
				newRibbon.RemovePendingToolRegistration(this, isRegistering: true);
				newRibbon.VerifyGroupIsRegistered(this);
			}
			XamRibbon.SetRegisteredOwner(this, newRibbon);
			VerifyRibbonGroupSite();
		}

		private void RaiseAutomationExpandCollapseStateChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is RibbonGroupAutomationPeer ribbonGroupAutomationPeer)
			{
				ribbonGroupAutomationPeer.RaiseExpandCollapseStateChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		internal void SynchronizeItemsHeight()
		{
			if (_itemsPresenter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				if (base.Parent != null)
				{
					_itemsPresenter.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.RibbonGroupItemsHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, ribbon));
				}
				else if (base.Tag == XamRibbon.RibbonGroupForResizingTag)
				{
					ribbon.SetBinding(XamRibbon.RibbonGroupItemsHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _itemsPresenter));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHighlightContentBindings(ContentControl target)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsMouseOverContentProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsMouseCaptureWithinContentProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				SetBinding(IsMouseOverContentProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsMouseOverProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, target));
				SetBinding(IsMouseCaptureWithinContentProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsMouseCaptureWithinProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, target));
			}
		}

		private void VerifyRibbonGroupSite()
		{
			VerifyRibbonGroupSite(forceUpdate: false);
		}

		private void VerifyRibbonGroupSite(bool forceUpdate)
		{
			if (_groupPresenterCollapsed == null || _groupPresenterNormal == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isDropDown = IsDropDown;
			if (!(!isDropDown || IsOpen || forceUpdate))
			{
				return;
			}
			ContentControl contentControl = (isDropDown ? _groupPresenterNormal : _groupPresenterCollapsed);
			ContentControl contentControl2 = (isDropDown ? _groupPresenterCollapsed : _groupPresenterNormal);
			if (contentControl.Content == null || contentControl.Content == Utilities.DisconnectedItem)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = Ribbon;
			ribbon?.SuspendToolRegistration();
			try
			{
				object content = contentControl.Content;
				using (new TempValueReplacement(content as DependencyObject, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty))
				{
					contentControl.Content = Utilities.DisconnectedItem;
					contentControl2.Content = content;
				}
				if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(RibbonGroupPanel), allowSubclassOfType: true) is RibbonGroupPanel ribbonGroupPanel)
				{
					ribbonGroupPanel.PrepareCollapsedRibbonGroup(this);
				}
				UpdateHighlightContentBindings(contentControl2);
			}
			finally
			{
				ribbon?.ResumeToolRegistration();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ClosedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnClosed(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = OpenedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnOpened(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpening(RibbonGroupOpeningEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		private void RaiseOpening(RibbonGroupOpeningEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = OpeningEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnOpening(args);
		}

		internal bool RaiseOpeningEvent()
		{
			RibbonGroupOpeningEventArgs args = new RibbonGroupOpeningEventArgs(this);
			RaiseOpening(args);
			return true;
		}

		bool IKeyTip.Activate()
		{
			if (IsDropDown)
			{
				Focus();
				IsOpen = true;
				return IsOpen;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IKeyTip.Equals(IKeyTip provider)
		{
			return this == provider;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTip.GetContainer()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
			IsOpen = false;
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && base.Focusable)
			{
				Focus();
			}
			RequestBringIntoViewCancelHelper.CancelBringIntoView(this);
		}

		IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			VerifyRibbonGroupSite(forceUpdate: true);
			foreach (IRibbonTool registeredTool in _registeredTools)
			{
				RibbonToolProxy toolProxy = registeredTool.ToolProxy;
				if (toolProxy != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(toolProxy.GetKeyTipProviders((FrameworkElement)registeredTool));
				}
			}
			if (IsCollapsed)
			{
				list.Add(this);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		bool IRibbonPopupOwner.FocusFirstItem()
		{
			return PopupOwnerProxy.FocusFirstItem(this);
		}
	}
	internal class RequestBringIntoViewCancelHelper
	{
		private static readonly DependencyProperty HelperProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Helper", typeof(DispatcherOperation), typeof(RequestBringIntoViewCancelHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		private RequestBringIntoViewCancelHelper()
		{
		}

		private static DispatcherOperation GetHelper(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (DispatcherOperation)d.GetValue(HelperProperty);
		}

		private static void SetHelper(DependencyObject d, DispatcherOperation value)
		{
			d.SetValue(HelperProperty, value);
		}

		internal static bool ShouldIgnoreBringIntoView(FrameworkElement fe)
		{
			if (fe != null)
			{
				return GetHelper(fe) != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void CancelBringIntoView(FrameworkElement fe)
		{
			GetHelper(fe)?.Abort();
			DispatcherOperation value = fe.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, new SendOrPostCallback(OnCallback), fe);
			SetHelper(fe, value);
		}

		private static void OnCallback(object param)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = param as FrameworkElement;
			frameworkElement.ClearValue(HelperProperty);
		}
	}

		public static readonly ResourceKey PagerScrollRightButtonStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(RibbonGroupCollection), "PagerScrollRightButtonStyleKey");

		internal void RaiseResetNotification()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}
	}

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class TextEditorTool : XamTextEditor, IRibbonTool
	{
		protected class TextEditorToolProxy : RibbonToolProxy<TextEditorTool>
		{

			{
				XamTextEditor.HorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty,
				XamTextEditor.TextAlignmentProperty,
				XamTextEditor.TextWrappingProperty,
				XamTextEditor.VerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty
			};

			protected override void Bind(TextEditorTool sourceTool, TextEditorTool targetTool)
			{
				base.Bind(sourceTool, targetTool);
				RibbonToolProxy.BindToolProperties(_bindProperties, sourceTool, targetTool);
				RibbonToolProxy.BindToolProperties(TextEditorBaseProperties, sourceTool, targetTool);
				RibbonToolProxy.BindToolProperties(CommonEditorProperties, sourceTool, targetTool);
			}

			protected override ToolMenuItemDisplayMode GetMenuItemDisplayMode(TextEditorTool tool)
			{
				return ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.EmbedToolInCaptionArea;
			}

			protected override void RaiseToolEvent(TextEditorTool sourceTool, RoutedEventArgs args)
			{
				sourceTool.OnRaiseToolEvent(args);
			}
		}

		static TextEditorTool()
		{
			CommonEditorProperties = new DependencyProperty[8]
			{
				ValueEditor.FormatProperty,
				ValueEditor.FormatProviderProperty,
				ValueEditor.InvalidValueBehaviorProperty,
				ValueEditor.IsReadOnlyProperty,
				ValueEditor.ValueProperty,
				ValueEditor.ValueConstraintProperty,
				ValueEditor.ValueToTextConverterProperty,
				ValueEditor.ValueTypeProperty
			};
			TextEditorBaseProperties = new DependencyProperty[2]
			{
				TextEditorBase.NullTextProperty,
				TextEditorBase.ValueToDisplayTextConverterProperty
			};
			ActivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.ActivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			ClonedEvent = MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			CloneDiscardedEvent = MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			DeactivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.DeactivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			CaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			HasCaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasCaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			HasImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			IdProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			ImageResolvedProperty = RibbonToolHelper.ImageResolvedProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			IsActiveProperty = XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			IsQatCommonToolProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsQatCommonToolProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			IsOnQatProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			LargeImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.LargeImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			SizingModeProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			SmallImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(TextEditorTool));
			EditAreaWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EditAreaWidth", typeof(double), typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(100.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, null));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool)));
			RibbonGroup.MaximumSizeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextNormalBox));
			RibbonGroup.MinimumSizeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextNormalBox));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Style()));
			ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(TextEditorTool), AccessKeyManager.AccessKeyPressedEvent, new AccessKeyPressedEventHandler(OnEditorAccessKeyPressed));
			XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey);
			XamRibbon.LocationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey);
			UIElement.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(TextEditorTool), new CommandBinding(EditingCommands.EnterParagraphBreak, null, delegate(object o, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				TextEditorTool textEditorTool = (TextEditorTool)o;
				if (!textEditorTool.AcceptsReturn)
				{
					e.CanExecute = false;
					e.Handled = true;
					e.ContinueRouting = true;
				}
			}));
		}

		internal static void OnEditorAccessKeyPressed(object sender, AccessKeyPressedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is ValueEditor d && !e.Handled && e.Scope == null && e.Target == null)
			{
				ToolLocation location = XamRibbon.GetLocation(d);
				if (location == ToolLocation.Unknown || location == ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
				{
					e.Target = (UIElement)sender;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRaiseToolEvent(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class ToolMenuItem : System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem, IRibbonToolHost, IKeyTipContainer
	{
		private class ToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider : IKeyTip
		{
			private ToolMenuItem _menuItem;

			public KeyTipAlignment Alignment => ToolKeyTipProvider.GetToolAlignment(ToolLocation.Menu, RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal);

			public string AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

			public string Caption
			{
				get
				{
					if (_menuItem.Header == null)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return _menuItem.Header.ToString();
				}
			}

			public KeyTipActivationBehavior ActivationBehavior => KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers;

			public bool IsEnabled => _menuItem.IsEnabled;

			public bool IsVisible => _menuItem.IsVisible;

			public string KeyTipValue => RibbonToolHelper.GetKeyTip(_menuItem);

			public System.Windows.Point Location => ToolKeyTipProvider.GetToolKeyTipLocation(_menuItem, ToolLocation.Menu, RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal);

			public char Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(Caption);

			public UIElement AdornedElement => _menuItem;

			public char DefaultPrefix => 'M';

			public bool CanAutoGenerateKeyTip => true;

			internal ToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider(ToolMenuItem menuItem)
			{
				_menuItem = menuItem;
			}

			public bool Activate()
			{
				switch (_menuItem.Role)
				{
				case MenuItemRole.TopLevelHeader:
				case MenuItemRole.SubmenuHeader:
					_menuItem.OpenMenu(PopupOpeningReason.KeyTips);
					return _menuItem.IsSubmenuOpen;
				case MenuItemRole.TopLevelItem:
				case MenuItemRole.SubmenuItem:
					_menuItem.OnClick();
					_menuItem.SimulateMouseLeave();
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}

			public bool Equals(IKeyTip provider)
			{
				if (provider is ToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider)
				{
					return _menuItem == ((ToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider)provider)._menuItem;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public IKeyTipContainer GetContainer()
			{
				switch (_menuItem.Role)
				{
				default:
					return null;
				case MenuItemRole.TopLevelHeader:
				case MenuItemRole.SubmenuHeader:
					return _menuItem;
				}
			}
		}

		internal class LogicalContainer : FrameworkElement
		{
			private IList<object> _children;

			protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => _children.GetEnumerator();

			internal LogicalContainer()
			{
				_children = new List<object>();
			}

			internal void AddLogicalChildInternal(object child)
			{
				if (child != null)
				{
					_children.Add(child);
					AddLogicalChild(child);
				}
			}

			internal void RemoveLogicalChildInternal(object child)
			{
				if (child != null)
				{
					_children.Remove(child);
					RemoveLogicalChild(child);
				}
			}
		}

		private class ToolTipHelper
		{
			private static object ToolTipId = new object();

			private GroupTempValueReplacement _originalValues;

			private DispatcherOperation _cancelOperation;

			private ToolTipHelper()
			{
			}

			private object CancelToolTip(object param)
			{
				OnToolTipClosed(param, EventArgs.Empty);
				return null;
			}

			private void OnToolTipOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (_cancelOperation != null)
				{
					_cancelOperation.Abort();
					_cancelOperation = null;
				}
				((System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip)sender).Opened -= OnToolTipOpened;
			}

			private void OnToolTipClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip = (System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip)sender;
				if (_cancelOperation != null)
				{
					if (_cancelOperation.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Pending)
					{
						_cancelOperation.Abort();
					}
					toolTip.Opened -= OnToolTipOpened;
					_cancelOperation = null;
				}
				toolTip.Closed -= OnToolTipClosed;
				if (toolTip.Tag == ToolTipId)
				{
					toolTip.Content = null;
				}
				if (_originalValues != null)
				{
					_originalValues.Dispose();
					_originalValues = null;
				}
			}

			internal static bool ShowToolTip(ToolMenuItem menuItem, ToolTipEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.Handled || menuItem.ToolTip == null)
				{
					return e.Handled;
				}
				if (!(menuItem.DataContext is FrameworkElement frameworkElement) || menuItem.ToolTip != frameworkElement.ToolTip)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (frameworkElement.DataContext == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ToolTipHelper toolTipHelper = new ToolTipHelper();
				toolTipHelper._originalValues = new GroupTempValueReplacement();
				System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip = frameworkElement.ToolTip as System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip;
				if (toolTip == null)
				{
					toolTip = new System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip();
					toolTip.Tag = ToolTipId;
					toolTip.DataContext = frameworkElement.DataContext;
					toolTip.Content = frameworkElement.ToolTip;
					toolTipHelper._originalValues.Add(menuItem, FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, toolTip);
				}
				else
				{
					ValueSource valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(toolTip, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
					if (valueSource.BaseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Inherited && valueSource.BaseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default)
					{
						return false;
					}
					toolTipHelper._originalValues.Add(toolTip, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, frameworkElement.DataContext);
				}
				toolTipHelper._cancelOperation = menuItem.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, new DispatcherOperationCallback(toolTipHelper.CancelToolTip), toolTip);
				toolTip.Opened += toolTipHelper.OnToolTipOpened;
				toolTip.Closed += toolTipHelper.OnToolTipClosed;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class RightHandedAlignmentConverter : IMultiValueConverter
		{
			private object _lastNonCustomValue = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;

			public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (values != null && values.Length == 3 && values[0] is PlacementMode && values[1] is double && values[2] is double)
				{
					PlacementMode placementMode = (PlacementMode)values[0];
					double num = (double)values[1];
					double num2 = (double)values[2];
					switch (placementMode)
					{
					case PlacementMode.RelativePoint:
						return _lastNonCustomValue = num;
					case PlacementMode.Bottom:
					case PlacementMode.Top:
						return _lastNonCustomValue = num - num2;
					case PlacementMode.Custom:
						return _lastNonCustomValue;
					}
				}
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}

			public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static Style ItemOnlyStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (_itemOnlyStyle == null)
				{
					_itemOnlyStyle = new Style(typeof(ToolMenuItem));
					FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ContentPresenter));
					System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
					binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneTime;
					binding.Path = new PropertyPath(HeaderedItemsControl.HeaderProperty);
					binding.RelativeSource = RelativeSource.TemplatedParent;
					frameworkElementFactory.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, binding);
					ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate(typeof(ToolMenuItem));
					controlTemplate.VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory;
					Setter setter = new Setter();
					setter.Property = System.Windows.Controls.Control.TemplateProperty;
					setter.Value = controlTemplate;
					_itemOnlyStyle.Setters.Add(setter);
					setter = new Setter();
					setter.Property = FrameworkElement.OverridesDefaultStyleProperty;
					setter.Value = KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
					_itemOnlyStyle.Setters.Add(setter);
				}
				return _itemOnlyStyle;
			}
		}

		private object MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthForItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (RibbonTool is MenuToolBase menuToolBase && Location != ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu)
				{
					return menuToolBase.GetValue(MenuToolBase.MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthProperty);
				}
				return RibbonKnownBoxes.DoubleZeroBox;
			}
		}

		internal PopupOpeningReason OpeningReason => _openingReason;

		internal PopupOpeningReason OpeningReasonResolved
		{
			get
			{
				PopupOpeningReason popupOpeningReason = _openingReason;
				if (popupOpeningReason == PopupOpeningReason.None && RibbonTool is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
				{
					popupOpeningReason = menuToolBase.OpeningReasonResolved;
				}
				return popupOpeningReason;
			}
		}

		internal ToolMenuItem ParentMenuItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (_parentMenuItem == null && GetType() == typeof(ToolMenuItem))
				{
					_parentMenuItem = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(ToolMenuItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) as ToolMenuItem;
				}
				return _parentMenuItem;
			}
		}

		internal IRibbonTool RibbonTool => Tool;

		internal bool ShouldHandleCanExecute
		{
			get
			{
				return _shouldHandleCanExecute;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _shouldHandleCanExecute)
				{
					_shouldHandleCanExecute = value;
					HookUnhookCommand(base.Command, value);
					UpdateCanExecute();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool UseLargeImagesForItems
		{
			get
			{
				IRibbonTool ribbonTool = RibbonTool;
				if (ribbonTool == null)
				{
					return (bool)GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.UseLargeImagesOnMenuProperty);
				}
				if (ribbonTool is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
				{
					return menuToolBase.UseLargeImages;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		static ToolMenuItem()
		{
			IsSegmentedPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsSegmented", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsSegmentedProperty = IsSegmentedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsSeparatorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsSeparator", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsSeparatorProperty = IsSeparatorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToolMenuItem));
			MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("MenuItemDescriptionMinWidth", typeof(double), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0));
			MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthProperty = MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			PopupVerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("PopupVerticalScrollBarVisibility", typeof(ScrollBarVisibility), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled));
			PopupVerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty = PopupVerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ResizeModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ResizeMode", typeof(PopupResizeMode), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PopupResizeMode.None));
			ToolPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Tool", typeof(IRibbonTool), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ToolProperty = ToolPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			UseLargeImagePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("UseLargeImage", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			UseLargeImageProperty = UseLargeImagePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ImageSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ImageSource", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnImageSourceChanged));
			IsCheckableInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsCheckableInternal", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, null, CoerceIsCheckableInternal));
			IsPopupConstrainedVerticallyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsPopupConstrainedVertically", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsSegmentedInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSegmentedInternal", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsSegmentedInternalChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem)));
			ItemsPanelTemplate itemsPanelTemplate = new ItemsPanelTemplate(new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(MenuToolPanel)));
			itemsPanelTemplate.Seal();
			ItemsControl.ItemsPanelProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(itemsPanelTemplate));
			System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsSubmenuOpenProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceIsSubmenuOpen));
			Selector.IsSelectedProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsSelectedChanged, CoerceIsSelected));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToolMenuItem), Mouse.PreviewMouseDownOutsideCapturedElementEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseDownOutsideCapturedElement));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new CommandBinding(MenuTool.SegmentedButtonCommand, OnExecuteCommand, OnCanExecuteCommand));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToolMenuItem), Keyboard.KeyDownEvent, new System.Windows.Input.KeyEventHandler(OnClassKeyDown));
			ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsCheckableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsCheckableChanged));
			System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsCheckedProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolMenuItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsCheckedChanged));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			ToolMenuItem parentMenuItem = ParentMenuItem;
			if (parentMenuItem != null)
			{
				if (parentMenuItem.ResizeMode == PopupResizeMode.None || RibbonTool is GalleryTool)
				{
					ClearValue(PopupResizerDecorator.ResizeConstraintsProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					PopupResizerDecorator.Constraints constraints = PopupResizerDecorator.GetResizeConstraints(this);
					if (constraints == null)
					{
						constraints = new PopupResizerDecorator.Constraints();
						PopupResizerDecorator.SetResizeConstraints(this, constraints);
					}
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = base.DesiredSize;
					constraints.MinimumWidth = desiredSize.Width;
					constraints.MinimumHeight = desiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (RibbonTool is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
			{
				menuToolBase.ClearContainerForItemInternal(this, element, item);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearContainerForItemBase(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			if (RibbonTool is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
			{
				return menuToolBase.GetContainerForItemInternal(this);
			}
			return new ToolMenuItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			if (RibbonTool is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
			{
				return menuToolBase.IsItemItsOwnContainerInternal(item);
			}
			return item is ToolMenuItem;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ToolMenuItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnGotKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotKeyboardFocus(e);
			if (e.NewFocus != this || Utilities.IsDescendantOf(this, e.OldFocus as DependencyObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			IRibbonTool ribbonTool = RibbonTool;
			if (!(ribbonTool is FrameworkElement frameworkElement) || ribbonTool.ToolProxy.GetMenuItemDisplayMode(frameworkElement) != RibbonToolProxy.ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.UseToolForEntireArea || ((Keyboard.GetKeyStates(Key.Up) & KeyStates.Down) == 0 && (Keyboard.GetKeyStates(Key.Down) & KeyStates.Down) == 0 && (Keyboard.GetKeyStates(Key.Right) & KeyStates.Down) == 0 && (Keyboard.GetKeyStates(Key.Left) & KeyStates.Down) == 0 && (Keyboard.GetKeyStates(Key.Tab) & KeyStates.Down) == 0))
			{
				return;
			}
			FocusNavigationDirection focusNavigationDirection = FocusNavigationDirection.First;
			System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = e.OldFocus as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement2 == null && e.OldFocus is DependencyObject)
			{
				frameworkElement2 = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(e.OldFocus as DependencyObject, typeof(FrameworkElement), allowSubclassOfType: true) as FrameworkElement;
			}
			if (frameworkElement2 != null)
			{
				point = TranslatePoint(point, frameworkElement2);
			}
			if (point.Y < 0.0)
			{
				focusNavigationDirection = FocusNavigationDirection.Last;
			}
			else if (ribbonTool is GalleryTool { ItemBehavior: GalleryToolItemBehavior.StateButton, SelectedItem: not null, ItemActivatedEventFiredOnceDuringDropdown: false } galleryTool && Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(GalleryToolDropDownPresenter), allowSubclassOfType: true) is GalleryToolDropDownPresenter galleryToolDropDownPresenter)
			{
				GalleryItemPresenter firstPresenterForItem = galleryToolDropDownPresenter.GetFirstPresenterForItem(galleryTool.SelectedItem);
				if (firstPresenterForItem != null)
				{
					firstPresenterForItem.Focus();
					e.Handled = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(focusNavigationDirection);
			if (frameworkElement.MoveFocus(request))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnKeyDownImpl(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolMenuItem parentMenuItem = ParentMenuItem;
			if (parentMenuItem != null)
			{
				parentMenuItem.OnChildKeyDown(this, e);
				if (e.Handled)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Return:
				if (RibbonTool is ValueEditor valueEditor)
				{
					if (valueEditor.IsInEditMode)
					{
						valueEditor.EndEditMode(acceptChanges: true, force: false);
					}
					else
					{
						valueEditor.StartEditMode();
					}
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (IsSegmented && RibbonTool is MenuTool menuTool && menuTool.CanExecuteSegmentedButton())
				{
					menuTool.OnSegmentedButtonClick();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Up:
			case Key.Right:
			case Key.Down:
				if (base.IsFocused && !base.IsTabStop)
				{
					FocusNavigationDirection value = GetDirection(e).Value;
					TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(value);
					if (MoveFocus(request))
					{
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				else if (!base.IsKeyboardFocused && base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && Keyboard.FocusedElement is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = frameworkElement.PredictFocus(GetDirection(e).Value);
					if (dependencyObject != null)
					{
						dependencyObject = GetElementToFocus(dependencyObject);
					}
					if (dependencyObject is IInputElement inputElement)
					{
						inputElement.Focus();
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			IRibbonTool ribbonTool = RibbonTool;
			if (ribbonTool != null && ribbonTool.ToolProxy.GetMenuItemDisplayMode(ribbonTool as FrameworkElement) != RibbonToolProxy.ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.Standard)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ribbonTool is System.Windows.Controls.RadioButton && ((System.Windows.Controls.RadioButton)ribbonTool).IsChecked == true)
			{
				if (!base.StaysOpenOnClick)
				{
					XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this)?.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnClick();
			}
			ribbonTool?.ToolProxy.OnMenuItemClick(ribbonTool as FrameworkElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Header is ValueEditor { IsInEditMode: not false })
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyProperty property = e.Property;
			if (property == System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsSubmenuOpenProperty && false.Equals(e.NewValue) && base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !base.IsKeyboardFocused && base.IsMouseCaptureWithin)
			{
				Focus();
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (property == HeaderedItemsControl.HeaderProperty)
			{
				if (base.Role == MenuItemRole.TopLevelHeader)
				{
					return;
				}
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = e.OldValue as FrameworkElement;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = e.NewValue as FrameworkElement;
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					UnwireHeader(frameworkElement);
				}
				if (frameworkElement2 != null)
				{
					if (frameworkElement2 is SeparatorTool || frameworkElement2 is Separator)
					{
						SetValue(IsSeparatorPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					}
					else
					{
						ClearValue(IsSeparatorPropertyKey);
					}
					if (RibbonTool is ValueEditor)
					{
						AddHandler(ValueEditor.EditModeStartedEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeStartedEventArgs>(OnEditModeStarted));
						AddHandler(ValueEditor.EditModeEndedEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeEndedEventArgs>(OnEditModeEnded));
					}
					else
					{
						frameworkElement2.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged += OnHeaderIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(IsSeparatorPropertyKey);
				}
			}
			else if (property == IsPopupConstrainedVerticallyProperty || property == ResizeModeProperty)
			{
				RefreshPopupVerticalScrollBarVisibility();
			}
			else if (property == System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.IsSubmenuOpenProperty)
			{
				ClearValue(IsPopupConstrainedVerticallyProperty);
				if (true.Equals(e.NewValue))
				{
					KeyTipManager.NotifyPopupOpened(OpeningReasonResolved, this);
					ActivateKeyTipProviderAfterDelay();
				}
				else
				{
					DeactivateKeyTipProviderIfNeeded();
				}
			}
			else if (property == MenuToolBase.MenuItemDescriptionProperty)
			{
				SetValue(MenuToolBase.HasMenuItemDescriptionPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(e.NewValue != null));
			}
			else if (_shouldHandleCanExecute)
			{
				if (property == System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandProperty)
				{
					HookUnhookCommand(e.OldValue as ICommand, hook: false);
					HookUnhookCommand(e.NewValue as ICommand, hook: true);
					UpdateCanExecute();
				}
				else if (property == System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandParameterProperty || property == System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.CommandTargetProperty)
				{
					UpdateCanExecute();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnToolTipOpening(ToolTipEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnToolTipOpening(e);
			e.Handled = ToolTipHelper.ShowToolTip(this, e);
		}

		internal void PrepareContainerForItemBase(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.DataContext = item;
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = element as ToolMenuItem;
			toolMenuItem?.SetValue(ToolPropertyKey, item as IRibbonTool);
			IRibbonTool ribbonTool = RibbonTool;
			MenuToolBase menuToolBase = ribbonTool as MenuToolBase;
			if (menuToolBase != null || ribbonTool == null)
			{
				ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem2 = element as ToolMenuItem;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item as FrameworkElement;
				if (toolMenuItem2 != null)
				{
					object value = KnownBoxes.FromValue(UseLargeImagesForItems);
					toolMenuItem2.SetValue(UseLargeImagePropertyKey, value);
					toolMenuItem2.SetValue(MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthPropertyKey, MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthForItems);
					bool flag = false;
					if (frameworkElement != null && item is IRibbonTool)
					{
						frameworkElement.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.UseLargeImagesOnMenuProperty, value);
						if (((IRibbonTool)item).ToolProxy.GetMenuItemDisplayMode(frameworkElement) == RibbonToolProxy.ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.UseToolForEntireArea)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(item is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem) && item is FrameworkElement)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						toolMenuItem?.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.UseLargeImagesOnMenuProperty, value);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						toolMenuItem2.SetValue(KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty, KeyboardNavigationMode.Continue);
						toolMenuItem2.IsTabStop = false;
					}
					if (MenuToolBase.MenuToolMenu.ShowKeyboardCuesProperty != null)
					{
						toolMenuItem2.SetValue(MenuToolBase.MenuToolMenu.ShowKeyboardCuesProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					}
					if (frameworkElement != null && toolMenuItem2 != frameworkElement)
					{
						toolMenuItem2.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, frameworkElement));
					}
				}
				if (menuToolBase != null)
				{
					menuToolBase.PrepareContainerForItemInternal(this, element, item);
				}
				else
				{
					base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
				}
				if (toolMenuItem2 != null && toolMenuItem2.Location == ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems)
				{
					toolMenuItem2.SetValue(UseLargeImagePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
					if (frameworkElement != null && item is IRibbonTool)
					{
						frameworkElement.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.UseLargeImagesOnMenuProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			}
		}

		private static void OnImageSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = (ToolMenuItem)d;
			System.Windows.Controls.Image image = toolMenuItem.Icon as System.Windows.Controls.Image;
			if (e.NewValue == null)
			{
				image = null;
			}
			else
			{
				if (image == null)
				{
					image = new AutoDisabledImage();
					Utilities.SetSnapElementToDevicePixels(image, value: true);
					if (toolMenuItem.RibbonTool != null)
					{
						image.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, toolMenuItem.RibbonTool));
					}
				}
				image.Source = (ImageSource)e.NewValue;
			}
			toolMenuItem.Icon = image;
		}

		private static object CoerceIsCheckableInternal(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = d as ToolMenuItem;
			if (toolMenuItem.IsCheckable)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnIsSegmentedInternalChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem)
			{
				toolMenuItem.SetValue(IsSegmentedPropertyKey, e.NewValue);
				if (toolMenuItem.RibbonTool is MenuTool)
				{
					MenuTool.BindCommandProperties(toolMenuItem, (MenuTool)toolMenuItem.RibbonTool);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddLogicalChildInternal(FrameworkElement child)
		{
			if (_logicalContainer == null)
			{
				_logicalContainer = new LogicalContainer();
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, RibbonTool);
				_logicalContainer.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, binding);
				AddLogicalChild(_logicalContainer);
			}
			_logicalContainer.AddLogicalChildInternal(child);
		}

		internal IKeyTip[] GetChildKeyTipProviders()
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = base.ItemContainerGenerator;
			if (itemContainerGenerator != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
				{
					ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = item as ToolMenuItem;
					if (toolMenuItem == null)
					{
						toolMenuItem = itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) as ToolMenuItem;
					}
					if (toolMenuItem != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(toolMenuItem.GetKeyTipProviders());
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static FocusNavigationDirection? GetDirection(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			return e.Key switch
			{
				Key.Down => FocusNavigationDirection.Down, 
				Key.Up => FocusNavigationDirection.Up, 
				Key.Left => FocusNavigationDirection.Left, 
				Key.Right => FocusNavigationDirection.Right, 
				Key.Tab => ((e.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != ModifierKeys.None) ? FocusNavigationDirection.Previous : FocusNavigationDirection.Next, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetElementToFocus(DependencyObject predictedTarget)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = predictedTarget;
			while (dependencyObject != null && !(dependencyObject is ToolMenuItem))
			{
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null && false.Equals(dependencyObject.GetValue(UIElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithinProperty)) && true.Equals(dependencyObject.GetValue(UIElement.FocusableProperty)))
			{
				predictedTarget = dependencyObject;
			}
			return predictedTarget;
		}

		internal IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders()
		{
			IRibbonTool ribbonTool = RibbonTool;
			if (ribbonTool != null)
			{
				RibbonToolProxy ribbonToolProxy = ribbonTool?.ToolProxy;
				if (ribbonToolProxy != null)
				{
					return ribbonToolProxy.GetKeyTipProviders((FrameworkElement)ribbonTool, this);
				}
				return new IKeyTip[0];
			}
			return new IKeyTip[1]
			{
				new ToolMenuItemKeyTipProvider(this)
			};
		}

		internal virtual void OnChildKeyDown(ToolMenuItem childMenuItem, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void OpenMenu(PopupOpeningReason reason)
		{
			try
			{
				_openingReason = reason;
				base.IsSubmenuOpen = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				_openingReason = PopupOpeningReason.None;
			}
		}

		internal virtual CustomPopupPlacement[] GetCustomPopupPlacement(System.Windows.Size popupSize, System.Windows.Size targetSize, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			Popup popup = GetTemplateChild("PART_Popup") as Popup;
			bool flag = ((FrameworkElement)(((object)popup) ?? ((object)this))).FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight;
			List<CustomPopupPlacement> list = new List<CustomPopupPlacement>();
			switch (base.Role)
			{
			default:
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(targetSize.Width, 0.0), PopupPrimaryAxis.Vertical));
					list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - popupSize.Width, 0.0), PopupPrimaryAxis.Vertical));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - (popupSize.Width + targetSize.Width), 0.0), PopupPrimaryAxis.Vertical));
					list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), PopupPrimaryAxis.Vertical));
				}
				break;
			case MenuItemRole.TopLevelItem:
			case MenuItemRole.TopLevelHeader:
			{
				double x = (flag ? 0.0 : (0.0 - popupSize.Width));
				list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(x, targetSize.Height), PopupPrimaryAxis.Horizontal));
				list.Add(new CustomPopupPlacement(new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0 - popupSize.Height), PopupPrimaryAxis.Horizontal));
				break;
			}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal void RemoveLogicalChildInternal(FrameworkElement child)
		{
			if (_logicalContainer != null)
			{
				_logicalContainer.RemoveLogicalChildInternal(child);
			}
		}

		internal void SimulateMouseLeave()
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs(InputManager.Current.PrimaryMouseDevice, Environment.TickCount));
		}

		private void ActivateKeyTipProviderAfterDelay()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.DataBind, new XamRibbon.MethodInvoker(ActivateKeyTipProviderIfNeeded));
		}

		private void ActivateKeyTipProviderIfNeeded()
		{
			if (base.IsSubmenuOpen)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.HasKeyTipManager)
				{
					IKeyTipContainer container = (RibbonTool as IKeyTipContainer) ?? this;
					ribbon.KeyTipManager.ActivateKeyTipProviderIfNotPending(container);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CaptureMouseForElementTree(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			IInputElement captured = Mouse.Captured;
			_elementTreeToCapture = element;
			if (captured is DependencyObject && Utilities.IsDescendantOf(_elementTreeToCapture, captured as DependencyObject))
			{
				captured.AddHandler(UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnElementLostMouseCapture));
			}
			else if (Mouse.Capture(element, CaptureMode.SubTree) && _elementTreeToCapture != null)
			{
				((IInputElement)_elementTreeToCapture).AddHandler(UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, (Delegate)new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnElementLostMouseCapture));
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceIsSelected(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = d as ToolMenuItem;
			if (true.Equals(newValue) && toolMenuItem.RibbonTool != null && !toolMenuItem.RibbonTool.ToolProxy.IsActivateable(toolMenuItem.RibbonTool as FrameworkElement))
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static object CoerceIsSubmenuOpen(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (target is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem && value is bool && (bool)value)
			{
				MenuToolBase menuToolBase = toolMenuItem.RibbonTool as MenuToolBase;
				if (toolMenuItem is MenuToolPresenter { IsMenuButtonAreaEnabled: false })
				{
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
				menuToolBase?.RaiseOpeningEvent();
				toolMenuItem.OnSubMenuOpening();
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void DeactivateKeyTipProviderIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!base.IsSubmenuOpen)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.HasKeyTipManager)
				{
					IKeyTipContainer container = (RibbonTool as IKeyTipContainer) ?? this;
					ribbon.KeyTipManager.DeactivateKeyTipContainer(container);
				}
			}
		}

		private void HookUnhookCommand(ICommand command, bool hook)
		{
			if (command != null)
			{
				if (_canExecuteChangedHandler == null)
				{
					_canExecuteChangedHandler = OnCanExecuteChanged;
				}
				if (hook)
				{
					command.CanExecuteChanged += _canExecuteChangedHandler;
				}
				else
				{
					command.CanExecuteChanged -= _canExecuteChangedHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsLogicalAncestor(DependencyObject ancestor, DependencyObject descendant)
		{
			while (descendant != null)
			{
				if (descendant == ancestor)
				{
					return true;
				}
				descendant = Utilities.GetParent(descendant, includeLogicalParent: true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void OnCanExecuteCommand(object target, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem && args.Command == MenuTool.SegmentedButtonCommand && toolMenuItem.RibbonTool is MenuTool menuTool)
			{
				args.CanExecute = menuTool.CanExecuteSegmentedButton();
				args.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private static void OnClassKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = sender as ToolMenuItem;
			PopupOpeningReason openingReason = toolMenuItem._openingReason;
			try
			{
				toolMenuItem._openingReason = PopupOpeningReason.Keyboard;
				toolMenuItem.OnKeyDownImpl(e);
				if (!e.Handled)
				{
					try
					{
						toolMenuItem.OnKeyDown(e);
						return;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				toolMenuItem._openingReason = openingReason;
			}
		}

		private void OnEditModeEnded(object sender, EditModeEndedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement { IsKeyboardFocusWithin: var isKeyboardFocusWithin } frameworkElement)
			{
				ReleaseMouseCaptureForElementTree();
				frameworkElement.PreviewMouseDown -= OnHeaderPreviewMouseDown;
				if (e.ChangesAccepted && isKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this)?.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnEditModeStarted(object sender, EditModeStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				CaptureMouseForElementTree(frameworkElement);
				frameworkElement.PreviewMouseDown += OnHeaderPreviewMouseDown;
			}
		}

		private void OnElementLostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IInputElement inputElement = sender as IInputElement;
			inputElement.RemoveHandler(UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnElementLostMouseCapture));
			IInputElement captured = Mouse.Captured;
			if (captured != null || !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(this, Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject))
			{
				if (captured is DependencyObject && IsLogicalAncestor(_elementTreeToCapture, captured as DependencyObject))
				{
					captured.AddHandler(UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnElementLostMouseCapture));
				}
				else
				{
					_elementTreeToCapture = null;
				}
			}
			else if (_elementTreeToCapture != null && _elementTreeToCapture != inputElement)
			{
				Mouse.Capture(_elementTreeToCapture, CaptureMode.SubTree);
				if (_elementTreeToCapture != null)
				{
					((IInputElement)_elementTreeToCapture).AddHandler(UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, (Delegate)new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnElementLostMouseCapture));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnExecuteCommand(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem && args.Command == MenuTool.SegmentedButtonCommand && toolMenuItem.RibbonTool is MenuTool menuTool)
			{
				menuTool.OnSegmentedButtonClick();
				args.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnHeaderIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = ((Mouse.Captured is DependencyObject element) ? FocusManager.GetFocusScope(element) : null);
				DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(this);
				if (dependencyObject == null || focusScope == dependencyObject)
				{
					CaptureMouseForElementTree(frameworkElement);
					frameworkElement.PreviewMouseDown += OnHeaderPreviewMouseDown;
				}
				return;
			}
			frameworkElement.PreviewMouseDown -= OnHeaderPreviewMouseDown;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
			KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler handler = OnPreventLostKeyboardFocus;
			if (dependencyObject2 != null)
			{
				Keyboard.AddPreviewLostKeyboardFocusHandler(dependencyObject2, handler);
			}
			try
			{
				ReleaseMouseCaptureForElementTree();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dependencyObject2 != null)
				{
					Keyboard.RemovePreviewLostKeyboardFocusHandler(dependencyObject2, handler);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnHeaderPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(frameworkElement, e.MouseDevice.GetPosition(frameworkElement));
			if ((hitTestResult == null || hitTestResult.VisualHit == null) && (!(e.OriginalSource is DependencyObject) || !IsLogicalAncestor(frameworkElement, e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject)))
			{
				Mouse.Captured?.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				if (frameworkElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					Focus();
				}
			}
		}

		}

			}
		}

		}

		}

		private static void OnIsSelectedChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		private void OnSubMenuOpening()
		{
			RefreshPopupVerticalScrollBarVisibility();
			if (RibbonTool is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
			{
				menuToolBase.SetReparentedToolsOwner(this);
				menuToolBase.SetValue(MenuToolBase.ToolMenuItemProperty, this);
			}
			if (!(GetTemplateChild("PART_Popup") is Popup popup))
			{
				return;
			}
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			ItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = base.ItemContainerGenerator;
			object value = KnownBoxes.FromValue(UseLargeImagesForItems);
			object menuItemDescriptionMinWidthForItems = MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthForItems;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = items.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!(itemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) is ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (this is ApplicationMenuPresenter && toolMenuItem.Location == ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems)
				{
					value = KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
				IRibbonTool ribbonTool = toolMenuItem.RibbonTool;
				if (ribbonTool is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.UseLargeImagesOnMenuProperty, value);
					toolMenuItem.Focusable = ((IRibbonTool)frameworkElement).ToolProxy.IsActivateable(frameworkElement);
					if (frameworkElement is MenuToolBase)
					{
						((MenuToolBase)frameworkElement).SetReparentedToolsOwner(toolMenuItem);
					}
				}
				else if (ribbonTool == null)
				{
					toolMenuItem.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.UseLargeImagesOnMenuProperty, value);
				}
				toolMenuItem.SetValue(UseLargeImagePropertyKey, value);
				toolMenuItem.SetValue(MenuItemDescriptionMinWidthPropertyKey, menuItemDescriptionMinWidthForItems);
			}
			try
			{
				if (!(this is ApplicationMenuPresenter) && Location != ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu)
				{
					PopupResizeMode resizeMode = PopupResizeMode.None;
					foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
					{
						if (item is GalleryTool galleryTool)
						{
							if (galleryTool.AllowResizeDropDown)
							{
								resizeMode = ((galleryTool.MaxDropDownColumns == galleryTool.MinDropDownColumns) ? PopupResizeMode.VerticalOnly : PopupResizeMode.Both);
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					ResizeMode = resizeMode;
					return;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
				popup.ClearValue(Popup.HorizontalOffsetProperty);
				if (popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallback == new CustomPopupPlacementCallback(GetCustomPopupPlacement))
				{
					popup.InvalidateProperty(Popup.PlacementProperty);
					popup.InvalidateProperty(Popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallbackProperty);
				}
				if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsMenuDropRightAligned)
				{
					if (ResizeMode != PopupResizeMode.None)
					{
						MultiBinding multiBinding = new MultiBinding();
						multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new System.Windows.Data.Binding
						{
							Path = new PropertyPath(Popup.PlacementProperty),
							RelativeSource = RelativeSource.Self
						});
						multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new System.Windows.Data.Binding
						{
							Path = new PropertyPath(FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty),
							Source = popup.Child
						});
						multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new System.Windows.Data.Binding
						{
							Path = new PropertyPath(FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty),
							Source = popup.PlacementTarget
						});
						multiBinding.Converter = new RightHandedAlignmentConverter();
						multiBinding.FallbackValue = popup.HorizontalOffset;
						popup.SetBinding(Popup.HorizontalOffsetProperty, multiBinding);
					}
					else
					{
						popup.SetCurrentValue(Popup.PlacementProperty, PlacementMode.Custom);
						popup.SetCurrentValue(Popup.CustomPopupPlacementCallbackProperty, new CustomPopupPlacementCallback(GetCustomPopupPlacement));
					}
				}
			}
			if (ParentMenuItem is ApplicationMenuPresenter applicationMenuPresenter && applicationMenuPresenter.GetTemplateChild("PART_SubMenuArea") is FrameworkElement frameworkElement2)
			{
				System.Windows.Point location = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement2, default(System.Windows.Point));
				double actualWidth = frameworkElement2.ActualWidth;
				double actualHeight = frameworkElement2.ActualHeight;
				popup.Placement = PlacementMode.Absolute;
				popup.PlacementTarget = null;
				popup.PlacementRectangle = new Rect(location, new System.Windows.Size(actualWidth, actualHeight));
				popup.Width = actualWidth;
				popup.Height = actualHeight;
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseMenuItemOnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			OnKeyDown(e);
		}

		private void RefreshPopupVerticalScrollBarVisibility()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (ResizeMode != PopupResizeMode.None && !IsPopupConstrainedVertically)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ClearValue(PopupVerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey);
			}
			else
			{
				SetValue(PopupVerticalScrollBarVisibilityPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityAutoBox);
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseMouseCaptureForElementTree()
		{
			FrameworkElement elementTreeToCapture = _elementTreeToCapture;
			_elementTreeToCapture = null;
			IInputElement captured = Mouse.Captured;
			if (captured != null)
			{
				captured.RemoveHandler(UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(OnElementLostMouseCapture));
				if (IsLogicalAncestor(elementTreeToCapture, captured as DependencyObject))
				{
					captured.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCanExecute()
		{
			if (_shouldHandleCanExecute)
			{
				_canExecute = base.Command == null || Utilities.CanExecuteCommand(this);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!_canExecute.HasValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				_canExecute = null;
			}
			CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
		}

		private void UnwireHeader(FrameworkElement header)
		{
			header.PreviewMouseDown -= OnHeaderPreviewMouseDown;
			if (header is ValueEditor)
			{
				RemoveHandler(ValueEditor.EditModeStartedEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeStartedEventArgs>(OnEditModeStarted));
				RemoveHandler(ValueEditor.EditModeEndedEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeEndedEventArgs>(OnEditModeEnded));
			}
			else
			{
				header.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged -= OnHeaderIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
			}
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
			base.IsSubmenuOpen = false;
		}

		IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
		{
			return GetChildKeyTipProviders();
		}
	}
