		private System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverrideImpl(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			List<ColumnInfo> columns = _columns;
			if (columns != null)
			{
				UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
				Rect finalRect = new Rect(finalSize);
				double num = finalSize.Height / 3.0;
				RibbonPanelVerticalToolAlignment verticalToolAlignment = VerticalToolAlignment;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = columns.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					ColumnInfo columnInfo = columns[i];
					finalRect.Width = columnInfo.Width;
					finalRect.Y = 0.0;
					if (columnInfo.IsLargeTool)
					{
						finalRect.Height = finalSize.Height;
						internalChildren[columnInfo.StartingIndex].Arrange(finalRect);
					}
					else
					{
						finalRect.Height = num;
						double num2 = 0.0;
						switch (verticalToolAlignment)
						{
						case RibbonPanelVerticalToolAlignment.Bottom:
							finalRect.Y = finalSize.Height - num * (double)columnInfo.ItemCount;
							break;
						case RibbonPanelVerticalToolAlignment.Center:
						{
							double num3 = finalSize.Height - num * (double)columnInfo.ItemCount;
							num2 = (finalRect.Y = num3 / (double)(columnInfo.ItemCount + 1));
							break;
						}
						}
						int j = columnInfo.StartingIndex;
						for (int num5 = Math.Min(internalChildren.Count - 1, columnInfo.EndingIndex); j <= num5; j++)
						{
							UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[j];
							if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
							{
								uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
								finalRect.Y += num2 + num;
							}
						}
					}
					finalRect.X += columnInfo.Width + 0.0;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = availableSize;
			availableSize2.Height /= 3.0;
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			System.Windows.Size result = default(System.Windows.Size);
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			List<ColumnInfo> list = new List<ColumnInfo>();
			ColumnInfo columnInfo = null;
			bool flag = false;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement == null || uIElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				RibbonToolSizingMode sizingMode = RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(uIElement);
				RibbonToolSizingMode maximumSize = RibbonGroup.GetMaximumSize(uIElement);
				bool flag2 = sizingMode == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge;
				bool flag3 = maximumSize == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge;
				if (uIElement is Separator)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				bool flag4 = flag3 && !flag2;
				if (columnInfo != null)
				{
					bool flag5 = flag2 || flag4 != flag || num2 == 3;
					if (!flag5 && num2 > 0 && ToolSizingModeAction.GetPreviousSizingMode(internalChildren[columnInfo.StartingIndex]) != ToolSizingModeAction.GetPreviousSizingMode(internalChildren[i]))
					{
						flag5 = true;
					}
					if (flag5)
					{
						columnInfo.EndingIndex = (flag2 ? (i - 1) : i);
						columnInfo.Width = num3;
						columnInfo.ItemCount = num2;
						columnInfo = null;
						result.Width += num3;
						num2 = 0;
						num3 = 0.0;
					}
				}
				flag = flag4;
				if (flag2)
				{
					uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
					result.Width += desiredSize.Width;
					if (result.Height < desiredSize.Height)
					{
						result.Height = desiredSize.Height;
					}
					list.Add(new ColumnInfo(i, desiredSize.Width, isLarge: true));
					continue;
				}
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize2);
				System.Windows.Size desiredSize2 = uIElement.DesiredSize;
				if (num < desiredSize2.Height)
				{
					num = desiredSize2.Height;
				}
				num2++;
				if (num3 < desiredSize2.Width)
				{
					num3 = desiredSize2.Width;
				}

				}
			}
			if (num2 > 0 && columnInfo != null)
			{

				columnInfo.Width = num3;
				columnInfo.ItemCount = num2;

		private void GetResizableLargeTools(List<FrameworkElement> tools, RibbonToolSizingMode destination)
		{
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			bool flag = destination == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly;
			int num = 0;
			for (int num2 = _columns.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				ColumnInfo columnInfo = _columns[num2];
				int num3 = num;
				num = ((columnInfo.IsLargeTool && internalChildren[columnInfo.StartingIndex] is FrameworkElement && !(internalChildren[columnInfo.StartingIndex] is SeparatorTool) && RibbonGroup.GetMinimumSize(internalChildren[columnInfo.StartingIndex]) <= destination) ? ((!(internalChildren[columnInfo.StartingIndex] is MenuTool { IsGalleryPreviewVisible: not false })) ? (num + 1) : 0) : 0);
				if (num == 3)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
					{
						tools.Add((FrameworkElement)internalChildren[_columns[num2 + i].StartingIndex]);
					}
					num = 0;
				}
				else if (flag && ((num3 > 0 && num == 0) || num2 == 0))
				{
					int num4 = ((num2 != 0) ? (num2 + 1) : 0);
					int num5 = ((num2 == 0) ? num : num3);
					for (int j = 0; j < num5; j++)
					{
						tools.Add((FrameworkElement)internalChildren[_columns[num4 + j].StartingIndex]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		IList<FrameworkElement> IRibbonToolPanel.GetResizableTools(RibbonToolSizingMode destinationSize)
		{
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			if (!base.IsMeasureValid)
			{
				Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			}
			if (internalChildren.Count == 0 || _columns == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_columns.Count > 0)
			{
				if (internalChildren.Count <= _columns[_columns.Count - 1].EndingIndex)
				{
					return null;
				}
				List<FrameworkElement> list = new List<FrameworkElement>();
				switch (destinationSize)
				{
				case RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal:
					GetResizableLargeTools(list, RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal);
					break;
				case RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly:
				{
					int count = internalChildren.Count;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count2 = _columns.Count; i < count2; i++)
					{
						ColumnInfo columnInfo = _columns[i];
						if (columnInfo.IsLargeTool)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int j = columnInfo.StartingIndex;
						for (int endingIndex = columnInfo.EndingIndex; j <= endingIndex; j++)
						{
							if (internalChildren[j] is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(frameworkElement) == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal && RibbonGroup.GetMinimumSize(frameworkElement) == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly)
							{
								list.Add(frameworkElement);
							}
						}
					}
					GetResizableLargeTools(list, RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageOnly);
					break;
				}
				}
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("RibbonGroups")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Contextual", GroupName = "ContextualStates")]

	public class RibbonTabItem : TabItemEx, IKeyTip, IKeyTipContainer

					_ribbon = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(XamRibbon), allowSubclassOfType: true) as XamRibbon;

		KeyTipAlignment IKeyTip.Alignment => KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter;

		{

				if (!IsInContextualTabGroup)
				{
					return null;

				return XamRibbon.GetString("ContextualTabGroupTabAutoGeneratePrefix");
			}
		}

		string IKeyTip.Caption
		{
			get
			{
				string text = ((base.Header != null) ? base.Header.ToString() : RibbonToolHelper.GetCaption(this));
				if (IsInContextualTabGroup)
				{
					text = ContextualTabGroup.Caption + text;
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		KeyTipActivationBehavior IKeyTip.ActivationBehavior => KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers;

		bool IKeyTip.IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = base.IsEnabled;
				if (flag)
				{
					ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = ContextualTabGroup;
					if (contextualTabGroup != null && !contextualTabGroup.IsVisible)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		bool IKeyTip.IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = ContextualTabGroup;
				if (contextualTabGroup != null && !contextualTabGroup.IsVisible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

		string IKeyTip.KeyTipValue => RibbonToolHelper.GetKeyTip(this);

		System.Windows.Point IKeyTip.Location
		{
			get
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
				Rect keyTipPlacementElementRect = XamRibbon.GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(KeyTipPlacementType.Caption, this, this);
				double y = (keyTipPlacementElementRect.IsEmpty ? rect.Bottom : keyTipPlacementElementRect.Bottom);
				return new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left + rect.Width / 2.0, y);
			}
		}

		char IKeyTip.Mnemonic
		{
			get
			{
				string text = ((base.Header != null) ? base.Header.ToString() : RibbonToolHelper.GetCaption(this));
				return Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(text);
			}

		public RibbonTabItem()
		{
			RibbonGroupCollection ribbonGroupCollection = new RibbonGroupCollection();
			ribbonGroupCollection.CollectionChanged += OnGroupsCollectionChanged;
			SetValue(RibbonGroupsPropertyKey, ribbonGroupCollection);
			SetValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty, ribbonGroupCollection);
		}

		static RibbonTabItem()
		{
			ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ContextualTabGroup", typeof(ContextualTabGroup), typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnContextualTabGroupChanged));
			ContextualTabGroupProperty = ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsFirstTabInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsFirstTabInContextualTabGroup", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsFirstTabInContextualTabGroupProperty = IsFirstTabInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsInContextualTabGroup", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsInContextualTabGroupChanged));
			IsInContextualTabGroupProperty = IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsLastTabInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsLastTabInContextualTabGroup", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			IsLastTabInContextualTabGroupProperty = IsLastTabInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(RibbonTabItem));
			RibbonGroupsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("RibbonGroups", typeof(RibbonGroupCollection), typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			RibbonGroupsProperty = RibbonGroupsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem)));
			System.Windows.Controls.Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentStretchBox));
			UIElement.VisibilityProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisibilityChanged));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Style()));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, null, CoerceFocusable));
			KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Local));
			XamRibbon.RibbonProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnRibbonChanged));
			TabItem.IsSelectedProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnIsSelectedChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(RibbonTabItem), Keyboard.LostKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnTabKeyboardFocusChanged), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(RibbonTabItem), Keyboard.GotKeyboardFocusEvent, new KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler(OnTabKeyboardFocusChanged), handledEventsToo: true);
		}

		protected override void OnHeaderChanged(object oldHeader, object newHeader)
		{
			if (oldHeader != null)
			{
				_logicalChildren.Remove(oldHeader);
			}
			if (newHeader != null)
			{
				_logicalChildren.Add(newHeader);
			}
			base.OnHeaderChanged(oldHeader, newHeader);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Down && XamRibbon.GetIsActive(this))
			{
				foreach (RibbonGroup ribbonGroup in RibbonGroups)
				{
					if (ribbonGroup.IsVisible && ((IRibbonPopupOwner)ribbonGroup).FocusFirstItem())
					{
						e.Handled = true;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnToolTipOpening(ToolTipEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsMouseOverTab)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			base.OnToolTipOpening(e);
		}

		protected override void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			base.SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			if (IsInContextualTabGroup)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Contextual", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "NonContextual", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem)
			{
				ribbonTabItem.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldSerializeProperty(DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			if (dp == TabItem.IsSelectedProperty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.ShouldSerializeProperty(dp);
		}

		private static void OnContextualTabGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = d as RibbonTabItem;
			if (ribbonTabItem != null)
			{
				ribbonTabItem.ClearValue(IsFirstTabInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey);
				ribbonTabItem.ClearValue(IsLastTabInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey);
			}
			ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup = (ContextualTabGroup)e.OldValue;
			ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup2 = (ContextualTabGroup)e.NewValue;
			contextualTabGroup?.VerifyFirstLastTabItems();
			if (contextualTabGroup2 != null)
			{
				contextualTabGroup2.VerifyFirstLastTabItems();
				ribbonTabItem.SetValue(IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				TabItemPanel.SetGroup(ribbonTabItem, contextualTabGroup2);
			}
			else
			{
				ribbonTabItem.ClearValue(IsInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey);
				ribbonTabItem.ClearValue(TabItemPanel.GroupProperty);
			}
			foreach (RibbonGroup ribbonGroup in ribbonTabItem.RibbonGroups)
			{
				if (contextualTabGroup2 != null)
				{
					ribbonGroup.SetValue(RibbonGroup.ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, contextualTabGroup2);
				}
				else
				{
					ribbonGroup.ClearValue(RibbonGroup.ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsInContextualTabGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = (RibbonTabItem)d;
			if (ribbonTabItem.IsSelected)
			{
				XamRibbon.GetRibbon(ribbonTabItem)?.RibbonTabControl.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsSelectedItemInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		internal void AddLogicalChildHelper(object newChild)
		{
			if (newChild != null)
			{
				_logicalChildren.Add(newChild);
				AddLogicalChild(newChild);
				if (newChild is RibbonGroup && IsInContextualTabGroup)
				{
					((RibbonGroup)newChild).SetValue(RibbonGroup.ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, ContextualTabGroup);
				}
				if (newChild is RibbonGroup)
				{
					((RibbonGroup)newChild).SynchronizeItemsHeight();
				}
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceFocusable(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			if (false.Equals(newValue))
			{
				RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = d as RibbonTabItem;
				if (ribbonTabItem._hasKeyboardFocus)
				{
					return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
				}
				if (ribbonTabItem._pendingRefocus)
				{
					return KnownBoxes.TrueBox;
				}
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private void OnGroupsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					AddLogicalChildHelper(newItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					RemoveLogicalChildHelper(oldItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				foreach (object oldItem2 in e.OldItems)
				{
					((DependencyObject)oldItem2).SetValue(RibbonGroup.ReplacedByGroupPropertyKey, e.NewItems[e.OldItems.IndexOf(oldItem2)]);
					RemoveLogicalChildHelper(oldItem2);
				}
				foreach (object newItem2 in e.NewItems)
				{
					AddLogicalChildHelper(newItem2);
				}
				if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.DataBind, new XamRibbon.MethodInvoker(RibbonGroups.RaiseResetNotification));
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
			{
				Dictionary<object, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, bool>();
				if (base.Header != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(base.Header, value: true);
				}
				foreach (RibbonGroup ribbonGroup in RibbonGroups)
				{
					dictionary.Add(ribbonGroup, value: false);
				}
				for (int num = _logicalChildren.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					object obj = _logicalChildren[num];
					if (obj is RibbonGroup && !dictionary.ContainsKey(obj))
					{
						_logicalChildren.RemoveAt(num);
						RemoveLogicalChild(obj);
						((RibbonGroup)obj).ClearValue(RibbonGroup.ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey);
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary[obj] = true;
					}
				}
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<object, bool> item in dictionary)
					{
						if (!item.Value)
						{
							AddLogicalChildHelper(item.Key);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsSelectedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!true.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d);
			if (ribbon == null || !ribbon.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamTabControl ribbonTabControl = ribbon.RibbonTabControl;
			if (ribbonTabControl.SelectedItem != d)
			{
				int num = ribbonTabControl.Items.IndexOf(d);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					ribbonTabControl.SelectedIndex = num;
				}
				else
				{
					DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(d, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem)
			{
				XamRibbon xamRibbon = e.NewValue as XamRibbon;
				if (xamRibbon == null)
				{
					ribbonTabItem.ClearValue(UIElement.FocusableProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					ribbonTabItem.SetBinding(UIElement.FocusableProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamRibbon.IsModeSpecialProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, xamRibbon));
				}
				ribbonTabItem._ribbon = xamRibbon;
			}
		}

		private static void OnTabKeyboardFocusChanged(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = sender as RibbonTabItem;
			if (e.RoutedEvent == Keyboard.GotKeyboardFocusEvent)
			{
				if (ribbonTabItem._pendingRefocus)
				{
					ribbonTabItem._pendingRefocus = false;
					if (ribbonTabItem._ribbon != null && false.Equals(ribbonTabItem._ribbon.GetValue(XamRibbon.IsModeSpecialProperty)))
					{
						ribbonTabItem._ribbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (e.RoutedEvent == Keyboard.LostKeyboardFocusEvent)
			{
				Window window = Window.GetWindow(ribbonTabItem);
				if (window != null && window.IsActive)
				{
					ribbonTabItem._pendingRefocus = false;
				}
				else if (e.NewFocus == null || Window.GetWindow(ribbonTabItem) != Window.GetWindow(e.NewFocus as DependencyObject))
				{
					ribbonTabItem._pendingRefocus = true;
				}
			}
			ribbonTabItem._hasKeyboardFocus = ribbonTabItem.IsKeyboardFocused;
			ribbonTabItem.CoerceValue(UIElement.FocusableProperty);
		}

		private static void OnVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ContextualTabGroup)d.GetValue(ContextualTabGroupProperty))?.OnTabVisibilityChanged();
			XamRibbon.GetRibbon(d)?.VerifySelectedTab();
		}

		internal void RemoveLogicalChildHelper(object oldChild)
		{
			if (oldChild != null)
			{
				_logicalChildren.Remove(oldChild);
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldChild);
				((RibbonGroup)oldChild).ClearValue(RibbonGroup.ContextualTabGroupPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		bool IKeyTip.Activate()
		{
			BringIntoView();
			Focus();
			DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			UpdateLayout();
			return base.IsSelected;
		}

		bool IKeyTip.Equals(IKeyTip provider)
		{
			return this == provider;
		}

		IKeyTipContainer IKeyTip.GetContainer()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
			XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon != null && ribbon.RibbonTabControl.IsMinimized)
			{
				ribbon.RibbonTabControl.IsDropDownOpen = false;
			}
			else if (ribbon != null && ribbon.RibbonTabControl.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && base.Focusable)
			{
				Focus();
			}
		}

		IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			foreach (RibbonGroup ribbonGroup in RibbonGroups)
			{
				list.AddRange(((IKeyTipContainer)ribbonGroup).GetKeyTips());
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class RibbonToolCollection : ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>
	{
		internal bool ContainsId(string toolId)
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				string text = base.Items[i].GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty) as string;
				if (text == toolId)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Menu", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Ribbon", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "QAT", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenu", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenuFooterToolbar", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenuRecentItems", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "AppMenuSubMenu", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "TabItemAreaToolbar", GroupName = "LocationStates")]
	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class SeparatorTool : Separator, IRibbonTool
	{
		protected class SeparatorToolProxy : RibbonToolProxy<SeparatorTool>
		{
			internal static readonly SeparatorToolProxy Instance = new SeparatorToolProxy();

			public override bool CanAddToQat => false;

			protected override void RaiseToolEvent(SeparatorTool sourceTool, RoutedEventArgs args)
			{
				sourceTool.OnRaiseToolEvent(args);
			}

			protected override ToolMenuItemDisplayMode GetMenuItemDisplayMode(SeparatorTool tool)
			{
				return ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.EmbedToolInCaptionArea;
			}

			protected override bool IsActivatable(SeparatorTool tool)
			{
				return false;
			}

			internal override IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(SeparatorTool tool, ToolMenuItem menuItem)
			{
				return new IKeyTip[0];
			}
		}

		private bool _hasVisualStateGroups;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LocationProperty;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent ClonedEvent;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent CloneDiscardedEvent;

		[Bindable(true)]
		public ToolLocation Location => (ToolLocation)GetValue(LocationProperty);

		RibbonToolProxy IRibbonTool.ToolProxy => SeparatorToolProxy.Instance;

		public event EventHandler<ToolClonedEventArgs> Cloned
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<ToolCloneDiscardedEventArgs> CloneDiscarded
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent, value);
			}
		}

		static SeparatorTool()
		{
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(SeparatorTool));
			ClonedEvent = MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(SeparatorTool));
			CloneDiscardedEvent = MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(SeparatorTool));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SeparatorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(SeparatorTool)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SeparatorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			XamRibbon.LocationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SeparatorTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected virtual void OnRaiseToolEvent(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			RibbonToolHelper.SetToolVisualState(this, useTransitions, null);
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is SeparatorTool separatorTool)
			{
				separatorTool.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}
	}

				ButtonTool.BindCommandProperties(toolMenuItem, tool);

				sourceTool.OnRaiseToolEvent(args);

		{
			CaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			HasCaptionProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasCaptionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			HasImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.HasImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			IdProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			ImageResolvedProperty = RibbonToolHelper.ImageResolvedProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			IsActiveProperty = XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			IsQatCommonToolProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsQatCommonToolProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			IsOnQatProperty = RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			KeyTipProperty = RibbonToolHelper.KeyTipProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			LargeImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.LargeImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			LocationProperty = XamRibbon.LocationProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			SizingModeProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			SmallImageProperty = RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			ActivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.ActivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			ClonedEvent = MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			CloneDiscardedEvent = MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			DeactivatedEvent = MenuToolBase.DeactivatedEvent.AddOwner(typeof(ToggleButtonTool));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool)));
			RibbonGroup.MaximumSizeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonKnownBoxes.RibbonToolSizingModeImageAndTextNormalBox));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Style()));
			ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox));
			ContentControl.ContentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ButtonTool.OnContentChanged));
			XamRibbon.IsActiveProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.IsActivePropertyKey);
			XamRibbon.LocationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged), XamRibbon.LocationPropertyKey);
			UIElement.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ToggleButtonTool), UIElement.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new System.Windows.Input.MouseEventHandler(ButtonTool.OnButtonLostMouseCapture), handledEventsToo: true);

			{
				XamRibbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon(this);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		{
			base.OnClick();
			ButtonTool.OnButtonClick(this);

			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string caption = Caption;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption))
			{
				return caption;
			}
			if (base.Content is string)
			{
				caption = base.Content as string;
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		{
			RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		{
			RibbonToolHelper.SetToolVisualState(this, useTransitions, IsActive);
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ToggleButtonTool toggleButtonTool)
			{
				toggleButtonTool.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

	public abstract class ToolbarBase : ItemsControl
	{
		private List<IRibbonTool> _registeredTools;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ContainingToolbarPropertyKey;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty ContainingToolbarProperty;

		internal List<IRibbonTool> RegisteredTools => _registeredTools;

		internal ToolbarBase()
		{
			_registeredTools = new List<IRibbonTool>();
		}

		static ToolbarBase()
		{
			ContainingToolbarPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("ContainingToolbar", typeof(ToolbarBase), typeof(ToolbarBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnContainingToolbarChanged));
			ContainingToolbarProperty = ContainingToolbarPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolbarBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ToolbarBase)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ToolbarBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
		}

		private static void OnContainingToolbarChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ToolbarBase toolbarBase = (ToolbarBase)e.OldValue;
			ToolbarBase toolbarBase2 = (ToolbarBase)e.NewValue;
			if (toolbarBase != null && d is IRibbonTool)
			{
				toolbarBase._registeredTools.Remove((IRibbonTool)d);
			}
			if (toolbarBase2 != null && d is IRibbonTool)
			{
				toolbarBase2._registeredTools.Add((IRibbonTool)d);
			}
		}

		internal static ToolbarBase GetContainingToolbar(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (ToolbarBase)d.GetValue(ContainingToolbarProperty);
		}

		internal virtual bool ContainsId(string toolId)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					string text = frameworkElement.GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty) as string;
					if (text == toolId)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool ContainsToolInstance(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			ItemCollection items = base.Items;
			int count = items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] == tool)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class ToolInstanceManager
	{
		private class IdInfo
		{
			private string _id = string.Empty;

			private List<FrameworkElement> _toolInstances = new List<FrameworkElement>(5);

			internal List<FrameworkElement> ToolInstances => _toolInstances;

			internal IdInfo(string id)
			{
				if (id == null || id == string.Empty)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("id");
				}
				_id = id;
			}

			internal bool AddTool(FrameworkElement tool)
			{
				if (tool == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("tool");
				}
				string id = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool);
				if (_id != id)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Wrong ID!");
				}
				if (_toolInstances.Count > 0 && tool.GetType() != _toolInstances[0].GetType())
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_MismatchedToolTypeForId"));
				}
				if (!ContainsTool(tool))
				{
					int count = _toolInstances.Count;
					if (count > 0)
					{
						RibbonToolProxy.BindTool(_toolInstances[count - 1], tool);
					}
					_toolInstances.Add(tool);
					tool.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsRegisteredProperty, true);
					return true;
				}
				tool.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsRegisteredProperty, true);
				return false;
			}

			internal bool ContainsTool(FrameworkElement tool)
			{
				return _toolInstances.Contains(tool);
			}

			internal bool RemoveTool(FrameworkElement tool)
			{
				if (tool == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("tool");
				}
				int num = _toolInstances.IndexOf(tool);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				_toolInstances.RemoveAt(num);
				tool.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsRegisteredProperty, false);
				if (_toolInstances.Count == 1 && XamRibbon.GetLocation(_toolInstances[0]) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_toolInstances[0])?.QuickAccessToolbar.RemoveTool(_toolInstances[0]);
				}
				if (_toolInstances.Count > 0)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = XamRibbon.GetClonedFromTool(tool);
					if (frameworkElement == null && _toolInstances.Count > 1)
					{
						int i = 0;
						for (int count = _toolInstances.Count; i < count; i++)
						{
							FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = _toolInstances[i];
							if (XamRibbon.GetClonedFromTool(frameworkElement2) == tool)
							{
								frameworkElement = frameworkElement2;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (frameworkElement != null)
						{
							XamRibbon.SetClonedFromTool(frameworkElement, null);
						}
						int j = 0;
						for (int count2 = _toolInstances.Count; j < count2; j++)
						{
							FrameworkElement frameworkElement3 = _toolInstances[j];
							if (XamRibbon.GetClonedFromTool(frameworkElement3) == tool)
							{
								RibbonToolProxy.BindTool(frameworkElement3, frameworkElement);
								XamRibbon.SetClonedFromTool(frameworkElement3, frameworkElement);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<string, IdInfo> _idInfos = new Dictionary<string, IdInfo>(50);

		private XamRibbon _ribbon;

		private static Random _randomizer = new Random();

		private ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement> _allToolInstances = new ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>();

		internal ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement> AllToolInstances => _allToolInstances;

		internal ToolInstanceManager(XamRibbon xamRibbon)
		{
			_ribbon = xamRibbon;
		}

		internal bool ChangeToolInstanceRegistrationId(FrameworkElement tool, string oldId)
		{
			string id = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool);
			if (id == oldId)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!CanRegisterTool(tool, id))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_ToolRegisteredWithSameId", id));
			}
			if (_idInfos.ContainsKey(oldId))
			{
				_idInfos[oldId].RemoveTool(tool);
			}
			return RegisterToolInstance(tool);
		}

		internal IEnumerator GetAllInstancesWithId(string toolId)
		{
			if (_idInfos.ContainsKey(toolId))
			{
				return _idInfos[toolId].ToolInstances.GetEnumerator();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static string GetNewId()
		{
			return "(ID)" + DateTime.Now.Ticks + _randomizer.Next();
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetToolInstanceFromToolId(string toolId)
		{
			if (_idInfos.ContainsKey(toolId) && _idInfos[toolId].ToolInstances.Count > 0)
			{
				return _idInfos[toolId].ToolInstances[0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool IsRegistered(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			string id = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool);
			return IsRegistered(tool, id);
		}

		internal bool IsRegistered(FrameworkElement tool, string toolId)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolId))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_idInfos.ContainsKey(toolId))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _idInfos[toolId].ContainsTool(tool);
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		internal void OutputInstanceTree()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IdInfo> idInfo in _idInfos)
			{
				if (idInfo.Value.ToolInstances.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (FrameworkElement toolInstance in idInfo.Value.ToolInstances)
				{
					ToolLocation location = XamRibbon.GetLocation(toolInstance);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool RegisterToolInstance(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tool");
			}
			string text = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool);
			if (text == null || text == string.Empty)
			{
				text = GetNewId();
				tool.SetCurrentValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty, text);
			}
			if (_idInfos.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				if (!CanRegisterTool(tool, text))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_ToolRegisteredWithSameId", text));
				}
				IdInfo idInfo = _idInfos[text];
				if (idInfo.AddTool(tool))
				{
					if (idInfo.ToolInstances.Count > 0 && RibbonToolHelper.GetIsOnQat(idInfo.ToolInstances[0]))
					{
						tool.SetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					}
					_allToolInstances.Add(tool);
				}
				return true;
			}
			IdInfo idInfo2 = new IdInfo(text);
			if (idInfo2.AddTool(tool))
			{
				_allToolInstances.Add(tool);
			}
			_idInfos.Add(text, idInfo2);
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetPropertyValueOnAllRelatedToolInstances(string toolId, DependencyProperty dp, object value)
		{
			if (toolId != null && !(toolId == string.Empty) && dp != null)
			{
				SetPropertyValueOnAllRelatedToolInstances(toolId, dp, null, value);
			}
		}

		internal void SetPropertyValueOnAllRelatedToolInstances(string toolId, DependencyPropertyKey dpKey, object value)
		{
			if (toolId != null && !(toolId == string.Empty) && dpKey != null)
			{
				SetPropertyValueOnAllRelatedToolInstances(toolId, null, dpKey, value);
			}
		}

		private void SetPropertyValueOnAllRelatedToolInstances(string toolId, DependencyProperty dp, DependencyPropertyKey dpKey, object value)
		{
			if (!_idInfos.ContainsKey(toolId))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<FrameworkElement> toolInstances = _idInfos[toolId].ToolInstances;
			int count = toolInstances.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = toolInstances[i];
				if (dependencyObject != null)
				{
					if (dp != null)
					{
						dependencyObject.SetValue(dp, value);
					}
					else if (dpKey != null)
					{
						dependencyObject.SetValue(dpKey, value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool UnRegisterToolInstance(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tool");
			}
			string id = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool);
			if (id == null || id == string.Empty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_idInfos.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = _idInfos[id].RemoveTool(tool);
			if (flag)
			{
				FrameworkElement clonedFromTool = XamRibbon.GetClonedFromTool(tool);
				if (clonedFromTool != null)
				{
					RibbonToolProxy.ReleaseToolClone(tool);
				}
				int num = _allToolInstances.IndexOf(tool);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_allToolInstances.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool CanRegisterTool(FrameworkElement tool, string toolId)
		{
			if (!_idInfos.TryGetValue(toolId, out var value))
			{
				return true;
			}
			List<FrameworkElement> toolInstances = value.ToolInstances;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = toolInstances.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				switch (XamRibbon.GetLocation(toolInstances[i]))
				{
				case ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case ToolLocation.Ribbon:
					if (toolInstances[i].Parent is RibbonGroup d && XamRibbon.GetLocation(d) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						num++;
					}
					break;
				default:
					num++;
					break;
				}
			}
			switch (XamRibbon.GetLocation(tool))
			{
			case ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar:
				return !flag;
			case ToolLocation.Ribbon:
			{
				RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = (RibbonGroup)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(tool, typeof(RibbonGroup), allowSubclassOfType: true);
				if (ribbonGroup != null && XamRibbon.GetLocation(ribbonGroup) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					return !flag2;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return num == 0;
		}
	}

		internal delegate void MethodInvoker();

		private class TabControlPopupManager : IRibbonPopupOwner
		{
			private XamRibbon _ribbon;

			private PopupOwnerProxy _popupProxy;

			XamRibbon IRibbonPopupOwner.Ribbon => _ribbon;

			bool IRibbonPopupOwner.CanOpen => _ribbon.RibbonTabControl.IsMinimized;

			bool IRibbonPopupOwner.IsOpen
			{
				get
				{
					return _ribbon.RibbonTabControl.IsDropDownOpen;
				}
				set
				{
					_ribbon.RibbonTabControl.IsDropDownOpen = value;
				}
			}

			UIElement IRibbonPopupOwner.PopupTemplatedParent => _ribbon.RibbonTabControl;

			bool IRibbonPopupOwner.HookKeyDown => true;

			FrameworkElement IRibbonPopupOwner.ParentElementToFocus => _ribbon.SelectedTab;

			internal TabControlPopupManager(XamRibbon ribbon)
			{
				_ribbon = ribbon;
				_popupProxy = new PopupOwnerProxy(this);
				_ribbon.RibbonTabControl.DropDownOpened += OnRibbonTabControlDropDownOpened;
				_ribbon.RibbonTabControl.DropDownClosed += OnRibbonTabControlDropDownClosed;
				_popupProxy.Initialize(_ribbon.RibbonTabControl);
			}

			bool IRibbonPopupOwner.FocusFirstItem()
			{
				RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = _ribbon.ActiveItem as RibbonTabItem;
				if (ribbonTabItem == null)
				{
					ribbonTabItem = _ribbon.RibbonTabControl.SelectedItem as RibbonTabItem;
				}
				if (ribbonTabItem != null)
				{
					foreach (RibbonGroup ribbonGroup in ribbonTabItem.RibbonGroups)
					{
						if (ribbonGroup.IsCollapsed)
						{
							if (ribbonGroup.Focusable)
							{
								return ribbonGroup.Focus();
							}
						}
						else if (PopupOwnerProxy.FocusFirstItem(ribbonGroup))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			private void OnRibbonTabControlDropDownClosed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				_popupProxy.OnClose();
				_ribbon.RibbonTabControl.Focusable = false;
			}

			private void OnRibbonTabControlDropDownOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				_ribbon.RibbonTabControl.Focusable = true;
				_popupProxy.OnOpen();
			}
		}

		internal XamTabControl RibbonTabControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ribbonTabControl == null)
				{
					_ribbonTabControl = new XamTabControl();
					_ribbonTabControl.ItemsSource = TabsInView;
					_ribbonTabControl.SetResourceReference(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, RibbonTabControlStyleKey);
					_ribbonTabControl.TabDirectionalNavigation = KeyboardNavigationMode.Continue;
					_ribbonTabControl.TabStripPlacement = Dock.Top;
					_ribbonTabControl.TabLayoutStyle = TabLayoutStyle.SingleRowSizeToFit;
					_ribbonTabControl.Focusable = false;
					SetBinding(SelectedTabProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Selector.SelectedItemProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, _ribbonTabControl));
					_ribbonTabControl.SetBinding(XamTabControl.TabItemContentHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, RibbonGroupContainerForSizing));
					_ribbonTabControl.SetBinding(XamTabControl.AllowMinimizeProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(AllowMinimizeProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
					_ribbonTabControl.SetBinding(XamTabControl.IsMinimizedProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(IsMinimizedProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
					_ribbonTabControl.SetBinding(XamTabControl.DropDownPlacementProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(TabAreaDropDownPlacementProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, this));
					_ribbonTabControl.SetBinding(XamTabControl.PostTabItemContentProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(TabItemAreaToolbarProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
					SetBinding(TabHeaderHeightProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding
					{
						Path = new PropertyPath(XamTabControl.TabHeaderHeightProperty),
						Source = _ribbonTabControl
					});
					_tabControlPopupManager = new TabControlPopupManager(this);
					if (_ribbonTabControlSite != null)
					{
						_ribbonTabControlSite.Content = _ribbonTabControl;
					}
					_ribbonTabControl.SetValue(AutomationProperties.AutomationIdProperty, "XamRibbonTabs");
					_ribbonTabControl.DropDownClosed += OnTabControlDropDownClosed;
					_ribbonTabControl.DropDownOpened += OnTabControlDropDownOpened;
					_ribbonTabControl.DropDownOpening += OnTabControlDropDownOpening;
					_ribbonTabControl.SelectionChanged += OnTabControlSelectionChanged;
				}
				return _ribbonTabControl;
			}
		}

		internal IRibbonWindow RibbonWindow => (IRibbonWindow)GetValue(RibbonWindowProperty);

		internal bool ShouldCaptureMouseForRibbonMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsApplicationMenu2010Open)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!IsWithinRibbonWindow)
				{
					if (_ribbonMode != RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive)
					{
						return _ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal ToolInstanceManager ToolInstanceManager => _toolInstanceManager;

		internal FrameworkElement TopLevelVisual => _topLevelVisual;

		private UIElement RibbonGroupContainerForSizing
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ribbonGroupContainerForSizing == null)
				{
					RibbonGroupCollection content = CreateRibbonGroupsForSizing(out _ribbonGroupForSizing);
					ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
					contentPresenter.Name = "RibbonGroupForResizing";
					contentPresenter.Content = content;
					contentPresenter.SetResourceReference(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, new DataTemplateKey(typeof(RibbonGroupCollection)));
					_ribbonGroupContainerForSizing = contentPresenter;
					AddLogicalChildHelper(_ribbonGroupContainerForSizing);
				}
				return _ribbonGroupContainerForSizing;
			}
		}

		private RibbonGroup RibbonGroupForSizing => _ribbonGroupForSizing;

		public XamRibbon()
		{
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamRibbon), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			_tabsInViewInternal = new ObservableCollectionExtended<RibbonTabItem>();
			_toolInstanceManager = new ToolInstanceManager(this);
			SetValue(RibbonProperty, this);
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				SetBinding(UIElement.FocusableProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(IsModeSpecialProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, this));
			}
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			SetResourceReference(IsOffice2013ThemeInternalProperty, RibbonWindowContentHost.IsOffice2013ThemeKey);
			SetResourceReference(IsScenicThemeInternalProperty, RibbonWindowContentHost.IsScenicThemeKey);
			SetResourceReference(UseScenicApplicationMenuInternalProperty, RibbonWindowContentHost.UsesScenicApplicationMenuKey);
			SetResourceReference(SystemMenuFontProperty, System.Windows.SystemFonts.MenuFontFamilyKey);
			InitializePreferredFont();
			HwndHostTracker.SetHwndHost(this, null);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), base.RenderSize);
			if (rect.Contains(hitTestParameters.HitPoint))
			{
				return new PointHitTestResult(this, hitTestParameters.HitPoint);
			}
			return base.HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			RibbonGroupContainerForSizing.Measure(constraint);
			RibbonGroupContainerForSizing.Arrange(new Rect(RibbonGroupContainerForSizing.DesiredSize));
			bool flag = false;
			if (AutoHideEnabled && _topLevelVisual != null && GetWindowState(_topLevelVisual) == WindowState.Normal)
			{
				double autoHideHorizontalThreshold = AutoHideHorizontalThreshold;
				flag = autoHideHorizontalThreshold > 0.0 && _topLevelVisual.Width < autoHideHorizontalThreshold;
				if (!flag)
				{
					double autoHideVerticalThreshold = AutoHideVerticalThreshold;
					if (autoHideVerticalThreshold > 0.0 && _topLevelVisual.Height < autoHideVerticalThreshold)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (IsRenderingMinimizedWindow)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SetValue(AutoHideStatePropertyKey, RibbonAutoHideState.Hidden);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(AutoHideStatePropertyKey);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override void OnAccessKey(AccessKeyEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (_ribbonMode)
			{
			case RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending:
				ProcessPendingKeyTip(e.Key);
				break;
			case RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive:
				KeyTipManager.ProcessKey(e.Key[0], beepOnFail: false);
				break;
			default:
				base.OnAccessKey(e);
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SuspendToolRegistration();
			try
			{
				VerifyParts();
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeToolRegistration();
			}
			WireTopLevelVisual();
			VerifyApplicationMenuSite();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamRibbonAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.System:
			{
				Key systemKey = e.SystemKey;
				if (systemKey == Key.LeftAlt || systemKey == Key.RightAlt)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case Key.Return:
			case Key.Space:
			case Key.F4:
			{
				if (Mode != RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation)
				{
					break;
				}
				FrameworkElement activeItem = ActiveItem;
				if (activeItem is RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem)
				{
					if (AllowMinimize)
					{
						DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(ribbonTabItem, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
						if (RibbonTabControl.IsDropDownOpen)
						{
							((IRibbonPopupOwner)_tabControlPopupManager).FocusFirstItem();
						}
						else
						{
							ribbonTabItem.Focus();
						}
						e.Handled = true;
					}
					else
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
						e.Handled = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (activeItem is MenuToolBase menuToolBase)
				{
					if (menuToolBase.IsOpen)
					{
						menuToolBase.IsOpen = false;
					}
					else
					{
						menuToolBase.OpenMenu(PopupOpeningReason.Keyboard);
					}
					e.Handled = true;
					break;
				}
				if (e.Key == Key.Space)
				{
					if (activeItem is IRibbonTool)
					{
						RibbonToolProxy toolProxy = ((IRibbonTool)activeItem).ToolProxy;
						if (toolProxy != null)
						{
							toolProxy.PerformAction(activeItem);
							if (!toolProxy.RetainFocusOnPerformAction)
							{
								SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
					}
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				if (activeItem is ApplicationMenu2010FileTab)
				{
					ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu = ApplicationMenu2010;
					if (applicationMenu != null)
					{
						applicationMenu.Show();
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case Key.Escape:
			{
				RibbonMode ribbonMode = _ribbonMode;
				if (ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending || ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation)
				{
					SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case Key.Up:
			case Key.Down:
				if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation)
				{
					FocusNavigationDirection direction = ((e.Key == Key.Up) ? FocusNavigationDirection.Up : FocusNavigationDirection.Down);
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = ((Keyboard.FocusedElement is UIElement uIElement) ? uIElement.PredictFocus(direction) : null);
					if (dependencyObject == null || this != GetRibbon(dependencyObject))
					{
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				break;
			case Key.Tab:
				if (Mode == RibbonMode.Normal && (!IsApplicationMenu2010Open || !ApplicationMenu2010.IsKeyboardFocusWithin))
				{
					if ((Keyboard.Modifiers & (ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Windows)) == 0)
					{
						ProcessTabKeyWithinActiveTool((Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) == 0);
					}
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyUp(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			Key key = e.Key;
			if (key == Key.System)
			{
				key = e.SystemKey;
				if (key == Key.LeftAlt || key == Key.RightAlt)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGotKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotKeyboardFocus(e);
			if (e.OldFocus is DependencyObject)
			{
				DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(e.OldFocus as DependencyObject);
				while (focusScope is MenuToolBase.MenuToolMenu)
				{
					focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(((MenuToolBase.MenuToolMenu)focusScope).Parent);
				}
				if (focusScope != this && _ribbonMode != RibbonMode.Normal)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					if (IsApplicationMenu2010Open && Utilities.IsDescendantOf(ApplicationMenu2010, e.NewFocus as DependencyObject, preferLogicalTree: true))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag && !FocusManager.GetIsFocusScope(this) && _ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation && ActiveItem != null)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						SetActiveItem(GetNewActiveItem(SelectedTab));
					}
				}
			}
			_ = e.NewFocus is DependencyObject;
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			UpdateTabsInView();
			if (ApplicationMenu == null)
			{
				SetValue(ApplicationMenuProperty, new ApplicationMenu());
			}
			if (QuickAccessToolbar == null)
			{
				SetValue(QuickAccessToolbarProperty, new QuickAccessToolbar());
			}
			SetResourceReference(IsSystemHighContrastProperty, SystemParameters.HighContrastKey);
			SetResourceReference(ControlColorProperty, System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlColorKey);
			SetResourceReference(ControlTextColorProperty, System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlTextColorKey);
			SetResourceReference(IsMenuDropRightAlignedProperty, SystemParameters.IsMenuDropRightAlignedKey);
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			if (!false.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Keyboard.FocusedElement is System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu { PlacementTarget: not null } contextMenu && GetRibbon(contextMenu.PlacementTarget) == this)
			{
				if (Mode != RibbonMode.Normal)
				{
					SetMode(RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation);
				}
				return;
			}
			SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
			if (FocusManager.GetIsFocusScope(this))
			{
				IInputElement focusedElement = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(this);
				if (focusedElement != null && !(focusedElement is RibbonTabItem))
				{
					FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(this, null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)

			base.OnMouseWheel(e);
			ProcessMouseWheel(e);
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)

			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);

			}
		}

		internal void SetActiveItem(FrameworkElement newActiveItem)
		{
			FrameworkElement activeItem = _activeItem;
			if (newActiveItem == activeItem)
			{
				return;
			}
			IRibbonTool ribbonTool = newActiveItem as IRibbonTool;
			_activeItem = newActiveItem;
			SetValue(ActiveItemPropertyKey, newActiveItem);
			RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<FrameworkElement> e = new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<FrameworkElement>(activeItem, newActiveItem);
			e.RoutedEvent = ActiveItemChangedEvent;
			e.Source = newActiveItem;
			RaiseActiveItemChanged(e);
			if (activeItem != null)
			{
				SetIsActive(activeItem, value: false);
				ItemDeactivatedEventArgs e2 = new ItemDeactivatedEventArgs(activeItem);
				e2.RoutedEvent = MenuToolBase.DeactivatedEvent;
				e2.Source = activeItem;
				if (activeItem is IRibbonTool tool)
				{
					RibbonToolProxy.RaiseToolEvent(tool, e2);
				}
				else
				{
					activeItem.RaiseEvent(e2);
				}
			}
			if (newActiveItem != null)
			{
				SetIsActive(newActiveItem, value: true);
				ItemActivatedEventArgs e3 = new ItemActivatedEventArgs(newActiveItem);
				e3.RoutedEvent = MenuToolBase.ActivatedEvent;
				e3.Source = newActiveItem;
				if (ribbonTool != null)
				{
					RibbonToolProxy.RaiseToolEvent(ribbonTool, e3);
				}
				else
				{
					newActiveItem.RaiseEvent(e3);
				}
				RibbonMode ribbonMode = _ribbonMode;
				if ((ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive || ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation) && !newActiveItem.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					newActiveItem.Focus();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsHighContrastModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = (XamRibbon)d;
			ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = (true.Equals(e.NewValue) ? RibbonHighContrast.Instance : new ResourceDictionary());
			bool flag = false;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((FrameworkElement)xamRibbon.RibbonWindow) ?? xamRibbon;
			if (xamRibbon._highContrastDictionary != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = frameworkElement.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (frameworkElement.Resources.MergedDictionaries[i] == xamRibbon._highContrastDictionary)
					{
						frameworkElement.Resources.MergedDictionaries[i] = resourceDictionary;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			xamRibbon._highContrastDictionary = resourceDictionary;
			if (!flag)
			{
				frameworkElement.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Insert(0, resourceDictionary);
			}
			frameworkElement.InvalidateMeasure();
			frameworkElement.UpdateLayout();
			if (xamRibbon._ribbonWindow != null)
			{
				xamRibbon._ribbonWindow.OnIsHighConstrastChanged();
			}
			xamRibbon.CoerceValue(ThemeProperty);
		}

		private void InitializePreferredFont()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.FontFamily systemMenuFont = SystemMenuFont;
			System.Windows.Media.FontFamily value = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("Segoe UI");
			if (systemMenuFont != null && (systemMenuFont.Equals(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("MS Mincho")) || systemMenuFont.Equals(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("MS PMincho")) || systemMenuFont.Equals(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("Meiryo")) || systemMenuFont.Equals(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("Meiryo UI")) || systemMenuFont.Equals(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("Yu Gothic")) || systemMenuFont.Equals(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("Yu Gothic UI"))))
			{
				value = systemMenuFont;
			}
			SetValue(PreferredFontPropertyKey, value);
		}

				{
					xamRibbon.RibbonTabControl.SetValue(IsSelectedItemInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					xamRibbon.RibbonTabControl.ClearValue(IsSelectedItemInContextualTabGroupPropertyKey);
				}
				if (ribbonTabItem != null && xamRibbon._ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation)

				if (xamRibbon._ribbonMode == RibbonMode.Normal)
				{
					xamRibbon.SetSelectedTabAsFocusElement();
				}
				if (xamRibbon.SelectedTab != null)
				{
					xamRibbon.CloseApplicationMenu2010();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnRibbonWindowChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = (XamRibbon)d;
			IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow = e.OldValue as IRibbonWindow;
			IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow2 = e.NewValue as IRibbonWindow;
			if (ribbonWindow != null)
			{
				ribbonWindow.Activated -= xamRibbon.OnRibbonWindowActivationChanged;
				ribbonWindow.Deactivated -= xamRibbon.OnRibbonWindowActivationChanged;
			}
			xamRibbon._ribbonWindow = ribbonWindow2;
			if (ribbonWindow2 != null)
			{
				ribbonWindow2.Activated += xamRibbon.OnRibbonWindowActivationChanged;
				ribbonWindow2.Deactivated += xamRibbon.OnRibbonWindowActivationChanged;
				xamRibbon.SetValue(IsWithinRibbonWindowPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				RibbonWindowContentHost.SyncApplicationAccentColor(xamRibbon, ribbonWindow2 as FrameworkElement);
				if (xamRibbon.Parent is RibbonWindowContentHost contentHost)
				{
					SyncTheme(xamRibbon, contentHost);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				xamRibbon.ClearValue(IsWithinRibbonWindowPropertyKey);
			}
			xamRibbon.VerifyIsGlassCaptionGlowVisible();
			_ = xamRibbon.Theme;
			xamRibbon.VerifyIsRibbonWindowActive();
			if (ribbonWindow2 != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(xamRibbon) > 0)
			{
				xamRibbon.OnWindowStateChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void OnKeyTipPlacementChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(d) || (e.NewValue != null && e.OldValue != null) || !(d is UIElement uIElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = d;
			while (dependencyObject != null && !(dependencyObject is IRibbonTool) && (!(dependencyObject is ToolMenuItem) || dependencyObject is MenuToolPresenter) && !(dependencyObject is ApplicationMenu2010Item) && !(dependencyObject is IKeyTip))
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = dependencyObject;
				dependencyObject = ((dependencyObject is FrameworkElement) ? ((FrameworkElement)dependencyObject).TemplatedParent : null);
				dependencyObject = dependencyObject ?? LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject2) ?? VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject2);
			}
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<WeakReference> list = (IList<WeakReference>)dependencyObject.GetValue(KeyTipPlacementListProperty);
			if (list != null && e.NewValue == null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					WeakReference weakReference = list[i];
					UIElement uIElement2 = CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(weakReference) as UIElement;
					if (uIElement2 == null || uIElement2 == uIElement)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(i);
						i--;
						if (uIElement2 == uIElement)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (e.OldValue == null)
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<WeakReference>();
					dependencyObject.SetValue(KeyTipPlacementListProperty, list);
				}
				list.Add(new WeakReference(uIElement));
			}
		}

		private static void OnLocationChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			d.CoerceValue(RibbonToolHelper.SizingModeProperty);
			RibbonToolHelper.UpdateImageProperties(d);
			switch ((ToolLocation)e.NewValue)
			{
			case ToolLocation.Ribbon:
			case ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar:
			case ToolLocation.TabItemAreaToolbar:
				d.ClearValue(HideAccessKeyPropertyKey);
				break;
			case ToolLocation.Unknown:
			case ToolLocation.Menu:
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenu:
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar:
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuRecentItems:
			case ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuSubMenu:
				d.SetValue(HideAccessKeyPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				break;
			default:
				d.SetValue(HideAccessKeyPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				break;
			}
		}

				XamRibbon xamRibbon2 = (XamRibbon)e.NewValue;

		}

		private static void OnTopLevelVisualActualHeightChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = d as XamRibbon;
			double autoHideVerticalThreshold = xamRibbon.AutoHideVerticalThreshold;
			if (xamRibbon._topLevelVisual == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (autoHideVerticalThreshold > 0.0 && xamRibbon._topLevelVisual.Height < autoHideVerticalThreshold && xamRibbon.AutoHideState == RibbonAutoHideState.NotHidden)
			{
				xamRibbon.InvalidateMeasure();
				return;
			}
			double autoHideHorizontalThreshold = xamRibbon.AutoHideHorizontalThreshold;
			if ((!(autoHideHorizontalThreshold > 0.0) || !(xamRibbon._topLevelVisual.Width < autoHideHorizontalThreshold)) && xamRibbon._topLevelVisual.Height > autoHideVerticalThreshold && xamRibbon.AutoHideState == RibbonAutoHideState.Hidden)
			{
				xamRibbon.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		}

		public static ValueEditor GetToolInEditMode(ValueEditor valueEditor)
		{
			if (valueEditor == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("valueEditor");
			}
			ValueEditor result = (valueEditor.IsInEditMode ? valueEditor : null);
			string id = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(valueEditor);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = GetRibbon(valueEditor);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					IEnumerator allInstancesWithId = ribbon.ToolInstanceManager.GetAllInstancesWithId(id);
					if (allInstancesWithId != null)
					{
						while (allInstancesWithId.MoveNext())
						{
							if (allInstancesWithId.Current is ValueEditor { IsInEditMode: not false } valueEditor2)
							{
								result = valueEditor2;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool AddToolToQat(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (tool is ToolMenuItem)
			{
				tool = ((ToolMenuItem)tool).RibbonTool as FrameworkElement;
			}
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((bool)tool.GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatProperty))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (tool is ValueEditor { IsInEditMode: not false } valueEditor)
			{
				valueEditor.EndEditMode(acceptChanges: true, force: false);
			}
			string associatedTargetId = tool.GetValue(RibbonToolHelper.IdProperty) as string;
			QatPlaceholderTool newItem = new QatPlaceholderTool(associatedTargetId, (tool is RibbonGroup) ? QatPlaceholderToolType.RibbonGroup : QatPlaceholderToolType.Tool);
			QuickAccessToolbar.Items.Add(newItem);
			return true;
		}

		internal double CalcKeyTipMinWidth()
		{
			KeyTip keyTip = new KeyTip();
			AddLogicalChild(keyTip);
			AddVisualChild(keyTip);
			keyTip.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			keyTip.Arrange(new Rect(keyTip.DesiredSize));
			RemoveLogicalChild(keyTip);
			RemoveVisualChild(keyTip);
			return keyTip.RenderSize.Width;
		}

		internal void CalculateMargins()
		{
			bool isOffice2013ThemeInternal = IsOffice2013ThemeInternal;
			RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost = ((_ribbonWindow != null) ? _ribbonWindow.ContentHost : null);
			Thickness thickness = ribbonWindowContentHost?.BorderThickness ?? default(Thickness);
			Thickness thickness2 = ribbonWindowContentHost?.RibbonAreaMargin ?? default(Thickness);
			Thickness thickness3 = default(Thickness);
			bool useScenicApplicationMenuInternal = UseScenicApplicationMenuInternal;
			if (_ribbonWindow != null && _ribbonWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				if (isOffice2013ThemeInternal)
				{
					SetValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, -4.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
				else if (useScenicApplicationMenuInternal)
				{
					if (_ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal)
					{
						SetValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 7.0, 0.0, 0.0));
					}
					else if (IsScenicTheme)
					{
						SetValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 4.0, 0.0, 0.0));
					}
					else
					{
						SetValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 6.0, 0.0, 0.0));
					}
				}
				else if (_ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal)
				{
					SetValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 4.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey);
				}
				if (!isOffice2013ThemeInternal && (ApplicationMenuMode == ApplicationMenuMode.Office2010 || useScenicApplicationMenuInternal))
				{
					if (_ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal)
					{
						if (useScenicApplicationMenuInternal)
						{
							thickness3.Top += 5.0;
						}
						else
						{
							thickness3.Top += 6.0;
						}
					}
					else if (!IsScenicTheme)
					{
						thickness3.Top += 1.0;
					}
					else
					{
						thickness3.Top += 2.0;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (_ribbonWindow != null && !isOffice2013ThemeInternal && useScenicApplicationMenuInternal)
			{
				if (_ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal)
				{
					SetValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 3.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
				else
				{
					SetValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 6.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(CaptionPanelMarginPropertyKey);
			}
			SetValue(WindowIconMarginPropertyKey, thickness3);
			bool flag = UseScenicApplicationMenuInternal || IsUsingApplicationMenu2010;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_ribbonWindow != null && (_ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal || isOffice2013ThemeInternal))
				{
					SetValue(ApplicationMenuMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
				else
				{
					SetValue(ApplicationMenuMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(Math.Max(thickness.Left - thickness2.Left, 0.0), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			else if (_ribbonWindow != null && (_ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal || isOffice2013ThemeInternal) && _ribbonWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				if (isOffice2013ThemeInternal)
				{
					SetValue(ApplicationMenuMarginPropertyKey, default(Thickness));
				}
				else
				{
					SetValue(ApplicationMenuMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 6.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetValue(ApplicationMenuMarginPropertyKey, new Thickness(0.0, 2.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			}
			if (ribbonWindowContentHost == null || _ribbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal || isOffice2013ThemeInternal || (_ribbonWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal && (isOffice2013ThemeInternal || !flag)))
			{
				ClearValue(QuickAccessToolbarMarginPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(TabAreaMarginPropertyKey);
				return;
			}
			Thickness thickness4 = new Thickness(Math.Max(thickness.Left - thickness2.Left, 0.0), 0.0, Math.Max(thickness.Right - thickness2.Right, 0.0), 0.0);
			SetValue(TabAreaMarginPropertyKey, thickness4);
			if (QuickAccessToolbarLocation == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.BelowRibbon)
			{
				SetValue(QuickAccessToolbarMarginPropertyKey, thickness4);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(QuickAccessToolbarMarginPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		internal ToolMenuItem CreateMinimizeMenuItem(string displayTextResourceName)
		{
			ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = new ToolMenuItem();
			toolMenuItem.Header = GetString(displayTextResourceName);
			toolMenuItem.IsChecked = IsMinimized;
			toolMenuItem.CommandTarget = this;
			toolMenuItem.IsCheckable = true;
			RoutedEventHandler value = delegate(object s, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem2 = (ToolMenuItem)e.Source;
				DispatcherOperationCallback method = delegate(object param)
				{
					ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem3 = (ToolMenuItem)param;
					RibbonCommands.ToggleRibbonMinimizedState.Execute(toolMenuItem3.CommandParameter, toolMenuItem3.CommandTarget);
					return (object)null;
				};
				toolMenuItem2.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, method, toolMenuItem2);
			};
			toolMenuItem.Checked += value;
			toolMenuItem.Unchecked += value;
			return toolMenuItem;
		}

		internal void ForcePendingToolRegistrations()
		{
			if (_pendingToolRegOperation != null)
			{
				_pendingToolRegOperation.Abort();
				ProcessPendingToolRegistrations();
			}
			else if (_implicitResumeRegOperation != null && _implicitResumeRegOperation.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Pending)
			{
				_implicitResumeRegOperation.Abort();
				_implicitResumeRegOperation = null;
				ResumeToolRegistration(delay: false);
			}
		}

		internal static UIElement GetKeyTipPlacementElement(KeyTipPlacementType placementType, DependencyObject keyTipProvider)
		{
			IList<WeakReference> list = (IList<WeakReference>)keyTipProvider.GetValue(KeyTipPlacementListProperty);
			if (list != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int num = list.Count; i < num; i++)
				{
					WeakReference weakReference = list[i];
					if (CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(weakReference) is UIElement uIElement)
					{
						if (placementType.Equals(uIElement.GetValue(KeyTipPlacementTypeProperty)) && uIElement.IsVisible)
						{
							return uIElement;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						list.RemoveAt(i);
						i--;
						num--;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static Rect GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(KeyTipPlacementType placementType, DependencyObject keyTipProvider, UIElement relativeElement)
		{
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			UIElement keyTipPlacementElement = GetKeyTipPlacementElement(placementType, keyTipProvider);
			if (keyTipPlacementElement != null)
			{
				rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, keyTipPlacementElement.RenderSize.Width, keyTipPlacementElement.RenderSize.Height);
				Thickness thickness = (Thickness)keyTipPlacementElement.GetValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
				Thickness thickness2 = (Thickness)keyTipPlacementElement.GetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Control.PaddingProperty);
				rect = SubtractThickness(rect, thickness);
				rect = SubtractThickness(rect, thickness2);
				if (keyTipPlacementElement != relativeElement)
				{
					rect = TryTransformToVisual(keyTipPlacementElement, relativeElement, rect) ?? rect;
				}
			}
			return rect;
		}

		internal int GetRibbonGroupSmallToolRow(FrameworkElement toolElement)
		{
			RibbonGroup containingGroup = RibbonGroup.GetContainingGroup(toolElement);
			if (containingGroup != null && containingGroup.CurrentContentSite != null && containingGroup.CurrentContentSite.Content != null)
			{
				GeneralTransform generalTransform = null;
				try
				{
					generalTransform = toolElement.TransformToAncestor(containingGroup.CurrentContentSite);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
				}
				if (generalTransform != null)
				{
					double y = generalTransform.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, toolElement.ActualHeight / 2.0)).Y;
					double toolRowVerticalOffset = RibbonGroupForSizing.GetToolRowVerticalOffset(1);
					if (Math.Abs(toolRowVerticalOffset - y) < 3.0)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					if (toolRowVerticalOffset < y)
					{
						return 2;
					}
					return 0;
				}
			}
			return 1;
		}

		internal double GetRibbonGroupToolVerticalOffset(int rowNumber, UIElement toolElement)
		{
			RibbonGroup ribbonGroupForSizing = RibbonGroupForSizing;
			double toolRowVerticalOffset = ribbonGroupForSizing.GetToolRowVerticalOffset(rowNumber);
			RibbonGroup containingGroup = RibbonGroup.GetContainingGroup(toolElement);
			if (containingGroup != null)
			{
				ContentControl currentContentSite = containingGroup.CurrentContentSite;
				if (currentContentSite != null)
				{
					GeneralTransform generalTransform = null;
					try
					{
						generalTransform = currentContentSite.TransformToVisual(toolElement);
					}
					catch (ArgumentException)
					{
					}
					catch (InvalidOperationException)
					{
					}
					if (generalTransform != null)
					{
						return generalTransform.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, toolRowVerticalOffset)).Y;
					}
				}
			}
			return toolElement.RenderSize.Height / 2.0;
		}
