		internal void RegisterTool(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (IsToolRegistrationSuspended)
			{
				AddToPendingToolRegistrations(tool, isRegistering: true);
				return;
			}
			ForcePendingToolRegistrations();
			XamRibbon registeredOwner = GetRegisteredOwner(tool);
			if (registeredOwner != null && registeredOwner != this)
			{
				registeredOwner.ForcePendingToolRegistrations();
			}
			IRibbonToolLocation locationProvider;
			ToolLocation toolLocation = GetToolLocation(tool, out locationProvider);
			tool.SetValue(LocationPropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.FromValue(toolLocation));
			SetRegisteredOwner(tool, this);
			RemovePendingToolRegistration(tool, isRegistering: true);
			if ((bool)tool.GetValue(IsRegisteredProperty))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!(tool is IRibbonToolPanel))
			{
				ToolInstanceManager.RegisterToolInstance(tool);
			}
			if (tool is IRibbonTool || tool is IRibbonToolPanel)
			{
				if (toolLocation == ToolLocation.Ribbon)
				{
					tool.SetValue(RibbonGroup.ContainingGroupPropertyKey, locationProvider as RibbonGroup);
				}
				else if (locationProvider is ToolbarBase)
				{
					tool.SetValue(ToolbarBase.ContainingToolbarPropertyKey, (ToolbarBase)locationProvider);
				}
				if (tool is IRibbonToolPanel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (toolLocation == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				string id = RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool);
				ToolInstanceManager.SetPropertyValueOnAllRelatedToolInstances(RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool), RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
		}

		internal bool RemoveToolFromQat(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (tool is ToolMenuItem)
			{
				tool = ((ToolMenuItem)tool).RibbonTool as FrameworkElement;
			}
			if (tool == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((ToolLocation)tool.GetValue(LocationProperty) != ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
			{
				return true;
			}
			QuickAccessToolbar.RemoveTool(tool);
			return true;
		}

		internal void ResumeToolRegistration()
		{
			ResumeToolRegistration(delay: true);
		}

		internal void ResumeToolRegistration(bool delay)
		{
			if (_implicitResumeRegOperation != null && (_implicitResumeRegOperation.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Executing || _implicitResumeRegOperation.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Completed))
			{
				_implicitResumeRegOperation = null;
			}
			if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref _toolRegistrationSuspendCount) == 0)
			{
				if (delay)
				{
					ProcessPendingToolRegistrationsWithDelay();
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessPendingToolRegistrations();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool SelectAdjacentTab(int offset)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.TabControl ribbonTabControl = _ribbonTabControl;
			if (ribbonTabControl != null)
			{
				int selectedIndex = ribbonTabControl.SelectedIndex;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = Math.Abs(offset);
				int count = ribbonTabControl.Items.Count;
				if (selectedIndex < 0)
				{
					offset = 1;
				}
				for (int i = selectedIndex + offset; 0 <= i && i < count; i += offset)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = ribbonTabControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(ribbonTabControl.Items[i]);
					UIElement uIElement = ((dependencyObject == null) ? (ribbonTabControl.Items[i] as UIElement) : (dependencyObject as UIElement));
					if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed && uIElement.IsEnabled)
					{
						num++;
						if (num == num2)
						{
							ribbonTabControl.SelectedIndex = i;
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SuspendToolRegistration()
		{
			Interlocked.Increment(ref _toolRegistrationSuspendCount);
		}

		internal static void SyncTheme(XamRibbon ribbon, RibbonWindowContentHost contentHost)
		{
			ValueSource valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(ribbon, ThemeProperty);
			ValueSource valueSource2 = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(contentHost, ThemeProperty);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2;
			if (valueSource.BaseValueSource >= valueSource2.BaseValueSource)
			{
				frameworkElement = ribbon;
				frameworkElement2 = contentHost;
			}
			else
			{
				frameworkElement = contentHost;
				frameworkElement2 = ribbon;
			}
			frameworkElement2.SetCurrentValue(ThemeProperty, frameworkElement.GetValue(ThemeProperty));
		}

		internal static void TransferFocusOutOfRibbon(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			GetRibbon(element)?.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
		}

		internal void TransferFocusOutOfRibbon()
		{
			if (base.IsLoaded)
			{
				if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					Keyboard.Focus(null);
				}
				if (FocusManager.GetIsFocusScope(this))
				{
					FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(this, null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void TransferFocusOutOfRibbonHelper(FrameworkElement fe)
		{
			if (!fe.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = GetRibbon(fe);
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				if (ribbon.Mode != RibbonMode.Normal)
				{
					ribbon.SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
				}
				else
				{
					ribbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static Rect? TryTransformToVisual(Visual source, Visual relativeVisual, Rect rect)
		{
			try
			{
				GeneralTransform generalTransform = source.TransformToVisual(relativeVisual);
				return generalTransform.TransformBounds(rect);
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal void UnregisterGroup(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.Id) && group != null && group.CloneFromGroup == null && _registeredGroups.ContainsKey(group.Id))
			{
				_registeredGroups.Remove(group.Id);
			}
		}

		internal void UnregisterTool(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (!IsToolRegistrationSuspended)
			{
				SuspendToolRegistration();
				_implicitResumeRegOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new MethodInvoker(ResumeToolRegistration));
			}
			if (IsToolRegistrationSuspended)
			{
				AddToPendingToolRegistrations(tool, isRegistering: false);
			}
			else
			{
				UnregisterToolImpl(tool);
			}
		}

		private void UnregisterToolImpl(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			SetRegisteredOwner(tool, null);
			RemovePendingToolRegistration(tool, isRegistering: false);
			tool.ClearValue(RibbonGroup.ContainingGroupPropertyKey);
			tool.ClearValue(ToolbarBase.ContainingToolbarPropertyKey);
			if (!(tool is IRibbonToolPanel))
			{
				if (GetLocation(tool) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					ToolInstanceManager.SetPropertyValueOnAllRelatedToolInstances(RibbonToolHelper.GetId(tool), RibbonToolHelper.IsOnQatPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
				ToolInstanceManager.UnRegisterToolInstance(tool);
				tool.SetValue(LocationPropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.ToolLocationUnknownBox);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyGroupIsRegistered(RibbonGroup group)
		{
			string id = group.Id;
			VerifyGroupIsRegistered(group, id);
		}

		internal void VerifyIsRibbonWindowActive()
		{
			bool value = _ribbonWindow != null && _ribbonWindow.IsActive;
			SetValue(IsRibbonWindowActivePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(value));
		}

		internal void VerifyMenuToolChildrenAsync(MenuToolBase rootMenu)
		{
			if (_menuToolVerificationList == null)
			{
				_menuToolVerificationList = new HashSet();
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new MethodInvoker(VerifyMenuToolChildren));
			}
			_menuToolVerificationList.Add(rootMenu);
		}

		private void VerifyMenuToolChildren()
		{
			if (_menuToolVerificationList != null)
			{
				MenuToolBase[] array = _menuToolVerificationList.ToArray<MenuToolBase>();
				_menuToolVerificationList = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i].VerifyReparentedToolsContainer();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyQatVisibility()
		{
			if (_captionPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = QuickAccessToolbar;
			bool flag = true;
			if (_applicationMenu2010 != null && IsOffice2013Theme && _applicationMenu2010.IsOpen)
			{
				flag = false;
				_isQatVisibilityResetPending = quickAccessToolbar != null && (_isQatVisibilityResetPending || quickAccessToolbar.Visibility == Visibility.Visible);
				quickAccessToolbar?.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
			}
			else if (quickAccessToolbar != null && _isQatVisibilityResetPending)
			{
				_isQatVisibilityResetPending = false;
				quickAccessToolbar.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox);
			}
			if (_captionPanel.IsQatVisible != flag)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					_captionPanel.ClearValue(RibbonCaptionPanel.IsQatVisiblePropertyKey);
				}
				else
				{
					_captionPanel.SetValue(RibbonCaptionPanel.IsQatVisiblePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifySelectedTab()
		{
			object obj = RibbonTabControl.SelectedItem;
			if (!IsMinimized && (obj == null || (obj is TabItem && ((TabItem)obj).Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)))
			{
				obj = ((!SelectAdjacentTab(1) && !SelectAdjacentTab(-1)) ? null : RibbonTabControl.SelectedItem);
			}
			foreach (RibbonTabItem item in _tabsInViewInternal)
			{
				if (item != obj)
				{
					DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(item, TabItem.IsSelectedProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				SelectedTab = null;
			}
		}

		private void AddLogicalChildHelper(object newChild)
		{
			if (newChild != null)
			{
				_logicalChildren.Add(newChild);
				AddLogicalChild(newChild);
			}
		}

		internal void AddToPendingToolRegistrations(FrameworkElement tool, bool isRegistering)
		{
			if (_pendingToolRegistrations == null)
			{
				_pendingToolRegistrations = new Dictionary<FrameworkElement, bool>();
			}
			if (_pendingToolRegistrations.TryGetValue(tool, out var value))
			{
				if (isRegistering != value)
				{
					_pendingToolRegistrations.Remove(tool);
					if (_toolsToVerify == null)
					{
						_toolsToVerify = new HashSet();
					}
					_toolsToVerify.Add(tool);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_pendingToolRegistrations.Add(tool, isRegistering);
			}
		}

		private void CloseApplicationMenu2010()
		{
			ApplicationMenu2010?.Close();
		}

		internal static object CoerceTabNavigation(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = (XamRibbon)d;
			switch (xamRibbon._ribbonMode)
			{
			case RibbonMode.Normal:
			case RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending:
				return newValue;
			case RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive:
			case RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation:
				return KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle;
			default:
				return KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu CreateRibbonContextMenu(FrameworkElement targetElement, bool canAddTargetToQat, object originalSource)
		{
			RibbonContextMenu ribbonContextMenu = new RibbonContextMenu();
			System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem menuItem;
			if (canAddTargetToQat)
			{
				menuItem = new ToolMenuItem();
				ribbonContextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem);
				menuItem.CommandTarget = this;
				if (targetElement is GalleryTool)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = targetElement.Parent as MenuTool;
					if (dependencyObject == null)
					{
						ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem = (ToolMenuItem)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(targetElement, typeof(ToolMenuItem), allowSubclassOfType: true);
						if (toolMenuItem != null)
						{
							ToolMenuItem parentMenuItem = toolMenuItem.ParentMenuItem;
							dependencyObject = ((parentMenuItem != null) ? (parentMenuItem.RibbonTool as MenuTool) : null);
						}
					}
					if (dependencyObject == null)
					{
						dependencyObject = Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(targetElement, typeof(MenuTool), allowSubclassOfType: true);
					}
					menuItem.CommandParameter = dependencyObject;
				}
				else
				{
					menuItem.CommandParameter = targetElement;
				}
				bool flag = QuickAccessToolbar.ContainsToolInstance(menuItem.CommandParameter as FrameworkElement);
				if (flag && targetElement is RibbonGroup && GetLocation(targetElement) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar && originalSource is DependencyObject && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType((DependencyObject)originalSource, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) is Popup descendant && Utilities.IsDescendantOf(targetElement, descendant))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					menuItem.Command = RemoveItemFromQatCommand;
					menuItem.Header = GetString("ToolContextMenu_RemoveFromQat");
				}
				else
				{
					menuItem.Command = AddItemToQatCommand;
					if (targetElement is GalleryTool || (targetElement is MenuTool && ((MenuTool)targetElement).HasGalleryPreview))
					{
						menuItem.Header = GetString("ToolContextMenu_AddGalleryToQat");
					}
					else
					{
						menuItem.Header = GetString("ToolContextMenu_AddToQat");
					}
				}
				SeparatorTool separatorTool = new SeparatorTool();
				SetLocation(separatorTool, ToolLocation.Menu);
				ribbonContextMenu.Items.Add(separatorTool);
			}
			menuItem = new ToolMenuItem();
			if (QuickAccessToolbarLocation == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon)
			{
				menuItem.Header = GetString("ToolContextMenu_ShowQatBelowRibbon");
			}
			else
			{
				menuItem.Header = GetString("ToolContextMenu_ShowQatAboveRibbon");
			}
			menuItem.Command = RibbonCommands.ToggleQatLocation;
			menuItem.CommandTarget = this;
			ribbonContextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem);
			if (AllowMinimize)
			{
				SeparatorTool separatorTool = new SeparatorTool();
				SetLocation(separatorTool, ToolLocation.Menu);
				ribbonContextMenu.Items.Add(separatorTool);
				menuItem = CreateMinimizeMenuItem("ToolContextMenu_MinimizeRibbon");
				ribbonContextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem);
			}
			return ribbonContextMenu;
		}

		private void DelayedTransferFocus()
		{
			if (Mode != RibbonMode.Normal || !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin || !(Keyboard.FocusedElement is DependencyObject dependencyObject) || !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(this, dependencyObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(this) == null;
			if (flag)
			{
				DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(dependencyObject);
				if (focusScope != this && focusScope is UIElement && ((UIElement)focusScope).IsVisible)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag && Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && Mouse.DirectlyOver is DependencyObject descendant && Utilities.IsDescendantOf(dependencyObject, descendant))
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
			}
		}

		private bool ExecuteCommandImpl(RoutedCommand command, object commandParameter)
		{
			if (command == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("command");
			}
			if (!Commands<XamRibbon>.IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(this, command))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecutingCommandEventArgs e = new ExecutingCommandEventArgs(command);
			if (!RaiseExecutingCommand(e))
			{
				return !e.ContinueKeyRouting;
			}
			bool flag = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != 0;
			bool flag2 = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != 0;
			bool flag3 = Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.Tab);
			SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal, restoreFocusOnNormal: true);
			TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (command == RibbonCommands.ToggleRibbonMinimizedState)
			{
				IsMinimized = !IsMinimized;
				flag4 = true;
			}
			else if (command == RibbonCommands.ToggleQatLocation)
			{
				if (QuickAccessToolbarLocation == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.BelowRibbon)
				{
					QuickAccessToolbarLocation = QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon;
				}
				else
				{
					QuickAccessToolbarLocation = QuickAccessToolbarLocation.BelowRibbon;
				}
				flag4 = true;
			}
			else if (command == RibbonCommands.CloseApplicationMenu)
			{
				if (ApplicationMenuMode == ApplicationMenuMode.Office2010)
				{
					CloseApplicationMenu2010();
				}
				else if (ApplicationMenu != null)
				{
					ApplicationMenu.IsOpen = false;
				}
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				RaiseExecutedCommand(new ExecutedCommandEventArgs(command));
			}
			return flag4;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetNewActiveItem(FrameworkElement fallback)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			if (Mode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
				while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
				{
					dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				frameworkElement = dependencyObject as FrameworkElement;
				while (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.TemplatedParent != null)
				{
					frameworkElement = frameworkElement.TemplatedParent as FrameworkElement;
				}
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = frameworkElement;
				for (DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = frameworkElement; dependencyObject2 != null; dependencyObject2 = Utilities.GetParent(dependencyObject2, includeLogicalParent: true))
				{
					if (dependencyObject2 is IRibbonTool)
					{
						frameworkElement = dependencyObject2 as FrameworkElement;
						break;
					}
					if (dependencyObject2 is RibbonGroup)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (frameworkElement != null && GetRibbon(frameworkElement) != this)
				{
					frameworkElement = null;
				}
			}
			return frameworkElement ?? fallback;
		}

		private static ToolLocation GetToolLocation(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			IRibbonToolLocation locationProvider;
			return GetToolLocation(tool, out locationProvider);
		}

		private static ToolLocation GetToolLocation(FrameworkElement tool, out IRibbonToolLocation locationProvider)
		{
			DependencyObject parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(tool);
			locationProvider = null;
			while (parent != null)
			{
				locationProvider = parent as IRibbonToolLocation;
				if (locationProvider != null)
				{
					if (locationProvider is IRibbonToolLocationEx)
					{
						return ((IRibbonToolLocationEx)locationProvider).GetLocation(tool);
					}
					return locationProvider.Location;
				}
				parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(parent);
			}
			locationProvider = (IRibbonToolLocation)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(tool, typeof(IRibbonToolLocation), allowSubclassOfType: true);
			if (locationProvider != null)
			{
				return locationProvider.Location;
			}
			return ToolLocation.Unknown;
		}

		private static WindowState GetWindowState(Visual topLevelVisual)
		{
			if (topLevelVisual is Window window)
			{
				return window.WindowState;
			}
			return WindowState.Normal;
		}

		private void OnApplicationMenu2010ItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_applicationMenu2010 != null && _applicationMenu2010.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				VerifyApplicationMenuMode();
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)_applicationMenu2010.Items).CollectionChanged -= OnApplicationMenu2010ItemsChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationMenuSiteLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ContentControl contentControl = sender as ContentControl;
			contentControl.Loaded -= OnApplicationMenuSiteLoaded;
			VerifyApplicationMenuSite();
		}

		private static void OnCanExecuteInternalCommand(object target, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!(target is XamRibbon))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.Command == AddItemToQatCommand)
			{
				if (args.Parameter is FrameworkElement d && !RibbonToolHelper.GetIsOnQat(d))
				{
					args.CanExecute = true;
				}
				else
				{
					args.CanExecute = false;
				}
			}
			else if (args.Command == RemoveItemFromQatCommand && args.Parameter is FrameworkElement)
			{
				if (args.Parameter is FrameworkElement d2 && GetLocation(d2) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					args.CanExecute = true;
				}
				else
				{
					args.CanExecute = false;
				}
			}
			args.Handled = true;
		}

		private static void OnGotFocus_ClassHandler(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
			{
				dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = dependencyObject as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = GetRibbon(frameworkElement);
			if (ribbon == null || ribbon.Mode == RibbonMode.Normal)
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement activeItem = ribbon.ActiveItem;
			while (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				if (frameworkElement is XamRibbon)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (frameworkElement is IRibbonTool)
				{
					ribbon.SetActiveItem(frameworkElement);
					break;
				}
				if (frameworkElement is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup)
				{
					if (ribbonGroup.Focusable)
					{
						ribbon.SetActiveItem(ribbonGroup);
					}
					break;
				}
				if (frameworkElement is RibbonTabItem activeItem2)
				{
					ribbon.SetActiveItem(activeItem2);
					break;
				}
				if (frameworkElement is ApplicationMenu2010Item)
				{
					ribbon.SetActiveItem(frameworkElement);
					break;
				}
				if (frameworkElement is ApplicationMenu2010FileTab)
				{
					ribbon.SetActiveItem(frameworkElement);
					break;
				}
				if (frameworkElement.TemplatedParent is ToolbarWithOverflow && frameworkElement.Name == "PART_OverflowButton")
				{
					ribbon.SetActiveItem(frameworkElement);
					break;
				}
				frameworkElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(frameworkElement) as FrameworkElement;
			}
			if (activeItem != ribbon.ActiveItem || activeItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				ribbon.SetActiveItem(null);
			}
			else if (frameworkElement != activeItem)
			{
				DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(activeItem);
				DependencyObject focusScope2 = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(frameworkElement);
				if (focusScope2 == focusScope && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(activeItem, frameworkElement))
				{
					ribbon.SetActiveItem(ribbon.GetNewActiveItem(null));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnExecuteInternalCommand(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is XamRibbon xamRibbon)
			{
				xamRibbon.SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal, restoreFocusOnNormal: true);
				xamRibbon.TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();

				{
					xamRibbon.AddToolToQat(args.Parameter as FrameworkElement);

				else if (args.Command == RemoveItemFromQatCommand && args.Parameter is FrameworkElement)

					xamRibbon.RemoveToolFromQat(args.Parameter as FrameworkElement);
					args.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnLostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = sender as XamRibbon;
			if (!xamRibbon.ShouldCaptureMouseForRibbonMode || Mouse.Captured == xamRibbon)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			if (Mouse.Captured == null && dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != xamRibbon && GetRibbon(dependencyObject) == xamRibbon)
			{
				IntPtr? intPtr = null;
				try
				{
					intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetCaptureApi();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Mouse.Capture(xamRibbon, CaptureMode.SubTree);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviewMouseDownOutsideCapturedElement(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = sender as XamRibbon;
			if (xamRibbon.ShouldCaptureMouseForRibbonMode && xamRibbon.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				xamRibbon.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
			{
				dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null && ApplicationMenu2010.GetMenu(dependencyObject) == xamRibbon.ApplicationMenu2010)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = dependencyObject;
			while (dependencyObject2 != null && dependencyObject2 != xamRibbon)
			{
				if (xamRibbon.IsAncestorOf(dependencyObject2))
				{
					dependencyObject2 = xamRibbon;
				}
				else
				{
					while (true)
					{
						DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject2);
						if (parent == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						dependencyObject2 = parent;
					}
				}
				if (dependencyObject2 is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					IInputElement inputElement = uIElement.InputHitTest(e.GetPosition(uIElement));
					if (inputElement != null)
					{
						DependencyObject dependencyObject3 = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
						if (dependencyObject3 != null && Utilities.IsUIElementOrUIElement3D(dependencyObject3) && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject3) == null && LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject3) is Popup)
						{
							dependencyObject3 = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject3);
						}
						while (true)
						{
							DependencyObject templatedParent = Utilities.GetTemplatedParent(dependencyObject3);
							if (templatedParent == null)
							{
								break;
							}
							dependencyObject3 = templatedParent;
						}
						if (Utilities.IsDescendantOf(dependencyObject3, inputElement as DependencyObject))
						{
							break;
						}
						IInputElement focusedElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement;
						IInputElement captured = Mouse.Captured;
						DependencyObject dependencyObject4 = inputElement as DependencyObject;
						while (dependencyObject4 != null && dependencyObject4 != xamRibbon)
						{
							if (dependencyObject4 is UIElement { Focusable: not false, IsEnabled: not false } uIElement2)
							{
								uIElement2.Focus();
								e.Handled = true;
								break;
							}
							dependencyObject4 = Utilities.GetParent(dependencyObject4, includeLogicalParent: true);
						}
						if (!(e.OriginalSource is IInputElement inputElement2))
						{
							break;
						}
						inputElement2.ReleaseMouseCapture();
						if (!inputElement2.IsMouseCaptured && inputElement2 is DependencyObject)
						{
							DependencyObject element = inputElement2 as DependencyObject;
							DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(element);
							if (focusScope != null && focusScope != FocusManager.GetFocusScope(dependencyObject4))
							{
								FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(focusScope, null);
							}
						}
						e.Handled = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (dependencyObject2 != xamRibbon)
				{
					dependencyObject2 = Utilities.GetParent(dependencyObject2, includeLogicalParent: true);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void OnRibbonToolContextMenuOpening(object sender, ContextMenuEventArgs e)
		{
			ContextMenuEventArgs e2 = null;
			if (_lastContextMenuArgs != null)
			{
				e2 = CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_lastContextMenuArgs) as ContextMenuEventArgs;
				if (e2 == e)
				{
					return;
				}
				e2 = null;
				_lastContextMenuArgs = null;
			}
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = null;
			IRibbonToolHost ribbonToolHost = sender as IRibbonToolHost;
			bool canAddTargetToQat = false;
			IRibbonTool ribbonTool = ((ribbonToolHost == null) ? (sender as IRibbonTool) : ribbonToolHost.Tool);
			if (ribbonTool != null)
			{
				RibbonToolProxy toolProxy = ribbonTool.ToolProxy;
				if (toolProxy != null)
				{
					canAddTargetToQat = toolProxy.CanAddToQat;
				}
			}
			else if (sender is RibbonGroup)
			{
				canAddTargetToQat = true;
			}
			if (!(sender is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			xamRibbon = GetRibbon(dependencyObject);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((sender is RibbonGroup || sender is RibbonTabItem || sender is XamTabControl || (sender is QuickAccessToolbar && xamRibbon != null && xamRibbon.QuickAccessToolbarLocation == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.BelowRibbon)) ? (sender as FrameworkElement) : ((!(sender is ToolMenuItem)) ? (ribbonTool as FrameworkElement) : (((ToolMenuItem)sender).RibbonTool as FrameworkElement)));
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				_lastContextMenuArgs = new WeakReference(e);
				if (xamRibbon == null || frameworkElement == xamRibbon.QuickAccessToolbar.QuickCustomizeMenu)
				{
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu contextMenu = ContextMenuService.GetContextMenu(dependencyObject);
				object obj = dependencyObject.ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty);
				if (obj is BindingExpressionBase)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = null;
					frameworkElement2 = ((!(dependencyObject is ToolMenuItem)) ? GetClonedFromTool(frameworkElement) : frameworkElement);
					if (frameworkElement2 != null)
					{
						obj = frameworkElement2.ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty);
					}
				}
				if (obj != null && contextMenu == null)
				{
					contextMenu = xamRibbon.CreateRibbonContextMenu(frameworkElement, canAddTargetToQat, e.OriginalSource);
					DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
					while (dependencyObject2 is ContentElement)
					{
						dependencyObject2 = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject2);
					}
					contextMenu.PlacementTarget = dependencyObject2 as UIElement;
					contextMenu.Placement = PlacementMode.RelativePoint;
					contextMenu.HorizontalOffset = e.CursorLeft;
					contextMenu.VerticalOffset = e.CursorTop;
					contextMenu.IsOpen = true;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu contextMenu2 = ContextMenuService.GetContextMenu(dependencyObject);
				if (contextMenu2 != null || dependencyObject.ReadLocalValue(ContextMenuService.ContextMenuProperty) == null)
				{
					_lastContextMenuArgs = new WeakReference(e);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnToolsNotInRibbonCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					ToolInstanceManager.RegisterToolInstance((FrameworkElement)newItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					QuickAccessToolbar.RemoveToolId(RibbonToolHelper.GetId((DependencyObject)oldItem));
					ToolInstanceManager.UnRegisterToolInstance((FrameworkElement)oldItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				foreach (object oldItem2 in e.OldItems)
				{
					QuickAccessToolbar.RemoveToolId(RibbonToolHelper.GetId((DependencyObject)oldItem2));
					ToolInstanceManager.UnRegisterToolInstance((FrameworkElement)oldItem2);
				}
				{
					foreach (object newItem2 in e.NewItems)
					{
						ToolInstanceManager.RegisterToolInstance((FrameworkElement)newItem2);
					}
					break;
				}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void OnToolTipClosed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is XamRibbonScreenTip xamRibbonScreenTip)
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = GetRibbon(sender as DependencyObject);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					xamRibbonScreenTip.Closed -= OnToolTipClosed;
					xamRibbonScreenTip.PlacementRectangle = ribbon._originalToolTipPlacementRectangle;
					xamRibbonScreenTip.Placement = ribbon._originalToolTipPlacement;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnToolTipOpening(object sender, ToolTipEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.OriginalSource is FrameworkElement { ToolTip: System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip toolTip } frameworkElement) || (!(toolTip is XamRibbonScreenTip) && !(frameworkElement.TemplatedParent is RibbonGroup)))
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = GetRibbon(sender as DependencyObject);
			if (ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon2 = GetRibbon(frameworkElement);
			if (ribbon2 != ribbon || GetLocation(frameworkElement) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar || !(Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(frameworkElement, typeof(RibbonGroup), allowSubclassOfType: true) is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup))
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = frameworkElement;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = null;
			while (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject2 != ribbon)
			{
				dependencyObject2 = dependencyObject;
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = (dependencyObject2 as FrameworkElement) ?? ribbon;
			if (GetLocation(frameworkElement) == ToolLocation.Unknown && frameworkElement2 != ribbon && !ribbonGroup.IsAncestorOf(frameworkElement))
			{
				DependencyObject parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(frameworkElement2);
				if (parent != null && (!ribbonGroup.IsAncestorOf(parent) || !frameworkElement.IsDescendantOf(frameworkElement2)))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Point location;
			System.Windows.Point point;
			try
			{
				location = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
				point = Utilities.PointToScreenSafe(frameworkElement2, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			toolTip.Closed += OnToolTipClosed;
			ribbon._originalToolTipPlacementRectangle = toolTip.PlacementRectangle;
			ribbon._originalToolTipPlacement = toolTip.Placement;
			Rect layoutSlot = LayoutInformation.GetLayoutSlot(frameworkElement);
			Rect rect = new Rect(location, layoutSlot.Size);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(frameworkElement, new System.Windows.Point(location.X, location.Y - (location.Y - point.Y)));
			Rect placementRectangle = new Rect(point2.X, point2.Y, layoutSlot.Width, frameworkElement2.ActualHeight);
			toolTip.Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom;
			toolTip.PlacementRectangle = placementRectangle;
		}

		}

		private void OnWindowIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (false.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				if (!(Keyboard.FocusedElement is System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu))
				{
					SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, new MethodInvoker(DelayedTransferFocus));
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowPreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Handled || !base.IsEnabled || !base.IsVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Key != Key.System || e.SystemKey != Key.F10)
			{
				_f10KeyDownTime = DateTime.MaxValue;
			}
			else if (!e.IsRepeat)
			{
				_f10KeyDownTime = DateTime.Now;
				_resetRibbonModeOnF10Up = _ribbonMode != RibbonMode.Normal;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.System:
				switch (e.SystemKey)
				{
				case Key.LeftAlt:
				case Key.RightAlt:
					if (IsApplicationMenu2010Open)
					{
						if (_ribbonMode != RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive)
						{
							SetMode(RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending);
							e.Handled = true;
						}
					}
					else if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.Normal && !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending);
					}
					else
					{
						if (_ribbonMode != RibbonMode.Normal || FocusManager.GetIsFocusScope(this) || !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
						{
							break;
						}
						DependencyObject dependencyObject = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
						bool flag = true;
						while (dependencyObject != null)
						{
							if (dependencyObject is RibbonGroup { IsCollapsed: not false, IsOpen: not false })
							{
								flag = false;
								break;
							}
							if (dependencyObject is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem { Role: not MenuItemRole.TopLevelHeader })
							{
								flag = false;
								break;
							}
							if (dependencyObject is ValueEditor { IsInEditMode: not false })
							{
								flag = false;
								break;
							}
							dependencyObject = Utilities.GetParent(dependencyObject, includeLogicalParent: true);
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							SetMode(RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending);
						}
					}
					break;
				case Key.F10:
					if ((_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending || !IsApplicationMenu2010Open) && (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending || _ribbonMode == RibbonMode.Normal) && (Keyboard.Modifiers & (ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift)) == 0)
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive);
						e.Handled = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Up:
			case Key.Right:
			case Key.Down:
				ProcessNavigationKey(e);
				break;
			case Key.Tab:
				if ((e.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Alt) == 0)
				{
					ProcessNavigationKey(e);
				}
				break;
			case Key.Escape:
			{
				RibbonMode ribbonMode = _ribbonMode;
				if (ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive)
				{
					KeyTipManager.ProcessEscKey();
					if (!KeyTipManager.IsActive)
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
					}
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case Key.F1:
				if (!AllowMinimize || (e.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers & (ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift | ModifierKeys.Windows)) != ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !IsApplicationMenu2010Open)
				{
					if (Keyboard.FocusedElement is DependencyObject && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject, typeof(XamRibbon), allowSubclassOfType: true, null, typeof(Popup)) != this)
					{
						break;
					}
					SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
					if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
					}
				}
				IsMinimized = !IsMinimized;
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowPreviewKeyUp(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsVisible)
			{
				SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal, restoreFocusOnNormal: true);
				return;
			}
			Key key = e.Key;
			if (key == Key.System)
			{
				switch (e.SystemKey)
				{
				case Key.LeftAlt:
				case Key.RightAlt:
					if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending)
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive);
						e.Handled = true;
					}
					else if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive || _ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation)
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
						e.Handled = true;
					}
					break;
				case Key.F10:
					if (IsApplicationMenu2010Open && (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.Normal || _ribbonMode == RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation))
					{
						SetMode(RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive);
						e.Handled = true;
					}
					else if (_ribbonMode != RibbonMode.Normal)
					{
						bool flag = _resetRibbonModeOnF10Up;
						if (!flag && DateTime.Now.Subtract(_f10KeyDownTime).TotalSeconds > 1.5)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
							e.Handled = true;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!e.Handled && _ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending)
			{
				SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Mode == RibbonMode.Normal)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			bool flag = dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject.GetValue(RibbonProperty) == this;
			bool flag2 = dependencyObject != null && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(Popup), allowSubclassOfType: true) != null;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			while (dependencyObject is Visual || dependencyObject is Visual3D)
			{
				if (dependencyObject is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem)
				{
					flag3 = true;
					break;
				}
				if (dependencyObject is ApplicationMenu2010)
				{
					if (dependencyObject == ApplicationMenu2010)
					{
						flag4 = true;
					}
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is ApplicationMenu2010FileTab)
				{
					if (HasKeyTipManager)
					{
						KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips();
					}
					return;
				}
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			if (flag && Mode != RibbonMode.Normal)
			{
				bool restoreFocusOnNormal = !flag2 && !flag3 && !flag4;
				SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal, restoreFocusOnNormal);
			}
			else if (!flag)
			{
				SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowPreviewMouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessMouseWheel(e);
		}

		private void OnWindowPreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending)
			{
				string text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.SystemText) ? e.Text : e.SystemText);
				if (ProcessPendingKeyTip(text))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_ribbonMode != RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive)
				{
					return;
				}
				string text2 = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.SystemText) ? e.Text : e.SystemText);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					string text3 = text2;
					foreach (char charCode in text3)
					{
						if (!KeyTipManager.ProcessKey(charCode, beepOnFail: true))
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive && !KeyTipManager.IsActive)
				{
					SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsMouseOver && base.IsEnabled && base.IsVisible && !IsApplicationMenu2010Open && _ribbonMode == RibbonMode.Normal && !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && _ribbonTabControl != null && !_ribbonTabControl.IsMinimized)
			{
				int offset = ((e.Delta < 0) ? 1 : (-1));
				SelectAdjacentTab(offset);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessNavigationKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;
				if (!(dependencyObject is System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem) && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem), allowSubclassOfType: true) == null)
				{
					SetMode(RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessPendingKeyTip(string text)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				char[] array = text.ToCharArray();
				if (KeyTipManager.EvaluateKeyDuringPendingShow(array[0]))
				{
					SetMode(RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive);
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						KeyTipManager.ProcessKey(array[i], beepOnFail: false);
						if (!KeyTipManager.IsActive)
						{
							SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
							break;
						}
					}
					result = true;
				}
				if (_ribbonMode == RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending)
				{
					SetMode(RibbonMode.Normal);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ProcessPendingToolRegistrationsWithDelay()
		{
			_pendingToolRegOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, new MethodInvoker(ProcessPendingToolRegistrations));
		}

		private void ProcessPendingToolRegistrations()
		{
			_pendingToolRegOperation = null;
			VerifyMenuToolChildren();
			Dictionary<FrameworkElement, bool> pendingToolRegistrations = _pendingToolRegistrations;
			_pendingToolRegistrations = null;
			if (pendingToolRegistrations != null)
			{
				List<KeyValuePair<FrameworkElement, bool>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<FrameworkElement, bool>>(pendingToolRegistrations);
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					KeyValuePair<FrameworkElement, bool> keyValuePair = list[num];
					if (keyValuePair.Key is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup && !keyValuePair.Value)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num);
						ribbonGroup.ProcessPendingRegistrationChange(this, isRegistering: false);
					}
				}
				for (int num2 = list.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					KeyValuePair<FrameworkElement, bool> keyValuePair2 = list[num2];
					if (!(keyValuePair2.Key is RibbonGroup) && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(this, keyValuePair2.Key, preferLogicalTree: true))
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num2);
						UnregisterToolImpl(keyValuePair2.Key);
					}
				}
				for (int num3 = list.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					if (list[num3].Key is RibbonGroup ribbonGroup2)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num3);
						ribbonGroup2.ProcessPendingRegistrationChange(this, isRegistering: true);
					}
				}
				for (int num4 = list.Count - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
				{
					KeyValuePair<FrameworkElement, bool> keyValuePair3 = list[num4];
					if (!(keyValuePair3.Key is RibbonGroup))
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num4);
						if (!ToolInstanceManager.IsRegistered(keyValuePair3.Key))
						{
							RegisterTool(keyValuePair3.Key);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (_toolsToVerify == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet toolsToVerify = _toolsToVerify;
			_toolsToVerify = null;
			foreach (object item in toolsToVerify)
			{
				if (!(item is FrameworkElement frameworkElement) || frameworkElement is RibbonGroup)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IRibbonToolLocation locationProvider;
				ToolLocation toolLocation = GetToolLocation(frameworkElement, out locationProvider);
				frameworkElement.SetValue(LocationPropertyKey, RibbonKnownBoxes.FromValue(toolLocation));
				if (frameworkElement is IRibbonTool || frameworkElement is IRibbonToolPanel)
				{
					if (toolLocation == ToolLocation.Ribbon)
					{
						frameworkElement.SetValue(RibbonGroup.ContainingGroupPropertyKey, locationProvider as RibbonGroup);
					}
					else
					{
						frameworkElement.ClearValue(RibbonGroup.ContainingGroupPropertyKey);
					}
					if (locationProvider is ToolbarBase)
					{
						frameworkElement.SetValue(ToolbarBase.ContainingToolbarPropertyKey, (ToolbarBase)locationProvider);
					}
					else
					{
						frameworkElement.ClearValue(ToolbarBase.ContainingToolbarPropertyKey);
					}
					if (frameworkElement is IRibbonToolPanel)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessTabCollectionChange()
		{
			if (base.IsInitialized)
			{
				List<RibbonTabItem> list = new List<RibbonTabItem>();
				RefreshTabLogicalChildren(list);
				UpdateTabsInView();
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					RemoveLogicalChildHelper(list[num]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RefreshTabLogicalChildren(null);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessTabKeyWithinActiveTool(bool next)
		{
			IInputElement focusedElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement;
			if (!(focusedElement is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject root = dependencyObject;
			System.Windows.Controls.Control control = dependencyObject as System.Windows.Controls.Control;
			try
			{
				while (root != null)
				{
					root = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(root) ?? VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(root);
					if (root == this || root is RibbonGroup || root is QuickAccessToolbar)
					{
						root = control;
						break;
					}
					control = (root as System.Windows.Controls.Control) ?? control;
					if (root is IRibbonTool || root is ToolMenuItem)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return;
			}
			if (root == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			KeyboardFocusChangedEventHandler handler = delegate(object o, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (root != e.NewFocus && !Utilities.IsDescendantOf(root, e.NewFocus as DependencyObject, preferLogicalTree: true, usePopupTarget: true))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			};
			focusedElement.AddHandler(Keyboard.PreviewLostKeyboardFocusEvent, handler);
			try
			{
				TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest((!next) ? FocusNavigationDirection.Previous : FocusNavigationDirection.Next);
				if (focusedElement is ContentElement)
				{
					((ContentElement)focusedElement).MoveFocus(request);
				}
				else if (focusedElement is UIElement)
				{
					((UIElement)focusedElement).MoveFocus(request);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				focusedElement.RemoveHandler(Keyboard.PreviewLostKeyboardFocusEvent, handler);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshTabLogicalChildren(List<RibbonTabItem> tabsToRemoveAfter)
		{
			Dictionary<object, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, bool>();
			foreach (RibbonTabItem tab in Tabs)
			{
				dictionary.Add(tab, value: false);
			}
			foreach (ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup in ContextualTabGroups)
			{
				foreach (RibbonTabItem tab2 in contextualTabGroup.Tabs)
				{
					dictionary.Add(tab2, value: false);
				}
			}
			for (int num = _logicalChildren.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = _logicalChildren[num];
				if (obj is RibbonTabItem && !dictionary.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					if (tabsToRemoveAfter == null)
					{
						_logicalChildren.RemoveAt(num);
						RemoveLogicalChild(obj);
					}
					else
					{
						tabsToRemoveAfter.Add(obj as RibbonTabItem);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary[obj] = true;
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, bool> item in dictionary)
			{
				if (!item.Value)
				{
					AddLogicalChildHelper(item.Key);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveLogicalChildHelper(object oldChild)
		{
			if (oldChild != null)
			{
				_logicalChildren.Remove(oldChild);
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldChild);
			}
		}

		internal void RemovePendingToolRegistration(FrameworkElement tool, bool isRegistering)
		{
			if (_pendingToolRegistrations != null && _pendingToolRegistrations.TryGetValue(tool, out var _))
			{
				_pendingToolRegistrations.Remove(tool);
			}
		}

		private void SetMode(RibbonMode mode)
		{
			SetMode(mode, restoreFocusOnNormal: true);
		}

		private void SetMode(RibbonMode mode, bool restoreFocusOnNormal)
		{
			RibbonMode ribbonMode = _ribbonMode;
			if (mode == ribbonMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ribbonMode = mode;
			SetValue(IsModeSpecialPropertyKey, _ribbonMode != RibbonMode.Normal);
			switch (_ribbonMode)
			{
			case RibbonMode.ActiveItemNavigation:
				if (HasKeyTipManager)
				{
					KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips();
				}
				break;
			case RibbonMode.KeyTipsActive:
				Focus();
				if (IsMinimized)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement;
					if (IsUsingApplicationMenu2010)
					{
						ContentControl applicationMenuSite = ApplicationMenuSite;
						frameworkElement = ((applicationMenuSite != null) ? (applicationMenuSite.Content as ApplicationMenu2010FileTab) : null);
					}
					else
					{
						frameworkElement = ApplicationMenu?.Presenter;
					}
					if (frameworkElement != null)
					{
						frameworkElement.Focus();
					}
					else if (SelectedTab == null)
					{
						SelectNextTab();
					}
				}
				KeyTipManager.ShowKeyTips();
				break;
			case RibbonMode.KeyTipsPending:
				KeyTipManager.ShowKeyTipsAfterDelay();
				break;
			case RibbonMode.Normal:
				SetActiveItem(null);
				if (HasKeyTipManager)
				{
					KeyTipManager.HideKeyTips();
				}
				if (restoreFocusOnNormal)
				{
					TransferFocusOutOfRibbon();
					SetSelectedTabAsFocusElement();
				}
				break;
			}
			CoerceValue(KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigationProperty);
			if (ShouldCaptureMouseForRibbonMode)
			{
				DependencyObject d = Mouse.Captured as DependencyObject;
				if (Mouse.Captured == null || GetRibbon(d) != this)
				{
					Mouse.Capture(this, CaptureMode.SubTree);
				}
			}
			else if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		private void SetSelectedTabAsFocusElement()
		{
			DependencyObject focusScope = FocusManager.GetFocusScope(this);
			if (focusScope != null)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(this) as DependencyObject;
				while (dependencyObject is ContentElement)
				{
					dependencyObject = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (dependencyObject != null && IsAncestorOf(dependencyObject))
				{
					FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(focusScope, SelectedTab);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Rect SubtractThickness(Rect rect, Thickness thickness)
		{
			rect.X += thickness.Left;
			rect.Width -= Math.Min(rect.Width, thickness.Left + thickness.Right);
			rect.Y += thickness.Top;
			rect.Height -= Math.Min(rect.Height, thickness.Top + thickness.Bottom);
			return rect;
		}

		private void UpdateTabsInView()
		{
			List<RibbonTabItem> list = new List<RibbonTabItem>();
			list.AddRange(Tabs);
			foreach (ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup in ContextualTabGroups)
			{
				if (contextualTabGroup.IsVisible)
				{
					list.AddRange(contextualTabGroup.Tabs);
				}
			}
			bool flag = list.Count != _tabsInViewInternal.Count;
			if (!flag)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (list[i] != _tabsInViewInternal[i])
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = true;
				if (list.Count != 0 && _tabsInViewInternal.Count != 0 && SelectedTab != null)
				{
					Dictionary<RibbonTabItem, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<RibbonTabItem, int>();
					for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						dictionary[list[num]] = num;
					}
					if (dictionary.ContainsKey(SelectedTab))
					{
						flag2 = false;
						Dictionary<RibbonTabItem, int> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<RibbonTabItem, int>();
						for (int num2 = _tabsInViewInternal.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
						{
							RibbonTabItem key = _tabsInViewInternal[num2];
							if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
							{
								_tabsInViewInternal.RemoveAt(num2);
							}
							else
							{
								dictionary2[key] = num2;
							}
						}
						int num3 = 0;
						int j = 0;
						for (int count2 = list.Count; j < count2; j++)
						{
							RibbonTabItem ribbonTabItem = list[j];
							if (!dictionary2.TryGetValue(ribbonTabItem, out var value))
							{
								_tabsInViewInternal.Insert(j, ribbonTabItem);
								num3++;
								continue;
							}
							int num4 = num3 + value;
							if (num4 < 0 || num4 >= _tabsInViewInternal.Count || _tabsInViewInternal[num4] != ribbonTabItem)
							{
								num4 = _tabsInViewInternal.IndexOf(ribbonTabItem);
							}
							if (num4 != j)
							{
								_tabsInViewInternal.Move(num4, j);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					_tabsInViewInternal.ReInitialize(list);
				}
			}
			VerifySelectedTab();
		}

		internal static void UpdateThemeResources(string theme, XamRibbon ribbon, RibbonWindowContentHost contentHost)
		{
			string[] groupings = new string[3]
			{
				PrimitivesResourceSet<PrimitivesGeneric.Locator>.Location.Grouping,
				EditorsResourceSet<EditorsGeneric.Locator>.Location.Grouping,
				RibbonResourceSet<RibbonGeneric.Locator>.Location.Grouping
			};
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ribbon;
			if (contentHost != null)
			{
				frameworkElement = contentHost;
				if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(contentHost))
				{
					frameworkElement = contentHost.Parent as FrameworkElement;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (ribbon == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ribbon.Parent is RibbonWindowContentHost ribbonWindowContentHost && ribbonWindowContentHost.Ribbon == ribbon && ribbonWindowContentHost.Parent is IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow && (ribbonWindow.ContentHost == ribbonWindowContentHost || (ribbonWindow.ContentHost == null && ribbonWindow.Window != null && !ribbonWindow.Window.IsInitialized)))
				{
					frameworkElement = ribbonWindow.ContentHost;
					if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(contentHost))
					{
						frameworkElement = ribbonWindow.Window;
					}
				}
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Infragistics.Windows.Themes.ThemeManager.OnThemeChanged(frameworkElement, theme, groupings);
			if (ribbon != null && ribbon.IsInitialized)
			{
				ribbon.InvalidateMeasure();
				if (ribbon == frameworkElement)
				{
					ribbon.UpdateLayout();
				}
			}
			if (frameworkElement != ribbon && frameworkElement.IsInitialized)
			{
				frameworkElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				frameworkElement.UpdateLayout();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyAccentColorResourceDictionary(bool forceRebuildResources)
		{
			ValueSource valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(this, RibbonWindowContentHost.ApplicationAccentColorProperty);
			if (valueSource.BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default && _ribbonWindow != null)
			{
				valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(_ribbonWindow.Window, RibbonWindowContentHost.ApplicationAccentColorProperty);
				if (valueSource.BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default && _ribbonWindow.ContentHost != null)
				{
					valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(_ribbonWindow.ContentHost, RibbonWindowContentHost.ApplicationAccentColorProperty);
				}
			}
			bool flag = IsOffice2013Theme && valueSource.BaseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default;
			bool flag2 = _accentColorResourceDictionary != null;
			if (flag != flag2 || forceRebuildResources)
			{
				ResourceDictionary accentColorResourceDictionary = _accentColorResourceDictionary;
				_accentColorResourceDictionary = null;
				if (flag2)
				{
					base.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Remove(accentColorResourceDictionary);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = CreateOffice2013AccentResources();
					int index = ((base.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Count > 0 && Infragistics.Windows.Themes.ThemeManager.GetAppliedThemeDictionary(this) == base.Resources.MergedDictionaries[0]) ? 1 : 0);
					_accentColorResourceDictionary = resourceDictionary;
					base.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Insert(index, resourceDictionary);
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyApplicationMenuMode()
		{
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) && DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(this, ApplicationMenuModeProperty).BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default && _applicationMenu2010 != null && _applicationMenu2010.Items.Count != 0)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(ApplicationMenuModeProperty, ApplicationMenuMode.Office2010);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyApplicationMenuSite()
		{
			if (_applicationMenuSite != null && _applicationMenuSite.TemplatedParent != null)
			{
				if (ApplicationMenuMode == ApplicationMenuMode.Office2007)
				{
					_applicationMenuSite.Content = ApplicationMenu;
				}
				else if (!(_applicationMenuSite.Content is ApplicationMenu2010FileTab))
				{
					_applicationMenuSite.Content = new ApplicationMenu2010FileTab();
				}
				CoerceValue(AutoHideEnabledProperty);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyGroupIsRegistered(RibbonGroup group, string id)
		{
			RibbonGroup value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				group.Id = ToolInstanceManager.GetNewId();
			}
			else if (_registeredGroups.TryGetValue(id, out value))
			{
				if (value != group && group.CloneFromGroup != value)
				{
					RibbonGroup ribbonGroup = value.GetValue(RibbonGroup.ReplacedByGroupProperty) as RibbonGroup;
					if (ribbonGroup != group)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(GetString("LE_GroupRegisteredWithSameId", id));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_registeredGroups.Add(id, group);
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyHighContrast(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbon xamRibbon = (XamRibbon)d;
			xamRibbon.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.DataBind, new MethodInvoker(xamRibbon.VerifyHighContrast));
		}

		internal void VerifyHighContrast()
		{
			bool value = true.Equals(GetValue(IsSystemHighContrastProperty)) || (GetValue(ControlColorProperty).Equals(Colors.Black) && GetValue(ControlTextColorProperty).Equals(Colors.White)) || (GetValue(ControlColorProperty).Equals(Colors.White) && GetValue(ControlTextColorProperty).Equals(Colors.Black));
			SetValue(IsInHighContrastModePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(value));
		}

		private void VerifyIsGlassCaptionGlowVisible()
		{
			bool value = false;
			if (_ribbonWindow != null && GetIsGlassActive(this))
			{
				Version version = Environment.OSVersion.Version;
				if (version.Major >= 7 || version.Minor > 0)
				{
					value = true;
				}
				else if (_ribbonWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Normal)
				{
					value = true;
				}
			}
			SetValue(IsGlassCaptionGlowVisiblePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FromValue(value));
		}

		private void VerifyParts()
		{
			object[] array = new object[_logicalChildren.Count];
			_logicalChildren.CopyTo(array, 0);
			object[] array2 = array;
			foreach (object obj in array2)
			{
				using (new TempValueReplacement(obj as DependencyObject, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty))
				{
					RemoveLogicalChildHelper(obj);
					if (!(obj is DependencyObject) || LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(obj as DependencyObject) == null)
					{
						AddLogicalChildHelper(obj);
					}
				}
			}
			ApplicationMenu applicationMenu = ApplicationMenu;
			using (new TempValueReplacement(applicationMenu, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty))
			{
				bool flag = applicationMenu?.IsLoaded ?? false;
				if (flag)
				{
					RemoveLogicalChildHelper(applicationMenu);
				}
				if (_applicationMenuSite != null && _applicationMenuSite.Content == applicationMenu)
				{
					_applicationMenuSite.Content = null;
				}
				if (_applicationMenuSite != null)
				{
					_applicationMenuSite.Loaded -= OnApplicationMenuSiteLoaded;
				}
				_applicationMenuSite = GetTemplateChild("PART_ApplicationMenuSite") as ContentControl;
				if (flag)
				{
					AddLogicalChildHelper(applicationMenu);
				}
				if (_applicationMenuSite != null && _applicationMenuSite.Content == null && ApplicationMenuMode == ApplicationMenuMode.Office2007)
				{
					if (_applicationMenuSite.IsLoaded || applicationMenu == null || !applicationMenu.IsLoaded)
					{
						_applicationMenuSite.Content = applicationMenu;
					}
					else
					{
						_applicationMenuSite.Loaded += OnApplicationMenuSiteLoaded;
					}
				}
			}
			if (_ribbonTabControlSite != null && _ribbonTabControlSite.Content == RibbonTabControl)
			{
				_ribbonTabControlSite.Content = null;
			}
			if (_ribbonTabControlSite != null)
			{
				_ribbonTabControlSite.Loaded -= OnTabControlSiteLoaded;
			}
			_ribbonTabControlSite = GetTemplateChild("PART_RibbonTabControlSite") as ContentControl;
			if (_ribbonTabControlSite != null && _ribbonTabControlSite.Content == null)
			{
				if (_ribbonTabControlSite.IsLoaded || _ribbonTabControl == null || !_ribbonTabControl.IsLoaded)
				{
					_ribbonTabControlSite.Content = RibbonTabControl;
				}
				else
				{
					_ribbonTabControlSite.Loaded += OnTabControlSiteLoaded;
				}
			}
			using (new TempValueReplacement(QuickAccessToolbar, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty))
			{
				bool flag2 = QuickAccessToolbar != null && QuickAccessToolbar.IsLoaded;
				if (flag2)
				{
					RemoveLogicalChildInternal(QuickAccessToolbar);
				}
				if (_captionPanel != null)
				{
					_captionPanel.QuickAccessToolbar = null;
				}
				_captionPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_RibbonCaptionPanel") as RibbonCaptionPanel;
				if (_quickAccessToolbarBottomSite != null)
				{
					_quickAccessToolbarBottomSite.Content = null;
				}
				_quickAccessToolbarBottomSite = GetTemplateChild("PART_QuickAccessToolbarBottomSite") as ContentControl;
				if (flag2)
				{
					AddLogicalChildInternal(QuickAccessToolbar);
				}
			}
			VerifyQatLocation();
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_XamRibbonCaption") is FrameworkElement source)
			{
				SetBinding(CaptionHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(CaptionHeightProperty);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyQatLocation()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = QuickAccessToolbar;
			bool flag = QuickAccessToolbarLocation == QuickAccessToolbarLocation.AboveRibbon;
			if (quickAccessToolbar.IsBelowRibbon == flag)
			{
				quickAccessToolbar.SetValue(QuickAccessToolbar.IsBelowRibbonPropertyKey, !quickAccessToolbar.IsBelowRibbon);
			}
			CalculateMargins();
			if ((flag && _captionPanel != null && _captionPanel.QuickAccessToolbar == quickAccessToolbar) || (!flag && _quickAccessToolbarBottomSite != null && _quickAccessToolbarBottomSite.Content == quickAccessToolbar))
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (flag ? ((FrameworkElement)_captionPanel) : ((FrameworkElement)_quickAccessToolbarBottomSite));
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = ((frameworkElement != null && !frameworkElement.IsLoaded) ? frameworkElement : null);
			if (frameworkElement2 != _qatTargetPendingLoad)
			{
				if (_qatTargetPendingLoad != null)
				{
					_qatTargetPendingLoad.Loaded -= OnQatTargetLoaded;
				}
				_qatTargetPendingLoad = frameworkElement2;
				if (_qatTargetPendingLoad != null)
				{
					_qatTargetPendingLoad.Loaded += OnQatTargetLoaded;
				}
			}
			if (_qatTargetPendingLoad != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SuspendToolRegistration();
			try
			{
				if (flag && _quickAccessToolbarBottomSite != null)
				{
					_quickAccessToolbarBottomSite.Content = null;
				}
				else if (!flag && _captionPanel != null)
				{
					_captionPanel.QuickAccessToolbar = null;
				}
				if (!flag && _quickAccessToolbarBottomSite != null)
				{
					_quickAccessToolbarBottomSite.Content = quickAccessToolbar;
				}
				else if (flag && _captionPanel != null)
				{
					_captionPanel.QuickAccessToolbar = quickAccessToolbar;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeToolRegistration();
			}
		}

		private void WireTopLevelVisual()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((_ribbonWindow != null) ? _ribbonWindow.Window : null);
			if (frameworkElement == null && base.IsLoaded)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = this;
				while (dependencyObject != null)
				{
					dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
					if (dependencyObject is FrameworkElement)
					{
						frameworkElement = dependencyObject as FrameworkElement;
					}
				}
			}
			if (frameworkElement != _topLevelVisual)
			{
				if (_topLevelVisual != null)
				{
					_topLevelVisual.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged -= OnWindowIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewKeyDown -= OnWindowPreviewKeyDown;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewKeyUp -= OnWindowPreviewKeyUp;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewMouseDown -= OnWindowPreviewMouseDown;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewTextInput -= OnWindowPreviewTextInput;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewMouseWheel -= OnWindowPreviewMouseWheel;
				}
				_topLevelVisual = frameworkElement;
				if (_topLevelVisual != null)
				{
					_topLevelVisual.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged += OnWindowIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewKeyDown += OnWindowPreviewKeyDown;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewKeyUp += OnWindowPreviewKeyUp;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewMouseDown += OnWindowPreviewMouseDown;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewTextInput += OnWindowPreviewTextInput;
					_topLevelVisual.PreviewMouseWheel += OnWindowPreviewMouseWheel;
				}
				if (_topLevelVisual != null)
				{
					SetBinding(TopLevelVisualActualHeightProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualHeightProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _topLevelVisual));
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(TopLevelVisualActualHeightProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		bool ICommandHost.CanExecute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return routedCommand.OwnerType == typeof(RibbonCommands);
			}
			return false;
		}

		long ICommandHost.GetCurrentState(long statesToQuery)
		{
			RibbonStates ribbonStates = (RibbonStates)0L;
			FrameworkElement activeItem = ActiveItem;
			if (activeItem != null)
			{
				ribbonStates |= RibbonStates.ActiveItem;
				if (RibbonToolHelper.GetIsOnQat(activeItem))
				{
					ribbonStates |= RibbonStates.ActiveItemOnQat;
				}
				if (GetLocation(activeItem) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar)
				{
					ribbonStates |= RibbonStates.ActiveItemDirectlyOnQat;
				}
			}
			if (AllowMinimize)
			{
				ribbonStates |= RibbonStates.RibbonCanMinimize;
			}
			return (long)ribbonStates & statesToQuery;
		}

		bool ICommandHost.Execute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return ExecuteCommandImpl(routedCommand, commandInfo.Parameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IKeyTipContainer.Deactivate()
		{
		}

		IKeyTip[] IKeyTipContainer.GetKeyTips()
		{
			List<IKeyTip> list = new List<IKeyTip>();
			foreach (RibbonTabItem tab in Tabs)
			{
				list.Add(tab);
			}
			foreach (ContextualTabGroup contextualTabGroup in ContextualTabGroups)
			{
				foreach (RibbonTabItem tab2 in contextualTabGroup.Tabs)
				{
					list.Add(tab2);
				}
			}
			QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = QuickAccessToolbar;
			if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(quickAccessToolbar.GetKeyTipProviders(bumpedToolsOnly: false));
			}
			TabItemAreaToolbar tabItemAreaToolbar = TabItemAreaToolbar;
			if (tabItemAreaToolbar != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(tabItemAreaToolbar.GetKeyTipProviders(bumpedToolsOnly: false));
			}
			if (ApplicationMenuMode == ApplicationMenuMode.Office2007)
			{
				ApplicationMenu applicationMenu = ApplicationMenu;
				if (applicationMenu != null)
				{
					RibbonToolProxy toolProxy = ((IRibbonTool)applicationMenu).ToolProxy;
					if (toolProxy != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(toolProxy.GetKeyTipProviders(applicationMenu));
					}
				}
			}
			else if (IsUsingApplicationMenu2010)
			{
				ApplicationMenu2010 applicationMenu2 = ApplicationMenu2010;
				if (applicationMenu2 != null)
				{
					list.Add(applicationMenu2.KeyTipProvider);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class ToolsNotInRibbonCollection : ObservableCollectionExtended<FrameworkElement>
	{
		private XamRibbon _ribbon;

		protected override bool NotifyItemsChanged => true;

		internal ToolsNotInRibbonCollection(XamRibbon ribbon)
		{
			_ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		protected override void OnItemAdded(FrameworkElement itemAdded)
		{
			base.OnItemAdded(itemAdded);
			if (itemAdded != null)
			{
				itemAdded.SetValue(XamRibbon.IsInToolsNotInRibbonProperty, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				_ribbon.AddLogicalChildInternal(itemAdded);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(FrameworkElement itemRemoved)
		{
			base.OnItemRemoved(itemRemoved);
			if (itemRemoved != null)
			{
				itemRemoved.ClearValue(XamRibbon.IsInToolsNotInRibbonProperty);
				_ribbon.RemoveLogicalChildInternal(itemRemoved);
			}
		}
	}

		internal System.Windows.Size LogicalBorderSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsOffice2013Theme)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(1), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(1));
				}
				if (UseHwndBorderSize)
				{
					return NativeWindowMethods.GetHwndBorderSize(this);
				}
				return base.ResizeMode switch
				{
					ResizeMode.NoResize => new System.Windows.Size(SystemParameters.FixedFrameVerticalBorderWidth, SystemParameters.FixedFrameHorizontalBorderHeight), 
					_ => new System.Windows.Size(SystemParameters.ResizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth, SystemParameters.ResizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight), 
				};
			}
		}

		private MinimizedRenderMode MinimizedRenderMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.ShowInTaskbar && NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(this) == WindowState.Minimized)
				{
					if (IsOffice2013Theme)
					{
						return MinimizedRenderMode.CustomRender;
					}
					return MinimizedRenderMode.OSRender;
				}
				return MinimizedRenderMode.None;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size NonClientSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsOffice2013Theme)
				{
					double num = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(1);
					return new System.Windows.Size(num * 2.0, num * 2.0);
				}
				if (MinimizedRenderMode == MinimizedRenderMode.CustomRender)
				{
					return default(System.Windows.Size);
				}
				if (UseHwndBorderSize)
				{
					System.Windows.Size hwndBorderSize = NativeWindowMethods.GetHwndBorderSize(this);
					return new System.Windows.Size(hwndBorderSize.Width * 2.0, hwndBorderSize.Height);
				}
				if (base.ResizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResize || base.ResizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(2.0 * SystemParameters.ResizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth, SystemParameters.ResizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight);
				}
				return new System.Windows.Size(2.0 * SystemParameters.FixedFrameVerticalBorderWidth, SystemParameters.FixedFrameHorizontalBorderHeight);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size Office2013CaptionButtonSize
		{
			get
			{
				double num = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(10.0, this);
				int pixelValue;
				int pixelValue2;
				if (num > 14.0)
				{
					pixelValue = 37;
					pixelValue2 = 30;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(num > 11.0))
					{
						return new System.Windows.Size(29.0, 22.0);
					}
					pixelValue = 33;
					pixelValue2 = 26;
				}
				return new System.Windows.Size(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(pixelValue, this), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(pixelValue2, this));
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			MinimizedRenderMode minimizedRenderMode = MinimizedRenderMode;
			if (IsOffice2013Theme && minimizedRenderMode != MinimizedRenderMode.CustomRender)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			}
			if (VisualChildrenCount > 0)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = arrangeBounds;
				if (minimizedRenderMode == MinimizedRenderMode.CustomRender)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.RECT lpRect = default(NativeWindowMethods.RECT);
					NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowRect(new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle, ref lpRect);
					size = new System.Windows.Size(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(lpRect.Width, this), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(lpRect.Height, this));
					arrangeBounds.Width = size.Width;
					arrangeBounds.Height = size.Height;
				}
				if (IsGlassActiveInternal)
				{
					System.Windows.Size nonClientSize = NonClientSize;
					size.Height = Math.Max(arrangeBounds.Height - nonClientSize.Height, 0.0);
					size.Width = Math.Max(arrangeBounds.Width - nonClientSize.Width, 0.0);
				}
				else if (base.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized && _contentHost != null && _contentHost.StatusBar != null && _contentHost.StatusBar.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					size.Height = Math.Max(0.0, size.Height - LogicalBorderSize.Height);
				}
				if (!(GetVisualChild(0) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidRibbonWindowRootElement"));
				}
				frameworkElement.Arrange(new Rect(size));
				if (base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					frameworkElement.LayoutTransform = new MatrixTransform(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, arrangeBounds.Width, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					frameworkElement.LayoutTransform = null;
				}
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			MinimizedRenderMode minimizedRenderMode = MinimizedRenderMode;
			if (IsOffice2013Theme && minimizedRenderMode != MinimizedRenderMode.CustomRender)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			if (VisualChildrenCount > 0 && GetVisualChild(0) is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = default(System.Windows.Size);
				System.Windows.Size size2 = availableSize;
				EnforceMinMax(ref size2);
				if (minimizedRenderMode == MinimizedRenderMode.CustomRender)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.RECT lpRect = default(NativeWindowMethods.RECT);
					NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowRect(new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle, ref lpRect);
					size2 = new System.Windows.Size(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(lpRect.Width, this), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(lpRect.Height, this));
				}
				if (IsGlassActiveInternal)
				{
					size = NonClientSize;
					if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(size2.Width))
					{
						size2.Width = Math.Max(size2.Width - size.Width, 0.0);
					}
					if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(size2.Height))
					{
						size2.Height = Math.Max(size2.Height - size.Height, 0.0);
					}
				}
				else if (base.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized && _contentHost != null && _contentHost.StatusBar != null && _contentHost.StatusBar.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					size2.Height = Math.Max(0.0, size2.Height - LogicalBorderSize.Height);
				}
				uIElement.Measure(size2);
				System.Windows.Size size3 = uIElement.DesiredSize;
				size3.Width += size.Width;
				size3.Height += size.Height;
				EnforceMinMax(ref size3);
				if (minimizedRenderMode == MinimizedRenderMode.CustomRender)
				{
					size3 = size2;
				}
				return size3;
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		{

				SetBinding(ResizeGripWidthProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
			}
			else

				ClearValue(ResizeGripWidthProperty);
				ClearValue(ResizeGripVisibilityProperty);
			}
		}
