		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (_contentHost == null || IsGlassActiveInternal || base.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsOffice2013Theme)
			{
				dc.DrawRectangle(base.Background, null, new Rect(base.RenderSize));
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ((!base.IsActive) ? OuterBrush : OuterBrushActive);
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = base.RenderSize;
			Rect rect = new Rect(renderSize);
			if (_contentClip != null)
			{
				Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
				geometry = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, geometry, _contentClip);
				geometry.Freeze();
				dc.PushClip(geometry);
			}
			dc.DrawRectangle(brush, null, rect);
			if (IsScenicTheme)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = ((!base.IsActive) ? OuterShadowBrush : OuterShadowBrushActive);
				if (brush2 != null && brush2 != brush)
				{
					Geometry geometry2 = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
					Geometry geometry3 = new RectangleGeometry(Rect.Offset(rect, -1.0, -1.0));
					geometry2 = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, geometry2, geometry3);
					geometry2.Freeze();
					dc.PushClip(geometry2);
					dc.DrawRectangle(brush2, null, rect);
					dc.Pop();
				}
			}
			if (_contentClip != null)
			{
				dc.Pop();
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnSourceInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_contentHost == null)
			{
				base.OnSourceInitialized(e);
				return;
			}
			if (IsOffice2013Theme)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			IntPtr handle = windowInteropHelper.Handle;
			HwndSource hwndSource = HwndSource.FromHwnd(handle);
			hwndSource.AddHook(HookProc);
			UpdateWindowBorders();
			ExtendGlassIntoClientArea();
			SynchronizeCaptionInformation();
			UpdateWindowClipRegion();
			NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(handle, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 0, 0, 567);
			base.OnSourceInitialized(e);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, new XamRibbon.MethodInvoker(SynchronizeCaptionInformation));
		}

		internal void InitializeContentHost(RibbonWindowContentHost contentHost)
		{
			if (_contentHost != null && _contentClip != null)
			{
				_contentClip = null;
				_contentHost.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
			}
			_contentHost = contentHost;
			SetValue(ContenHostPropertyKey, _contentHost);
			SynchronizeIsScenicTheme();
			SynchronizeIsGlassActive();
			ExtendGlassIntoClientArea();
			SynchronizeCaptionInformation();
		}

		internal void OnResizeWindowDestroyed(ExternalResizeWindow resizeWindow)
		{
			if (_externalResizeWindows != null)
			{
				int num = Array.IndexOf(_externalResizeWindows, resizeWindow);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					_externalResizeWindows[num] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private IntPtr CallWndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled, int excludedBits)
		{
			return CallWndProc(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam, ref handled, excludedBits, ignoreAllMessages: true, onlyRestoreRemovedBits: false);
		}

		private IntPtr CallWndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled, int excludedBits, bool ignoreAllMessages, bool onlyRestoreRemovedBits)
		{
			IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, -16);
			int bitsRemoved;
			IntPtr intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(windowLong, excludedBits, out bitsRemoved);
			if (intPtr != windowLong)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, -16, intPtr);
			}
			IntPtr result = CallWndProc(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam, ref handled, ignoreAllMessages);
			if (intPtr != windowLong)
			{
				if (!onlyRestoreRemovedBits)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, -16, windowLong);
				}
				else
				{
					IntPtr windowLong2 = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, -16);
					IntPtr dwNewLong = NativeWindowMethods.AddBits(windowLong2, bitsRemoved);
					NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, -16, dwNewLong);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private IntPtr CallWndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			return CallWndProc(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam, ref handled, ignoreAllMessages: true);
		}

		private IntPtr CallWndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled, bool ignoreAllMessages)
		{
			bool flag = isInMessageLoop;
			IntPtr result = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				if (!ignoreAllMessages)
				{
					CallWndProcMessages.Add(message);
				}
				else
				{
					isInMessageLoop = true;
				}
				result = NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!ignoreAllMessages)
				{
					CallWndProcMessages.Remove(message);
				}
				else
				{
					isInMessageLoop = flag;
				}
			}
			handled = true;
			return result;
		}

		private void DrawOffice2013NonClientBorders(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr wParam, bool drawAsActive)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			Graphics graphics = null;
			System.Drawing.Pen pen = null;
			try
			{
				intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowDC(hwnd);
				NativeWindowMethods.RECT lpRect = default(NativeWindowMethods.RECT);
				NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowRect(hwnd, ref lpRect);
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					graphics = Graphics.FromHdc(intPtr);
					System.Windows.Media.Color color = ((!drawAsActive) ? System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(131, 131, 131) : RibbonWindowContentHost.GetApplicationAccentColor(this));
					System.Drawing.Color color2 = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(color.R, color.G, color.B);
					Rectangle rect = lpRect.Rect;
					rect.X = 0;
					rect.Y = 0;
					rect.Width--;
					rect.Height--;
					pen = new System.Drawing.Pen(color2);
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Left, rect.Top), new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Right, rect.Top));
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Right, rect.Top), new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom));
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom), new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom));
					graphics.DrawLine(pen, new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), new System.Drawing.Point(rect.Left, rect.Top));
					pen.Dispose();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics?.Dispose();
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.ReleaseDC(hwnd, intPtr);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ExtendGlassIntoClientArea()
		{
			if (!IsGlassActiveInternal || _contentHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
			if (!(handle == IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				HwndTarget compositionTarget = HwndSource.FromHwnd(handle).CompositionTarget;
				originalBackgroundColor = compositionTarget.BackgroundColor;
				compositionTarget.BackgroundColor = Colors.Transparent;
				double num = 0.0;
				if (!_contentHost.IsScenicTheme && _contentHost.UseScenicApplicationMenuInternal)
				{
					num = Math.Ceiling((double)_contentHost.GetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.TabHeaderHeightProperty));
				}
				int top = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(_contentHost.CaptionHeightResolved + num, this);
				NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS pMargins = new NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS(0, 0, top, 0);
				haveExtendedGlass = NativeWindowMethods.DwmExtendFrameIntoClientAreaApi(handle, ref pMargins) == 0;
				if (!haveExtendedGlass)
				{
					compositionTarget.BackgroundColor = originalBackgroundColor;
				}
			}
		}

		private ImageSource GetDefaultIcon()
		{
			WindowInteropHelper windowInteropHelper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
			return GetDefaultIcon(windowInteropHelper.Handle);
		}

		private static ImageSource GetDefaultIcon(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			if (hwnd == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IntPtr zero = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				zero = NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(hwnd, 127, new IntPtr(2), IntPtr.Zero);
				if (zero == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					zero = NativeWindowMethods.GetClassLongPtr(hwnd, -34);
				}
				if (zero == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					zero = NativeWindowMethods.LoadImageApi(IntPtr.Zero, 32512, 1u, (int)SystemParameters.SmallIconWidth, (int)SystemParameters.SmallIconHeight, 32768u);

		private void GetStandardNonClientExtents(out double frameBorderWidth, out double frameBorderHeight)
		{

		private void EnforceMinMax(ref System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size2 = new System.Windows.Size(base.MinWidth, base.MinHeight);
			System.Windows.Size size3 = new System.Windows.Size(base.MaxWidth, base.MaxHeight);
			System.Windows.Size size4;
			System.Windows.Size size5;
			if (_hasMinMax)
			{
				size4 = new System.Windows.Size(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(_minTrackSizeX, this), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(_minTrackSizeY, this));
				size5 = new System.Windows.Size(Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(_maxTrackSizeX, this), Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(_maxTrackSizeY, this));
			}
			else
			{
				size4 = new System.Windows.Size(SystemParameters.MinimumWindowTrackWidth, SystemParameters.MinimumWindowTrackHeight);
				size5 = new System.Windows.Size(SystemParameters.MaximumWindowTrackWidth, SystemParameters.MaximumWindowTrackHeight);
			}
			size4.Width = Math.Max(size2.Width, size4.Width);
			size4.Height = Math.Max(size2.Height, size4.Height);
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(size3.Width) && size3.Width < size5.Width)
			{
				size5.Width = size3.Width;
			}
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(size3.Height) && size3.Height < size5.Height)
			{
				size5.Height = size3.Height;
			}
			size5.Width = Math.Max(size5.Width, size4.Width);
			size5.Height = Math.Max(size5.Height, size4.Height);
			size.Width = Math.Max(size4.Width, Math.Min(size5.Width, size.Width));
			size.Height = Math.Max(size4.Height, Math.Min(size5.Height, size.Height));
		}

		private static void OnCanExecuteCommand(object target, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!(target is XamRibbonWindow xamRibbonWindow))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.Command == MaximizeCommand)
			{
				args.CanExecute = xamRibbonWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Maximized && xamRibbonWindow.ResizeMode != ResizeMode.CanMinimize;
				if (args.CanExecute && NativeWindowMethods.IsWindowStyleRemoved(xamRibbonWindow, 65536))
				{
					args.CanExecute = false;
				}
			}
			else if (args.Command == MinimizeCommand)
			{
				args.CanExecute = xamRibbonWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Minimized;
				if (args.CanExecute && NativeWindowMethods.IsWindowStyleRemoved(xamRibbonWindow, 131072))
				{
					args.CanExecute = false;
				}
			}
			else if (args.Command == RestoreCommand)
			{
				args.CanExecute = xamRibbonWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Normal && xamRibbonWindow.ResizeMode != ResizeMode.CanMinimize;
				if (args.CanExecute && NativeWindowMethods.IsWindowStyleRemoved(xamRibbonWindow, (xamRibbonWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized) ? 65536 : 131072))
				{
					args.CanExecute = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (args.Command != CloseCommand)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!NativeWindowMethods.PreventClose(xamRibbonWindow))
				{
					args.CanExecute = true;
				}
				else
				{
					args.CanExecute = false;
				}
			}
			args.Handled = true;
		}

		private static void OnExecuteCommand(object target, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (target is XamRibbonWindow xamRibbonWindow)
			{
				if (args.Command == MaximizeCommand)
				{
					xamRibbonWindow.WindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
					args.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (args.Command == MinimizeCommand)
				{
					xamRibbonWindow.WindowState = WindowState.Minimized;
					args.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (args.Command == RestoreCommand)
				{
					xamRibbonWindow.WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
					args.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (args.Command == CloseCommand)
				{
					xamRibbonWindow.Close();
					args.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnIconChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbonWindow xamRibbonWindow = (XamRibbonWindow)d;
			if (xamRibbonWindow._contentHost != null)
			{
				xamRibbonWindow._contentHost.SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.IconResolvedPropertyKey, xamRibbonWindow.GetDefaultIcon());
			}
		}

			VerifyExternalResizeWindows();
		}

		private static void OnWindowStateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamRibbonWindow xamRibbonWindow = (XamRibbonWindow)d;
			if (!xamRibbonWindow.IsGlassActiveInternal && !WindowState.Minimized.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				xamRibbonWindow.InvalidateVisual();
			}
			if (xamRibbonWindow._contentHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XamRibbon ribbon = xamRibbonWindow._contentHost.Ribbon;
			MinimizedRenderMode minimizedRenderMode = xamRibbonWindow.MinimizedRenderMode;
			xamRibbonWindow._contentHost.IsRenderingMinimizedWindow = minimizedRenderMode != MinimizedRenderMode.None;
			xamRibbonWindow._contentHost.CalculateMargins();
			xamRibbonWindow._contentHost.BumpCaptionButtonVersion();
			ribbon?.OnWindowStateChanged();
			if (!WindowState.Minimized.Equals(e.OldValue) && !WindowState.Minimized.Equals(e.NewValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(xamRibbonWindow).Handle;
			if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPosApi(handle, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 0, 0, 567);
				if (!xamRibbonWindow.ShowInTaskbar)
				{
					xamRibbonWindow.UpdateWindowClipRegion();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshCaptionButtonAreaWidth(IntPtr windowHandle)
		{
			if (_contentHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsGlassActiveInternal)
			{
				if (windowHandle == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return;
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.TITLEBARINFOEX lparam = default(NativeWindowMethods.TITLEBARINFOEX);
				lparam.rgstate = new uint[6];
				lparam.rgrect = new NativeWindowMethods.RECT[6];
				lparam.cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf((object)lparam);
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(windowHandle, 831, IntPtr.Zero, ref lparam);
				Rectangle rect = lparam.rgrect[2].Rect;
				Rectangle rect2 = lparam.rgrect[3].Rect;
				Rectangle rect3 = lparam.rgrect[4].Rect;
				Rectangle rect4 = lparam.rgrect[5].Rect;
				Rectangle rectangle = UnionRects(rect, rect2, rect4);
				if (rectangle.Width > 0 && rectangle.Height > 0)
				{
					Rectangle rect5 = lparam.rcTitleBar.Rect;
					if (rectangle.Right > rect5.Right)
					{
						rectangle.Width = Math.Max(0, rectangle.Width - (rectangle.Right - rect5.Right));
					}
					if (rectangle.X < rect5.X)
					{
						rectangle.X = rect5.X;
					}
				}
				if (rectangle.Width > 0 && rectangle.Height > 0)
				{
					double num = Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(rectangle.Width, this);
					_contentHost.SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.CaptionButtonAreaWidthPropertyKey, num);
				}
			}
			else if (IsOffice2013Theme)
			{
				_contentHost.SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.CaptionButtonAreaWidthPropertyKey, Office2013CaptionButtonSize.Width * 3.0);
			}
			else if (Environment.OSVersion.Version.Major > 5)
			{
				_contentHost.SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.CaptionButtonAreaWidthPropertyKey, 96.0);
			}
			else
			{
				_contentHost.SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.CaptionButtonAreaWidthPropertyKey, SystemParameters.WindowCaptionButtonWidth * 3.0);
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshCaptionButtonHeight()
		{
			if (_contentHost != null)

				if (!IsGlassActiveInternal)

				}
				else if (IsOffice2013Theme)

				}
				else

					_contentHost.ClearValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.CaptionButtonHeightPropertyKey);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseExternalResizeWindows()
		{
			if (_externalResizeWindows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ExternalResizeWindow[] externalResizeWindows = _externalResizeWindows;
			for (int i = 0; i < _externalResizeWindows.Length; i++)
			{
				_externalResizeWindows[i]?.Close();
				if (externalResizeWindows != _externalResizeWindows)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			_externalResizeWindows = null;
		}

		private void RemoveGlassFromClientArea()
		{
			if (haveExtendedGlass)
			{
				IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
				if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					HwndSource.FromHwnd(handle).CompositionTarget.BackgroundColor = originalBackgroundColor;
					NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS pMargins = default(NativeWindowMethods.MARGINS);
					haveExtendedGlass = NativeWindowMethods.DwmExtendFrameIntoClientAreaApi(handle, ref pMargins) != 0;
				}
				else
				{
					haveExtendedGlass = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SendMessageWithoutBits(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, int excludedBits)
		{
			IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(hwnd, -16);
			IntPtr intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(windowLong, excludedBits);
			if (intPtr != windowLong)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, -16, intPtr);
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
			if (intPtr != windowLong)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(hwnd, -16, windowLong);
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeCaptionInformation()
		{
			IntPtr windowHandle = IntPtr.Zero;

			{
				windowHandle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
			}
			RefreshCaptionButtonAreaWidth(windowHandle);
			RefreshCaptionButtonHeight();
			RefreshCaptionButtonWidth();
			if (_contentHost != null)
			{
				_contentHost.SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.IconResolvedPropertyKey, GetDefaultIcon());
			}
			VerifyExternalResizeWindows();
		}

		internal void SynchronizeIsGlassActive()
		{
			SynchronizeIsOffice2013Theme();
			bool isGlassActiveInternal = IsGlassActiveInternal;
			SetValue(IsGlassActivePropertyKey, isGlassActiveInternal);
			UpdateWindowBorders();
		}

		internal void SynchronizeIsOffice2013Theme()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (_contentHost != null)
			{
				flag = _contentHost.Ribbon?.IsOffice2013ThemeInternal ?? _contentHost.IsOffice2013ThemeStandalone;
				_contentHost.IsOffice2013Theme = flag;
			}
			if (!_cachedIsOffice2013Theme.HasValue || _cachedIsOffice2013Theme.Value != flag || _contentHost == null)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
				InvalidateArrange();
				_cachedIsOffice2013Theme = flag;
				if (flag)
				{
					SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.IsOffice2013ThemePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.IsOffice2013ThemePropertyKey);
				}
				if (_contentHost != null)
				{
					_contentHost.IsOffice2013Theme = flag;
				}
				SynchronizeCaptionInformation();
				if (IsGlassActiveInternal)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, new Action(SynchronizeCaptionInformation));
				}
				VerifyExternalResizeWindows();
			}
		}

		internal void SynchronizeIsScenicTheme()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (_contentHost != null)
			{
				flag = _contentHost.Ribbon?.IsScenicThemeInternal ?? ((bool)_contentHost.GetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.IsScenicThemeInternalProperty));
				_contentHost.IsScenicTheme = IsScenicTheme;
			}
			if (_cachedIsScenicTheme.HasValue && _cachedIsScenicTheme.Value == flag && _contentHost != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_cachedIsScenicTheme = flag;
			if (flag)
			{
				SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.IsScenicThemePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.IsScenicThemePropertyKey);
			}
			if (_contentHost != null)
			{
				_contentHost.IsScenicTheme = flag;
				if (flag)
				{
					SetResourceReference(OuterBrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicWindowBorderOuterBrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(OuterBrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicActiveWindowBorderOuterBrushKey);
				}
				else
				{
					SetResourceReference(OuterBrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.WindowBorderOuterBrushKey);
					SetResourceReference(OuterBrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ActiveWindowBorderOuterBrushKey);
				}
				SetResourceReference(OuterShadowBrushProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicWindowBorderOuterShadowBrushKey);
				SetResourceReference(OuterShadowBrushActiveProperty, RibbonBrushKeys.ScenicActiveWindowBorderOuterShadowBrushKey);
			}
			UpdateWindowBorders();
		}

		private static Rectangle UnionRects(params Rectangle[] rects)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < rects.Length; i++)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle2 = rects[i];
				if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty)
				{
					rectangle = ((!rectangle.IsEmpty) ? Rectangle.Union(rectangle2, rectangle) : rectangle2);
				}
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		private void UpdateWindowBorders()
		{
			if (_contentHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Thickness thickness = default(Thickness);
			if (ResizeGripVisibility != Visibility.Collapsed && !double.IsNaN(ResizeGripWidth))
			{
				thickness.Right = ResizeGripWidth;
			}
			WindowState windowState = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(this);
			if (IsOffice2013Theme)
			{
				if (base.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
				{
					GetStandardNonClientExtents(out var frameBorderWidth, out var frameBorderHeight);
					_contentHost.BorderThickness = new Thickness(frameBorderWidth, frameBorderHeight, frameBorderWidth, frameBorderHeight);
				}
				else
				{
					_contentHost.BorderThickness = default(Thickness);
				}
			}
			else if (IsGlassActiveInternal)
			{
				_contentHost.BorderThickness = default(Thickness);
			}
			else
			{
				System.Windows.Size logicalBorderSize = LogicalBorderSize;
				double top = ((!IsScenicTheme) ? 1 : 2);
				_contentHost.BorderThickness = new Thickness(logicalBorderSize.Width, top, logicalBorderSize.Width, logicalBorderSize.Height);
				if (!_contentHost.UseScenicApplicationMenuInternal)
				{
					thickness.Left += logicalBorderSize.Width;
					thickness.Right += logicalBorderSize.Width;
				}
			}
			_contentHost.SetValue(RibbonWindowContentHost.StatusBarPaddingPropertyKey, thickness);
			_contentHost.CalculateMargins();
			Thickness statusBarAreaMargin = _contentHost.StatusBarAreaMargin;
			SetValue(ResizeGripMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, statusBarAreaMargin.Right, statusBarAreaMargin.Bottom));
			if (_contentHost.Ribbon != null)
			{
				_contentHost.Ribbon.CalculateMargins();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateWindowClipRegion()
		{
			if (_contentHost == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsOffice2013Theme)
			{
				int num = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(base.ActualWidth, this) + 1;
				int num2 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(base.ActualHeight, this) + 1;
				_contentClip = null;
				_contentHost.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
				switch (base.WindowState)
				{
				case WindowState.Normal:
					UpdateWindowClipRegion(NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi(0, 0, num, num2));
					break;
				case WindowState.Maximized:
				{
					IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
					NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWINFO pwi = default(NativeWindowMethods.WINDOWINFO);
					NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowInfo(handle, ref pwi);
					UpdateWindowClipRegion(NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi((int)pwi.cxWindowBorders, (int)pwi.cyWindowBorders, num - (int)(1 + pwi.cxWindowBorders), num2 - (int)(1 + pwi.cyWindowBorders)));
					break;
				}
				}
				InvalidateVisual();
			}
			else if (!IsGlassActiveInternal && MinimizedRenderMode != MinimizedRenderMode.OSRender)
			{
				int num3 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(base.ActualWidth, this) + 1;
				int num4 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(base.ActualHeight, this) + 1;
				System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.StatusBar statusBar = _contentHost.StatusBar;
				WindowState windowState = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowState(this);
				if (windowState == WindowState.Maximized)
				{
					System.Windows.Size logicalBorderSize = LogicalBorderSize;
					int num5 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(logicalBorderSize.Width, this);
					int num6 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(logicalBorderSize.Height, this);
					int num7 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(base.ActualWidth, this);
					int num8 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(base.ActualHeight, this);
					IntPtr newRegion = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi(num5, num6, num7 - num5, num8 - num6);
					UpdateWindowClipRegion(newRegion);
				}
				else
				{
					bool? cachedIsScenicTheme = _cachedIsScenicTheme;
					bool flag = true;
					if (cachedIsScenicTheme == true == flag && cachedIsScenicTheme.HasValue && _contentHost.IsClassicOSTheme)
					{
						UpdateWindowClipRegion(NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi(0, 0, num3, num4));
					}
					else if (statusBar != null && statusBar.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
					{
						IntPtr intPtr;
						if (_cachedIsScenicTheme == false)
						{
							intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRoundRectRgnApi(0, 0, num3, num4, 9, 9);
						}
						else
						{
							IntPtr intPtr2 = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRoundRectRgnApi(0, 0, num3, num4, 9, 9);
							int nTopRect = Math.Max(num4 - 9, 0);
							IntPtr intPtr3 = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi(0, nTopRect, num3, num4);
							intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi(0, 0, 0, 0);
							int num9 = NativeWindowMethods.CombineRgnApi(intPtr, intPtr2, intPtr3, NativeWindowMethods.RegionCombineMode.RGN_OR);
							NativeWindowMethods.DeleteObject(intPtr2);
							NativeWindowMethods.DeleteObject(intPtr3);
						}
						UpdateWindowClipRegion(intPtr);
					}
					else
					{
						int num10 = Utilities.ConvertFromLogicalPixels(_contentHost.CaptionHeightResolved, this);
						int num11 = ((_cachedIsScenicTheme != false) ? 9 : 9);
						IntPtr intPtr4 = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRoundRectRgnApi(0, 0, num3, num10, num11, num11);
						int num12 = 0;
						int num13 = 0;
						switch (base.SizeToContent)
						{
						case SizeToContent.Height:
							num13 = 1;
							break;
						case SizeToContent.Width:
							num12 = 1;
							break;
						case SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight:
							num12 = (num13 = 1);
							break;
						}
						IntPtr intPtr5 = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi(0, num10 - num11, num3 - num12, num4 - num13);
						IntPtr intPtr6 = NativeWindowMethods.CreateRectRegionApi(0, 0, 0, 0);
						int num14 = NativeWindowMethods.CombineRgnApi(intPtr6, intPtr4, intPtr5, NativeWindowMethods.RegionCombineMode.RGN_OR);
						NativeWindowMethods.DeleteObject(intPtr5);
						NativeWindowMethods.DeleteObject(intPtr4);
						UpdateWindowClipRegion(intPtr6);
					}
				}
				Rect rect = new Rect(base.RenderSize);
				if (rect.Width > 4.0 && rect.Height > 4.0 && windowState == WindowState.Normal)
				{
					rect.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
					if (_cachedIsScenicTheme == false)
					{
						_contentClip = new RectangleGeometry(rect, 5.0, 5.0);
					}
					else
					{
						_contentClip = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
					}
					if (_contentHost.StatusBarVisibility != Visibility.Visible)
					{
						Rect rect2 = default(Rect);
						rect2.Width = rect.Width;
						rect2.X = rect.X;
						rect2.Height = Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(4.0, rect.Height / 2.0));
						rect2.Y = rect.Bottom - rect2.Height;
						_contentClip = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Union, _contentClip, new RectangleGeometry(rect2));
					}
					_contentClip.Freeze();
					_contentHost.Clip = _contentClip;
				}
				else
				{
					_contentClip = null;
					_contentHost.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
				}
				InvalidateVisual();
			}
			else
			{
				_contentClip = null;
				_contentHost.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
				UpdateWindowClipRegion(IntPtr.Zero);
				InvalidateVisual();
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void VerifyExternalResizeWindows(bool allowAsync = true)
		{
			HwndSource hwndSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(this) as HwndSource;
			IntPtr intPtr = hwndSource?.Handle ?? IntPtr.Zero;
			if (hwndSource == null || intPtr == IntPtr.Zero || !IsOffice2013Theme || !base.IsEnabled || base.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || base.WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				ReleaseExternalResizeWindows();
				return;
			}
			if (allowAsync)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
				{
					VerifyExternalResizeWindows(allowAsync: false);
				});
				return;
			}
			if (_externalResizeWindows == null)
			{
				_externalResizeWindows = new ExternalResizeWindow[4];
				_externalResizeWindows[0] = new ExternalResizeWindow(this, Dock.Left);
				_externalResizeWindows[1] = new ExternalResizeWindow(this, Dock.Top);
				_externalResizeWindows[2] = new ExternalResizeWindow(this, Dock.Right);
				_externalResizeWindows[3] = new ExternalResizeWindow(this, Dock.Bottom);
			}
			double left = base.Left;
			double top = base.Top;
			double width = base.Width;
			double height = base.Height;
			double resizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight = SystemParameters.ResizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight;
			double resizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth = SystemParameters.ResizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth;
			for (int num = 0; num < _externalResizeWindows.Length; num++)
			{
				ExternalResizeWindow externalResizeWindow = _externalResizeWindows[num];
				if (externalResizeWindow != null && !externalResizeWindow.IsDestroyed)
				{
					switch (externalResizeWindow.Dock)
					{
					default:
						externalResizeWindow.Height = height + resizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight * 2.0;
						externalResizeWindow.Left = left - resizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth;
						externalResizeWindow.Top = top - resizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight;
						break;
					case Dock.Top:
						externalResizeWindow.Width = width + resizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth * 2.0;
						externalResizeWindow.Left = left - resizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth;
						externalResizeWindow.Top = top - resizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight;
						break;
					case Dock.Right:
						externalResizeWindow.Height = height + resizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight * 2.0;
						externalResizeWindow.Left = left + width;
						externalResizeWindow.Top = top - resizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight;
						break;
					case Dock.Bottom:
						externalResizeWindow.Width = width + resizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth * 2.0;
						externalResizeWindow.Left = left - resizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth;
						externalResizeWindow.Top = top + height;
						break;
					}
					if (!externalResizeWindow.IsVisible)
					{
						externalResizeWindow.Show();
					}
				}
			}
			VerifyExternalResizeWindowZOrder(invalidate: false);
		}

		private void VerifyExternalResizeWindowZOrder(bool invalidate)
		{
			if (_externalResizeWindows == null || !(PresentationSource.FromVisual(this) is HwndSource { Handle: var handle }) || !(handle != IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				return;
			}
			IntPtr hwndAfter = handle;
			for (int i = 0; i < _externalResizeWindows.Length; i++)
			{
				ExternalResizeWindow externalResizeWindow = _externalResizeWindows[i];
				if (externalResizeWindow != null && !externalResizeWindow.IsDestroyed && PresentationSource.FromVisual(externalResizeWindow) is HwndSource { Handle: var handle2 })
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetZorder(handle2, hwndAfter);
					hwndAfter = handle2;
					if (invalidate)
					{
						externalResizeWindow.InvalidateVisual();
					}
				}
			}
		}

	internal class ExternalResizeWindow : Window
	{
		private XamRibbonWindow _owner;

		private Dock _dock;

		private double _cornerExtent;

		private bool _isDestroyed;

		private const double MAX_GRADIENT_EXTENT = 7.0;

		private const double MIDDLE_STOP_OFFSET = 0.4;

		internal Dock Dock => _dock;

		internal bool IsDestroyed => _isDestroyed;

		private bool CanResize
		{
			get
			{
				ResizeMode resizeMode = _owner.ResizeMode;
				if (resizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResize || resizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private IntPtr OwnerHwnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(PresentationSource.FromVisual(_owner) is HwndSource hwndSource))
				{
					return IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				return hwndSource.Handle;
			}
		}

		internal ExternalResizeWindow(XamRibbonWindow owner, Dock dock)
		{
			_owner = owner;
			_dock = dock;
			base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
			base.AllowsTransparency = true;
			base.ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
			base.ShowActivated = false;
			base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			base.WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
			base.WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
			SetBinding(Window.TopmostProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(Window.TopmostProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, _owner));
			base.Template = null;
			switch (_dock)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
			case Dock.Right:
				_cornerExtent = SystemParameters.ResizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight;
				base.Width = SystemParameters.ResizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth;
				break;
			case Dock.Top:
			case Dock.Bottom:
				_cornerExtent = SystemParameters.ResizeFrameVerticalBorderWidth;
				base.Height = SystemParameters.ResizeFrameHorizontalBorderHeight;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = base.RenderSize;
			dc.DrawRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(1, 0, 0, 0)), null, new Rect(renderSize));
			if (!_owner.IsActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect? rect = null;
			Rect? rect2 = null;
			Rect? rect3 = null;
			switch (_dock)
			{
			default:
			{
				double height2 = base.Height;
				double num5 = height2 - 2.0 * _cornerExtent;
				if (num5 < 1.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				double height;
				double num6 = (height = base.Width);
				double num7 = Math.Min(num6, 7.0);
				double x = ((_dock == Dock.Left) ? (num6 - num7) : 0.0);
				rect = new Rect(x, _cornerExtent, num7, num5);
				break;
			}
			case Dock.Top:
			case Dock.Bottom:
			{
				double width = base.Width;
				if (width < 1.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				double height;
				double num = (height = base.Height);
				double num2 = Math.Min(num, 7.0);
				double y = ((_dock == Dock.Top) ? (num - num2) : 0.0);
				double num3 = width - 2.0 * _cornerExtent;
				if (num3 > 0.0)
				{
					rect = new Rect(_cornerExtent, y, num3, num2);
				}
				double num4 = Math.Min(_cornerExtent, 7.0);
				rect2 = new Rect(_cornerExtent - num4, y, num4, num2);
				if (num3 > _cornerExtent)
				{
					rect3 = new Rect(width - _cornerExtent, y, num4, num2);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(96, 0, 0, 0);
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(25, 0, 0, 0);
			System.Windows.Media.Color color3 = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(1, 0, 0, 0);
			if (rect.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color color4;
				System.Windows.Media.Color color5;
				System.Windows.Media.Color color6;
				double offset;
				switch (_dock)
				{
				default:
					color4 = color3;
					color5 = color2;
					color6 = color;
					offset = 0.6;
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
				case Dock.Bottom:
					color4 = color;
					color5 = color2;
					color6 = color3;
					offset = 0.4;
					break;
				}
				double angle;
				switch (_dock)
				{
				default:
					angle = 0.0;
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
				case Dock.Bottom:
					angle = 90.0;
					break;
				}
				GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new GradientStopCollection();
				gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(color4, 0.0));
				gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(color5, offset));
				gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(color6, 1.0));
				LinearGradientBrush brush = new LinearGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection, angle);
				dc.DrawRectangle(brush, null, rect.Value);
			}
			if (rect2.HasValue)
			{
				RadialGradientBrush brush2 = CreateCornerBrush(color, color2, color3, leftCorner: true);
				dc.DrawRectangle(brush2, null, rect2.Value);
			}
			if (rect3.HasValue)
			{
				RadialGradientBrush brush3 = CreateCornerBrush(color, color2, color3, leftCorner: false);
				dc.DrawRectangle(brush3, null, rect3.Value);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSourceInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			HwndSource hwndSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(this) as HwndSource;
			IntPtr intPtr = hwndSource?.Handle ?? IntPtr.Zero;
			if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				IntPtr windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(intPtr, -16);
				IntPtr windowLong2 = NativeWindowMethods.GetWindowLong(intPtr, -20);
				windowLong = NativeWindowMethods.RemoveBits(windowLong, 524288);
				windowLong2 = NativeWindowMethods.AddBits(windowLong2, 2176);
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(intPtr, -16, windowLong);
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowLong(intPtr, -20, windowLong2);
			}
			hwndSource?.AddHook(HookProc);
			base.OnSourceInitialized(e);
		}

		private RadialGradientBrush CreateCornerBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color insideColor, System.Windows.Media.Color middleColor, System.Windows.Media.Color outsideColor, bool leftCorner)
		{
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = new RadialGradientBrush();
			System.Windows.Point point = ((_dock != Dock.Top) ? (leftCorner ? new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0) : new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)) : (leftCorner ? new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0) : new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0)));
			radialGradientBrush.RadiusX = 1.0;
			radialGradientBrush.RadiusY = 1.0;
			radialGradientBrush.Center = point;
			radialGradientBrush.GradientOrigin = point;
			radialGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(insideColor, 0.0));
			radialGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(middleColor, 0.4));
			radialGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(outsideColor, 1.0));
			return radialGradientBrush;
		}

		private IntPtr HookProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			switch (message)
			{
			case 2:
				_isDestroyed = true;
				_owner.OnResizeWindowDestroyed(this);
				break;
			case 33:
				handled = true;
				_owner.Activate();
				return new IntPtr(3);
			case 161:
				if (CanResize)
				{
					handled = true;
					IntPtr ownerHwnd = OwnerHwnd;
					if (ownerHwnd != IntPtr.Zero)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(ownerHwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
					}
				}
				break;
			case 132:
			{
				if (!CanResize)
				{
					return new IntPtr(-1);
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(NativeWindowMethods.GetXFromLParam(lParam), NativeWindowMethods.GetYFromLParam(lParam));
				try
				{
					point = PointFromScreen(point);
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException)
				{
					break;
				}
				int value = _dock switch
				{
					Dock.Right => (!(point.Y <= _cornerExtent)) ? ((!(point.Y >= base.Height - _cornerExtent)) ? 11 : 17) : 14, 
					Dock.Top => (!(point.X <= _cornerExtent)) ? ((!(point.X >= base.Width - _cornerExtent)) ? 12 : 14) : 13, 
					Dock.Bottom => (!(point.X <= _cornerExtent)) ? ((!(point.X >= base.Width - _cornerExtent)) ? 15 : 17) : 16, 
					_ => (!(point.Y <= _cornerExtent)) ? ((!(point.Y >= base.Height - _cornerExtent)) ? 10 : 16) : 13, 
				};
				handled = true;
				return new IntPtr(value);
			}
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}
	}

		{
			private static bool hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown;

			internal static double VirtualScreenHeight
			{
				get
				{
					if (hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown)
					{
						return VirtualScreenHeightFallback;
					}
					try
					{
						return SystemParameters.VirtualScreenHeight;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown = true;
						return VirtualScreenHeightFallback;
					}
				}
			}

			private static double VirtualScreenHeightFallback
			{
				[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
				get
				{
					return ConvertToLogicalPixels(SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Height);
				}
			}

			internal static double VirtualScreenWidth
			{
				get
				{
					if (hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown)
					{
						return VirtualScreenWidthFallback;
					}
					try
					{
						return SystemParameters.VirtualScreenWidth;
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
						hasSecurityExceptionBeenThrown = true;
						return VirtualScreenWidthFallback;
					}
				}
			}

			private static double VirtualScreenWidthFallback
			{
				[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
				get
				{
					return ConvertToLogicalPixels(SystemInformation.VirtualScreen.Width);
				}
			}

			private static double ConvertToLogicalPixels(int pixelValue)
			{
				return Utilities.ConvertToLogicalPixels(pixelValue);
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceOrientation(DependencyObject target, object value)

	public abstract class RibbonToolProxy
	{

		{

			EmbedToolInCaptionArea,
			UseToolForEntireArea
		}

		private static Dictionary<Type, IList<DependencyProperty>> _cloneIgnoredProperties = new Dictionary<Type, IList<DependencyProperty>>();

		private static readonly object ClonePropertiesLock = new object();

		public virtual bool CanAddToQat => true;

		public virtual bool RetainFocusOnPerformAction => true;

		internal RibbonToolProxy()
		{
		}

		public abstract void Bind(FrameworkElement sourceTool, FrameworkElement targetTool);

		internal static void BindTool(FrameworkElement sourceTool, FrameworkElement targetTool)
		{
			((targetTool is IRibbonTool ribbonTool) ? ribbonTool.ToolProxy : null)?.Bind(sourceTool, targetTool);
		}

		internal static void BindToolProperties(DependencyProperty[] properties, FrameworkElement sourceTool, FrameworkElement destinationTool)
		{
			if (sourceTool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sourceTool");
			}
			if (destinationTool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationTool");
			}
			if (properties == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("properties");
			}
			int num = properties.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				DependencyProperty dependencyProperty = properties[i];
				if (dependencyProperty != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
					binding.Source = sourceTool;
					binding.Path = new PropertyPath(dependencyProperty);
					binding.Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay;
					binding.UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged;
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(destinationTool, dependencyProperty, binding);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static IList<object> CloneItems(IList items, bool bindRibbonTools, IList<FrameworkElement> clonedTools)
		{
			IList<object> list = new List<object>();
			ToolCloneManager toolCloneManager = new ToolCloneManager(null, cloneItems: false, skipRoot: false, bindRibbonTools, clonedTools);
			foreach (object item2 in items)
			{
				if (toolCloneManager.ShouldClone(item2))
				{
					object item = toolCloneManager.Clone(item2);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static bool IsActivatableTool(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			return ((tool is IRibbonTool ribbonTool) ? ribbonTool.ToolProxy : null)?.IsActivateable(tool) ?? false;
		}

		internal static void RaiseToolEvent(IRibbonTool tool, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(tool?.ToolProxy)?.RaiseToolEvent(tool as FrameworkElement, e);
		}

		internal static void ReleaseToolClone(FrameworkElement clonedTool)
		{
			FrameworkElement clonedFromTool = XamRibbon.GetClonedFromTool(clonedTool);
			ToolCloneDiscardedEventArgs e = new ToolCloneDiscardedEventArgs(clonedTool, clonedFromTool);
			e.RoutedEvent = MenuToolBase.CloneDiscardedEvent;
			e.Source = clonedFromTool;
			RaiseToolEvent(clonedFromTool as IRibbonTool, e);
			RoutedEventManager.ClearAllEventHandlers(clonedTool);
		}

		internal static DependencyProperty[] GetAllCloneIgnoredProperties(Type proxyType)
		{
			List<DependencyProperty> list = new List<DependencyProperty>();
			lock (ClonePropertiesLock)
			{
				while (proxyType != null)
				{
					if (_cloneIgnoredProperties.TryGetValue(proxyType, out var value) && value != null)
					{
						foreach (DependencyProperty item in value)
						{
							if (list.IndexOf(item) < 0)
							{
								list.Add(item);
							}
						}
					}
					proxyType = proxyType.BaseType;
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			return GetKeyTipProviders(tool, null);
		}

		internal virtual IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(FrameworkElement tool, ToolMenuItem menuItem)
		{
			return new IKeyTip[0];
		}

		internal static FrameworkElement GetRootSourceTool(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			FrameworkElement result = null;
			while (tool != null)
			{
				result = tool;
				tool = XamRibbon.GetClonedFromTool(tool);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void RegisterPropertiesToIgnore(Type proxyType, params DependencyProperty[] properties)
		{
			if (properties != null)
			{
				lock (ClonePropertiesLock)
				{
					_cloneIgnoredProperties[proxyType] = properties;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ToolCloneManager : CloneManager
	{
		private IList<DependencyProperty> _propertiesToSkip;

		private bool _skipRoot;

		private bool _cloneAndBindTools;

		private bool _cloneItems;

		private IList<FrameworkElement> _clonedTools;

		public ToolCloneManager(IList<DependencyProperty> propertiesToSkip, bool cloneItems, bool skipRoot, bool cloneAndBindTools, IList<FrameworkElement> clonedTools)
		{
			_propertiesToSkip = propertiesToSkip;
			_skipRoot = skipRoot;
			_cloneAndBindTools = cloneAndBindTools;
			_clonedTools = clonedTools;
			_cloneItems = cloneItems;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldSkipProperty(MarkupProperty property)
		{
			if (_propertiesToSkip != null && property.DependencyProperty != null)
			{
				return _propertiesToSkip.Contains(property.DependencyProperty);
			}
			return base.ShouldSkipProperty(property);
		}

		protected override object Clone(MarkupObject mo, CloneInfo cloneInfo)
		{
			if (_cloneAndBindTools && mo.Instance is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && (!_skipRoot || mo.Instance != cloneInfo.RootSource))
			{
				if (cloneInfo.TryGetClonedObject(frameworkElement, out var clone))
				{
					return clone;
				}
				FrameworkElement rootSourceTool = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(frameworkElement);
				RibbonToolProxy ribbonToolProxy = ((rootSourceTool is IRibbonTool ribbonTool) ? ribbonTool.ToolProxy : null);
				if (ribbonToolProxy != null)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = ribbonToolProxy.Clone(rootSourceTool);
					cloneInfo.AddClone(mo.Instance, frameworkElement2);
					ribbonToolProxy.Bind(rootSourceTool, frameworkElement2);
					if (_clonedTools != null)
					{
						_clonedTools.Add(frameworkElement2);
					}
					return frameworkElement2;
				}
			}
			return base.Clone(mo, cloneInfo);
		}

		protected override void CloneItems(object clone, MarkupProperty mp, CloneInfo cloneInfo)
		{
			if (!_cloneItems)
			{
				object value = mp.PropertyDescriptor.GetValue(clone);
				IList list = value as IList;
				if (list is ItemCollection && mp.Name == "Items")
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			base.CloneItems(clone, mp, cloneInfo);
		}

		public override bool ShouldClone(object source)
		{
			if (source is HwndHost)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.ShouldClone(source);
		}
	}
	public abstract class RibbonToolProxy<T> : RibbonToolProxy where T : FrameworkElement, IRibbonTool
	{
		private static DependencyProperty[] _baseProperties;

		private static DependencyProperty[] _ignoreDuringCloneProperties;

		private static DependencyProperty[] _menuItemCopyProperties;

		private static DependencyProperty[] _menuItemBindProperties;

		static RibbonToolProxy()
		{
			_baseProperties = new DependencyProperty[14]
			{
				RibbonToolHelper.LargeImageProperty,
				RibbonToolHelper.SmallImageProperty,
				RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty,
				RibbonToolHelper.IsQatCommonToolProperty,
				UIElement.VisibilityProperty,
				UIElement.IsEnabledProperty,
				FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty,
				FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty,
				FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty,
				ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty,
				ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty,
				ToolTipService.InitialShowDelayProperty,
				ToolTipService.BetweenShowDelayProperty,
				ToolTipService.HasDropShadowProperty
			};
			_menuItemCopyProperties = new DependencyProperty[7]
			{
				AutomationProperties.AcceleratorKeyProperty,
				AutomationProperties.AccessKeyProperty,
				AutomationProperties.AutomationIdProperty,
				AutomationProperties.HelpTextProperty,
				AutomationProperties.IsRequiredForFormProperty,
				AutomationProperties.ItemTypeProperty,
				AutomationProperties.NameProperty
			};
			_menuItemBindProperties = new DependencyProperty[6]
			{
				AutomationProperties.ItemStatusProperty,
				ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty,
				ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty,
				ToolTipService.InitialShowDelayProperty,
				ToolTipService.BetweenShowDelayProperty,
				ToolTipService.HasDropShadowProperty
			};
			RibbonToolProxy.RegisterPropertiesToIgnore(typeof(RibbonToolProxy<T>), ValueEditor.IsInEditModeProperty, FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty, FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, Commanding.CommandProperty, Commanding.CommandsProperty);
		}

		public sealed override void Bind(FrameworkElement sourceTool, FrameworkElement targetTool)
		{
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(sourceTool, "sourceTool");
			T toolAsType2 = GetToolAsType(targetTool, "targetTool");
			Bind(toolAsType, toolAsType2);
		}

		protected virtual void Bind(T sourceTool, T targetTool)
		{
			RibbonToolProxy.BindToolProperties(_baseProperties, sourceTool, targetTool);
		}

		public sealed override void ClearToolMenuItem(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (toolMenuItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("toolMenuItem");
			}
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(tool, "tool");
			ClearToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, toolAsType);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearToolMenuItem(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, T tool)
		{
			if (GetMenuItemDisplayMode(tool) == ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.Standard)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(toolMenuItem, HeaderedItemsControl.HeaderProperty);
			}
		}

		public sealed override FrameworkElement Clone(FrameworkElement sourceTool)
		{
			sourceTool = RibbonToolProxy.GetRootSourceTool(sourceTool);
			T sourceT = GetToolAsType(sourceTool, "sourceTool");
			T val = Clone(sourceT);
			bool eventHandlersAttached = RoutedEventManager.CopyAllEventHandlers(sourceT, val, (RoutedEvent routedEvent, RoutedEventHandlerInfo h) => ShouldHookEvent(routedEvent, h, sourceT));
			XamRibbon.SetClonedFromTool(val, sourceT);
			RibbonToolProxy ribbonToolProxy = val?.ToolProxy;
			if (ribbonToolProxy != null)
			{
				ToolClonedEventArgs e = new ToolClonedEventArgs(val, sourceT, eventHandlersAttached);
				e.RoutedEvent = MenuToolBase.ClonedEvent;
				e.Source = sourceT;
				ribbonToolProxy.RaiseToolEvent(sourceTool, e);
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected virtual T Clone(T sourceTool)
		{
			return CloneHelper(sourceTool, GetCloneIgnoredProperties());
		}

		private T CloneHelper(T sourceTool, IList<DependencyProperty> propertiesToSkip)
		{
			object obj = new ToolCloneManager(propertiesToSkip, cloneItems: false, skipRoot: true, cloneAndBindTools: true, null).Clone(sourceTool);
			return (T)obj;
		}

		public sealed override ToolMenuItemDisplayMode GetMenuItemDisplayMode(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(tool, "tool");
			return GetMenuItemDisplayMode(toolAsType);
		}

		protected virtual ToolMenuItemDisplayMode GetMenuItemDisplayMode(T tool)
		{
			return ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.Standard;
		}

		private DependencyProperty[] GetCloneIgnoredProperties()
		{
			DependencyProperty[] array = _ignoreDuringCloneProperties;
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = (_ignoreDuringCloneProperties = RibbonToolProxy.GetAllCloneIgnoredProperties(GetType()));
			}
			return array;
		}

		private T GetToolAsType(FrameworkElement tool, string parameterName)
		{
			if (tool == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(parameterName);
			}
			if (!(tool is T result))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_InvalidParameterType", parameterName, typeof(T)));
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal sealed override IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(FrameworkElement tool, ToolMenuItem menuItem)
		{
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(tool, "tool");
			IKeyTip[] array = GetKeyTipProviders(toolAsType, menuItem);
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = new IKeyTip[0];
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal virtual IKeyTip[] GetKeyTipProviders(T tool, ToolMenuItem menuItem)
		{
			return new IKeyTip[1]
			{
				new ToolKeyTipProvider(tool, menuItem)
			};
		}

		public sealed override bool IsActivateable(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(tool, "tool");
			return IsActivatable(toolAsType);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsActivatable(T tool)
		{
			return tool.IsEnabled;
		}

		public sealed override void OnMenuItemClick(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(tool, "tool");
			OnMenuItemClick(toolAsType);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMenuItemClick(T tool)
		{
		}

		public sealed override bool PerformAction(FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(tool, "tool");
			return PerformAction(toolAsType);
		}

		public virtual bool PerformAction(T tool)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((tool.Focusable && tool.IsVisible) ? tool : ((FrameworkElement)tool.GetValue(MenuToolBase.ToolMenuItemProperty)));
			if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.Focusable && frameworkElement.IsVisible)
			{
				return frameworkElement.Focus();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public sealed override void PrepareToolMenuItem(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, FrameworkElement tool)
		{
			if (toolMenuItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("toolMenuItem");
			}
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(tool, "tool");
			PrepareToolMenuItem(toolMenuItem, toolAsType);
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareToolMenuItem(ToolMenuItem toolMenuItem, T tool)
		{
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem.StaysOpenOnClickProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(MenuToolBase.StaysOpenOnClickProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
			ToolMenuItemDisplayMode menuItemDisplayMode = GetMenuItemDisplayMode(tool);
			if (menuItemDisplayMode == ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.UseToolForEntireArea)
			{
				toolMenuItem.Style = ToolMenuItem.ItemOnlyStyle;
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath("(0).(1)", XamRibbon.RibbonProperty, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
				binding.RelativeSource = RelativeSource.Self;
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, binding);
			}
			else
			{
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(ToolMenuItem.ImageSourceProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonToolHelper.ImageResolvedProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				if (menuItemDisplayMode == ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.EmbedToolInCaptionArea)
				{
					toolMenuItem.Header = tool;
					System.Windows.Data.Binding binding2 = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
					binding2.Path = new PropertyPath("(0).(1)", XamRibbon.RibbonProperty, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
					binding2.RelativeSource = RelativeSource.Self;
					toolMenuItem.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, binding2);
				}
				else
				{
					toolMenuItem.SetBinding(HeaderedItemsControl.HeaderProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(RibbonToolHelper.CaptionProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay, tool));
					toolMenuItem.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
					DependencyProperty[] menuItemCopyProperties = _menuItemCopyProperties;
					foreach (DependencyProperty dp in menuItemCopyProperties)
					{
						toolMenuItem.SetValue(dp, tool.GetValue(dp));
					}
					DependencyProperty[] menuItemBindProperties = _menuItemBindProperties;
					foreach (DependencyProperty dp2 in menuItemBindProperties)
					{
						toolMenuItem.SetBinding(dp2, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(dp2, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
					}
				}
				toolMenuItem.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
				if (!(tool is MenuToolBase))
				{
					toolMenuItem.InputGestureText = MenuToolBase.GetInputGestureText(tool);
				}
			}
			toolMenuItem.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, tool));
		}

		public sealed override void RaiseToolEvent(FrameworkElement sourceTool, RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("args");
			}
			T toolAsType = GetToolAsType(sourceTool, "sourceTool");
			RaiseToolEvent(toolAsType, args);
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseToolEvent(T sourceTool, RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			sourceTool.RaiseEvent(args);
		}

		private bool ShouldHookEvent(RoutedEvent routedEvent, RoutedEventHandlerInfo handlerInfo, T sourceElement)
		{
			return handlerInfo.Handler.Target != sourceElement;
		}
	}
	internal class ToolKeyTipProvider : IKeyTip
	{
		private FrameworkElement _tool;

		private RibbonToolProxy _proxy;

		private ToolMenuItem _menuItem;

		public FrameworkElement Tool => _tool;

		public ToolMenuItem MenuItem => _menuItem;

		protected bool IsOnQat => XamRibbon.GetLocation(_tool) == ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar;

		public virtual KeyTipAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				ToolLocation location = XamRibbon.GetLocation(_tool);
				if (location == ToolLocation.Ribbon && RibbonGroup.GetIsDialogBoxLauncherTool(_tool))
				{
					return KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter;
				}
				return GetToolAlignment(location, RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(_tool));
			}
		}

		public virtual string AutoGeneratePrefix => null;

		public virtual string Caption => RibbonToolHelper.GetCaption(_tool);

		public virtual KeyTipActivationBehavior ActivationBehavior
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_proxy.RetainFocusOnPerformAction)
				{
					return KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers;
				}
				return KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTips;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (_proxy != null && !_proxy.IsActivateable(_tool))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!_tool.IsEnabled)
				{
					if (_menuItem != null)
					{
						return _menuItem.IsEnabled;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_tool.IsVisible)
				{
					if (_menuItem != null)
					{
						return _menuItem.IsVisible;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public virtual string KeyTipValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsOnQat)
				{
					QuickAccessToolbar quickAccessToolbar = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(_tool)?.QuickAccessToolbar;
					if (quickAccessToolbar != null)
					{
						int index = quickAccessToolbar.VisibleIndexOf(_tool);
						return quickAccessToolbar.GetKeyTipAtIndex(index);
					}
				}
				return RibbonToolHelper.GetKeyTip(_tool);
			}
		}

		public virtual System.Windows.Point Location
		{
			get
			{
				if (_menuItem != null)
				{
					if (_proxy != null && _proxy.GetMenuItemDisplayMode(Tool) == RibbonToolProxy.ToolMenuItemDisplayMode.UseToolForEntireArea)
					{
						return GetToolKeyTipLocation(Tool, XamRibbon.GetLocation(Tool), RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal);
					}
					return GetToolKeyTipLocation(_menuItem, XamRibbon.GetLocation(Tool), RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextNormal);
				}
				return GetToolKeyTipLocation(_tool, XamRibbon.GetLocation(_tool), RibbonToolHelper.GetSizingMode(_tool));
			}
		}

		public virtual char Mnemonic => Utilities.GetFirstMnemonicChar(Caption);

		public virtual UIElement AdornedElement => _menuItem ?? _tool;

		public virtual char DefaultPrefix => _tool.GetType().Name[0];

		public virtual bool CanAutoGenerateKeyTip => !IsOnQat;

		internal ToolKeyTipProvider(FrameworkElement tool, ToolMenuItem menuItem)
		{
			if (!(tool is IRibbonTool ribbonTool))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The tool must be an 'IRibbonTool'.");
			}
			_tool = tool;
			_proxy = ribbonTool.ToolProxy;
			_menuItem = menuItem;
			if (_proxy == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(XamRibbon.GetString("LE_IRibbonToolProxyIsNull"));
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _tool.ToString();
		}

		internal static KeyTipAlignment GetToolAlignment(ToolLocation location, RibbonToolSizingMode sizingMode)
		{
			switch (location)
			{
			case ToolLocation.Ribbon:
				if (sizingMode == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge)
				{
					return KeyTipAlignment.MiddleCenter;
				}
				return KeyTipAlignment.MiddleLeft;
			case ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar:
			case ToolLocation.TabItemAreaToolbar:
				return KeyTipAlignment.TopCenter;
			default:
				return KeyTipAlignment.TopLeft;
			}
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Point GetToolKeyTipLocation(FrameworkElement toolElement, ToolLocation location, RibbonToolSizingMode sizingMode)
		{
			double actualHeight = toolElement.ActualHeight;
			double actualWidth = toolElement.ActualWidth;
			double y;
			switch (location)
			{
			default:
				y = actualHeight / 2.0;
				break;
			case ToolLocation.QuickAccessToolbar:
			case ToolLocation.TabItemAreaToolbar:
				y = actualHeight * 2.0 / 3.0;
				break;
			case ToolLocation.Ribbon:
			{
				XamRibbon ribbon = XamRibbon.GetRibbon(toolElement);
				if (ribbon != null)
				{
					int rowNumber = ((sizingMode == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge) ? 2 : ((!RibbonGroup.GetIsDialogBoxLauncherTool(toolElement)) ? ribbon.GetRibbonGroupSmallToolRow(toolElement) : 3));
					y = ribbon.GetRibbonGroupToolVerticalOffset(rowNumber, toolElement);
				}
				else
				{
					y = actualHeight / 2.0;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			double x;
			if (location == ToolLocation.Ribbon && (sizingMode == RibbonToolSizingMode.ImageAndTextLarge || RibbonGroup.GetIsDialogBoxLauncherTool(toolElement)))
			{
				x = actualWidth / 2.0;
			}
			else if (location == ToolLocation.ApplicationMenuFooterToolbar)
			{
				x = actualWidth / 2.0;
			}
			else
			{
				Rect rect = XamRibbon.GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(KeyTipPlacementType.CheckIndicator, toolElement, toolElement);
				if (rect.IsEmpty)
				{
					rect = XamRibbon.GetKeyTipPlacementElementRect(KeyTipPlacementType.SmallImage, toolElement, toolElement);
				}
				if (rect.IsEmpty)
				{
					rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, toolElement.ActualWidth, toolElement.ActualHeight);
				}
				x = (rect.Left + rect.Right) / 2.0;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		public virtual bool Activate()
		{
			if (ActivationBehavior != KeyTipActivationBehavior.DismissKeyTipsAndDeactivateContainers)
			{
				_tool.BringIntoView();
			}
			return _proxy.PerformAction(_tool);
		}

		public virtual bool Equals(IKeyTip provider)
		{
			if (this == provider)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (provider is ToolKeyTipProvider toolKeyTipProvider && toolKeyTipProvider._proxy == _proxy && toolKeyTipProvider._tool == _tool)
			{
				return toolKeyTipProvider._menuItem == _menuItem;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual IKeyTipContainer GetContainer()
		{
			return _tool as IKeyTipContainer;
		}
	}
}
